tei:div.tei:p: bya::ba 'gu/ //shā chi/hā :muḥ//9 'a cu05 000ji 'ang 5055ji cu 7 bci kho migaX 507 khor
— — ༷ 8 shā ci nga raX༅ 4 7pa༄78//cho zuX
/chil987 ༷ sgyu / ’ kyi ji 4 6 40511bam kyi snye/ ci ༄༅/ /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(deb bzhi pa/) sa skya'i dpe ning bsdu sgrig sna lhan nas bsgrigs/krung ge'i bod rig pa dpe skun khang /

sngon 'gro'i gtam/de yang spyir 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi blo gros kyi rtsal las byung ba'i shes rig gi rnam grangs la zad mtha' mi mngon pa zhig yod mod kyang / 'dir skabs bab kyi brjod bya rang cag gangs can pa'i mes po gong ma rnams kyis shul bzhag /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas lnga zhes rlung ltar grags pa las/ rig gnas chung ba lnga ni che ba lnga'i khongs su 'du zhing / de yang 'phral yun gyi phan bde sgrub pa'i thabs lam gnyis su nges pa ste/ bzo dang gso ba rig pa gnyis ni phyi dngos po'i 'byung 'phrod kyi nus pa bsdu len byas te skabs 'phral gyi bde ba tsam sgrub pa'i thabs dang / sgra dang tshad ma gnyis ni brjod bya dang rjod byed la rmongs pa'i ling tog bsal nas/ blang dor gyi mig 'byed de 'phral yun gnyis rka'i bde skyid sgrub thabs dang / nang rig pa ni 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/ lung dang rigs pas gtan la phabs te gnas lugs la nges shes rnyed par bya ba ste/ de ni 'phral bde tsam ma yin par nam zhig gtan gyi bde skyid 'tshol ba'i thabs lam ma nor ba zhig yin/de lta bu'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs chen po de dag la deng sang 'dzam gling shar 1

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/nub kun gyis bod rig pa zhes ming nas 'bod cing / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi lam bur bskyod pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs gtso bor gyur pa'i/ skye bo rnam dpyod can mang po zhig gis nang sems kyi bde skyid sgrub pa'i thabs lam ma nor ba zhig tu shes te/ yid dbang med du 'phrogs nas bkres pa zas dang / sgom pa chu'i dpe ltar sbyang brtson byed bzhin pa ni mthong chos su gyur pa lags/ des na yun ring gi bde skyid 'tshol ba'i gang zag zhig yin phyin chad/ spyir bsam blo'i slob gso dang / nyams myong gi mthong rgya/ khyad par du bod kyi rig gzhung nas bshad pa'i sems bzang dang / spyod bzang la bslab tshul 'di dag bde skyid sgrub pa'i lam phyogs zhig tu rtsa 'dzin byed pa ni/ gtan bde 'tshol ba'i kha phyogs ma nor ba zhig yin pa mngon thub kyi yod/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na rang re'i mes po gong mas dka' ba brgya dang ngal ba stong gis bsgrubs pa'i rin bral gyi shes rig 'di dag /dus rabs kyi 'gyur ba dang bstun te bya thabs gsar gtod kyis/ nyam pa slar gso/ mi nyam gong 'phel gyi sgo nas/ sbyong spyod spel gsum byas te rang gi shes 'jon gyi nus pa mtho ru gtong ba tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam gling gi skye 'gro kun la ya rabs spyod bzang gi legs skyes 'bul thub pa bya rgyu ni/ rang re'i phrag thog tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin/ de lta bu'i bod kyi rig gzhung chen mo de la brgyud srol tha dad pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta che/ po bco brgyad ces grags pa las/ da

sngon 'gro'i gtam/lam 'dir sgrub rgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi ya rgyal du gyur pa che ba bcu gcig ldan pa'i lam 'bras dang / bshad rgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu'i nang gses dpal sa skya pa chen po'i bshad srol te/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub gnyis ldan gyi bka' srol bla na med pa zhig /da sngon bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir gnas pa'i skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyi bgo skal du gyur pa la/ gnas gzhi'i ming chos brgyud la chags te dpal ldan sa skya pa zhes mtshan thogs pa de la/mkhas grub kyi skyes chen gser ri'i phreng ba ltar bar ma chad par byon pa rnams kyi gsung / rim bzhin myur skyobs kyis legs sgrig dang dpe sdur sogs kyis par skrun byas dang byed bzhin pa 'di ni/ thog mar 7sa skya khri 'dzin rin po che dang / mkhan rin po che yon tan bzang po/ mkhan rin po che rgya mtsho sogs kyis slob ston gyi bdag rkyen las byung ba zhig yin zhing / da sngon dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis rgyab skyor 'og /sa skya gong ma rnam lnga'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par sgrun 'grel spel zhus te/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba dang chabs cig /da dung mu mthud de chos brgyud 'dir gtogs kyi dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams gtso bor gyur pa myur skyobs bya ched/ dpal sa skya'i dpe rnying nyams gso khang zhes pa'i las khang zhig ched gnyer byas pa'i spyi khyab gtso 'dzin pa/ lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i mkhan po rta mgrin rdo rje dang / dpe sgrig zhu chen pa/ shes rig dang nyams myong 3

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/gi lang tsho rdzogs pa'i dgen thub bstan smon lam/ las da'i 'gan 'dzin pa/sku zhabs ngag dbang bzang po sogs kyis gnang ba brgyud/ rgyun par las mi lnga drug tsam gyis 'bad brtson byed bzhin yod pa las/da lam 'dir bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas zhib 'jug pa rnams kyi dgos mkho skong ched/ lo rgyus chos 'byung skor gtso bor byas pa'i deb drug dang / grwa sa khag gi slob gnyer gsar bu ba rnams kyi dgos mkho skong ched bsdus blo rtags gsum phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa rnams/ da lam par bskrun zhus te rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba'o/ /'byung char/ rang re'i mes po'i shul bzhag chos rig kun la kha zhe gnyis mtshungs kyi lhag bsam dkar ba'i mkhyen ldan rnams kyis/ phan tshun gzhog 'degs kyi sgo nas las gzhi 'di'i rigs la mthun sbyor gang mang gnang rgyu'i re smon dang bcas/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 2008lo'i zla8tshes3la ga bde legs kyis/4

bsdu sgrig pa'i gtam// cho rigs rin chen lha yi 'phrul las byu nga / /byung 'di rin chen mi lus mdzes pa'i rgya na/ /rgyan mchog rin chen bsgrun pas dben pa'i brgyu da/ /brgyud pa rin chen sha kya'i gdung de rgyal/ /de yang deng dus go la khyon du sna tshogs pa'i shes rig gi tsha rlabs dang 'gran rtsod kyi sno ngar brtas pa'i dus 'dir bzang phyogs nas go chod pa'i dngos rigs sna tshogs thon pa dang / ngan phyogs nas rkyen chung ngus kyang rang gzhan dmigs med kyi gnas su 'phen par byed pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bzo skrun byed pa'i dus skabs 'dir phan tshun brtse sems dang bsam zhig gis 'byor phyug ldan pa'i zhi bde'i 'dzam gling zhig bskrun par/ skye bo mi re ngo re'i lhag bsam dang 'bad rtsol la bsten dgos/ de'ang nga tshos sngar 'das zin pa'i gnas tshul la phyi mig zhig bltas nas da lta skyon yon la blang dor bya dgos pas/ re zhig lo rgyus yig tshang du 'khod pa/ 'dzam gling spyi'i chags 'jigs 'phel 'grib kyi gnas tshul dang yang sgos mi'i rigs kyi byung rim dang 'phel rim/ de'i nang gi rgyal rabs dang / rig gnas/ chos lugs dar tshul sogs la rtogs zhib mdzad de snang tshul dang gnas tshul/ drang bden dang brdzun pa / ya rabs dang ma rabs/ mthun sgril dang ngo lkog rang don dang lhag bsam/1

ba chen 'od snang/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/gzur gnas dang phyogs res/ dgos dbang dang rang 'dod/ yar rgyas dang rjes lus/ shes ldan dang rmongs pa/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug sogs la phan bde zhes pa ngo ma gang dang gang gis 'ong gi yod med kyi blang dor ma nor ba zhig byed par nges par du spyi dang bye brag gi lo rgyus la blta rtog mdzad de snyigs 'dor bcud len bya rgyu ni shin tu nas gal po che yin/ des na cung zad shes yon ldan pa rnams kyis kyang rang kho na yongs grags bya rgyu'i slob rtsom rnams dor nas sngar gyi lo rgyus yig tshang sogs la 'chad spel rgyun bsrings mdzad rgyu dang dpal 'byor dang go thob cung zad ldan pa rnams kyis kyang rgyan po 'gyes pa dang / phan med kyi 'gran rtsod dang / 'chal rgyug bya ba/ shul bzhag gi rig dngos la nyo tshong byed pa sogs dor nas rang re'i ma 'ongs pa'i blo gsar rnams kyis 'dzam gling 'di'i thog nga tsho shar phyogs pa'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang srol rgyun thun min rnams 'dzin skyong dang 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs su bskyod thub pa'i rmang gzhi zhig 'jog par 'bung 'tshal zhes kho bos gsol ba 'debs pa lags so//des na rang ljongs 'dir yang ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs dang / chos 'byung / lo rgyus/ 'bel gtam gyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis pa kun gyi rang rang so so'i khyad chos rtsal 'don la bsams te bltas na rin thang bral ba kho na yin kyang / 'dir nged sa skya'i dpe rnying bsdu sgrig khang 'di'i shes dpal zung gi nus pas ma lcogs pas gnas skabs sdo/ba mtha' bye brag pa zhig gi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan 2

bsdu sgrig pa'i gtam/bcos 'ga' zhig rnam dpyod bkra ba'i rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi spyan sngar phyogs bsdus byas te khyon deb drug bsgrigs pa las/ deb dang po'i nang rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan 6147 1216)gyis mdzad pa'i rgya bod rgyal rabs dang /rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo/ chos rje sa paṇa 61827251)gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo/ 'gro mgon chos 'phags 6234728ge kyis mdzad pa'i bod kyi rgyal rabs/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan63127399)gyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long bcas tshan pa lnga dang /deb gnyis pa'i nang bu ston rin po che rin chen grub 62907364)kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung / deb gsum pa'i nang stag tshang rdzong pa dpal 'byor rgya mtshos ('khrungs 'das gsal po med kyang rnam thar cung zad stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rang rnam du yod pas der gzigs 'a rma pa/)mdzad pa'i rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ deb bzhi pa'i nang mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub 64977557ngor ye waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan rabs bcu pa/)kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung la mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs 66497705ngor mgon pa 'i gdan rab nyer drugapa/)kyis kha skong mdzad pa de dang / deb lnga pa'i nang rtag nag mkhan chen chos rnam 4(5 (rtag nag thub bstan rnam rgyal dgon gyi gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa/)gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung dang / mang thos paṇ+ḍi ta klu sgrub rgya mtshos 652na mas yod bya rgod gzhong kyi gdan rabs lnga pa/)mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis kun btus gnyis/ deb drug pa'i nang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos lkong gsar lnga rig slob gling gi mkhan thog dang po/) mdzad pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs dang / lo rgyus dang rnam thar shin tu mang po ngo mtshar lha/ pad tshal/ dbus gtsang gi gnas

ba chen 'od snang/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/yig gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams la springs yig yang gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams la springs yig /paṇa chen shāka mchog 64287507thub bstan gser mdog can gyi gdan sa gnyis pa/) gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i chos 'byung dang dbu ma'i chos 'byung /des mdza sheg lo chen pos gangs can du bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul mdor tsam du byas pa dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags 65727641dgung lo so dgu la thub bstan yangs pa can gyi mkhan po mdzad/ slar dgung lo re dgu la 'dar grang mo tshe'i gdan sa mdzad/) kyis mdzad pa'i pod chen drug gi 'bel gtam bcas spyan bstar zhus pa 'dis mkhas dbang skya ser kun gyis skabs 'di'i 'brel yod yig cha kun 'byor dka' ba'i ngal ba sel phyir yig rnying lo rgyus sngar bskrun zin pa dang ma zin pa'i phyogs mtshungs rnams legs bsgrigs byas pa'i dpe tshogs 'di bla ldan skyes bu'i phongs sel dam par 'gyur ba'i 'dun pa'ang bcangs bzhin yod la thugs 'dun legs par bskong ba'i grogs su'ang 'gyur nges lags so/ /'dir mdzad pa po'i rnam thar ni yongs grags yin pas ngal ba ma byas te mkhyen 'dod rnams kyis 'brel yod yig cha rnams las rtogs par 'tshal lo//skabs 'di'i legs sgrig gi brgyud rim nang rnam dkar kho nas rogs ram mdzad pa nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'a kyig khang gi rgan rkarma bde legs lags sogs las rogs lhan rgyas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin la/ slad mar phyogs gang spyi'i thad nas rogs ram zhus par thugs rje mi chung bar zhu zhes gso 'as ba'ang 'debs pa lagasarbe1/ / zhes sa skya'i dbe rnying bsdu sgrig khang na thub bstan smon lam gyis/4

dkar chagadam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po'i rtsom 'phro kha skong legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod ces bya ba'i chos 'byung bzhugs so// (1)dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/(2)bsod nams snyed pa'i ched du bstan pa la bya ba bsgrub tshul/ (4)spro ba skyed pa'i ched du bshad sgrub kyi phan yon bstan pa/ (4)'jug ldog bde ba'i ched du bsgrub bya'i chos ngos bzung ba/ (11)blang dor shes pa'i ched du bshad sgrub bya tshul bstan pa/ (30)yid ches skyed phyir bstan 'dzin ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ (83)ston pa sangs rgyas byon tshul/ (83)bstan pa dam chos dar tshul/ (154)de nyid bod du dar tso/ (227)bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs/ (227)bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs/ (249)365 'phro kha skong / mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/(254)1

ba tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)bka' gdams pa/ (277)rdzogs chen pa/ (281)bka' brgyud pa/ (282)dus 'khor byon tshul/ (295)ngam rig pa/ (296)sa skya pa/ (298)zhi byed pa/ (332)dgon gnas dang skyes bu dam pa byon tshul/ (334)de dag gi skabs su bsgyur pa'i 'gyur byang dkar chag (354)brtson 'grus skyed phyir bstan pa'i gnas tshad bshad pa/ (394)bstan pa'i gnas tshad dngos/ (431)bstan pa nub par 'gyur ba'i tshul/ (443)mjug byang / (452)

༄༅/ /dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po'i rtsom 'phro kha skong legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod ces bya ba'i chos 95rgyung bas kyigs/ /༄7/ /oṃ su sti si ji/ dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po'i rtsom 'phro kha skong legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod dang bcas pa/ bla ma rnams dang lhag pa'i lha mchog mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhom med mkha' dbyings dag par rten 'byung las kyi 'byung bzhi la brten pa'i/ /gdul bya snod bcud gnyen por gang 'dul phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par spro/ /tshogs gnyisamathar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas dang des gsungs dam chos bstan 'dzin tshogs//yid bzhin nor 'dra'i mchog gsum rin chen sgo gsum dang bas kun nas mchod/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo/ /dge legs 'byung gnasathub bstan rin po che/ /bstan 'dzin ded dpon rnams kyi bka' drin las/ /phan bde'i snang bas phyogs kun khyab par gyur/ /de lta'i ngo mtshar rnam dpyod ni / / mthong bas 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs 1

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)che / / 'di nyid kho na blang bya'i mchog /'di 'chad pa la gnyis te/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub ces snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na gsal ba de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul gyi bstan bcos dngos bkod pa dang/ de'i rtsom 'phro kha bskang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di lta ste// dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i sdo/ chen ces bya ba bzhugs sku / // yo su sti si ji/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal 31/ /phun tshogs dge legs chu gter che las legs 'brungs shing / /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re 'dod ma lus yid bzhin skong / /lhar bcas skye rgu kun gyi gtsug na lham me ba/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpal ldan bla ma rgyal gyur cig /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis nam mkha' rab yangs par/ /chos kun gzigs pa'i mkhyen rab chu 'dzin rgyas pa las/ /'gro blo'i sa gzhir dam chos char chen 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra sgrogs dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /des gsungs gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /legs par babs pas sems kyi tha ba spyod (bcos ༄ dzad cing //phyogs kun khyab pa'i phan bde'i myu gu skyed mkhas pa'i/ /legs gsung dam chos gru char rgyas pa de la 'dud/ /de las byung ba'i lung rtogs bcud kyis 2

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/lus rgyas shing / /legs bshad gtam gyi sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i mgrin snyan can/ /thub bstan chu gter kun nas mdzes pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /tshogasamachog dge 'dun dang ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas dam chos rin po che/ /'thor ba bsdus dang dri ma sel ba dang / /yi ger bkod nas 'gro la gsal mdzad pa'i/ /sdud mdzad 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub 'phag bas pa lha/ /thogs med zhabs dang de gcung dbyig gi gnyen/ /phyogs kyi glang po chos kyi grags pa sogs/ /'jam gling mdzes byed paṇa grub kun la 'dud/ /byang sems sprul pa shān+ta rak+ṣi ta / / pad+ma 'byung gnas pad+ma'i ngang tshul sogs/ /'phags pa'i yul nas gangs can 'dir byon pa'i/ /lnga rig paṇa chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyur byed dam pa thon mi sa sto ṭa/ /sad mi mi bdun ka cog zhang gsum dang / /rin chen bzang po 'brog dang mar 'gos sogs/ /sprul pa'i lo tsā rnams la gus phyag 'chal/ /rgyal ba kun dngos mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzugs/ /mtha' yas gdul bya'i yid kyi me long dang / /mtsham par shar nas ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i cha/ /ston mkhas phyag 'os kun la gus btud nas/ /thub dbang yon tan rgya mtsho las 'ongs pa'i/ /dam chos yid bzhin nor bu'i dga' ston gyis/ /skal bzang skye rgu phan bder mdzad pa'i tshul/ /mdo tsam 'chad la bdag blo gus pa skyes/ /'dir bdag cag gi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyi rjes su slob la rjes su bsgrub cing rjes su bgyid par 3

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)'dod pa'i skyes bu blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas dam pa kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'di nyid yin par khong du chud par byas nas/ de nyid bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor bzhugs su gsol te/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir yun ring du gnas pa'i thabs la nyin dang mtshan du 'bad par bya bar rigs pa yin no/ /'di la gsum/ bsod nams skyed pa'i ched du bstan pa la bya ba bsgrub pa'i tshul/ yid ches skyed pa'i ched du bstan pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ brtson 'grus skyed pa'i ched du bstan pa'i gnas tshad bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ spro ba skyed pa'i ched du bshad sgrub kyi phan yon bstan pa/ 'jug ldog bde ba'i ched du bsgrub bya'i chos ngos bzung / blang dor shes pa'i ched du bshad sgrub bya tshul bstan pa'o/ /dang po la / lung gi chos la thos bsam byas pa'i phan yon/ rtogs pa'i chos la sgrub pa byas pa'i phan yon/ thos bsam sgom gsum spel mar byas pa'i phan yon/ de'i dang po la/ spyir thos bsam gyi phan yon/ khyad par nyan bshad kyi phan yon/sgos theg chen gyi chos bshad kyi phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur/ /thos pas don med spong bar 'gyur/ /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni rkang pa bzhi'i go rim bzhin du/phyi nang gi grub mtha' shes pas blang dor gyi gnas shes pa dang / tshul khrims kyi bslab pa thob nas nyes spyod las bzlog pa dang / sems kyi bslab pa thob nas 4

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/don med pa'i 'dod pa yongs su spang ba dang / shes rab kyi bslab pa thob nas zag zad mngon du byas pa'i myang 'das thob pa ste bzhi la rnam bshad rigs pa las bshad do/ /lung rnam 'byed las kyang / mang du thos pa la phan yon lnga yod de / phung po la mkhas pa dang / khams la mkhas pa dang / skye mched la mkhas pa dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang / de'i gdam ngag dang rjes su bstan pa gzhan la rag ma las pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ skyes rabasalas/ thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /rkun po sogs kyis mi 'byer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmonges pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pa'i grogs kyi mchog /phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin/ /gnod pa med pa'i mya ngan nad kyi sman/ /nyes pa chen po'i dgra 'jomasadapung gi mchog /grags dang dpal dang gter gyi mchog kyang yin/ /ya rabasarnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog/tshogs kyi nang du mkhas pa dga' bar 'gyur//phas kyi rgol bar nyi ma'i 'od dang 'dra/ /'gran pa rnams kyi grags dang dregasapa sel/ /che ba / pa nas/dul zhid rab tu gsal ba'i spobs pa skye/ /grags pa chen po 'phral du 'byung bar byed/ /smra lce bde 'gyur khyad par can gyi rgyu/ /thosapa'i dpal goms don gsal rtogs par 'gyur/ /thos dang ldan na 'gal ba med pa yin//snga gsum lam la rab tu gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bas na blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis mang du thos pa tshol ba la sogasapa'i sgo nas rang gi rgyud yon tan gyi chos kyis phyug pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o//de ltar yang skyes rabs las/yon tan yod na rgyal po'i go 'phang dang / /5

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ 9)skye rgu mngon par 'du ba'ang thob par 'gyur/ /lha dbang dpal yang yon tan la ltos te/ /yon tan yod na pha rol mgu bar 'gyur/ /grags pa rnams kyang yon tan nyid las 'phro/ /bdag nyid che ba'ang yon tan ldan las 'gyur/ /zla 'od las kyang gsal ba'i yon tan gyis//dgra bo mi bzad dregs shing sdang ba dang //'khon rnying yod cing phrag dog che ba yang / /yid ni rab tu dwangs shing mgu byed do / / zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa khyad par nyan bshad kyi phan yon la/ gusapas nyan pa'i phan yon/ legs par bshad pa'i phan yon/ 'dzin pa'i phan yon dang gsum las/ nyan pa'i phan yon ni/ rnam bshad rigs par/ dad pas nyan pa gang gis ni/ /mtho ris dga' ba'i bsod nams dang / /gang gis mya ngan 'das thob pa'i/ khres rab sa bon brtas par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos nyan pa la phan yon lnga gsungs te/ ma thos pa thos par 'gyur ba dang / thos pa yongs su byang bar 'gyur ba dang/ som nyi spong ba dang / lta ba drang por byed pa dang / shes rab kyi tshig dang don zab mo rtogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ dang po gnyis kyis thos pa'i shes rab dang / bar pa gnyis kyis bsam pa'i shes rab dang / tha mas sgom pa'i shes rab yongs su dag pa'i rgyur 'gyur bar bstan to/ /bshad pa'i phan yon la / sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba/ sems can la sbyin pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba/ bsod nams 'phel zhing mngon shes thob par 'gyur ba lta dang bsum las/ mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba ni mdo las/ gang la phan phyir nga yi chos/ /tshul bzhin bstan pas mchod 'gyur gyi/ /me tog byug pa mar 6

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhunas/me yis/ /rgyal ba yang dag mchod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sbyin pa 'i mchog tu 'gyur ba ni/ byams pa seng ge sgra'i mdo las/ gang gis gaṅgā'i ji snyed sangs rgyas zhing / /rin chen bdun gyis yongs su bkang byas nas/ /rab dga'i sems kyis rgyal la 'bul ba dang / /gang gis sems can gcig la tshags bcad byin/ /rin chen sbyin pa shin tu rgya che des/ /tshigs bcad sbyin pa snying rjes sgrub de la/ /char yang mi phod grangs su'ang ma yin na/ /gnyis dang gsum la bsam du ga la yod/ /ces dang / gaṅgā'i ji snyed rin chen gser dag gis/ /bkangs te gang la sbyin pa byin pa bas/ /tshig bzhi'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig brjod pa/ /de yi phan yon de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bsod nams 'phel zhing mngon shes thob pa ni/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba'i mdo las/ byams pa/ gang rnyed pa dang bkur sti mi 'dod par chos kyi sbyin pa byin na/ chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing med pa'i phan yon nyi shu ste/ nyi shu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ dran pa dang ldan pa yin/ blo dang ldan pa yin/ blo gros dang ldan pa yin/ mos pa dang ldan pa yin/ shes rab dang ldan pa yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab rjes su rtogs par 'gyur ba yin/ 'dod chags chung ba yin/ zhe sdang chung ba yin/ gti mug chung ba yin/ bdud kyis de la glags mi rnyed pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis de la dgongs pa yin/mi ma yin pa rnams kyis de la bsrung ba yin/ lha rnams kyis de'i lus la mdangs 'jug pa yin/ mi mdza' ba rnams kyis de la glags mi rnyed pa yin/de mdza' bo rnams dang mi phyed pa yin/ tshig gzung bar 'os pa yin/ mi 7

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/9)'jigs pa thob pa yin/yid bde ba mang ba yin/mkhas pas bsngags pa yin/de chos kyi sbyin pa de rjes su dran par 'gyur ba yin te/byams pa/phan yon nyi shu po de dag go/zhes dang /bslab ba lhas las/chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing med//bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin no//zhes gsungs shing /seng ges zhus pa las/chos kyi sbyin pas skye ba dran//zhes dang /klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa las/chos kyi sbyin pas ni zag pa zad pa'i mngon par shes pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs so//'dzin pa'i phan yon ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bstan pa las/dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams ni//sangs rgyas kun gyis nan tan du//bskal pa bye bar brjod mdzad kyang //mthar ma phyin par 'gyur ba lags//zhes dang /blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa//rgyal ba rnams kyis yongs su gzung bar 'gyur//lha dang klu dang mi'am ci rnams dang //bsod nams ye shes rnams kyis yongs su bzung //de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa//dran dang blo gros ldan zhing blo ldan 'gyur/shes rab rgya chen kun nas ye shes ldan//mkhas pa bag chags bcas pas nyon mongs spangs//zhes pa nas/de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa//brgya byin tshangs pa de bzhin 'jig rten skyong //'khor los bsgyur dang mi yi rgyal por 'gyur//bde dang yid bde'i byang chub de 'tshang rgya//zhes bya ba la sogs pa mang du gsungs so//gsum pa sgos theg chen gyi chos nyan bshad kyi phan yon la / gzhi dus su theg dman gyi dge ba zil gyis gnon pa/lam dus su sgrib 8

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'as na pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/pa ma lus pa spong ba/ 'bras dus su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ yum las/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khamasakyi sems can de dag thams cad nyid dgra bcom pa thob par 'gyur la/ dgra bcom pa de dag gis sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang /tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / bsgom pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gang yin pa de la/ kun dga' bo 'di ji snyam du sems/ bsod nams kyi phung po de mang ba yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mang lags so/ /bka' stsal pa / kun dga' bo/ de bas kyang su zhig la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos tha na nyi ma gcig bstan na/ de'i bsod nams kyi phung po ches mang du skye'o/ /zhes pa nas/ kun dga' bo 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de'i chos kyi sbyin pa ste/ nyan thos kyi theg pa thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lam dus su sgrib pa ma lus pa spong ba ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir sbyin pas longs spyod dag ni sgrub byed la/ khrims kyis mtho ris bsgoms pas nyon mongs spong byed la/ shes rab nyon mongs shes bya kun spong de yi phyir/ /'di mchog de nyid de yi rgyu ni 'di thos yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'bras dus su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ gang zhig tshig gi don bsgoms nas/ /tshigs bcad gnyis 'dzin rab spyor ba/ /sems can blo 9

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)ldan mchog de yis/ /yon tan rnam bcu 'thob 'gyur te/ khams ni zad par brtas pa dang / /'chi ba'i tshe na rab dga' thob/ /ji ltar 'dod par skye ba dang / /kun tu tshe rabs dran pa dang / /sangs rgyas rnams dang phrad pa dang / /de la theg mchog thos pa dang / /mos pa blo dang ldan pa dang / /sgo gnyis byang chub myur thob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bas na 'chad pa dang nyan pa la sogasapa'i sgo nas dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ /rtogs pa'i chos la sgrub pa byas pa'i phan yon ni/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gzhen nu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nang du yang dag 'jog la mngon par brtson pa'i phan yon ni 'di bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sems rnyogs pa med pa dang / bag yod par gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang /spyod pa la dad pa dang / ye shes la rnem nur med pa dang / sangs rgyas la byas pa gzo ba dang / chos mi spong ba dang / shin tu bsdams par gnas pa dang /dul ba'i rjes su 'thob pa dang / so sor yang dag par rig pa bzhi mngon sum du byed pa ste/ gzhon nu/ bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nang du yang dag 'jog la mngon par brtson pa'i phan yon no/ /zhes sogs nas/ byang chub sems dang 'a de ni shi 'phos nas/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams su 'gro/ /tshe dpag med las chos bzang mchog thob nas/ /skye ba med pa'i chos la bzod pa thob/ /ces gsungs so/ /thos bsam sgom gsum spel mar byas pa'i phan yon ni/ rgyan las/ 'di na dang po thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa las 10

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bsnyegs/kyang yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / /de las chos thob de yod de las blo gros rab tu skye/ /gang tshe de ni so sor rang gir med na ji ltar nges/ /zhes pa dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang/ shes rab rgyas byed pa ni thos pa ste/ /de dang bsam pa gnyis ni yod gyur na/ /de las sgom pa la ni rab tu spyor/ /des ni dngos grub bla na med pa 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 'jug ldog bde ba'i ched du bsgrub bya'i chos ngos gzung ba la/ chos kyi sgra 'jug pa'i yul gyi dbye ba/ de dag gi sgra don zhib tu bshad pa / skabs su babs pa'i chos ngos gzung ba'o/ /dang po ni rnam bshad rigs pa las/ chos ni shes bya lam dang ni/ /mya ngan 'das dang yid kyi yul/ /bsod nams tshe dang gsung rab dang / /'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o/ /zhes chos kyi sgra yul bcu la 'jug par gsungs te/ chos gang 'dus byas sam/'dus ma byas zhes pa lta bu shes bya dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba ni chos yin no zhes pa lta bu lam dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos zhes pa lta bu myang 'das dang / chos kyi skye mched ces pa lta bu yid kyi yul dang / gzhon nu rnams dang lhan cig chos spyod ces pa lta bu bsod nams dang / mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas zhes pa lta bu tshe dang / chos zhes bya ba ni mdo sde dang zhes pa lta bu gsung rab dang / lus 'di rgas pa'i chos yin no zhes pa lta bu 'gyung 'gyur dang / dge slong gi chos bzhi zhes pa lta bu nges pa dang / yul chosarigs chos zhes pa lta bu chos lugs rnams la 'jug go /de dag gi sgra don zhib tu bshad pa ni chos kyi skad dod dharma zhes pa yin la/ de'i byings ni/ khyo da //

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)ra ṇi zhes pa 'dzin pas na chos zhes bya ba la/ de la'ang shes bya ni mtshan nyid 'dzin pas chos te/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid gzugs rung 'dzin pa nas/ rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid chos thams cad mngon sum du byed pa'i bar rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin pa dang / 'dus byas mi rtag zag bcas sdug bsngal/ chos bdag med/ myang 'das zhi ba zhes pa spyi'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pas dang / lam dang myang 'das dang bsod nams gsum lhung ba las 'dzin pas dang / yid kyi yul ni rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i yid 'dzin pas dang / tshe ni lus 'dzin pa'am ris mthun 'dzin pas dang / gsung rab ni don dang don phyin ci ma log par 'dzin pas dang / 'byung 'gyur dang nges pa ni bya ba byed pa 'dzin pas dang /chos lugs ni yul dang rigs kyi spyod pa 'dzin pas chos zhes bya'o/ /skabs su bab pa'i chos ngos gzung ba ni/ bsod namasadang / lam dang / myang 'dasagasum brjod byar byas shing / gsung rab rjod byed du byed pa ste/ de la mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba dang gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni/ gang la dmigs na lus can rnams kyi sgrib pa zad cing yon tan bskyed pa'i thabs su gyur pa ste/ji skad du/ sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang / /sgrib pa kun sel dam pa'i chos/ /zhes so/ /sgra don ni/ sar dharma zhes pa dam pa'i chos te/ dam pa sangasargyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos yin pas sam/ dam pa yang yin la chos kyang yin pas sam/skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis spyad par bya ba yin pas dam pa'i chos so//dbye ba la gsum/ brjod bya rjod byed kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang / rgyu 'bras mchog dman gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la dbye na/ brjod bya rtogs pa'i 12

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/chos dang / rjod byed lung gi chos gnyis te mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chog rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes so/ /rtogs pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ lung gi chos kyi brjod byar gyur pa'i zag med de/ de la dbye ba gang zhig 'dod chags dang bral ba 'gog bden dang / gang gis 'dod chags dang bral ba lam bden dang rtan/ rgyud bla las/ gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba / / bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos//chags bral nyid ni 'gog pa dang //lam gyi bden pa dag gis bsdus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lung gi chos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rtogs pa'i chos la 'jug pa'i rjod byed de/ de la dbye na spros pa las byung ba'i bag chags dang / rgyu mthun las byung ba'i mngon brjod do/ /dang po ni/rta dang glang po la sogs pa'i gtam sna tshogs te/ 'khor ba dang chos mthun pa 'jig rten pa'i mngon brjod ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis te/ de yang chos nyid rtogs par byed pa'i rgyu mthun nam/ chos dbyings rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun las byung bas de skad ces bya ba ste/ dbus mtha' las rgyu mthun don gyi mchog nyid dang / /zhes gsungs so/ /de dag myang 'das dang chos mthun pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mngon brjod ces bya ste/ myang 'das kyi mdo las/ chu bo chen po bzhi rgya mtshor babs 'bab gzhol ba de bzhin du/chos thams cad mya ngan las 'das par babs 'bab gzhol lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyu 'bras mchog dman gyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ 'bras bu'i chos/bsgrub pa'i chos/ bshad pa'i chos dang gsum las/ 'bras bu'i chos ni 'gog pa ste/ sdug bsngal bdun zhi ba'i myang 'das so/ /sdug bsngal bdun ni/ skye ba/13

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (()rga ba/ na ba/ 'chi ba/ phrad pa/ bral pa/ 'dod pa ma rnyed pa/ phung po'i sdug bsngal rnams te de dag zhi ba'o/ /bsgrub pa'i chos ni lam ste/ 'bras bu'i chosade thob par byed pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /bshad pa'i chos ni lam gyi chos gsal bar byed pa ste/ dbye na bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis so/ /de yang mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus/ /legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel te/ /de yi dbang gisashākya'i bstan pa 'di/ /'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i dang po bka' la/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba dang gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni/ brjod bya don dang ldan pa/ rjod byed chos dang 'brel ba/ byed las khams gsum gyi nyon mongs spong ba/ 'bras bu zhi ba'i phan yon ston pa'i rjod byed bdag rkyen gyi gtso bo sangs rgyas las byung ba ste/rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsung / /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang / /de ni drang srong gsung yin bzlog pa gzhan/ /zhes so/ /sgra don ni/ su bha ṣi ta zhes pa legs par gsungs pas na bka'o/ /dbye ba la dus kyi/ brjod bya'i/ rjod byed kyi/ gnyen po'i/ gdul bya'i/ bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye ba ste drug go /dang po la/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i/ tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ste gsum mo/ /de'i dang po la/ rtsa ba'i lung so so thar pa/ bshad pa'i lung la lung gzhi/ lung rnam 'byed/ lung phran tsheg gzhung bla ma la sogs pa'o/ /bar pa ni/14

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul ba na pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/yum rgyas pa stong phrag brgya pa/ 'bring gi rgyas pa nyi khri lnga stong pa/ 'bring gi 'bring khri brgyad stong pa/ 'bring gi bsdus pa shes rab khri pa/ bsdus pa'i rgyasapa brgyad stong pa/ bsdus pa'i bsdus pa mdo bsdud pa la sogs pa mngon par rtogs pa'i don ston pa'i mdo dang / shes rab snying po la sogs pa zab mo'i don ston pa rnams so/ /tha ma ni/ sangs rgyas phal po che/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo/ lang kur gshegs pa/ dpal phreng seng ge sgra/ myang 'dasache chung la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa brjod bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ bden pa gnyis sam drang nges gnyis te rtsa ba shes rab las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chosabastan pa/ /bden pa gnyis la yang dag bstan/ /che'i gagasung bang pas/ kun rdzob bden pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa drang don dang don dam bden pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa nges pa'i don te/ blo gros mi zad pa bstan pa las/kun rdzob bsgrub pa ston pa ni drang ba'i don to/ /don dam bsgrub pa ston pa ni nges pa'i don to/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa rjod byed kyi sgo nas dbye na/gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis te/ snying po mchog las/ mdo sde dbyangasabasnyad lung bstan dang / /tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang / /skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang / /med byung gtan la dbab pa'i sde/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ mdo sde ni tshig don bsdus te lhug par gsungs pa/ dbyangs bsnyad ni mdo sde de nyid la dbus dang mtha' mar tshigs bcad kyis bsnyad pa/ lung bstan ni nyan thosadang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa lung bstan pa/ tshigs bcad ni/15

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)tshigs bcad du sdebs nas gsungs pa/ ched brjod ni zhu ba la ma ltos par bstan pa gnas pa'i ched du gsungs pa/ gleng gzhi ni gzhi gang la brten nas bslab pa bcas pa/ rtogs brjod ni don go bar bya ba'i phyir dpe dang bcas nas ston pa/ de lta bu byung ba ni sngon byung ba'i gtam brjod pa/ skyes rabs ni bcom ldan 'das kyi sngon gyi skyes rabs ston pa/ shin tu rgyas pa ni zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don ston pa/ med du byung ba ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos rnams kyi ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan brjod pa/ gtan la dbab pa ni chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'o/ /bzhi pa gnyen po'i sgo nas dbye ba ni sde snod gsum ste/ 'di la yan lag bcu gnyis sde sdod gsum du bsdu ba/ sde snod kyi sgra don/ gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs bcad ched brjod de lnga ni nyan thos kyi mdo sde/ gleng gzhi dang rtogs brjod dang de lta bu byung ba nyan thos kyi 'dul ba/skyes rabs ni byang sems kyi 'dul ba/ shin tu rgyas pa dang / med du byung ba'i sde ni byang sems kyi mdo sde/ gtan la dbab pa'i sde ni gnyis ga'i chos mngon pa'i sde snod yin no/ /sgra don la gnyis las/ spyi'i sgra don ni sde snod kyi skad dod la bi ṭa ka zhes 'byung la/ de nyid yul dbus kyi bre bo che'i ming yang yin pas bre bo che'i nang du bre'u chung mang po 'dus pa ltar 'di rnams kyi nang du brjod bya bslab pa mang po 'dus pas sde snod dam/ yang paṇ+ḍita zhes bsgyur na gong bu'i bsdus pa ste don mang po brjod byar bsdus pas sde snod do/ /so so'i sgra don la mdo sde'i skad dod su tra zhes pa mgo smos pa ste gang du gsungs pa'i gnas 16

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung chul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/dang / bden pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid dang / phung po la sogs pa'i chos dang / de rnams kyi dgongs pa'i don smos pa'i tshul gyis gsal bar ston pa'i phyir te/rgyan las/ gnas rnams dang ni mtshan nyid dang / /chos don smos phyir mdo yin rno / / zhes gsungs so/ /mngon pa'i skad dod la a bhi ste/ a bhi mu khya zhes pa mngon du phyogs pa ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i chos rnams ston pa dang / a bhi k+ṣa na zhes pa yang yang ste chos re'ang rnam pa mang pos yang yang ston pa dang / a bhi bhu zhes pa zil gnon te smra ba rnam par nges pa la mkhas pa'i phyir rgol ba zil gyis gnon pa dang / a bhi sa ma ya zhes pa rtogs pa ste shes bya ji snyed pa'i mdo sde'i don rnams rtogs par byed pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ mngon du'i phyir dang yang yang dang / /zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dul ba'i skad dod bhi na ya ste/ bi sa sti zhes pa rnam par lhung ba ste/ lhung ba sde lnga dang / de rnams byung ba'i rgyu dang / de dag las ldang ba'i tshul te bzhi dang / gang zag dang bslab pa bcas pa dang de'i dbye ba dang / bi ni: ya zhes pas rnam par nges pa rnams kyang ston pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ lhung dang 'byung dang ldang ba dang / /nges par 'byung dang gang zag dang / /bcas pa dang ni rab dbye dang / /rnam par nges phyir 'dul ba nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes gsungasate / 'dod chags la spyod pa'i gnyen por tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa 'dul ba/ zhe sdang la spyod pa'i gnyen por ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa 17

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ 9)gtso bor ston pa mdo sde/ gti mug la spyod pa'i gnyen por shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa mngon pa'i sde snod gsungs so/ /'o na gsang sngags kyi theg pa sde snod gsum gang du 'du zhe na/ slob dpon a ṣ+ṭha ka ra ni bslab pa gsum ka ston pas sde snod gsum na'o/ /zhes bzhed la/ slob dpon shārnyi pas/ zab mo'i don bsdus te ston pas mdo sde yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / slob dpon ār+ya de bas rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod bzhi par bshad do/ /lnga pa gdul bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ gnyis tshan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyan las gnyis kyang rung zhes gsungs pa ste/ gdul bya dman pa la mos pa la nyan thos kyi sde snod dang /rgya chen po la mos pa la theg pa chen po'i sde snod gsungs so/ /de gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ mdo sde la sogs pa chos rgya chen po la dmigs pa che ba/ rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis bsgrubs pas sgrub pa che ba/ rtogs pa'i dus na bdag med gnyis shes pas ye shes che ba/ grangs med gsum du gus par byas te sbyor ba brtson 'grus brtsams pas brtson 'grus che ba/ 'khor ba mi btang zhing kun nas nyon mongs pas mi gos pas thabs mkhas pa che ba ste rgyu'i khyad par lnga dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa la rbe1gas pa 'grub pa bang yang dag grub pa che ba dang / yang dang yang du byang chub pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi phrin las chen po ste 'bras bu'i khyad par gnyis dang bcas pa'i/ khyad par bdun ldan gyis theg pa chen po khyad par du 'phags te/ mdo sde rgyan las/dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni//de bzhin bsgrub pa gnyis dag dang / /ye shes brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang / /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang / /8

dam — 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/yang dag grwab pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po 'di dag dang jon pas/ /theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gdul bya dbang po rtul po rgyu la mos pa'i dbang du byas nas rgyu lam du byed pa mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / dbang po rnon po rgyu 'bras lhun grub la mos pa'i dbang du byas nas 'bras bu lam du byed pa sngags kyi theg pa gsungs pa yin te/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/ 'jam dpal gyis/ 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum po dag /bcom ldan nges par gsungs lags na/ /rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing / /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i/ /nges pa'i theg pa cis ma gsungs/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'bor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdo sngags kyi khyad pa ra ni/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang //thabasamang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ chos(rgyal 'phags pas/byang chub sems dang stong nyid dang / /snying rje nyid ni lam gyi gzhir/ /dgos pa'i phyir na don gcig pa/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma las/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par blangs/ /de tshe dbang gi ye shes kyis/ /lta ba dug med rtogs pas na/ /gzhi dang lta ba rtogs pa'i thabs /ma rmongs pa zhes bya ba ste/ /'di ni khyad par dang po yin/ /rgya chen bskyed pa'i rim pa yis/ /lus dang skye ba sbyor ba dang / /sangs rgyas zhing rnams dag pa 19

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)dang / /sems can yongs su smin par byed/ /zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa yis//sems dang 'chi ba sbyong ba dang / /nang gi sa dang lam bgrod nas/ /ting 'dzin ye shes mngon du byed/ /gzhan yang zhi rgyas dbang dang ni/ /mngon spyod la sogs thabs mang pos/ /tshe ring ba dang nad med dang / mas rab rnam par spel ba yis/ /lam gyi yan lag rdzogs byed pas/ /thabs mang ba zhes brjod pa yin/ /ji ltar sngags kyis byin rlabs pas/ /dug kyang bdud rtsir 'gyur ba dang / /thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis/ /nyon mongs rnams dang 'dod yon kun/ /yang dag lam du yongs bsgyur nas//bde ba kun la longs spyod pa//dka' ba med pa'i khyad par yin/ /sngags dang sman dang ting 'dzin gyis/ /tshe yi dngos grub bsgrub nas ni/ /rig 'dzin che dang lus bzang po/ /tshogs gnyis myur du zlums byas nas/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob byed pas/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas zhes/ /myur du 'grub pa'i khyad par yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /drug pa bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye na/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i/byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' gsum gyi dang po ni/'phags pa sdud pa lta bu/ gnyis pa la sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gsum du brgyad stong 'grel par gsungs pa ltar na/ skus byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyabs rnams kyis phyag g.yas pa byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po'i spyi bor bzhag pas/ des sa bcu pa gsungs pa lta bu/gsung gis byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ brgyad stong pa las/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis pha rol tu phyin pa las brtsams te ji ltar byang chub 20

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i sru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/sems dpa' rnams nges par 'byung bar gyur ba de ltar khyod spobs pa skyed cigaces gsungs pas de la sher phyin ston pa'i spobs pa byung ba lta bu/ thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis/ thugs thugs rjes/thugs bden pa'i stobs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gsum las/ dang po ni/bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas shā ri'i bu 'dri ba po dang / spyan ras gzigs lan 'debs pa por byin gyis brlabs nas shes rab snying po gsungs pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i sngags sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis nam mkha' dang / 'od zer dang / rol mo la sogs pa las chos kyi sgra byung 0lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po las chos bsdu ba'i tshe/ thog mar 'di skad bdag gis thos pa la sogs pa'i gleng slong / bar du mtshams sbyor gyi tshig chugs/ mtha' mar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do zhes bya ba chugs shig ces rjes su gnang ba lta bu'o/ // gnyis pa bstan bcog la/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ rtsom pa po rnam g.yeng med pa'i yid can gyis bka'i don bshad cing thar pa thob pa'i lem dang rjes su mthun pa ste/ rgyud blar/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gis/ /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blangs/ /zhes gsuX so/ /sgra don ni/ bstan bcos kyi skad

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)dod shāsta ste sha sa na zhes pa'i 'chos pa ste/ rgyu nyon mongs pa dug gsum las bslab pa gsum ldan du 'chos pa dang / tru yi zhes pa'am ta ra ṇa zhes pa ni skyob pa ste/ 'bras bu ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal las skyob pas na bstan bcos te/ nges tshig 'di bka' la'ang yod do/ /de ltar rnam bshad rigs pa las/ nyen mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang / /ngan 'gro srid las skyob pa gang yin pa/ /'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos te/ /gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med/ /de lta bas na sangs rgyas kyi gsung kho na don dam par bstan bcos yin pas/ 'chos pa la skyob pa'i yon tan gyi phyir yang don bzung ba la 'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dbye ba la bshad bya bka'i sgo nas/ brjod bya don gyi sgo nas/ byed pa las kyi sgo nas/'jug ldog mchog dman gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang bzhi las/ dang po la bka' spyi'i dgongs 'grel dang / bye brag gi dgongs 'grel gnyis/ de'i dang po la/tshig don gyi 'gal 'brel gcod pa'i bstan bcos dang / gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i bstan bcos gnyis kyi dang po la/ tshig gi 'gal 'brel gcod pa sgra'i bstan bcos dang / don gyi 'gal 'brel gcod pa rtog ge'i bstan bcos gnyis kyi dang po ni/ ming tshig yi ge gsum mam/ rang bzhin rkyen rnam 'gyur gsum brjod byar ston pa smra sgo dang / ka lā pa dang / tsan+d+ra pa la sogs pa rnamasaso / / de dag gi yan lag yi ge lci yang dang pra stu ra 'god tshul ston pa sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu dang / ming gi rnam grangs dang /rtags gsum gyi dbye ba dang / ming gcig don mang po la 'jug tshul sogs 22

dam ju 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'a sun pa'i gru chen kha nga dang bcas pa bzhugs/ston pa mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod lta bu dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan nyid dang / grub mtha'i 'dod tshul dang / rgyan gsum gyi dper brjod la sogs pa ston pa snyan ngag gi bstan bcos me long lta bu dang / de dag skad rigs dang sbyar nas ston pa zlos gar gyi bstan bcos klu kun tu dga' ba dang /'jig rten kun tu dga' ba la sogs pa lta bu ste/ 'di dag sgra rig pa'i yan lag yin par 'dod do/ /don gyi 'gal 'brel gcod pa ni gtan tshigs rig pa ste/ de la mngon sum/ rang don rjes dpag gzhan don rjes dpag gzhan sel/ dpe ltag chod brtag pa ste drug tu bsdus nas ston pa tshad ma'i mdo lta bu'am/ de'i dgongs 'grel rab tu byed pa sde bdun lta bu ste/ sde bdun gyi rgyasapa tshad ma rnam 'grel/ 'bring rnam nges/ bsdus pa rigs thigs te gtso bo lusalta bu gsum dang / gtan tshigs thigs pa/ 'brel ba brtag pa/ rtsod pa'i rig pa / rgyud gzhan sdo/ba pa ste 'khye1sa pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi ste bdun dang / de dag gi rjes su 'brangs ba'i bstan bcos rnams so/ /gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i bstan bcos la/ gzo rig pa/ gsob rig pa/ nang don rig pa gsum gyi dang po la phal pa dang / khyad par can gnyis kyi dang po ni/gser 'gyur dang spos sbyor gyi bstan bcos la sogs pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni sku gzugs kyi cha tshad ston pa'i bstan bcos so/ /gso ba rig pa ni/ lusadang byis pa gdon lus stod/ /mtshon dang 'chi ba rgas ro tsa/ /gso dpyad gang la gnas pa ni/ /yan lag brgyad du de bshad do/ /zhes pa ltar gso rig gi brjod bya don tshan brgyad du bsdus nas ston pa yan lag brgyad pa lta bu'o/ /de 23

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)dag kyang so sor yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa'i rgyur bslab par bya ba yin no / / nang rig pa'i bstan bcos ni/'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /de lta na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blo gros can rnams kyis shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga po 'di dag bsgrub pa la 'bad par bya ste/ rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phagasamachog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes bzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa bye brag gi dgong bas 'grel la/ gsum gyi dang po bka' dang po'i dgongs 'grel la gnyis las/ lta ba'i cha gsal bar byed pa ni mngon pa sde bdun te/ gang spel du/ chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus//gdags(pa'i bstan bcos mo gal bus/ khams kyi tshogs ni gang po ba byas/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /ye shes la 'jug ka tra'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyig bshes kyis/ /yang dag 'gro ba'i rnam grangs ni/ /bsus po che yisabyas zhes grags/ /ces so/ /'di rnams bye brag tu smra ba bkar 'dod la/ mdo sde pa yan chad bstan bcos su 'dod do/ /de ltar na yang bka' la mngon pa'i sde sdod ma tshang ba'i skyon med de mdo sde dang / 'dul ba gnyis kyi spyi khyab gseb tshags nas ston pas so/ /zhes gsungs/ bdun po de rnams kyi don bsdus pa'i bstan bcos bye brag tu bshad pa chen po dang de'i don bsdus pa mngon pa mdzod la sogs pa rnams lta ba'i cha ston pa yin no/ /spyod pa'i cha ston pa ni lung sde bzhi char gyi dgongs 'grel mdo rtsa ba dang / rnam 'byed gtso bor byas/ gzhan 24

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ji ltar rigs par bya ba'i dgongs 'grel me tog phreng rgyud dang / sum brgya pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa bka' bar pa'i dgongs 'grel la/ lta ba'i cha ston pa/spyod pa'i cha ston pa/ mngon rtogs kyi rim pa ston pa gsum las/ lta ba'i cha ston pa ni/ dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa ste/ de yang rang gzhan gyi sde pa gnyis ma'i bsgrub bya bden dngos thun mong du dgag pa rtsa ba'i shes rab/ rang sde dngos smra ba'i 'dod pa bye brag tu dgag pa rigs pa drag cu pa ste lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gnyis dang / rkyen brtags pa'i rab byed zlos 'phros nas rang bzhin med par smra ba la rigs pa dang 'gal ba spong ba rtsod bzlog dang / 'dus byas brtag pa'i rab byed las 'phros nas skye 'jig med par smra ba la lung dang 'gal ba spong ba stong nyid bdun cu pa ste yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos gnyis dang / bden dngos kyi sgrub byed rtog pa'i rigs pa 'gog pa zhib mo rnam 'thag ste lnga ni 'phags pas mdzad pa yin la/ kha cig don dam par rang bzhin med kyang kun rdzob tu 'jig rten tha snyad 'thad cing grub par ston pa tha snyad grub pa dang drug yin no zhes gsungs/ spyod pa'i cha ston pa ni/ mdo kun las ba yis pa dang / bslab ba yigs ma/ lta spyod zung 'brel du ston pa rin chen phreng ba/ spyod 'jug sgom rim gsum la sogs pa rnams so/ /mngon rtogs kyi rim pa ston pa ni/ yum gyi sbas don yul mkhyen pa gsum/ nyams len spyor ba bzhi/ 'bras bu chos sku ste brgyad du bsdus nasaston pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams so/ /de ltar bshad pa'i dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs rnams la dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa 25

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos dang / mngon par rtogs pa 'i rgyan la sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa ston pa'i bstan bcos zhes shing rta'i srol chen po gnyis su grags shing grub la/ kha cig de dag gi don ston pa sang rgya rten dang dbang du bya ba lor dang / /las chos spyod ༅ ji lta ra spyad pa bsgom rnam g.yeng gas ga 'a po ra bcu dang bcas pa dang / /rab byed dang phyir mi ldog mi stong nyid pas drug brtags dang lhung ba dang gnyis/ /phan yon sher phyin spyod pa'i bcas par yang dag brjod/ /ces pa ltar gyi gtso bo'i don sum cu rtsa gnyis su ston pa/ phyogs glang gis brgyad stong don bsdus dang / yum gyi don sgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig tu ston pa dbyig gnyen gyi 'bum ṭīka ste bzhi la shing rta'i srol 'byed bzhi zhes zer ro/ /sgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig ni/ thog mar gleng gzhis sgo phye nas/ /bsdus dang 'bring dang rgyas pa'i sgo/ yā ri'i bu dang rab 'byor la/ /bka' stsal re re brgya byin dang/ /rab 'byor byams pa gnyis bzhi gnyis/ /kun dga' bo la bka' stsal gcig /de ltar rnam grangs bcu gcig go /zhesapa ltar ro/ /gsum pa bka' mtha' ma'i dgongs 'grel la/ lta ba dang spyod pa'i cha gsal byed gnyis las/ lta ba'i cha gsal byed ni/ rgyan gnyis/ 'byed gnyis/ rgyud bla ma/ zhes pa ltar gyi byams pa'i chos lnga las mngon rtogs rgyan ma gtogs pa'i byams chos phyi ma bzhi rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams so/ /de yang mdo sde rgyan ni/ theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad don lngar bsdus nas ston pa ste/ gser la brdung byas 'dra zhing pad+ma rgyas pa bzhin/ /bkres pas nyen pa g.yos legs kha zas za ba 'dra/ /'phrin yig legs pa thos 'dra rin chen 26

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bsnan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/sgrom phye ltar/ /chos de 'dir bshad pas kyang dga' ba'i mchog bskyed da/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dbus mtha' rnam 'byed ni/ rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang /de spangs pas dbu ma'i lam rnam par 'byed pa ste/ de yang mtshan nyid sgrib pa de kho na/ /gnyen po dang ni sgom pa dang / /de yi gnas dang 'bras bu thob/ /theg pa bla na med pa yin/ /zhes don bdun gyis bstan pa yin no/ /chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed ni/ kun nas nyon mongs pa 'khor ba'i chos dang / rnam par byang ba mya ngan las 'das pa/ chos nyid rnam par dbye ba ston pas so/ /rgyud bla ma ni/theg pa chen po'i rgyud phyi ma'i dgongs pa rdo rje'i gnas bdun du bsdus nas ston pa ste/ de yang / sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang / /yon tan sangs rgyas phrin las tha ma ste/ /bstan bcos kun gyi lus ni mdor bsdu na/ /rdo rje yi ni gnas bdun 'di dag go /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i rjes su 'brangs pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga dang / bsdus pa'i bstan bcos sdom gnyis dang / dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i rab tu byed pa sde brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /sa sde lnga ni/ rnam shes lnga ldan yid kyi sa/ /rtog dpyod bcas sa rtog dpyod med/ /rtog med dpyod bcas mnyam gzhag sa/ /ma bzhag sems yod sems med sa/ /thos bsam sgom sa nyan rang sa/ /byang sa lhag bcas lhag med sa/ /zhes pa ltar gyi sa bcu bdun bsdus nas ston pa rtsa ba lta bu sa'i dngos gzhi/ de'i 'grel pa lta bu rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba / de dag sde snod gsum du bsdu tshul ston pa gzhi bsdu ba/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam byang gi rnam grangs bye brag tu ston pa rnam grangs bsdu ba/ de 27

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)dag 'chad tshul ston pa rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bsdu ba ste lnga'o/ /sdom gnyis kyi theg pa thun mong gi sdom ni de'i don mtshan nyid kun las bcas/ bden pa rnam nges/ chos rnam nges/ thob pa rnam nges/ 'bel gtam rnam nges te lngar bsdus nas ston pa mngon pa kun las btus so/ /theg pa chen po'i sdom ni/ theg chen gyi sde sdod kyi don shes bya'i gnas la sogs pa bcur bsdus nas ston pa theg bsdus so/ /rab tu byed pa sde brgyad ni/ chos thams cad sems tsam du ston pa sum cu pa/ de rigs pas bsgrub pa nyi shu pa/ de'i gzhi phung po lnga 'thad par ston pa phung po lnga pa/ nyan bshad 'thad par ston pa rnam bshad rigs pa/ sgo gsum gyi las 'thad par ston pa las grub pa'i rab byed de rang rgyud du brtsams pa lnga/ rten 'brel gyi mdo/ mdo sde rgyan/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed gsum gyi 'grel pa ste gzhan 'grel du brtsams pa gsum dang bcas pa'i brgyad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos sde nyi shu ni / byams chos lnga/ sa sde lnga sdom gnyis/ rab tu byed pa sde brgyad de nyi shu'o/kha cig dbyig gnyen gyis sa bcu pa'i 'grel pa la sogs pa mang du mdzad pas sde brgyad kyi nges pa med ces zer ro/ /spyod pa'i cha ston pa ni/ byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u dang sdom pa nyi shu pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa brjod bya don gyi sgo nas dbye na/ ji snyed pa ston pa dang / ji lta ba ston pa dang / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa gsum gyis dang po la/ phal pa dang khyad par can gnyis las/phal pa ni 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab brgya pa dang / skye bo gsothigs dang / tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod la sogs pa ste/ de dag mngon mtho'i 28

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/rgyu yin zhing thar pa'i rten du 'gro ba'ang srid de/ shes rab brgya pa las/mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ /'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug /ces gsungs so/ /de dag gi phyogs mthun ni/ 'dul ba lung bzhi las byung ba'i brtag pa brgyad dang /brtag pa bco brgyad la sogs pa rnams so/ khyad par can ni gong du bshad pa phyi'i rig gnas bzhi dang / phung khams skye mched la sogs pa chos can gyi cha brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa rnams so/ /ji lta ba ston pa ni/ rigs tshogs dang rgyan snang bden gsum dang / chos dbyings bstod pa la sogs pa chos dbyings zab mo'i don bye brag tu ston pa rnams so/ /thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ston pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba dang / bshes spring dang / bzhi brgya pa la sogs pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam ston pa rnams so/ /gsum pa byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ bka' rgya chen po bsdud pa dang / zab mo rnam par 'byed pa dang / 'khrug pa go rim du sdebs pa'i bstan bcos gsum las/ dang po ni/mdo sde rgyan dang mdo rtsa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni mngon rtogs rgyan lta bu/ gsum pa ni bslab bcas dang / skyes rabs lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa 'jug ldog mchog dman gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni sa sde sgo tshig da rigs pa)las/ don med don log don dang ldan//thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len dang //ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong / /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ don dang ldan pa dang / sgrub pa lhur len pa dang / sdug bsngal spong pa'i bstan bcos gsum ni mchog yin la/ gzhan drug ni dman pa yin no/ /29

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (()gsum pa blang dor shes pa'i ched du bshad sgrub bya ba'i tshul bstan pa ni/mdzod las/ de 'dzin byed pa smra byed pa/ /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la gsum/ lung gi chos la nyan bshad bya ba'i tshul/ rtogs pa'i chos la sgrub pa bya ba'i tshul/ bshad sgrub byas pa'i 'bras bu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ gang la nyan bshad bya ba'i chos/ gang gis nyan bshad byed pa'i gang zagaji ltar nyan bshad byas pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ gang la nyan bshad bya ba'i chos ni/ rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ lung rigs rjes su gdams pa'o/ /zhes gsungasate / mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang mthun pa'i lung / sgra tshad dngos stobs dang mthun pa'i rigs pa/ chos nyid zab mo dang mi 'gal ba'i rjes su gdams pa ste / mtshan nyid gsum mam gnyis sam gang rung gcig dang ldan yang rung / de rnams kyi nang nas yid ches pa'i lung dang / brgyud pa dri ma med pa las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa gtso che ste/ shin tu lkog tu gyur pa dpyod pa la lung nyid tshad ma yin pa'i phyir dang lung don man ngag brgyud pa'i ngag bgros kyis ma brgyan na/bde bar nyams su mi lon pa mang du yod pa'i phyir dang / gang zag kha cig lung gi tshig sgra ji bzhin pa la zhen nas don du mi 'gyur ba yang du ma yod par gsungs pas so/ /de skad du tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ lung ni yid ches tshig yin te/ /nyes pa zad pa brdzun gyi tshig /smra bar mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir/ /nyes zad lung du shes par bya/ /zhes dang / rgyan las/ don sgra ji bzhin yongs rtogs na/ /bdag nyid snyems shing blo nyams 'gyur/ /legs par gsungs pa'ang spangs pas na/ /brlag 'gyur chos la khong khros sgrib/ /ces gsungs 30

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul ba na pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/pas so/ /yang na/ 'od ldan las/ bslab pa gsum ni rab ston zhing / /phyag rgya gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /sangs rgyas gsung du mkhas pas rtogs/ /zhes gsungs(te/ de yang bsgrub bya bslab pa gsum ni/ mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhid / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshig rkang pa gsum gyis tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang / shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum go rim bzhin du bstan par gsungs so/ /yang na phyag rgya gsum dang ldan pa ste/ phyag rgya gsum ni/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa/ myang 'das zhi bde/ chos bdag med pa gsum mo//yang na mdo las/ dam/ pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba / don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba zhes gsungs te/ rjod byed lung gi chos ni thos pa las dad pa skye ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir thog mar dge ba/ bsam pa lalodaga' ba skyed pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir bar du dge ba/ bsgom pa las ji lta ba rtogs pa'i blo skye ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir tha mar dge ba/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis ston pa'i phyir don bzang po/ tshig dang yi ge 'jig rten na grags pa ltar brjod pas bzung sla ba'i phyir tshig 'bru bzang po ste lnga dang /brjod bya rtogs pa'i chos ni phyi rol pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir ma 'dres pa / khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa thams cad spong ba'i gnyen po rdzogs pa'i phyir yongs su rdzogs pa/ rang bzhin gyi dri ma med pa'i phyir yongs su dag pa/31

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ 9)glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i phyir yongs su byang ba ste yon tan bzhi dang ldan pa yin te/ rgyan las/ dad dang dga' dang blo rnams kyis/ khyu phyir chos 'di dge ba yin/ /don rnams gnyis ldan bzung sla dang / /yon tan bzhi can tshangs spyod ston/ /gzhan dang thun mong ma yin ldan pa dang / khams gsum nyon mongs rnams spong rdzogs byed dang / /ngo bo nyid dang dri mas dag pa ste/ /tshangs spyod yon to bzhi ldan yin par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mdor na bshad bya'i chos ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ sdud pa pos bsdus/ mkhas grub rnamasakyis bkral/ paṇ+ḍita sa bshad/ lo tsā rte/ bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag dang / lung gi rgyun dang ldan pa/ mkhas pa rnams la grags pa zhig la nyan bshad bya dgos kyi/ de las gzhan pa la bshad sgrub byas kyang chos su mi 'gyur ro / / gang gis nyan bshad byed pa'i gang zag la/ 'chad pa po slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ gtsang mkhas gzhan la phan par 'dod/ /ces te/ tshul khrimasadag pas lus gtsang ba/ shes rab dag pabs lung rig mkhas pa/ lhag bsam dag pas gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid gsum ldan te/ de yang tshul khrims dang mi ldan na yon tan gyi gzhi med pas rang gzhan gyi don mi 'grub/grags pa ngan pa 'phel/ bstan pa dri ma can du byed pas yon tan gyi gzhi ma tshul khrims dag pa gal che'o/ /de ltar yang sum brgya pa las/ tshul khrims ldan wo 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /nad pa snying brtse gcor ni dag pa dang / /chos dang zang zing phan thogs brtson pa dang / /dus su 'doms pa de dag bla mar bsngags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ lta shes rab dag pas lung rig mkhas pa 32

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/la gsum las/ bshad bya la mkhas pa ni/ spyir shes bya rig pa'i gan ba'i lnga'i/sde snod thams cad la mkhas na yang legs mod kyi/ 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos de'i tshig don la mkhas pa zhig dgos te/ de yod na slob ma'i the tshom gcod nus pas so/ /'chad byed la mkhas pa ni/ gang nas bshad kyang 'brel/ci tsam bshad kyang ran/ ji ltar bshad kyang 'thad pa gsum gyi sgo nas ngag 'brel zhing / rjod byed kyi brda dag pa dang / gzhan dga' bar nus pa'i dbyangs dang ldan pa'o/ /'chad tshul la mkhas pa ni/ gdul bya'i khams dang /bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par bshad kyi/ de dang mi mthun par mi 'chad pa ste/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa las/ byis pa dbang po zhan cing le lo zhan/ /theg pa gnyis la nan tan mi byed pa/ /theg pa chen po'i 'khor lo ldan mi 'gyur/ /de ni rgya chen theg chen snod ma yin/ /zhes dang /de bzhin sdod min nyan thos theg pa dag /theg chen bshad pa thos na rmongasa'agyur zhing / /chad par lta ba ngan song lhung 'gyur bas/ /des na dbang po brtag ste chos bstan to/ /zhes gsungs shing / spyod 'jug las kyang / rgya chen chos kyi snod gyur pa/ /dman pa'i chos la sbyar mi bya/ /zhes dang / dman la zab dang rgya che dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i sdod kyi mtshan nyid la mkhas pa dgos so / / lhag bsam dag pas gzhan la phan par brtson pa ni/ zang zing la mi lta ba'i yid kyis sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par 'dod pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs te chos de'i tshig don slob mas rtogs nas nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gyur cig snyam pa'i phan 'dod kyi bsam pa dang 33

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)ldan pa dgos te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ chog shes snying rje tshul khrims ldan/ /nyon mongs sel ba'i shes rab can/ /de dag la ni khyod bsten na/ khyod kyis mkhyen gyi gus par mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar bshad pas rang gis chos bshad pa lam du 'gyur la/ de lta bu dang mi ldan na bdud kyi las su 'gyur te / 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa'i mdo las/ chos ston kyang chos nyan pa rnams la snying rje chen po mi bskyed pa ni bdud kyi las so/ /zhes dang / mang du thos kyang gzhan gyis shes kyi dogs te/ chos la slob dpon gyis dpe mkhyud byed pa yang bdud kyi las so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang chos 'chad dusakyi ngal dub bzod cing skyo ba med pa dang / gzhan gyis dris pa dang rtsod pa bzod cing lan 'debs nus pa dang / 'khor mi srun pa'i log sgrub bzod cing 'khon du 'dzin pa med pa ste/ sbyor ba bzod pa gsum la sogs pa mtshan nyid mang du gsungs pa de dag kyang ci rigs par tshang dgos so/ /spyir bla ma mkhas shing chos bzhin byed pa mkhas par grags pa zhig la mnyan/ mi mkhas na the tshom gcod mi nus/ mi btsun na slob ma'i spyod pa chud 'dza'/ mkhas par ma grags na slob dpon la med par khyod la gang yod ces brnyas par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na rgyan las/ de ltar blo bzang skyo ba med ldan brtse ba can/ /snyan pa rab grags cho ga bzang shes ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs par smra ba yin pa de/ /bshad pas skye bo'i nang na nyi ma bzhin du lhang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig dgos so/ /slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid mdor bsdu na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi zhing nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan 34

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/lhag par brtson byas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la bsten/ /zhes gsungs pa la 'dus so/ /de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sa phyogs gang dang gang du bzhugs zhes gtam du dris shing / phyogs kun tu btsal la rnyed par gyur pa na chos bstan pa de'i tshig don gyi rjes su zhugs te nyams su blang na 'khor ba'i gcong rong las thar bar 'gyur ba yin te/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa las/ kun mkhyen gyis bsngags bla ma bsten/ /slob mas rang dgar ma yin te/ /long bas rang dgar ri bo la/ /'dzeg par nus pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nyan pa po slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ blo gsal shes 'dod bla mar gus/ /zhes te/ rang bzhin gyis blo gsal ba/ rtsol bas shes par 'dod pa/ dad pas bla ma la gus pa'i chosagasum ldan te/ de yang skyes stobs kyi blo gros dang ldan na tshig lobs skyen zhing don go sla/ sbyor byung gi don gnyer yod na yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel/ bla ma la mos gus yod na rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug cing chos kyis phan thogs so / / de bas na shes rab chung ngu dag kyang ma zhus par byas te/ thos bsam sgom gsum las byung ba'i shes rab bskyed pa'i thabs dang le lo dang phyi bsgol gyi dbang gis chos rgan bskyed la re ba lta bu ma yin par/ tshig don gnyis ka shesapa ra 'dod pa'i mdzad spyod kyi rjes su 'jug pa dang / smon lam gyi rjes su slob pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas dad pa dang gus pa snying thag pa nas yong ba zhig dgos so / / spyir slob ma chos la brtson pa/ 'bad par nus pa/ grags pa ngan pasa'ajigs pa zhig dgos te/ tshig don phra mo la yang brtson pa ma byas na don dang 35

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)tshig 'bru phyin ci ma log pa mi shes/ 'bad pas nan tan chung na ma byang zhing ngo gnong la yun ring du 'gor/ grags pa ngan pas 'jigs pa med na grwa sar grogs po rnams kyis khrel/ rang gi yul du gtam ngan rgya chen 'phel/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis brnyas pa'i gnas su 'gyur ro/ /slob ma'i mtshan nyid mdor bsdu na/ bzhi brgya pa las/ gzur gnas don gnyer blo ldan pa/ /nyan po snod ces bya bar brjod/ /ces gsungs so/ /ji ltar nyan bshad bya ba'i tshul la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgo gsum kun spyod rnam dag pas/ /bstan pa srung phyir gus pas bsgrub/ /ces gsungs te/ thog mar slob dpon gyi bya ba la bkod pa bshams pa/ bdud tshar bcad pa/ kun spyod dag par bya ba gsum las/ bkod pa bsham pa ni/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po las/ gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /yangs pa'i stan ni rab tu bsham bting nas/ /bzang po'i tshon gyis legs par kha bsgyur ba'i/ /chos gos gtsang ma de ni rab bsgos nas//rngul gzan nag po de ni bsham byas nas//sham thabs che tshad legs par rab bgos nas/ /bcos bu'i ras rnams sna tshogs legs bting ba/ /rkang rten bcas pa'i khri la rab 'dug cing / /rkang pa legs par bkrus te steng 'dzegs nas/ /gdong dang bzhin gyi mdangs ni rab snam zhing / /chos kyi stan de la ni rab 'dug nas/ /sems can lhags pa rtse gcig gyur rnams la/ /gtam yang rnam pa sna tshogs nye bar ston/ /le lo dag kyang rnam par rab spangs nas/ /skyo ba snyoms pa'i 'du shes skye mi bya/ /mkhas pas mi dga' thams cad rnam par spang / /byams pa'i stobs ni 'khor la 36

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/bsgom par bya/ /nyin mtshan du yang chos mchog rab tu bsgom/ /mkhas pa desani bye ba phrag khrig dpes/ /'khor rnams mgu zhing de bzhin dga' bar byed/ /de la nam yang 'dod pa cung zad med/ /gzhan du mkhas pas rtag tu bdag nyid dang / /sems can 'di dag sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /phan phyir 'jig rten chos gang ston pa de/ /bdag gi bde ba'i yo byad kun snyam sems/ /zhesagasungs pa ltar ro/ /bdud tshar gcod pa ni/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ ta bya thā/ sha me sha ma wa ti/ sha mi tā sha nyu/ e ku re/ me ku re/ mā ra dzi ta/kuṇ+ḍa de/ ke lha re/ te dzo ba ti/ o lo ya ti/ ni ṣa thā/ ni me le/ ma lu pa na ye/khu khu re/ kha ge gra the/gra bas zhe/ e mu khre/ pa ra mu khri/ a mu khri/sha mi tā ni/sarba gra ha ༷ nā ni/ ni gra hi ti/ sarba pa ra pra bā di ni bi mu lte mā pra shā/ za bi tā/burnya mu drwa/ a nu ta ghā ṭi na/ sarba mā re/ pu tsa ri ta/ pa ri shudhe/ bi ga tsā skyo/ sarba mā ra dme ni/ blo gros rgya mtsho 'di dag ni bdud tshar gcod pa'i tshig nyon mongs pa bsal ba'i tshig ste/ de dag chos smra ba des legs par kha tan du byasal chos kyi khri la 'dug ste/ byang chub kyi rnam pa mngon par bsgrubs pa'i byamasapas/ 'khor thams cad la khyab par byas la/ bdag la sman par 'du shesabaskyed de/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes dang / chos nyan pa la nad pa'i 'du shesadang / de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes dang / chos kyi tshul yun du gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed la/ sngags kyi tshig 'di dag sngon du byas te chos kyi gtam byed na/ de'i 'khor yug dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du bdud dang /bdud kyi rigs kyi lha rnams mig bskur ba'i phyir las kyis 'ong bar mi 'gyur 37

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)ro / / gang dag 'ong ba de dag kyang bar chad byed par mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs so / / kun spyod dag par bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyis lus nyal ba dang / 'phred pa dang/ brkyangs pa la sogs pa spangs te/ shākya'i rgyal pos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul du bya/ ngag sgra mang po dang/ bzlos pa dang / skad gdangs zhan pa dang / sgra gsang mtho dman can la sogs pa spangs te/ dbyangs kyi yan lag phun sum tshogs pas gsal la dag par bshad do/ /yid chags sdang spangs te yi dam lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ sems can thams cad phan bde la 'dod par 'dod pa'i bsam pas chos kyi char dbab bo snyam par bya'o/ /slob ma'i bya ba la/ dag pa'i yon dbul/ gus pa'i spyod lam bsnyen/ rkyen tshogs pa la dga' ba bsgom pa gsum las/ dag pa'i yon dbul ba ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du phyogs te gus pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rab tu byung ba yin na bla gos zlum por bgos te/ rkang pa gnyis mnyam por bzhibs la/ thal mo sbyar ba spyi bo'am dpral bar bzhag nas smad (gnas)lnga sa la 0yis/sa pasang phyag byas la/yid du 'ong ba'i yon dang/ rgya chen por dmigs pa'i maṇ+ḍal dbul/ gus pa'i spyod lam bsten pa ni/ skyes rabs las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rnam par bskyed/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /dri med rab tu dang ba'i yid/ /gus pa bskyed de rtse gcig btud/ /nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan bzhin/ /rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ nyal ba dang / bsnyes pa dang /slob dpon la rgyab kyis phyogs pa la sogs pa spangs te/ tsog pu'am pus mo 38

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la can pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/bcugs te/ gus pa'i spyod lam dang ldan pas ngag smra ba bcad de/ yid rtse gcig pas nyan no/ /rkyen tshogs pa la dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'byung ba brgya lam yin/ /mi yi lus ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /kye ma dad pa dang ni chos nyan pa/ /'di 'dra 'jig rten na ni shin tu dkon/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rkyen de dag tshogs nas chos nyan du yod pa la dga' zhing spro ba dang bcas pas nyan no/ /gnyis pa da ngos gzhi la/ slob dpon gyis legs par bshad/ slob mas gus pas mnyan/ gnyis kas phar phyin drug ldan du bya ba gsum las/ slob dpon gyisalegs par bshad pa ni/ 'chad pa'i skyon rnams spangs nas ni/ khren tu brtse ba'i bsam pas bshad/ /ces pa ste/ mi 'chad pa dang / legs par mi 'chad pa dang / the tshom gyis 'chad pa dang / dka' ba'i gnas la byil byil po dang /spro dgos par mi spro ba dang / mi dgos par spro ba dang / 'khrugs pa mi sdebs pa dang / mi dgos pa dkrugs te 'chad pa dang / skabs su babs pa mi 'chad pa dang / brjod pa mi gsal ba dang / myur ches pa dang/ bul tshes pa dang / tshig don legs par brda mi 'phrod pa la sogs pa spangs te/ byams pa'i sems dang / snying rje'i sems dang / phan pa'i sems dang ldan pas bshad do/ /spyir chos kyi sbyin par 'gro ba la/ chags sdang med pa'i bsam pas sde snod dang rgyud sde la sogs pa ba shad na chos kyi sbyin pa kha na ma tho ba med pa yin te/ mdzod las/ chos sbyin nyon mongs can min pas/ /mdo sogs yang dag ji bzhin ston/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /ji ltar 'chad na rnam bshad rigs pa las/39

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (3)mdo don smra ba rnams kyi ni/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang / /tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyar bcas/ /rgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lnga las/ dgos pa'i don ni/ mdo don che ba nyid thos nas/ /nyan pa dang ni 'dzin pa la/ /nyan pa po de gus 'gyur bas/ /thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ spyi'i dgos pa gong du bshad pa ltar nyan bshad byas pa'i phan yon dang / khyad par gyi dgos pa bshad bya'i chos kyi tshig don shes par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /bsdas pa'i don la/ngag don bsdus te bstan pa dang / /gzhung don so so'i bsdus|na no/ /zhes te/thog mar gzhung 'di'i ngag don 'di yin zhes gzhung de nas dngos su bshad pa rnams don tshan khrigs su bkod/ de la nye bar mkho na gzhung de na med kyang lung dang rigs pas gzhung gzhan nas blangs te go bde zhid gzung sla ba'i ngag don bsdus te thog mar bzhad do/ /gzhung don so so'i bsdus don ni/ bsdus don tshig gsal brjod pa bde/ /ngag nyung tshig sgoms gzung ba sla/ /bsdus don nyid kyis gzhung go ba/ /de 'dra gang gis shes te mkhas/ /zhes te gzhung gi thog mtha' ma lus pa blo yul du byas la/ spyi sdom chen po rnams so sor bzhaganang gses kyi dbye ba rnams mi 'gal bar phye/ yan lag gi dbye bsdu rnams ma 'dres par bshad de/ spyi'i bsdus don chod che ba/ bye brag gi bsdus don go bde ba / tshig gsal ba dang / brjod pa bde ba la sogs pa'i yon tan drug dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na rang nyid kyis brjod bde gzhan gyis rtogs sla/ gnyis ka la rna bar snyan pa zhig shes na mkhas pa yin no/ /tshig gi don ni/ gzhung 40

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i gru chen kha sbong dang bca4pa bzhugs/lugs gang dang gang 'chad pa/ /byed pa'i tshig gis rab sbyar te/ /tshig don legs par sbrel nas ni/ /'chad pa brda spyod byed pa'i lugs/ /zhes te/gzhung 'ga' zhig byed pa'i tshig drug la sogs pa dang sbyar te/ tshig don legs par sbrel nas mi dgos pa rnams mi 'chad/ dgos pa rnams mi 'dor bar dpyis phyin par 'chad pa ni sgra pa dag gi lugs so/ /bod la nye bar mkho ba'i 'chad tshul ni/las dang byed po bya ba yis//tshig don sbrel la ngag don blangs//zhes te/ las ni 'bras chen la sogs pa'o/ /byed pa po ni lhas byin la sogasapa'o/ /bya ba ni 'chad par byed pa la sogs pa'o/ /zhes pa lta bu'am/ gang bshad/ gang gis bshad/ ji ltar bshad ces bya ba la sogs pa bya byed lasagasum sbyar la bshad do/ /de yang / thog mar sgra la mkhas pa yis/ /tshig don rnam par phye ste bstan/ /de nas don la mkhas pa yis/ /lhag chad ga skrul pa med par bshad/ /ces te/ thog mar tshig la bsnyen nas don 'tshol dgos pas/ thun mong ba mngon pa nas bshad pa'i ming tshig yi ge gsum dang / thun mong ma yin pa mngon brjod dang / brda sprod kyi bstan bcos la sogs pa nasabyung ba'i ming tshig yi ge'i spros pa rnams la mkhas par bya ba'i sgo nas/ tshig gi cha ma 'dres par so sor phye ste bstan la/ de nas gzhung de'i brjod bya gang dang gang yin pa de dang de'i don lhag chad zhabrul pa med par 'chad pa'o/ /'chad pa'i tshul ni/ blo chen rnams la zab rgya che/ /blo chung gzung bde go sla ba/ /phyisanas tshig don 'brel chags nas/ /don sgra 'gal 'brel dpyad cing bshad/ /ces te/ slob ma dbang po rno zhing shes rab che ba rnams la tshig brling zhing sbrel 41

ba chen 'od snang la /gsu'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)legs pa/ don zab cing rgya che bar bshad/ dbang po rtul zhing blo chung ba rnams la / tshig gzung sla zhing go bde ba/ don rtogs sla zhing rna bar snyan pa bshad la/tshig don la 'brel cung zad chags shing dpyod par nus pa na/ brjod bya phra zhing phra ba nas bstan la tshig don gyi 'gal 'brel dpyad cing bshad do/ /de dag gi skabs su nye bar mkho ba la/ zhum la gzengs bstod rgod pa la/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs legs par bshad//rmugs pa rnams la ngo mtshar gyi//ga/tam bshad nas ni nyan du gzhug /ces te/ blo rtul ba/ gos pa dang / tshe thung ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas zhum ste/ nyan par mi 'dod pa rnams la 'phags pa lam phran brtan dang / dpal skyes dang / bha ska rgyu la sogs pa'i lo rgyus bshad la spro ba bskyed do/ /gzhan yang / rig pa nangs par 'chi yang bslab/ /tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / /skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/ /nor la rang nyid len dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa la sogs pa dran tu gzhug go /de bzhin du/ tshe 'di'i bya ba la zhen pa dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan gyis sems g.yengs te rgod pa rnams la mi rtag pa'i gtam dang / 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs dang / ngan song gi 'jigs pa la sogs pa bshad 'a se mas chos la bsgyur/ gnyid megs la sogs pa'i dbang du song ba rnams la/ seng ge dang wa skyes sam/ 'dro stong du nyal ba'i bud med la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud dang / gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus ci rigs par bshad la rmugs pa las bzlog par bya'o/ /mtshams sbyor ni / sgra dang don gyi dbye ba yis/ /mchar/sa sbyar ba ni rnam pa gnyis/ /don ni mdor bstan rgyas bshad dam/ /'gal 'brel sgo nas mtshams sbyor byed//42
