dam pa 'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ces te/ tshig gi mtshams sbyor ni/ tshig snga ma'i nus pas phyi ma 'dren mi nus pa'am/ nus kyang dngos su mi gsal ba'am/ gsal yang spyor tshul rtogs dka' ba 'ga' zhig tshig snga phyi'i don 'di ltar 'brel zhes go bde bar 'chad pa dang / don gyi mtshams sbyor ni/ de ltar mdor bstan nas de nyid rgyas par 'chad pa la zhes pa lta bu'am/ 'gal 'brel gyi sgo nas sam/ spang bya dang gnyen po'am/ rgyu dang 'bras bu la sogs pa phan tshun sbyar te 'chad pa'o//brgal lan ni/ brgal lan sgo nas gzhung gi don/ /lung dang rigs pas gtan la dbab/ /ces te/ gzhung gi don slob mas rtogs dka' ba 'ga' zhig la/ 'di dang 'di mi 'gal lam ji ltar yin zhes pa lta bu'i dri ba'am dogs pa khong nas blangs te/ de dag gi lan lung rigs dang mi 'gal ba bshad pa'i sgo nas 'gal ba spong zhing gzhung gi don 'tshol ba'o/ /slob mas gus pas mnyan pa ni/ nyan pa'i skyon rnams spangs nas ni/ mas par 'dod pas legs par mnyan/ /zhes te/ mdo las/ legs par nyon la rab tu yid la zungs shig dang ngas bshad do/ /zhes gsungs te de'i don ni/ snod kyi skyon gsum spangs nas nyan pa ste/ de yang legs par nyon zhes pa ni snod kha sbub lta bu'i skyon sbong ba ste/ snod kha sbub par bcud mi yong ba bzhin/ nyan pa'i dus su chos la don gnyer med pa dang / sems yul la g.yeng ba dang / gnyid thugs kyi dbang du song bas yid bsdus te chos la rna ba mi gtod pa spangs la nyon/ zhes pa'o//rab tu nyon ces bya ba ni/ snod dri ma can lta bu'i skyon spong ba ste/ snod dri ma can du bcud blugs kyang phan mi thogs pa bzhin sems nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dang 43

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (4)bcas pas chos nyan na rgyud la phan mi thogs pas/ nga rgyal dang ma dad pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bsam pa spangs la nyon zhes pa'o/ /yid la zungasal nyon zhes bya ba ni/ snod zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon spang ba ste/ snod zhabs rdol du bcud mi chags pa bzhin/ chos nyan pa la skyo ste tshig don la nan tan ma byas na phan mi thogs pas/ mi nus pa'i skyo ba spang la 'bad de nyon/ zhes pa'o/ /de yang rnam bshad rigs pa las/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang / /don du gnyer ba med nyid dang / /phyi rol rnam g.yeng yid bsdus dang / /skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis kas phar phyin drug ldan du bya ba ni/ chos kyi tshig don ster ba dang / de'i ched du yon dbul ba la sogs pa'i sbyin pa/ nyan bshad kyi mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i tshul khrims/ lusang ga gi dka' spyad la mi skyo ba'i bzod pa/ nyan bshad la spro ba'i brtson 'grus/ chos la rtse gcig pa'i bsam gtan tshig dang don rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan par nyams su len pa'o//de ltar yang mngon rtogs rgyan las/de dag so sor sbyin la sogs/ /rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yis/ /cho ga'i sgrub pa gang yin des/ /drug tshan drug gis ji ltar bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa rjes la gnyis las/ slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba/ dmigs med kyis rgyasagadab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam las/ sems kyi dbang du gyur pas na/ /bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /bdag gis de dag bshags par bgyi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs44

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/pa ji ltar rigs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyi skyes rabs las byung ba'i/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa yi/ /go 'phangs thob phyir skyon gyi dgra btul nas/ /rga dang na dang 'chi ba'i rlabs 'khrugs pa'i/ /srid pa'i mtsho las skye rgu 'don par shog /ces pa dang / slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ theg mchog dam chos rin chen bshad 'di la / / bsam yas bsod nams bdag gis gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro kun theg mchog dam pa'i chos/ /rin chen dri ma med pa'i snod gyur cig /cesagasungs pa dang / bzang spyod las byung ba'i/ rgyal ba rnams kyis dam pa'i chosa'adzin cing / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis dang / chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i/ bdud kyi sde dang mu stegs gzhud lugs dang / /chos ltar bcos pa'i mun sprul du ma dang / /gzhan yang 'gro ba'i nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/ /bdag gi stobs kyis rtsad nas 'joms gyur cig /ces bya ba la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yum las/ pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'i sbyin pa 'di yang sbyin par bya ba dang / len pa po dang / sbyin pa por dmigs pa dang bral bar gyur na/ 'jig rten lasa'adas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /zhes pa dang / 'jug pa las/ sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos stong / /'jig rten 'das pa'i pha rol phyin ces bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis rgyas gdab bo/ /slob ma'i bya ba la/ btang rag gi phyag bya ba/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba/ dran shes kyi rgyun bsten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bka' drin rjes su dran pa 45

ba tshe nan 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)dang bcas pas slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag bya'o/ /dge ba bsngo ba ni/ gzhan thams cad slob dpon gyi skabs bzhin las/ theg mchog dam chos rin chen nyan 'di las/ /zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /dran shes bsten pa ni/ chos kyi tshig don dran pa dang bcas dben par song la/ rnam par g.yeng ba dang rmugs pa la sogs pa spangs la/gang la nyan pa'i chos de yang dang yang du bsam par bya'o/ /klag par bya'o/ /bri bar bya'o/ /yid gnyis thams cad bla ma la dri bar bya'o/ /chos yongs su rdzogs nas btang rag dang bcas pas bla ma mnyes par bya'o/ /zhes chos la 'jug pa'i sgo las gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rtogs pa'i chos la bsgrub pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ chos mngon pa mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi gzhi nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'chal ba'i tshul khrims spangs nas yang dag pa'i tshul khrims la brten pa gal che ste/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/ shin tu legs par tshul khrims gang / /sdom pa'i mi de mdzes pa'i gzugs//'dul ba la ni nye bar gnas//tshul khrims bslab pa rang yid ches//mi de nyi ma gcig la yang / /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /bsog cing sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'grub/ /ces dang / tshul khrims 'di ni bde ba'i mchog /tshul khrims 'di ni thar pa'i lam/ /tshul khrims 'di ni yon tan gzhi/ /tshul khrims 'di ni sangs rgyas rgyu/ /zhes gsungs shing / mgon po klu sgrub kyis kyang / khrims 'di rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten 46

ngam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la jug pa 'i gru chen kha sdong dang bcas pa bzhugs/lags par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /tshul khrims rnams kyi nang nas ni rab tu byung ba'i phyogs kyi tshul khrims mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ rgyan las/rab tu byung ba'i phyogs dag ni/ /yon tan tshad med rnams dang ldan/ /de ltas sdom brtson khyim pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' las khyad 'phags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /tshul khrims dang mi ldan na mang du thos pa'i nor gyis phyug kyang /ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyob mi nus te/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji snyed chos kyi rnam pas byang chub kyang / /thos pas rgyags shing tshul khrims mi bsrung na/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba ngan 'gror de 'gro ste/ /de la thos pa mang pos skyob mi nus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bas thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyisatshul khrims dag pa'i thabs la 'bad pa gal che ste/ 'jug pa las/ so so skye bo rnams dang gsung skyes dang / /rang byang chub la bdag nyid nges rnams dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyis nges par legs pa dang / /mngon mtho'i rgyu ni tshul khrimasalas gzhan med/ /ces gsungs shing / ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las kyang /legs par spyad pa'i chos spyad bya/ /nyes par spyad pa de mi spyad/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /chos spyod pa ni bde bar gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i gang zag des 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu nyon mongs pa rnam par sbyong ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ /de'i rim pa yang /bslab pa kun las btus pa las/ bzod bya thos pa btsal bar bya/ /de nas nags su gnas par bya/ /mnyam par bzhag la brtson bya zhid / /mi sdug la sogs bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar skyo ba la ji mi snyam pa'i 47

ba chen 'od snang la /sa ci'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)bzod pa bskyed pa la bslab par bya ste/ de med na mang du thos pa la mi 'jug pas so/ /thos pa med na nyon mongs spong ba'i bsam gtan sgom pa'i thabs mi shes pas thos pa btsal lo/ /mang du thos pa ldan yang don mngon par mi shes na khye'u'i mgul du gter gyi kha byang gi yi ge btags pa dang 'dra bar don yod 'ad 〉pa byed mi nus pas/ don shes par bya ba'i slad du zab mo'i mdo sde lta ba dang / de dag gi don sems pa dang / 'jal ba dang / rtog pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rtag tu yid la byed pa la brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar yang theg bsdus las/thos pa'i bag chags brjod bcas pa'i/ /yid byed de ni tshul bzhin nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod de tshig don gyi cha la blo byang yang / bsgoms pas nyams su ma blangs na thos bsam don med du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de'i rjes su thos bsam gyis go yul du byas pas don mngon du byed pa'i thabs kyi gtso bor bstan pa'i snying po bsgrub pa nyams su blang ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar yang rgyan las/ 'di na dang po thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa las kyang yang dag don du yul la ye shes 'byung //de las chos thob de mod de las blo gros rab tu bskyed//de tshe de ni so so rang rig med na ji ltar nges/ /zhes dang / de ltar rnal 'byor can gyi bsgom pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /de ltar bde bar gshegs kyi bstan pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 'gyur na sgom pa don med 'gyur/ /gal te ma thos pa yang sgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa don med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / chos mngon pa kun las btus48

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul ba min pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/pa las kyang / sgom pa la ma bsten par thos pa dang sems pa'i sbyor ba 'ba' zhig gis kyang chos la gnas pa ma yin la/ thos pa dang sems pa la ma brten par sgom pa'i sbyor ba 'ba' zhig gis kyang chos la gnas pa ma yin la/ gnyis ka la brten te gnyis ka la gnas na chos la gnas pa yin no/ /zhes gsungasaso / / mang du thos kyang sgrub pa la mi brtson pa'i nyes pa ni/ 'phags pa lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba'i mdo las/ thos pas rgyags nas gus par mi 'gyur te / / rnam par 'gyed pa'i smra ba rnams la chags/ /brjed par 'gyur zhing shesabazhin med par 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /nang gi semasal shin tu ring bar 'gyur/ /lus dang sems kyang rab sbyangs ma yin 'gyur/khengs pa dang ni mdud pa mang por 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go / byis pa dam pa'i chos bsam rab tu nyams/ /sems ni mi nyan shin tu rtsub par 'gyur/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong dag dang rab tu ring / /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /rtag tu bla ma dag la gus pa med/ /spags pa'i gtam dag la ni dga' ba skyed/ /snying po med la gnas shing shes rab nyams/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /de ni lha tshogs rnams kyis mi bkur zhing / /de tshe de la'ang 'dod pa mi bskyed la/ /so so yang dag rig las nyams 'gyur te/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/gang dag lus ni mngon sum mang yod pa//mkhas pa de dag gis ni spro bar 'gyur/ /de yi srog ni don med mi 'gyur te/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /bdag ni sgrub nyams da ni ci bya zhes/ /'chi ba'i dus tshe byis pa mya ngan byed/ /gting rnyed ma gyur shin tu sdug bsngal 49

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /sa bskyod bzhin du 'gul zhing g.yo ba ste/ /de ni de ltar the tshom 'gyur du nges/ /de ni nam yang blo brtan mi 'gyur te/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /gar la blta ba'i khrod na 'dug pa zhig /dpa' bo gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pa bzhin/ /bdag nyid nan tan mnyam par 'gyur ba ste/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /de ni g.yo ldan yang zhing re 'chang 'gyur/ /phyi phyir bzhin ni rnam par 'gyed pa brtsam/ /'phags pa'i dam pa'i chos las rab tu rings/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /mthu chung bsti bstang gis ni dga' 'gyur te/ /mi shes ldan pa g.yo zhing 'gyur ba yin/ /spre ltar de yi sems ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /rang gi blo yis shes pa dma' ba'i phyir/ /rmongs pa de ni gzhan gyi dring la 'jog /de ni nyon mongs phyogs kyi dbang du 'gro/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/mig kyang 'khrul zhing de bzhin rna ba'ang 'khrul//sna yang 'khrul zhid de bzhin lce yang 'khrul/ /lus kyang 'khrul zhing yid kyang 'khrul par 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /de yi sems ni rna ba'i rnam shes la/ /rab tu chags shing sgras rgyags shes rab nyams/ /log par sems shing lam ngan 'gro bar 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go / zhes bya ba la sogs pa nas yun ring dus nas smra la dga' bas na/ /desani bdag nyid dga' ba mi 'thob bo/ /tshig gang dga' ba mtha' yas 'thob 'gyur ba/ /tshig gcig tsam zhig bsam yang mchog yin no/ /bu ram shing shun snying po ci yang med/ /dga' bar bya ba'i ro ni nang na 'dug khun pa zos pa'i 50

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor la can pa'i spu chen 'asgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/mis ni bu ram ro/ /zhim po rnyed par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /ji ltar shun pa de bzhin smra ba ste/ /ro lta bu ni 'di la don sems yin/ /de lta bas na smra la dga' spangs te/ /rtag tu bag yod byos la don soms shig /ces gsungs shing /ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ nga yis rab tu bzang ba'i chos bshad kyang / khyod kyis thos nas yang dag ma spyad na/ /nad pa sman gyi rkyal ba thogs pa rnams/ /rang gi nad sna gso bar mi nus bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sgrub pa nyams su len pa de yang thog mar/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba zhing las dang / tshong las dang /phyi 'dod yon dang / nang sems can la chags pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spang bar bya ste/ de rnams ma spangs na sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang 'du byed kyi las la chags pa'i nyes pa ni/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba'i mdo las/ bla mas bskul na ka blo mi bde zhing / /rjes su bstan na mthun par 'dzin mi byed/ /de ni myur du tshul khrims nyams par 'gyur/ /nyesapa 'di dag las la dga' ba'i yin/ khyim na gnas pa'i las rnams rtag sems pas/ /de ni rtag tu gdung bar 'gyur ba ste/ /bsam gtan dang ni spong ba de mi byed/ /nyes pa 'di dag las la dga' ba'i yin/ /nyin dang mtshan du sems gzhan med par ni/ /zas dang skom la rgyun du sems par byed/ /de ni rtag tu yon tan 'dod pa min/ /nyes pa 'di dag las la dga' ba'i yin/ /de ni 'dod chags shas ni che bar skye/ /de ni bro ba rnams la chags shing zhen/ /de ni ngan ngon tsam gyis dga' mi 'gyur/ /nyes pa 'di dag las la dga' ba'i yin/ /de ni 'khor mang po la dga' 'gyur te/ /de nyams na ni shin tu sdug 51

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)bsngal 'gyur/ /de ni bong bu bzhin du lang long gyur/ /nyes pa 'di dag las la dga' ba'i yin/ /de ni 'jig rten pa yi bya ba 'dri/ /rigs pa min pa'i smra ba rnams la dga'/ /rigs pa'i smra la de ni dga' mi 'gyur/ /nyes pa 'di dag las la dga' ba'i yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /spyod 'jug las/ 'dod ldan ngan pa kha cig ni/ /nyin rangs las kyis yongs dub ste/ khyim du 'ongs nas chad pa'i lus/ /ro dang 'dra ba nyal bar byed/ kha cig byes bgrod nyon mongs dang / /ring du song ba'i sdug bsngal can/ /bud med 'dod bzhin bud med rnams/ khyus skor los kyang mthong mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ khyad par du nor la chags pa'i nyes pa ni/bsags dang bsrung dang brlag pa'i gdung ba yi//nor ni phung khrol mtha' yas shes par bya/ /nor la chags pa'i g.yeng bar gyur pa rnams/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las grol skabs med do/ /'dod ldan rnams la de la sogs/ /nyes dmigs mang la mnog chung ste/ khreng rta 'dren pa'i phyugs dag gis/ /rtswa ni kham gang zos pa bzhin/ /phyugs kyis bsgrub na'ang mi dkon pa'i/ /mnog chung gang yin de don du/ /dal 'byor phun tshogs rnyed dka' 'di/ /las kyis mnar ba rnams kyis bcom/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nang sems can la chags pa'i nyes pa yang / de nyid las/ sems can rnams la chags byas na/ /yang dag nyid la kun tu bsgrib/ /skyo ba'i sems kyang 'jig par byed/ /tha mar mya ngan gdung bar 'gyur/ /de la sems dpa' 'ba' zhig gis/ /tshe 'di don med 'da' bar 'gyur/ /rtag pa med pa'i mdza' bshes kyis/ /g.yung drung chos kyang 'jig par 'gyur/ /byis dang skal pa mnyam spyod 32

dam pa'i chos byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'as na pa 'i thu chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/na / / nges par ngan 'gror 'gro 'gyur te/ /skal mi mnyam par 'khrid byed na/ /byis pa brten pas ci zhig bya/ /skad cig gis ni mdza' 'gyur la/ /yud tsam gyis ni dgrar yang 'gyur/ /dga' ba'i gnas la khro byed pas/ /so so'i skye bo mgu bar dka'/ /phan par smra na khro bar byed/ /bdag kyang phan las bzlog par byed//de dag ngag ni ma nyan par/ khros pas ban 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran/ /dma' la nga rgyal bstod na dregs/ /mi snyan brjod na khong khro bskyed/ /nam zhig byis las phan pa thob/ /byis dang 'grogasan byis pa las/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang / /'khor bar dga' ba'i gtam la sogs/ /mi dge cis kyang nges par 'byung/ /de ltar bdag dang gzhan bsten pa/ /de ni phung bar 'gyur bar zad/ /des kyang bdag don ma byas la/ /bdag kyang de don mi 'gyur bas/ /byis las thag rings byol bar bya / / phrad na dga' ba'i mgu bya ste//'dris chen nyid du mi 'gyur bar/ /tha mal pa tsam legs par bya/ /bung bas me tog sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /chos kyi don tsam blangs nas ni/ /kun la sngon chad ma mthong bzhin/ /'dris pa med par gnasapar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ khyad par bud med la chags pa'i nyes pa ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ rnam pa kun tu nor 'jig dang / /ngan song rtsa ba bud med yin/ /mi gang dag ni bud med 'dod/ /de dag bde ba ga la 'gyur/ /zhesadang / bud med phung bar byed pa ste/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /gal te bdag la phan 'dod na/ /de bas bud med rnam par spangs/ /zhes gsungasashing / skyes rabs las kyang / smad pa'i bud med khyim ni gnyis ka yang / /53

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ 9)grags pa dang ni 'byor pa med par byed/ /mtshan mo'i zla ba sprin rum nub pas ni / / gnas pa'i bye brag mdzes pa med pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du sha'i ro la chags pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ lang sgar gshegs pa las/ sha yi phyir ni sems can gsod/ /sha yi phyir ni nor sbyin byed/ /de dag gnyis ka sdig las can/ /ngu 'bod byed la sogs par 'tshed/ /gang gis thub pa'i tshig 'das te/ /bsam pa ngan pa'i sha zan dang / /'jig rten gnyis ni bshigs pa'i phyir/ shwakya'i bstan las brtul zhugs nyams/ stan na tu mi bzad dmyal bar yang / /sdig pa'i las can de dag 'gro/ /ma rung ngu 'bod la sogs su/ /sha zan de dag 'tshed par 'gyur/ /rnam gsum dag pa'i sha rnams ni/ /ma brtags pa dang ma blangs dang / /ma bskul ba yang yong med pas/ /de bas sha ni mi za'o/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa nas/ ma 'ongs pa yi dus na ni/ kha za gti mug smra ba dag tan ni sdig med rung ba'o zhes/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad ces zer/ /thar pa'i chos dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ /mi rnams dngangs bar 'gyur ba'i sha /de phyir za bar mi bya ste/ /'di ni 'phags pa'i rgyal mtshan no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du chang la chags pa'i nyes pa yang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ chang la brten pa'i mi dag ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi sta gri yin/ /ngo tsha med par byed pa'i mchog /spang ba dag tu nye bar gnas/ /blo ni shin tu rmongs bskyed cing / /'jig rten gnyis ni rnam 'jig byed/ /thar pa'i chos la me lta bur/ /sreg byed nyid ni chang yin no/ /zhes dang / chang 'thung ba la rtag tu ni/ /nyes dmigs sum cu rtsa gnyis yod/ /de bas nyes dmigs shes pa gang / /de 34

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mi'i 'a sun pa'i gru chen 'a skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/yis chang ni rtag tu spongs/ /rigs btsun mkhas pa dag la ni/ /dri ma chen por byed pa yin/ /skye bo sos da'i me tog ltar/ /spangs pa kho nar byed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / dge sdig rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo las/ tshe 'di la chang 'thung zhing myos pa ni zangs khu 'thung ba'i dmyal bar lhung ngo / /zhes dang / seng ges zhus pa las/ gzhan la chang sbyin na skye ba lnga brgyar lag rdum du skye'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bum pa can kyi skyes rabs las kyang / gang zhig 'thungasapas rang la 'os pa'i ngo tsha 'dor/ /gos dang bral zhing gcer bu byung yang mi dga' med/ /grong khyer skye bo mang po'i lam du yid brten 'gro/ /bum pa 'dir ni 'tshong bar 'os pa de blugs so/ /gang zhig 'thung na skyugs pa'i zas kyis gos 'gyur zhing/ khyi yis kha yang dogs pa med par ldag gyur la/ /dran pa med cing lam po cher yang nyal 'gyur ba/ /bcongs na brin pa de ni bum pa 'dir blugs so/ /gang zhig 'thung na myos te dbang med par/ /pha ma dag kyang shing la 'ching bar byed/ /nor gyi bdag po dag kyang khyad du gsod/ /phan brlag de ni bum pa 'dir blugs so/ /zhes dang / mi bden pa yang bden pa bzhin du ngo mthon smra/ /mi bya ba yang bya ba bzhin du dga' zhing byed/ /gang gi mthu yis yod med phyin ci log tu shes/ /'di ni sdig pa'i gzugs bzhin bum pa 'di na 'dug /ces dang / mi yi dbang po chang ni de 'dra yang / /'jig rten na ni bcud ces rab tu grags/ /yon tan la ni gang dag mi dga' ba/ /de dag chang gisamyos la 'bad par byed/ /ces dang chang de nyung ngu 'thungs kyang rnam par smin pa ni / mi yi gnas su skyes kyang tshul khrims lta nyams te/ /de yis slar yang mnar 55

ba chen 'od snang la /skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)med 'bar bar sreg 'gyur zhing / /yi dwags yul dang dud 'gro dman par gnas par 'gyur//tshul khrims nyams 'gyur gtam ngan sngon du 'byung ba dang //ngo tsha med cing blo gros dri ma can 'gyur ba/ /gang zhig 'thungs pas yon tan de dang de nyams te/ /des na rgyal po khyod kyis chang 'thung ga la rigs/ /zhesagasungs so/ /mdor na thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyis ji ltar 'dod chags spong ba de ltar sha dang chang spang ba la bslab par bya ste/ de dag thar pa la gegs byed par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang lang gshegs las/ ji ltar 'dod chags thar pa la/ /bar chad byed par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /de ltar sha dang chang la sogs/ /bar chad byed par 'gyur ba'o/ /dgra la sdang ba'i semasakyang spang bar bya ste/ rang gi khro ba ma thul na phyi rol gyi dgra gzhom gyis mi lang zhing / khro ba'i dgra thul na phyi rol gyi dgra gzhom mi dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/sems can mi bsrun nam mkha' bzhin/ /de dag gzhom gyis yongs mi lang /khro ba'i sems 'di gcig bcom na/ /dgra de thams cad choms dang 'dra/ /sasteng 'di dag ko g.yog tu/ /de snyed ko bas ga la lang / /lhum mthil tsam gyi ko bas ni/ /sa steng thams cad g.yogs dang 'dra/ /de bzhin phyi rol dngos po yang / /bdag gis phyir zlog mi lang gi /bdag gis sems ni bzlog bya yi/ /gzhan ni bzlog ko ci zhig dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bsan zhe sdang ni rang gzhan gnyis ga'i rgyud sreg par byed ya yin pas gang zhig la brten nas zhe sdang skyes par gyur pa na/ de la dmigs pa'i byams pa dang snying rjes kun nas bslangs nas bzod pa bsgom pa la 'bad par bya ste/ rang dang gzhan gyi khro 56

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la jug pa 'i gru chen 'a sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ba'i me dpung 'jil bar byed pa'i thabs ni bzod pa'i chu rgyun 'bebs pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang drang srong bzod pa can gyi skyes rabs las/yid la zhe snang yod na bdag dang gzhan dag la/ /phan par 'gyur ba rab tu bsreg 'gyur me dang 'dra/ /de bas skye bo sdig la 'dzems pa de dag gis/ /gnyen po rnams la bsten nas sdig pa spang bar bya/ /nags la me ni rab tu 'bar bar gyur pa yang / /chu klung chen po mtha' yas 'bab dang phrad gyur na/ /ji ltar rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ /yid kyi gdung ba'ang bzod la brten nas zhi bar 'gyur/ /de phyir sdig pa'i rgyu ni zil gyis gnon pa'i bzod pa bsgom/ /des ni byams la brten pa'i dgra yang 'phel mi 'gyur/ /de la dga' zhing dga' bas bde ba'i skal bar ldan gyur te/ /bsod nams byas pa'i yon tan las kyang mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang kye btsun mo dgabazod pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/dge ba'i rang bzhin can du rab tu grags/ /bsod nams grags pa dag kyang rab tu 'phel/ /chu yis ma ba spru/sa par yang rnam dag 'gyur/ /yon tan de dang de dag phun sum tshogs/ /gzhan la gnod pa rtag tu yongs mi shes/ /snying stobs can gyi chos nyid yid 'ong mdzes/ /yon tan mngon bsgrub 'jig rten don byed pa/ /bzod pa'i ming du snying rje can gyis gsungs/ /mthu dang ldan pa rnams kyi rgyan yang yin/ /dka' thub can gyi stobs mchog phun sum tshogs/ /gnod sems nags kyi me la chu rgyun 'bebs/ /bzod pas don med rnams kyang zhi bar byed/ /dam pa rnams kyi go cha bzod pa yin/ /skye bo ngan pa'i tshig ngan mda' jugs te/ /phal cher yon tan bsngags57

'tshen na 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)pa'i me tog 'gyur/ /de ni grags pa'i yan lag can du 'gyur/ /chos kyi mi mthun phyogs rnams bzod pas 'joms/ /rnam par thar pa'i bde ba bzod par 'thob/ /rab tu 'bad na bzod pa phan par 'gyur/ /bzod pa de ni mi byed su zhig yod/ /ces gsungs shing / gtsug phud byang chub kyi skyes rabasalas kyang / gang zhig zil gnon dge ba stongs par 'gyur/ /don rnams grub kyang nyams par 'gyur ba yi/ khro ba ma rungs gdon gyis bsgyur 'dra ba/ /tshul min byed pa gdon gyis zin par 'ong / /btsub shing btsubs pa las ni me byung na / / de nyid rab tu tshig par 'gyur ba ltar/ /log par rtogs las 'bar bar gyur pa yi/ khro bas de bzhin bdag nyid phung bar byed/ /rab tu 'bar zhing 'tshig pa'i me bzhin du/ /snying la gdung ba'i khro ba ma bcil na/ /'dir ni grags pa min pas nyams 'gyur te/ /nyi ma shar bas zla 'od nyams pa bzhin/ /gzhan la gnod par bya ba mi sems par/ khro ba la ni dgra bzhin gang blta ba//de yi grags pa nges par rgyas 'gyur te/ /zla ba yar gyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba bzhin/ /'di ltar khro ba la nyes dmigs chen po gzhan dag kyang yod de/ khro ba'i me yis bzhin mdog nyams 'gyur na/ /rgyan gyis brgyan kyang mdzes par yong mi snang / /mal stan bzang bo dag la nyal gyur kyang / khro ba'i zug nus sems ni sdug bsngal 'gyur/ khro bas gdungs na lam ngan 'gro bar byed/ /rang la phan 'dod bsgrub pa'ang brjed 'gyur zhing / /grags dang don grub pa las nyams 'gyur te/ /zla ba mar gyi ngo bzhin dpal las nyams/ khro bas mi rigasagayang sar lhung 'gyur te/ /mdza' bshes rnams kyis rab tu bzlog gyur kyang //38

nam ske 'a chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la du ka pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/phan dang gnod pa byed pa'i blo nyams nas/ /phal cher 'gal zhing sems ni rmongs par 'gyur/ khro bas sdig pa'i las ni goms byas pas/ /ngan song dag tu lo brgyar sdug bsngal myong / /gnod pa chen po byas pa'i sha gnyen ba'i/ /dgras kyang de las lhag pa ci byar yod/ khro ba 'di ni nang gi dgra/ /bdag gis de ltar shes nas ni/ /de yi mthu ni khro ba dag /skyes bu su zhig bzod par byed//de bas bdag ni gson bzhin du/ khro ba g.yos kyang ma shor te/ /phung bar byed pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /su zhig yal bar 'dor bar byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /'dod yon la dga' ba dang khyim la chags pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ rgya che rol pa las/ 'dod pa thams cad mi gcig gis thob kyang/ /des kyang tshim pa med pa ra da dung 'tshol/ /'dod pa bsten na slar yang sred pa 'phel/ /'dod pa'i khol po rnams ni gshags shing btub/ /ces dang / 'dod pa sdug bsngal rtsa ba ste / / bsam gtan dka' thub 'jig par byed/ /'dod nga lan tshwa'i chu 'thung bzhin/ /slar yang sred pa 'phel bar byed/ /ces dgasungs shing / skyes rabs las kyang / phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung / khyim na gnas pa nad che ste/ /gcig ni srung ba'i nyon mongs la/ /gnyis pa 'tshol ba'i sha thang ngo / /phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung / /gang na bde ba med bzhin du/ /rmongs te de la dga' ba ni/ /sdig pa'i 'bras bu smin pa bzhin/ /zhes dang / bsgrub dang bsrung sogs sprug bsngal nges pa can/ /'ching dang gsod pa'i sdug bsngal gzhir gyur pa'i/ /'byor pa'i rgyal po rnams kyang chog mi shes/ /char chu 'bab pa'i rgya mtsho mi ngoms bzhin/ /yongs su rtag pa'i dbang gis ma yin pa'i/ /'di las ji 59

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)ltar nam zhig ga la bde/ /rmongs pa'i yul na nye bar spyad pa yang / /me g.ya' phrugs pa'i bde ba bzhin du zad/ /gzhan yang / phal che ba ni 'di lta bu yin te/khyim na phal cher 'byor na rgyags pa dang / /rigs dang nga rgyal stobs kyis snyems 'gyur la/ /rgud na'ang khro dang zhus pa'i sdug bsngal can/ /de ni nam zhig rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar chags sdang skye ba'i yul dang / 'dod yon la zhen pa'i rnam rtog spangs nas rab tu dben pa'i dgon pa bsten par bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/ de ltar 'dod la skyo bya ste/ /dben pa la ni dga' ba skyed/ /rtsod dang nyon mongs kyis stongs pa'i/ /zhi ba'i nags kyi nang dag tu/ /skal ldan zla 'od tsan dan gyis bsil ba'i/ /yangs pa'i rdo leb khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /sgra med zhi ba'i nags rlung g.yo ba yis/ /gzhan la phan don sems shing 'chag par byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /dben pa'i saphyogs der gnas ci lta bu zhig tu 'dug par bya zhe na/ rgyan las/ blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang dang / /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes gsungs pas/bsod snyoms la sogs pa'i mthun rkyen legs par rnyed pa dang / chom rkun la sogs pa med pa'i gnas bzang ba dang / sa chu la sogs pa rkyen gyi nad mi 'byung ba'i gnas bzang ba dang / grogs chos ldan rang dang lta spyod mthun pa yod pa'i grogs bzang ba dang / nyin par skye bo 'dus pa'i rnam g.yeng med cing / mtshan mo sgra drag po mi grags pa rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na rnam g.yeng med cing dge sbyor 'phel ba'i gnas su 'dug par 60

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i spu chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/bya'o/ /de lta bu'i gnas su las dang po pa'i gang zag rnams skyes bu dam pa'i grogs la brten nas gnas par bya ste/ skyes rabs las/ dam pa'i skye bo susakyang mi srid ste/ /dul ba'i tshul gyis dge la bsnyen par bya/ /de dang nye na de yi yon tan rdul/ /ched du ma bsgrub par yang 'gos par 'gyur/ /dam pa rnamasadang lan cig tsam/ /ji ltar 'dod pa phrad kyang rung / /'dris par bya ba mi dgos par/ /rab tu brtan pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i grogs ma rnyed na rang nyid gcig pur 'dug par bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/'jig rten kun nas gdung bzhin du/ /ji srid skyes bu bzhi yis ni/ /de las de ni ma gtegs par/ /de srid du ni nags su song / /bshes med 'khon pa'ang med byas nas/ /lus ni gcig pu dben gnas te/ /snga nas shi dang 'drar brtsis nas/ khre na'ang mya ngan byed pa'ang med/ /drung na'ang 'khod pa su dag kyang / /mya ngan gnod pa byed med pas/ /de yis sangs rgyas rjes dran sogs/ /sus kyang g.yeng bar 'gyur ba med/ /de bas shin tu mdangs dga' bas/ /nags tshal tshegs chung bde skyid cing / /g.yeng ba thams cad zhi byed par/ /bdag nyid gcig pu gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dgon pa'i gnasader bsam pa ji lta bu zhig gis gnas par bya zhe na/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i sems can rnams bskyab par 'dod pa'i bsam pas gnas par bya ste/ skye rabs las/ yang dang yang du skye ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /rga dang rgud dang na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang / /'chi bar 'gyur snyam sems pa'i 'jig rten rnams/ /bskyab pa'i phyir na bdag ni de ltar gnas/ /zhes gsungs61

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)pa ltar ro/ /de ltar bsams nas dgon par gnas pa la yon tan mang du yod de / zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ rab tu byung nas chos spyod ci 'dra bar/ /zas dang sgom dang de bzhin gos rnams dang / /me tog spos dang phreng ba rnams kyis ni/khyu mchog rgyal la bsnyen bkur byas mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig byang chub rab tu 'dod byed cing / /'dus byas ngan pas yid 'byung sems can gyi/ /don du dgon par phyogs te gom bdun bor/ /'di ni de bas bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / nyes pa'i chos rnams thams cad spangs nas su/ /rnal 'byor can ni rtag tu byed pa nyung //rnal 'byor can brtson nam yang rtsod pa med/ /dgon par gnas pa de yi yon tan 'di/ /de ni rtag tu 'dus byas yid 'byung 'gyur/ /de ni 'jig rten ci la'ang 'dod pa med/ /zag pa rnams ni rnam par 'phel mi 'gyur/ /nags na gnas pa de yi yon tan 'di/ /de ni nam yang rtsod par mi 'gyur te/ /rtag tu zhi zhing dga' ba'i dben par rgyu/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rab bsdams 'gyur/ /dgon par gnas pa 'di la yon tan mang / /zhes gsungs so/ /dgon par gnas te chos la brtson par byas na ma bsgrub par yang bde ba dang mi bde ba du ma thob par 'gyur te/ skyes rabs las/ nags su bya ba ngan pa mang po btang / /yongs su gzung ba'i sdug bsngal spangs la gtsang / /zhi ba 'ba' zhig yid la byed cing mgu/ /bde dang bsod nams grags pa'ang thob par 'gyur/ /mi rnams chos kyis bsrung gi nor dang dpung gis min/ /chos kyis bde ba chen po 'thob kyis 'byor pas min/ /chosakyi bdag nyid can ni shi na dga' bar 'gyur/ /chos la 'bad pa ngan 'gro'i 62

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/'jigs pa med par 'gyur/ /las kyi khyad par dag kyang ji bzhin gnas/ /dge dang sdig pa'i mtshan nyid tha dad de/ /mi dge'i rnam par smin pas ngan 'gror lhung / /bsod nams bsags pa bde ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dgon pa'i gnas der dam pa'i chos de nyams su len pa la tsha grang dang bkres skom la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bzod pa gal che ste/ spyod 'jug las/ nya pa gdol pa zhing pa la sogs pa/ /rang gi 'tsho ba tsam zhig sems pa yang / /grang dang tsha la sogs pa'i gnod bzod na/ /'gro ba bde phyir bdag lta cis mi bzod/ /ces dang / rang bzhin 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyur pa'i nyon mongs dag /g.yul ngor bdar tshe nan gyis gzhom par 'dod pa yang / /mda' mdung mtshon gyis phog pa'i sdug bsngal khyad bsad nas/ /don ma grub par phyir phyogs 'byor par mi byed na/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal kun gyi rgyur 'gyur ba / / rang bzhin dgrar des gzhom brtson bdag la deng / /sdug bsngal brgya phrag rgyur 'gyur gang gis kyang / /yi chad skyid lug mi 'gyur smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar nyams su len pa la brtson 'grus shin tu gal che ste/spyod 'jug las/ de ltar bzod pas brtson 'grus brtsom/ /'di ltar brtson la byang chub gnas/ /rlung med g.yo ba med pa bzhin/ /bsod nams brtson 'grus med mi 'byung / /brtson gang dge la spro ba'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / de yi mi mthun phyogs bshad bya/ /le lo ngan la zhen pa dang / /skyid lug bdag nyid brnyas pa dang / /snyom las bde ba'i ro myang dang / /gnyid la brten pa'i sred pa yis/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi skyo la/ /le lo nye bar skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes63

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)gsungs pas/ le lo nam skyes pa na dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba dang / rnyed pa'i dus 'dir le lo spangs nas dge ba sgrub par 'dod pa'i blo bskyed dgosate / spyod 'jug las/ mi yi gru la bsten nas ni/ /sdug bsngal chu bo che lasasgrol/ /gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log/ces gsungs shing / skyes rabs las kyang / de bsand med brgya yi gnas/ /lus 'di sdug bsngal nyam thag pa/ /'di rnams 'phongs las sgrol ba yi/ /gzings su 'gyur ba bdag gis bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dge ba phyis byas pasachog go snyam na/ nyis long skabs yod pa'i nges pa med de/ spyod 'jug las/nyon mongs rgya bas bshor nas ni/ /skye ba'i rgyar ni chud gyur nas/ /'chi bdag khar ni song gyur pa/ /ci ste da dung mi shes sam/ /rang sde rim gyis gsod pa yang / khyod kyis mthong bar ma gyur tam/ /'on kyang gnyid la bsnyen pa gang / /gdol pa dang ni ma he bzhin/ /lam ni kun nas bkag nas su/ /'chi bdag gis ni bltas bzhin du/ /ji ltar khyod ni za dga' zhing / /'di ltar gnyid log ji ltar dga'/ /myur ba nyid du 'chi 'gyur bas/ /de srid du ni tshogs bsagasabya / / de tshe le lo spangs kyang ni/ /dus ma yin pas ci zhig bya/ /'di ni ma byasabartsams pa dang / /'di phyed byas par gnas pa las/ /glo bur 'chi bdag 'ongs nas ni/ /kye shud bcom zhes sems par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing /skyes rabs las/ 'gro ba 'di lta bu ni 'khod pa la/ /skye bo 'jigs pa med par ngo mtshar skye/ /lam rnams thams cad 'chi bdag gis bkag kyang / /dogs pa med par rab tu dga' zhing spyod/ /na dang rga dang 'chi ba'i gnod byed 64

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/dgra/ /mthu chen dgag tu mi nus yod bzhin du/ /'jig rten pha rol nyam nga ra nges 'gro na/ /sems shes su zhig 'di la dga' bar sems/ /sprin chen gser phreng 'dra ba'i glog 'byug cing / /rgya mtsho chen po 'dra ba'i sgra 'byin la/ /char chen 'bebs pa'i rtsom pa drag byed pa/ /kun nas 'dus kyang de nas dengs par 'gyur/ /'bab chu drag po'i shugs kyis shing rnams kyi/ /rtsa ba 'gram na zab tu zug pa yang / /rtsad nas bton te slar yang chu de nyid/ /rim gyis phri nas mya ngan gdung ba bzhin/ /rlung gi mthus kyang ri yi rtse mo bsnyil/ /sprin gyi tshogs kyang drag po'i shugs kyis gtor/ /rgya mtsho'i chu yang rnam par dmigs shing klongs//de lta'i rlung yang rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /me lce rab 'bar me stag 'phro ba yis//nags tshal mdzes dang rto rnams kun bsregs nas/ /rab tu 'bar bar gyur pa de 'dra yi/ /me yang rim gyis zhi ste med par 'gyur/ /'dus pa gang zhig bral bar ma gyur yod/ /dar ba gang zhig rgud par ma gyur yod/ /'gro ba rnams ni rab tu mi brtan yang / /ma brtag par ni skye bo dga' bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang /dang po mngal du zhugs pa'i nub mo nyid/ /deng nas brtsams te 'jig rten 'di rnams ni/ /lam du zhugs nas lam gzhan ma gol bar/ /'chi bdag drung du de ni nye bar 'gro/ /thabs dang rab tu ldan zhing mthu yod kyang / /'chi dang rga lasasu yang thar pa med/ /ces pa dang / 'di gnyis kyis ni 'di kun rab tu mnar//de bas chos kyi don du nags su 'gro/ /mi rta gling chen shing rta mang po'i dmag tshogs rnams/ /rgyal po dpung dang ldan pas thag thog med par thob/ /gshin rje dgra ni gcig bur 'dug kyang yongs mi thul/ /de bas bdag blo chos la 65

ga tshe chen 'od snang la /sa lha'i chos nga gces bsdus/ 9)'bad blo skyed par 'gyur/ rta dang glang chen rkang thang shing rtas yongs bsrung na//rgyal po rnams ni dgra las rnam par thar bar 'gyur/ stobs ldan dpung dpre bcas pa rnams kyang dbang med par/ /rab tu mthu chen 'chi bdag dgra yisadabang du 'gyur/ /glang chen spyo ba'i mche bas mkhar gyi rta babs dang / /g.yul ngor mi dang shing rta glang po rnams kyang 'joms/ /gad pa chen po'i ngos dral rgyal bar gyur pa yi/ /mche ba de yis gshin rje'i khar song 'debs mi nus/ /go mtshon bzang po bgos shing phub bzung nas/ /g.yul ngor rgyang rings mda' yang 'phen par gyur/ /de 'dra'i 'phong skyen pas kyang 'khon rnying can/ /dgra bo gshin rje la ni 'phen mi nus/ /seng ge rnams kyang sder mo rnon pos glang chen gyi / / gzi brjed zil gnon spyi bo'i bum pa dral zhing dbang / /sgra skad drag po grags pas gzhan gyi sems skrag byed/ /'chi bdag 'ongs nas mthu dang grags pa nyams nas nyal/ /rgyal po rnams kyang gzhan gyis nyes byas nas/ /nyes dang rjes su mthun par chad pas gcod/ /'chi bdag dgra la nyes pa cher byas kyang / /chad pas gcad pa'i thabs ni yongs mi bsham/ /rgyal po rnams ni mjal 'dum la sogs pa'i/ /thabs kyis nyes pa byas pa zhi bar byed/ /'chi bdag gtum po dregs pa goms byas la/ /mjal dum la sogs pas ni bsdam mi nus/ /sbrul chen khros pa'i rlung gis mche ba dug chen gyi/ /rtse mo 'bar dres mi rnams mngon du 'bigs byed cing / sha la chags pas gsod pa'i thabs la mkhas gyur kyang / /'chi bdag 'ongs nas za ba'i rtsol ba nyams par 'gyur/ /sbrul gdug khros nas 'khrug pas zin pa'i dug rnams kyang / /sman pa rnams 66

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa ba gas/kyis sngags dang sman gyis zhi bar byed/ /gshin rje 'di ni myur ba'i dug lasarab gdug pas/ /sngags dang sman la sogs pas thub par yongs mi nus/ /'dab bzang khyung yang gshog pa'i rlung gis rgya mtsho'i chu/ /nya mang 'phyo ba 'byug sgra grags pas dkrugs pa yang / /rnam par gtor nas gdengs ka 'phyar ba'i klu rnams 'dzin/ /de bzhin 'chi bdag rab tu gzhom par yongs mi nus/ /stag kyang nags tshal dag tu ri dwags bros pa rnams/ /rab tu mgyogs pasabasnyabs nas sder mo'i rdo rje yis/ /thang gcig btab pa tsam gyis bzungasanas khrag 'thung na/ /'chi bdag 'ong na de ltar brtul phod med par 'gyur/ /stag gis kha gdangs mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa yi/ /nang du song ba'i ri dwagasarnams kyang thar ba srid/ /gshin rjes kha gdangs na dang rga ba'i mche ba gcigs/ /de yi nang du song ba su zhig thar ba yod/ /mi sdug 'jigs rung gdon gyis mi rnams kyang / /bzung ste srog dang lhan cig mdangs kyang 'phrog/'chi bdag dgra dang 'thab mo'i dus ran la/ /rab tu dregs pa'i mthu rtsal nyams par 'gyur/ /mchod 'dod gnod byed 'ongs pa'i gdon rnams dang / /rigs sngags grub pa rnams kyi mthu dag kyang / /dka' thub bde legs sman gyis zhi bar nus/ /'chi bdag gdon ni bzlog par yongs mi nus/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis mang po 'dus pa yi/ /skye bo rnams kyi mig kyang bslu bar nus/ /gshin rje 'di la med kyi mthu zhig yod/ /de dag gis kyang mig bslu yongs ma nus/ /gsang sngags grub pa'i dka' thub mthu yis dug zhi nus/ /sman pa mchog gis mi yi nad kyang zhi bar nus/ /'chi bdag la sogs zhi ba yang ni 67

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (4)yong mi nus/ /de bas chos phyir bdag blo bas mthar 'gro la mos/ /rigasasngags 'chang rnams gsang sngags mthu stobs sna tshogs kyis/ /mngon du 'byung zhing slar yang bar bar mi snang 'gyur/ /bar bar mkha' la 'gro zhing bar bar sa 'og 'gro/ /'chi bdag byung na mthu stobs rab tu nyams par 'gyur/ /lha dbang dregs pa rnams kyang lha min dmag gis bzlog /lha dbang dregs pa rnams kyang lha yid dpung gis bzlog /'gas rkang gcig hor dag kun bstongasapas kyang 'chi bdag yongs mi thub/ /ces gsungs so/ /de la sogs pa rnam grangs du ma'i sgo nas nges par 'chi ba dran par byas la 'jig rten 'dir snang gi rnam rtog dang 'du 'dzi la dga' ba'i blo spang bar bya ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba'i mdo las/ 'dod chags spangs shing zhe sdang rab spangs nas/ /rnal 'byor can ni 'du 'dzir mi gnas te/ /de ni de la gzhol zhing de la 'bab/ /nyes pa de ni dga' bar byed mi 'gyur/ /rgod dang de bzhin bshad gad rnam rtog pa / / 'di dag thams cad 'du 'dzi rnams las byung/ /snying po med pa'i 'du 'dzi su byed pa/ /de ni lang long spyod cing ma bsdams yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bsam gtan gyi g.yeng rkyen don med kyi long gtam smra ba spang bar bya ste/ mdo de nyid las/ byis pa dag ni 'jig rten gtam la dga'/ /byis pa de dag mchog gi gtam las nyams/ /zhe sdang 'phel zhing rnam rtog shas kyang che/ /nyesapa des na de la mi chags so/ /rigs pa ma yin smra la dga' bskyed nas/ /dge slong thos pa rnam par 'phel mi byed/ /de lta bas na mi rigs smra spongs la/ /chos la rtag tu dga' ba thob par gyis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rang gzhan gnyis68

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/gnyes pa'i rgyu grogs kyi skyon nas brjod pa spang bar bya ste/ de nyid las/ yon tan 'dod na nags na gnas pa yis/ /pha rol dag gi skyon la brtag mi bya/ /bdag ni khyad par 'phags shing bdag mchog ces/ /de snyam du ni sems bskyed mi bya'o/ /rgyags ni bag med kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /dge slong dman la brtas par yongs mi bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bas na tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i grogs la byams shing snying nye bar bya ste/ skyes rabs las/ mdza' bo rnams la sems shing byams na grags pa thob/ /yid brtan rim gro byed pa'i bde ba'ang de las thob//yang dag grogs kyi yon tan thob cing yid kyang 'phrog/dgra rnams kun gyis mi tshugs mtho ris thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungasaso / / gzhan ma dad cing rang gi byang sems nyams pa'i rgyu spros pa ste 'thab mo la dga' ba spang bar bya ste/ mdo de nyid las/ gang na spros pa'am rtsod pa yod pa las/ /dpag tshad brgya yi pha rol 'gro ba mchog /gang la nyon mongs yod pa de dag tu/ /yud tsam zhig kyang gnas shing 'dug mi bya/ /rab byung don 'dod yon tan 'dod pa rnams/ /sdang ba'i sems kyis rtsod pa ma byed cig khyed la zhing med zhing la tshong bya med/ /gang la nor phyir 'di dag 'byung bas spros/ /zhes pa dang / zhi zhing rab tu zhi ba bsten pa yis/ /ngur smig gos dag dad pasablangs nas ni/ /zhi zhing rab zhi nye bar zhi bar byos/ /spros pa rnam par spongs la bzod pa bskyed/ /mi bzod sems ni sbrul gdug 'dra ba srungs/ /spros la spyod pa sems can dmyal ba dang / /dud 'gro gshin rje'i yul dang ring mi 'gyur/ /de lta bsan bzod dang brtson 'grus bskyed/ /ces gsungs so/ /69

brtse 'a 'od snang la /sa ci'i chos 'gung shes bsdus/ 9)dus tshod ma yin pa'i gnyid la dga' ba spang bar bya ste/ de nyid las/ gang zhig gnyid dang rmugs la dga' 'gyur ba/ /de yi shes rab shin tu nyam chung 'gyur/ /de yi blo yang yongs su nyams par 'gyur/ /ye shes las ni rtag tu de nyams 'gyur/ /gang zhig rmugs dang gnyid la dga' 'gyur ba/ /mi shes le lo snyoms las shes rab 'chal/ /de la mi ma yin pas glags rnyed de/ /nags na gnas pa'i tshe na'ang 'tshe bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa nas/ gang zhig rmugs dang gnyid la dga' 'gyur ba/ /bdag nyid mi shes le lo can gyur nas/ /brtson 'grus stobs dang ldan la phrag dog byed/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa rnams la mi snyan smra/ /zhes gsungs so/ /snyan grags dang bsnyen bkur thob pa la dga' ba'i blo spang bar bya ste/ 'od srungs kyi le'u las/ lta 'gyur 'ching dang rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /grags pa'i 'ching ba rab tu 'byung ba yis/ /'ching ba dam zhes 'phags pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /de dag rtag tu rab tu byung bas spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /yang dben pa'i gnas su zas dang gos dang gnas mal dang / sman la sogs pa'ang ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa gal che ste/ skyes rabs las/ mang du thos la snyegs pa med/ /'byor pa rnams la ser sna med/ /nags tshal gnas la chog shes pa/ /yon tan rgyan gyi mchog yin no/ /zhes dang /chog shes nges pa'i bdag nyid can//'tsho ba gang na'ang btsal mi dga'//cadang lo ma chu yi gnas/ /gang na'ang med pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing /bshes spring las/ nor rnams kun gyi nang nas chog shes pa/ /rab mchog lags par lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/ /kun tu chog shes mdzod cig chog 70

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen kha nga dang bcas pa bzhugs/mkhyen na/ /nor mi bdog kyang yang dag 'byor pa lags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gal te rang nges 'byung gi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing dge ba'i phyogs la brtson pa lhur byed pa yin la/ bsgrub pa'i tshe na tshegs dang 'bad rtsol gyis bsgrub mi dgos shing / longs spyod pa'i tshe na chags zhen dang mngon zhen drag po mi skye na gos kar+sha pa ni 'bum ri ba dang / khang pa brtsegs pa khang mig lnga brgya pa dang / kha zas ro brgya pa dang sman bzang po la yang longs spyod pas chog ste/ 'dul ba las/ 'dod pa bsod snyoms kyi mtha' dang / ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' gnyis ka spang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rang nyams su mi len zhing gzhan la mi phan bzhin du rnyed grags la sogs pa'i don du chos smra ba spang bar bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/ lus kyis 'di dag spyad par bya/ /tshig tsam brjod pas ci zhig 'grub/ /sman dpyad klags pa tsam gyis ni/ /nad pa dag la phan 'gyur ram/ /zhes gsungs sa shing / dgongs pa ngebs 'grel las/'dod phyir su dag dam chos ston byed pa/ /de dag 'dod pa btang ba phyir len te / / myos pa de dag thang med rin chen chos/ /thos par gyur kyang sprang po rgyu bar byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /rang 'du 'dzi nyung zhing dben par gnas pa'i nga rgyal byed cing / gzhan de dang mi ldan pa rnams la brnyas shing de dag la smod pa spang bar bya ste/ mdo bsdad pa las/ rab tu dben pa'i grong dang grong khyer ri sul dang / /dgon pa dben pa nags khrod rab tu bsnyen byed cing / /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /bdud kyis yongs su bslus zhing blo chung rigs par bya/ /rtag tu grong dang yul 'khor grong mthar gnas byed 71

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)cing / /sems can smin byed byang chub brtson pa ma gtogs pa/ /de ni dgra bcom rang rgyal 'dod pa gzhan mi bskyed/ /de ni bde bar gshegs kyi sras kyi dben par gsungs/ /gang zhig dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa'i ri yi sul/ /sprul gyis gang ba lo mang bye ba gnas byed kyang / /dben pa 'di mi shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnyed nas 'dre bar gnas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na gnas skabs thams cad du rang gzhan gyi 'byor rgud dang / 'du 'bral la sogs pa mthong ba'i chos rnams la rjes su dpagasanas 'khor ba la yid 'byung drag po bskyed pa dang / tshe yang glog ltar g.yo zhing mi brtan pa'i ngang tshul can du shes nas rang gi sgo gsum gyi spyod pa la yang dang yang du brtags te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang skyes bu dam pa rnam bas kyi thugs kyis bas par mi 'gyur ba'i thabs la bslab par bya ste/skyes rabs las/ 'du ba gang yod mtha' ni bral 'gyur la/ /dar ba yod na ngan zhing rgud pa mtha'/ /tshe yang glog ltar 'gyur zhing mi brtan pas/ /de phyir bag yod pa yis brtan par gyis/ /zhes pa dang / de ltar bdag ni skyon la dad gyur zhing / /yon tan khyad du bsad pa'i tshul ngan na/ /dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyis khrel bar 'gyur/ /de ltar gyur na gson yang ci zhig rung / /zhes gsungs shing / spyod 'jug las kyang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /kun tu thogs med gzigs par ldan/ /de dag thams cad spyan snga na/ /bdag ni rtag par gnas so zhes/ /de ltar bsam nas ngo tsha dang / /gus dang 'jigs ldan de bzhin mnos/ /des ni sangs rgyas rjes dran pa'ang / /de la yang dang 72

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/yang du 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar skyon gyi chos thams cad spangs nasa'adi dang phyi ma'i bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad med du byung ba'i yon tan la brten nas 'byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir yon tan gyi chos bsgrub pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya ste/ skyes khar bas las/ med du med pa mi yi lus su skyes gyur zhing / /de bzhin dbang po rnams kyang ma nyams blo dang ldan/ /'on kyang 'chi bdag de bzhin legs pa mi byed pa/ /bag med rnams ni nyin re bzhin yang bslu bar 'gyur/ /rab tu sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs ma sbyangs na/ /rigasadang gzugs dang lang tsho'i yon tan ldan rnams dang / /stobs ni rab tu che zhing nor gyis phyug gyur kyang / /phyi ma'i tshe la sus kyang bde ba thob mi 'gyur/ /rigs la sogs pa dman yang sdig la ma chags shing / /sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs yon tan ldan pa rnams/ /dbyar gyi dus na 'bab chus rgya mtsho gang ba bzhin/ /phyi ma'i tshe la'ang nges par bde ba rgyas par 'gyur/ /rigs dang gzugs kyi yon tan rnams dang ni/ /stobs dang ldan zhing nor gyis phyug pa rnams la yang / /yon tan yod na tshe 'di la yang mdzes 'gyur te/ /gser gyi phreng ba phyug po rnams la mdzes pa bzhin/ /me tog rnams ni ljon pa'i shing gi rgyan du 'gyur/ /glog phreng 'gyu ba char sprin rnams kyi rgyan du 'gyur/ /bung ba myos shing 'du ba pad+ma'i mtsho yi rgyan/ /yon tan khyad par 'phags pa lus can rnams kyi rgyan/ /nad med tshe ring nor dang gzugs dang rigs rnams ni/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma'i bye brag sna tshogs pa'i/ /skye bo 'di dag ngo bo nyid las gyur pa yin/ /gzhan gyis bskyed min las ni rnam par gsum las 'gyur/ /73

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (() 'gro ba'i chos nyid 'di ltar tsho nges par gnas pa dang / /srog kyang mi brtan 'chi dang nye bar shes nas ni/ /dge ba'i phyogs la brten nas sdig pa spang bar bgyi/ /grags dang bde ba thob pa'i lam ni 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dkar po'i chos kyi yon tan thams cad dad pa la brten nas 'byung ba'i phyir/yul gyi yon tan la dad pa dang / de thob par 'dod pa dang / las 'bras la yid ches pa'i dad pa bskyed pa gal che ste/ dkon mchog sgron ma'i mdo las/dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar skyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad srung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pa bde ba'i grong khyer mtshon pa yin/ /che'i(bya ba la sogs pa dang / skyes rabs las kyang / dge dang mi dge'i las la 'jig rten pha rol tu/ /bde dang sngag bsngal 'byung bar rab tu nges pa rnams/ /sdig pa spangs te dge ba'i las zlo 'bad mod kyi/ /dad pa med na ji ltar bde ba'i lam du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs so/ khyad par du theg pa chen po'i lam la bsnyen pa'i yon tan thams cad snying rje las byung ba'i phyir/sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi 'byor pa thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis shin tu brnag par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal gsum dang / de dag gi rgyu ma rig pa'i mun pas rmongs pa'i sems can rnams sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las skyob par 'dod pa'i snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba gal che ste/ rgyan las/ snying rje chen po yon tan 'byung gnas kyi/ /sems can rnams la snying rje su mi byed/ /'di ltar de dag las ni sdug bsngal yang / /brtse bskyed bde ba gzhal du med pa 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /skyes rabs las kyang / snying rjes non pa'i sems74

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen 'a sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/kyis gzhan la gnod pa byed mi 'gyur/ /gtsang ma de yi lus dang ngag kyang gzhan du 'gyur ba med/ /de ltar byed pa gzhan la phan 'dod de yi dga' ba 'phel/ /sbyin dang bzod la sogs pa'i yon tan yod na yon tan yin/ /snying rje yod na nye bar zhi bas gzhan gyi yid mi 'byin/ /snying rje yod na skye bo rnams kyi gnyen zhing yid brtan 'gyur/ /snying rje'i dbang gyur snying la 'thab mo'i 'khrugs pa yod mi 'gyur/ /snying rje'i chu brlan sems la 'khrugs pa'i me 'bar yong mi 'gyur/ /mdor na gzigs shig mkhas shing brtan pa'ang snying rje'i chos la brten/ /dge la dga' ba'i yon tan can rnams snying rje mi bsten su / / zhes gsungs so/ /de bas na tshe 'di'i phun sum tshogs pa gang la'ang ma chags shing / srid pa'i bde ba thams cad rmi lam gyi yul gyi dga' skyid dang 'dra bar shes nas yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la dad pa dang / dman pa rnams la snying rje'i bsam pa lhag par brtas pa'i dbang gis snying thag pa nas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi ched du dam pa'i chos sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag des/gang la brten nas ston pa gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog par ngan 'gro dang srid zhi'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag las skyob par nus shing / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum po kho na yin par nges pa'i shes pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ de dag la bdag dang sems can thams cad byang chub kyi snying po la reg gi bar gyi skyabs gnas zhu bar 'dod pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig pas skyabs su 'gro ba gal che ste/75

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)yab sras mjal ba las/ byang chub dam pa don du gnyer slad du/ /skyabs kyi dam pa rab tu mi bslu ba/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten mi 'jigs stsol ba po/ khyed la bdag ni nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /gang la dga' ba'i yid kyis skyabs song na / / log lhung dag tu lhung bar mi 'gyur ba/ /de la bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /dpe med byang chub 'tshol ba'i slad du'o/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dag ni bshig bcom zhing / /mya ngan las brgal nyon mongs dag 'gyur la/ /'dren pa gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa/ khyod la bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de bas na dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bya ba dang spyod lam ci byed kyang dkon mchog la blo ling bkal nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bsam sbyor thams cad sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gro ba zhig dkon mchog mkhyen snyam du rtse gcig tu yid la bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro 'di ni blo chos su 'gro bar byed pa'i thabs khyad par can yin pas lam gyi sngon 'gro yin la / tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs kyi mchog yin pas lam gyi dngos gzhi'ang yin nyid / lam gyi bar chad thams cad sel ba'i gegs sel gyi mchog kyang yin no/ /de ltar yang rgyan las skyabs su 'gro ba 'dir song don che ste/ /des ni tshad med yon tan tsho gos 'phel byed/ /'gro ba 'di la snying rje'i bsam pas khyab/ /mtshungs med 'phags mchog chos kyang rgyas par byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu'i gtso bo theg pa chen po'i lam gyi dngos gzhi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa'i nying khu stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub kyi sems 76

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/bsgom pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /de yang gang zhe na/ rgyud las/ stong nyid nga rje tha dad med/ /gang du sems ni rnam sgom pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun gyi yang bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing mgon po byams pas/bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bcad de/ /sems can sred phyir brtse ldan zhi thob min/ /de ltar blo brtse byang chub thabs bsten nas/ /'phagasapa 'khor ba'i mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub skyes kyang /bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis/ /bla med byang chub thob 'dod na/ /de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang / /phyogs mthas gtugs sa pa'i snying rje dang / /gnyis(la mi brten ye shes lags/ /che'i gsung ba'iso / / de'i don nyams su len pa la/ snying rje dang / byang chub kyi sems dang /gnyis su med pa'i blo ste gsum gyi/ dang po snying rje la dbye na/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'am bdag dang brdeg gir 'dzin pa'i dbang gis khams gsum du zo chun gyi 'phrul 'khor 'phyan pa ltar/ rang dbang med par 'khyams pa'i semasacan rnams la dmigs nas/ rnam pa sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob par 'dod pa sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang /shin tu dwangs pa'i chu nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shar ba rlung gis bskyod pa na skad cig re re bzhin gzugs brnyan chu dang bcas pa 'jig pa ltar 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgya mtshor ma rig pa'i chu sngon po'i nang du rnam rtog gi rlung gis bskyod pa'i dbang gis rang gi las kyi gzugs brnyan lta bur snang ba rnams skad cig re re la yang g.yo zhing mi rtag pa'i sems can la dmigs nas/ rnam pa 77

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)'du byed kyi sdug bsngal las skyob par 'dod pa chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang / dpe snga ma de nyid la zla ba rang bzhin gyis stong par nges pa ltar/ semasacan du snang yang sems can rang bzhin gyis stong par shes te de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la dmigs nas/ rnam pa phyin ci log gi rnam rtog las skyob par 'dod pa dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'i snying rje bsgom par bya ste/ de dag kyang 'jug pa las/ dang por nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing / /bdag gi 'di zhes dngos la chags bskyed pas/ /zo chun 'phyan ltar rang dbang med pa yi / / 'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud/ /'gro ba g.yo ba chu yi nang gi zla ba ltar/ /g.yo dang rang bzhin nyid kyis stong par mthong ba yi/ /rgyal ba'i srasapo 'di yi sems gang 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam par grol bar bya phyir snying rje'i dbang gyur cing / /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na snying rje gsum du bzhag pa ni/dmigs pa'i sgo nas so sor phye ba yin la/ rnam pa ni gsum char yang sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las skyob par 'dod pa'i blo tsam du mtshungs te/ de nyid las/ sdug bsngal can rnams yongs skyob pa/ /thugs rje chen po'o zhes dang /'grel pa las kyang / thugs rje chen po ni sems can sdug bsngal bar gyur pa yongs su skyob pa'i mtshan nyid can no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems ni bshad ma thag pa'i snying rje gsum gyi dbang du byas pa la brten nas/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad srid zhi'i rgud pa las skyob pa'i slad du rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po thob par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa drag pos/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i bslab par bya bar rnams la yang slob par khas 'che ba ste/ sgom 78

dam pa ḍi chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/rim dang por/ 'gro ba kun la phan pa'i ched du sangs rgyas su gyur cig ces gang thog mar don du gnyer ba de ni smon pa'i sems so/ /gang phan chad sdom pa bzungs te tshogs rnams la zhugs pas ni 'jug pa'i sems so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis su med pa'i blo ni/ de ltar bdag gis 'gro ba mtha' dag rdzo gas pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya'o/ /zhes sems bskyed cing dam bcas pa de yang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang bral na mi 'grub pas/ de'i 'og tu gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi mtshan nyid can gyi don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi sems de yang sems rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas la brten nas 'byung bas/ thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyi sgo na bang zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i rim pa rnams la bslab par bya'o/ /de yang spyod 'jug las/zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni/ /'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar zhi gnas grub nas thog mar nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po gang zag gi bdag med dang / de nas shes sgrib kyi gnyen po chos kyi bdag med sgom pa'o/ /de la gang zag gi bdag med bsgom tshul ni/ ma brtag gcig pu nyams dga' ba'i dbang du byasanas nye bar len pa'i phung po la dmigs te nga dang nga yir zhes 'dzin pa ni 'brul pa'o snyam du bsam mo/ /de'i rgyu mtshan/ bdag ces bya ba de yod na de ming ngam/ lus sam/ sems gang yin/ ming ni glo bur du btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyir bdag ma yin/ lus ni sha khrag la sogs pa du ma 'dus pa'i phung po 79

'tshe na 'od snang la/gci'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)la btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyir bdag ma yin zhing / spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar gyi phyi nang gang na'ang bdag med/ sems ni 'das pa'i sems 'gagam 'ongs pa'i sems ma skyes da ltar ba'i sems de ma thag tu 'gag par 'gyur ba'i phyir bdag tu mi rung ngo / /des na bdag ces bya ba ni gzhi med la 'khrul pa kho nar zad do/ /zhes yang dang yang du yid la bya'o/ /de ltar yang rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa'i mdo las/ ming ni bdag ma yin te btags pa tsam/ /lus ni bdag ma yin te sha rus rnams/ /'byung chen 'dus pa phyi rol rtsigs pa 'dra/ /sems kyang bdag ma yin te dngos por med/ /ces gsungasaso / / chos kyi bdag med bsgom tshul ni/ phyi nang gi chos ji ltar snang ba dang / ji ltar myong ba 'di dag thams cad la brtags pa'i blo la snang zhing myong yang / rnam par brtags na gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i phyir rang bzhin med la/ rang bzhin med bzhin du snang ba rmi lam dang 'dra zhing / de ltar snang ba'i chos de dag la dmigs nas dge ba dang mi dge ba dang / bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang /'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa kun tu 'byung ba'i phyir/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i gzhir gyur pa ni sems yin la/ sems de yang rnam par dpyad na kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub/ gcig dang du ma dang bral/ phyi dang nang dang gnyis kyi bar na mi gnas pa'i phyir rang gi ngo bo med pa de la/ mtha' dang dbus dgag rgyu med pa'i phyir dus gsum las rnam par grol lo/ /de ltar mtha' dang dbus med cing spros pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba de nyid la sems kyi chos nyid ces bya la chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin yang de nyid yin 80

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bsnan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/zhing / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku'i ngo bo yang de nyid do zhes spros pa bcad la sems yod med dang yin min la sogs pa gang du yang mi 'dzin pas spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /de yang dang po ma goms pa'i tshe sems kyi 'phro 'du sna tshogs byung yang / rim gyis goms pa'i tshe nang du sems gsal zhing mi rtog pa dang / phyi rol yul gyi snang cha ma 'gag bzhin du mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral zhing / rtog pas ma spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur la/ ting nge 'dzin de nyid rgyu bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyis bskrun pas 'jig rten pa'i lam bsgrod de/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i sgrib pa rnams spangs nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa mthong ba'i lam gyi ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mnyam gzhag las ldang ba na/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can 'di rnams mi shes pa'i mun pa dang / las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral na ci ma rung snyam du snying rje yang dang yang du bsgom la/ de ltar bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag la brten nas bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig snyam du bsam zhing / bsngo ba dang smon lam la sogs pa ci nus pa bya'o/ /rjes kyi gnas skabs su'ang chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sgyu ma'i snang ba ltar dran par byas la gang la yang chags pa dang sdang ba med par longs spyad par bya'o/ /gal te nad dang gdon la sogs pa'i 'gal rkyen byung na gang byung rang bzhin med par shes pa'am/gzhan gyi rkyen ngan thams cad bdag la len pa'am/ dkon mchog la blo gtad 81

ba tshe nan 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni 'gal rkyen thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gyur ba yin pas de rnams la 'bad pa rtsal du gdon par bya'o/ /de ltar byas kyang lam du mi lhongs shing srog dang dge sbyor gyi bar chad du 'gyur na/ sman la sogs pa bsten pas de dag bar chad mi 'gyur ba shes na sman sngags la sogs pa la yang bsten par bya ste/ dge slong sman dang sman pa ma bsten pas srog dang dge ba'i bar chad du 'gyur ba rnams spang ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang sman dang sman pa bsten pa'i tshul bstan pa yin nyid / bslab ba yis las/ dge slong dgon pa bas sbrul dang chom rkun la sogs pa bsrung ba'i sngags zlos par gsungs so/ /bsam gtan bsgoms pas sangs rgyas kyi sku mthong ba dang lung ston pa la sogs pa byung na de dag la brten nas byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'phel zhing dge sdig gi blang dor la brtson par gyur na yon tan yin zhing /byang chub kyi sems gnyis rka'am gang rung las nyams par gyur la/ rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod na skyon yin pas de dag gang yin brtag pa'i man ngag gis kyang brtags la ngo shes par byas te lam du blang ngo / /spyir brtag thabs kyang gong gi de rnams su 'dus shing nyes pa spong ba'i thabs kyang byang chub sems gnyis bsgom pa dang dus rtag tu dkon mchog la blo gtod pa rnams yin no/ /de ltar snying rje chen pos gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa dang / shes rab chen pos chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dngos su nyan bshad dang sgom sgrub la sogs pa thabs shes rab kyi cha gang nyams su blangs kyang thabs shes zung 'brel du 'gyur ba yin pas/ de ltar 82

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstar pa 'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/shes nas nyams su blang bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas thob pa la thabs shes zung 'brel dgos par bka' dang bstan bcos du ma nas gsungs so/ /gsum pa bshad sgrub byas pa'i 'bras su bshad pa ni/ slob pa lam gyi skabs su lung gi chos mang du thos shing 'dzin pa las mthar thug me long lta bu'i ye shes dang /bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes bsgoms pa las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / gzhan la yang dag pa'i chos bstan pa las so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang / gzhan gyi don gyi bya ba bsgrubs pa las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rnams thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar yang rgyan las/ 'dzin pa'i phyir dang semasamanyam phyir/ /yang dag chos rab ston phyir dang / /bya ba grub pa nyid kyi phyir/ /ye shes bzhi po yang dag 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan la 'jug pa'i tshul/ /de nyid gzigs pa rnams kyi bzhed gzhung bzhin/ /de la gus pa'i yid kyis bkod pa ste/ /de yi dge bas thub bstan rgyas gyur cig/dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen las/ bsod namaX ༷skyed pa'i ched du bstan pa la bya ba bsgrub tshul bshad pa'i skabs te dang pa///ga/nga/ la brten nas thog med 'khor ba nas/ /lan brgyar bsagasapa'i sgrib gnyis mun pa'i tshogs/ /sel mkhas thub dbang nyi ma la btud de/ /des gsungs dam chos byung tshul bshad kyis nyon/ /gnyis pa yid ches bskyed pa'i ched du bstan pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la/ ston pa sangs rgyas byon tshul/bstan pa dam chos dar tshul/ de nyid bod du byung tshul lo/ /dang po la/ spyir 83

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)'jig rten du sangs rgyas byon tshul/ khyad par mi mjed du byon tshul/ dgos 'dzam bu gling du byon tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ spyir sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'gron pa la rgyu gsum tshang dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa/ byang sems kyi tshogs bsags pa/ gdul bya'i khams smin pa ste gsum 'dzom na sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon gyi gzhan mi 'byon no/ /de yang sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa'i bskal pa la sgron ma'i bskal pa zhes zer la/ mi 'byon pa'i bskal pa la mun pa'i bskal pa zhes zer ro/ /sgron bskal yang da ltar gyi bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byon la/ de'i rjes su mun bskal drug cu rtsa lnga / de nas snyan pa chen po zhes bya ba'i sgron bskal la sangs rgyas khri/ de'i rjes su mun bskal brgyad cu/ de nas skar ma lta bu zhes bya ba'i sgron bskal la sangs rgyas brgyad khri/ de'i rjes su mun bskal sum brgya/ de nas yon tan bkod pa zhes bya ba'i sgron bskal la sangs rgyas brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba bskal bzang nas bshad do/ kha cig sgron bskal phyi ma gsum gyi go rim yon tan bkod pa/ snyan pa chen po/ skar ma lta bu rnams yin par bzhed la/ mun bskal gyi grangs la'ang mi 'dra ba ci rigs snang ngo / khyad par mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams su sangs rgyas stong byon tshul la/ zhing 'di la mi mjed ces zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mi mjed ni bzod pa'i ming ste/ nyen mongs dug gsum gyis mi 'phrogs shing bzod la/ de la sems bsran thub pas mi mjed de/ snying rje pad dkar las/ ci'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams de mi mjed ces bya zhe na/ semasacan de dag 'dod chags la mi mjed pa dang / zhe sdang la mi mjed pa dang /84

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/gti mug la mi mjed pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba rnams la mi mjed pas/ de'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams de ni mi mjed ces bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der bskal pa chen po bzang po zhes bya ba byung bar gyur to/ /de ci'i phyir bzang po zhes bya zhe na/ bskal pa chen po bzang po de la sems can 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug la spyod pa rnams kyi nang du rdzogasapa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa stong 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs so/ /stong 'byon pa'i ltas kyang sngon 'jig rten chags pa'i tshe rgya mtsho'i nang nas gser gyi pad+ma stong byung ba la gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis brtags pas sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba'i ltas su shes te/kye ma bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o zhes brjod pas bskal pa bzang po zhesagrags par gyur te zhes snying rje chen po pad+ma dkar po las bshad do/ /der sangs rgyas byon pa'i tshul ni/ sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa mdzes par snang ba la 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya bar sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas rin chen sna tshogs bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /de'i tshe pho brang rnam par dag pa can du gling bzhi pa la dbang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung zhes bya ba btsun mo bdun 'bum dang sras stong du tshang ba yod do/ /de'i tshe rgyal po des sangs rgyas de dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la lo bye ba tshang bar bsnyen bkur te/ dge slong re re la'ang g.yog gsum gsum phul lo/ /de'i tshe rgyal bu de dag sangs rgyas 'byung ba brgya lam rnyed par 'gyur/ /mir skye ba yang shin tu dka' ba rnyed/ /grogs po 85

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa ca'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)gang dag dad dang chos nyan pa/ /'di 'dra bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed pa dka'/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa smra zhing / tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i nang du rgyal po sras dang btsun mor bcas pa bzhugs nas nam mkha' la phyin te/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar 'khod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rgyal po chen po/ dad pa ni yongs su mi nyams shing khyad par du 'gro bar 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i chos bstan pa mnyan nas rang gi khyim du phyin pa dang / zla ba nya la bab pa na/ btsun mo ma smad pa'i pang par khye'u chos sems dang / dpe med ma'i pang par chos kyi blo gros gnyis brdzus te byung ngo / / de gnyis dang bcas te sangs rgyas la chos mnyan no/ /de'i tshe yab rgyal po 'di snyam du rgyal bu 'di thams cad byang chub tu zhugs pa sha stag yin na/gang thog mar 'tshang rgya brtag par bya'o snyam ste/ gzhon nu de thams cad kyi ming bris nas rin po che sna bdun gyi bum par bcug ste zhag bdun du mchod pa byas nas btsun mo'i 'khor dang / sras stong dang / gzhen nu gnyis dang bcas pa'i mdun du nang mis bum pa'i nang nas ming rnams phyung bas/ thog mar gzhen nu rnam par dag pa'i blo gros kyi ming byung bas sa g.yos shing rol mo'i sgra byung ste/de ni 'khor ba 'jig go/de nas gzhen nu rnam par rgyal ba'i sde gser thub bo//dbang po zhi ba 'od srungs so/ /don thams cad grub pa ni shākya thub pa'o/ /ske rags can byams pa'o/ /de bzhin du rgya cher byas te sras stong gi nang nas gcig bzhag pa cod pan brgyan pa'i bar du byung ste/ de ni sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas grags pa'o/ /de nas tha chung blo gros mtha' yas kyi ming byung ba dang /86

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/snag gi gnyen mtshams dang spun rnams na re/ bdag cag gis sems can thams cad smin par byas/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byas pa'i 'og tu khyod kyis ci byar yod/ ces spyo ba dang / des smras pa/ sangs rgyas chos rnams 'di dag nam mkha' mtshungs shing 'dra/ /bdag gi yid la sems can zad pa med snyam bgyid/ /tshul khrims kyis ni bdag gi smon lam 'di dag gyur/ /bdag kyang tshig ma tshang )de kun ma lus snyed/ /ces pa la sogs pa smras te/ de ni stong gi mtha' ma mos pa zhes bya ste/ sangs rgyas dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu'i tshe tshad dang / nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ji snyed pa de snyed du gyur cing / bdag nyid de ltar mos pas mos pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas rgyal bu stong gis khye'u chos sems dang /chos kyi blo gros la/ khyed gnyis smon lam ji ltar 'debs zhes dris pas/ chosasems na re/ nga khyed thams cad kyi lag na rdo rjer gyur te/ nang na spyod cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba thams cad las phyi rol du ma gyur la/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad nyan mos rtogs par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /de ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ sangs rgyas stong gi bka' bsdud pa po yin zhing / ma 'ongs pa na bskal pa rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba la 'jig rten gyi khams kun nas yongs su dag par sangs rgyas rdo rjes rnam par gnon pa zhes bya bar lung bstan to/ /chos kyi blo gros kyis khyed rnams chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa por gyur cig ces smon lam btab ste de ni tshangs pa gtsug phud can no/ /yab rgyal po yul 'khor srung ni mar me mdzad do/ /zhesagasang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa las byung ngo / /de lta bu'i sangs(rgyas stong yang 87

nga na 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)chags pa'i bskal pa dang 'jig pa'i bskal pa la mi 'byon gyi/ gnas pa'i bskal pa la 'byon no/ /gnas pa la yang tshe lo yar 'phel dang mar 'grib gnyis las mar 'grib kyi brgyad khri pa nas brgya pa'i bar la phal cher 'byung ngo / / (yar 'phel la two ba shas chung bas chos don du mi gnyer bas so/ /brgya pa bas 'phyi bar mi 'byung ste/ sems can dang / tshe dang / nyon mongs pa dang / lta ba dang / dus kyi snyigs ma lnga shin tu bdo bar 'gyur bas so/ /yar 'phel la mi 'byung ste/ mi dge ba ngang gis spong zhing / dngos po rnams 'phel bas de dag skyo ba mi skye bas so/ /gal te brgyad khri pa nas 'as༄ bar mi 'byung na/ sangasargyas mos pa 'byon pa'i dus mi rnams tshe lo dpag tu med pa thub par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ bden mod kyi de ni sangs rgyas kyi smon lam gyi stobs yin pas bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de dag kyang bskal pa bzang po 'di'i rnam gzhag la dgongs kyi thams cad du ni ma yin te/ dam chos pad+ma dkar por/ tshe lo bcu pa'i dus su 'jig rten gyi khams mthe bos khebs pa zhes bya bar mi mthe bong tsam gyi nang du/ sangs rgyas skar ma dga' ba zhes bya ba sku khru gang dang sor bdun gyi tshad tsam yod pa 'byung bar bshad cing / de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa na bskal pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba la/ mi rnams kyi tshe lo bar bskal brgyad thub pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul med pa zhes bya bar shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan pad+mo'i 'od ces bya ba gzhon nu'i dus ma gtogs pa'i sku tshe bar bskal bcu gnyis kyi bar du chos ston pa 'byung tshul la sogs pa mang du gsungs pas so/ /bskal bzang 'di'i tshe lo bzhi khri pa'i dus su 'khor ba 88

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/'jig sum khri pa'i dus su gser thub/ nyi khri pa'i dus su 'od srungs/ brgya pa'i dus su shākya thub pa/ brgyad khri pa'i dus su byam sa pa 'byung ngo / /mdo bskal bzang las/ sangs rgyas stong po re re la yang / yul dang rigs la sogs pa bcu bzhi bcu bzhi bstan te/ bcu bzhi ni/ yul dang rigs sa yab yum sras/ /rim gro shes rab rdzu 'phrul can/ /'od dang 'dus pa sku tshe'i tshad/ /dam chos gdung ste bcu bzhi'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gal te bskal pa bzang po la sangs rgyas stong du nges na/ brgyad stong pa las dge slong khri bskal bzang la 'tshang rgya bar gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ de ni bskal bzang gi ring la byang chub thob nas zhing khams gzhan du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston pa la dgongs pa yin la/ stong 'byung bar gsungs pa ni/ zhing 'dir 'jig rten dang mthun par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa mdzad pa sna tshogs ston pa la dgongs pa yin pas so/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir thub pa'i dbang po byon pa'i tshul ni/ theg pa thun mong ba'i lugs dang / theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs gnyis kyis/ thun mong ba'i lugs la/ dang por thugs bskyed tshul/ bar du tshogs bsags tshul/ tha mar sangs rgyas tshul gsum las/ thugs bskyed tshul ni/ lung gzhi las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs thog mar gang du bskyed/ zhusapa'i lan du/ sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus su/ rgyal po 'od ldan zhes bya ba'i yul du/ glang po che chen po mdog dkar ba gzugs bzang ba lta na sdug pa zhig byung ngo / /der rgyal po 'od ldan gyis glang po che 'dul mkhan bos nas 'di myur 89

'tshe tshen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)du dul bar byos la nga la phul cig ces bsgos pas/ glang po che 'dul mkhan des kyang glang po'i dam pa de 'dul bar byed do/ /de dul bar rig nas rgyal po la phul bas/ rgyal pos glang po che de zhen te/ 'dul mkhan yang gong du bskyon nas ri dwags bgor du song ngo / /ji zhig na glang po che de nags kyi ba lang mo'i dri tshor nas/ dri de'i rjes bzhin du rgyugs te rgyal po glang po che rlung ltar mgyogs pas khyer ba dang / 'dul mkhan la smras pa/ kye glang po che 'dul mkhan/ glang po che'i dbang po thul cig thul cig glang chen dbang po tshar bcad pa / / bzang po rab tu 'bad par gyi/ /glang chen nye'u rang (myur bas kyi byer ba yis/kho bo cir 'gyur tol med khyer/ /zhes smras pas/ glang po 'dul bas rgyal po la smras pa/ lha glang po che 'di ni 'khrul gyis/ shing gi yal ga la 'jus mdzod cigade nas rgyal po dang 'dul mkhan gnyis das shing gi yal ga la 'jus te 'dug pa dang / de shi ba las thar te bde bar gyur nas/ rgyal pos 'dul mkhan la smras pa/ khyed kyis glang po che ma thul bar nga la phul lo/ /des smras pa/ 'di bdag gis dul bar bgyis mod/ 'on kyang ba lang mo'i dri tshor nas nyan du ma gas bo/ /de ltar lags mod kyi dpyad (los/dran nas ring por mi thogs par mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas glang po che de myos pa dang bral nas zhag bdun lon pa dang dpyad (la1sa/rjes su dran nas/ rang gi gnas su 'ongs te 'dug go /der 'dul mkhan gyis rgyal po la smras pa/lha glang po che de ni mchis lags so//rgyal pos smras pa/ khyed kyis de ma thul lo/ /lha thul lags so/ /cis mngon lha'i spyan sngar 'bab bar bgyi'o/ /zhes smras nas lcags kyi tho lum bsregs te 90

dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/chodapyad kyi lo pa'i nas ra khyer nas glang po che len du 'jug par brtsams pa na/des bag tsha med par len par brtsams pa dang / 'dul mkhan gyis smras pa/lha len du ni btub na/ 'on kyang 'gum par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po yid ches te smras pa/ de ltar shin tu dul ba 'dis bdag cag g.yengs pas 'di la rgyu ci zhig yod/ lha bdag gibs sngar lus 'du pa ba lags kyis/ sems 'dul ba ni ma lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ sems 'dul ba la 'ga' yod par khyod kyis mthong ngam/ thos sam/ de lhas bskul nas smras pa/ lha lus 'dul ba dang sems 'dul ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mchis so/ /zhes sogasargya cher smras pa dang / rgyal pos sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi brtson 'grusadang stobs thos nas/ sbyin pa dag byin/ bsod nams dag byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab pa/ sbyin pa rgya cher gyur pa 'di yis ni/ /'gro ba rang byung sangs rgyas gyur nas ni/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i//skye bo'i tshogs dag bdag gis bsgral bar bya//zhes sogs kyi smon lam btab po/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi rgyal po 'od ldan gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin te ngas der bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /bar du tshogs bsags tshul ni/ de nyid las/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i slad du/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cig la bsnyen bkur bgyis lags/ rgyal po chen po/ re zhig grangs med dang po la/ sangasargyas shākya thub pa nas/ /'dren pa yul 'khor srung gi bar/ /de bar bdun khri lnga 91
