brtse chen 'od snang la /sa lha'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ tre)stong gi sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /grangs med gcig ni 'das pa yi / / rgyal ba ngas ni mchod byas te/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'dod pa'i phyir/ /nga la skyo ba'i sems med do/ /rgyal po chen po/ grangs med pa gnyis pa ni/ sangasargyas mar me mdzad nas ni/ /dbang po rgyal mtshan thub pa'i bar/ /bdun khri drug stong dag gi ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni nga yis mchod/ /grangs med gnyisapo tshang bar ni/ /rgyal ba nga yis mchod byas te/ /skye ba de dang de dag tu/ /nga la skyo ba'i sems med do/ /grangs med gsum pa de la yang / /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas bzung / /sangs rgyas 'od srungs bar dag tu/ /bdun khri bdun stong nga yis mchod//grangs med gsum po de la ni//rgyal ba nga yis mchod byas te/ /byang chub phyir ni spyod pa ni/ /de tshe nga la skyo sems med/ /da ni byang chub semasadapa' na/ /sangs rgyas mchog ni de dag mchod/ /'jig rten 'dren pa de kun gyis/ /nga ni sangs rgyas nyid du bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdzod ltar na/rin chen gtsug tor yan chad kyis grangs med dang po/ mar me mdzad yan chad kyis gnyis pa/ rnam gzigs yan chad kyis grangs med gsum pa rdzogs par 'dod de/ de nyid las/ rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug /grangs med gsum gyi tha mar 'byung / /dang po shākya thub pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de nas bskal pa brgyar mtshan bzang gi rgyu bsgrub pa'i tshe sangs rgyas skar rgyal la tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod cing / rkang pa gcig gis zhag bdun du bskor ba bar ma chad par byas pa dang bskal pa chen po dgu'i tshogs bzlums la/ de nas bskal pa chen po dgu bcu rtsa gcig 'das pa na grong khyer nyer ldan du 92

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor la jug pa 'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/sangs rgyas 'od srungs byon pa'i tshe/ bram ze'i khye'u bla mar gyur pa yan chad kyis mtshan bzang po'i rgyu grub ste/ byang chub sems dpa' nges pa la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /mtshan bzang gyi rgyu ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can re re bzhin nyan rang 'grub pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ji snyed pa de snyed bcu 'gyur gyis sangs rgyas kyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig ba spu'i khung bu ji snyed bskyed pa'i bsod nams de snyed brgya 'gyur gyis dpe byad bzang po gcigadape byad brgyad cu ji snyed 'grub pa'i bsod nams de snyed brgya 'gyur gyis ma tshan bzang po gcig mtshan bzang po ji snyed 'grub pa'i bsod nams stong 'gyur gyis zla ba nya ba lta bu'i mdzod spu/ mdzod spu 'grub pa'i bsod nams 'bum 'gyur gyis gtsug tor bltar mi mngon pa/ gtsug tor 'grub pa'i bsod nams dung phyur gcig gis chos kyi dung 'grub par rin chen phreng ba nas gsungs so/ /de ltar mtshan bzang gi rgyu grub nas dam pa tog dkar du 'khrungs pa ni skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems nga pa' zhes bya la/de nas 'dzam bu gling du rgyal po don grub tu gyur pa ni srid pa tha ma pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas tshul ni de ltar de yan chad du so so skye bo rang rgyud pa zhig gis bskal pa grangs med gsum du thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba bsags nas/ mthar rdo rje gdan du sgod la bdud btul/ gung la bsam gtan bzhi'i dngos gzhi la brten nas sbyor lam yan chad rgyud la bskyed de/ tho rangs skya rengs 'char kha'i skad cig yan chad la phar phyin drug rdzogs nas mngon par byang chub par 'dod do/ /de yang mdzod las/ ston dang bse ru byang 93

nga rma tshen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ (4)chub bar/ /bsam gtan mtha' rten gcig la kun/ /de yi gong du thar cha mthun/ /zhes dang / de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sangs rgyas te chos gzugs kyi sku'i bdag nyid can du gyur nas/ kun shes nas rab bzang gi bar la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te lhag med du mya ngan las 'das par 'dod do/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul zhib tu lung dang mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo las 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs la/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed tshul/ bar du grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags tshul/ mthar bdud bzhi bcom nas sangs rgyas tshul gsum gyis/ sems bskyed tshul la/ sems bskyed kyi ngo bo/ de'i dbye ba/ ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /rde dang de ni mdo bzhin du/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod/ /ces gsungs shing / nyi khri'i 'grel pa dag ldan las/ gzhan gyi don gyi phyir yang dag rdzogasapa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa ni sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes so/ /de'i rgyu ni/ rgyan las/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ /thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba/ /gzhan gyisabasnyen pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /ces kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi rgyu dang /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab bsnyen byas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags/ /chos la mi rtog ye shes ni/ /bskyed phyir 'di ni dam par 'dod/ /ces don dam sems bskyed kyi rgyu gsungs so/ /dbye ba la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas smon 94

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/'jug gnyis/ phra rags kyi sgo nas brda dang chos nyid kyis thob pa gnyis/ yul gyi sgo nas kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas mos pa dang /lhag bsam dag pa/ rnam par smin pa dang / sgrib pa spangs ba ste bzhi/ grog ba'idang dpe'i sgo nas 'dun pa dang ldan pa sa lta bu nas/ chos kyi sku dang ldan pa sprin lta bu ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul la mdo drin lan bsab pa ltar na/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'di so so skye bo 'ching ba mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i dus su re zhig las kyi dbang gis sems can dmyal ba'i gnas su shing rta 'dren pa'i rgyad cig tu gyur te/ der rigs dang ldan pa'i dbang gis sems can dmyal ba'i grogs po de rnams la rang bzhin gyis brtse bar gyur te/'di rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi khur yang bdag gis khur na ci ma rung snyam ste/gshin rje'i skyes bu rnams la kye grogs po dag 'di rnams kyi sdug bsngal yang bdag gis khur na ci gnang zhes smras pa dang / gshin rje'i skyes bu a waṃ zhes bya bas smras pa/ sems can rang rang gi las kyi skal ba la spyod na khyod ci brtol re che zhes smras te/ tho lum 'bar ba zhig mgo la bsnun par gyur to/ /snying rje'i stobs kyis de'i las zad pa'i rgyu byas/ des rkyen byas te de nas shi 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes nas lha'i bde ba yun ring du spyad par gyur to/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de nas ring zhig lon pa na 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i lho phyogs kyi rgyud du rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed ces bya bar gyur te/ de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa chen po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon par gyur te/khye'u de bzhin gshegs pa de la dad par gyur nas thug 'jam phor pa gang phul 95

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (zhu)te byang chub tu thugs bskyed nas smon lam gyi thog ma bskrun pa/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe tshad dang zhing khams dang /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'drar bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /ces smon lam btab bo/ /ji skad du bskal bzang las/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub de la/ /'jam gang zhig ni dbul bar byas nas kyang / /dang po byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ni smon lam gyi thog ma'o/ /zhes chos la 'jug pa'i sgo las gsungs so/ /snying rje pad+ma dkar po ltar na/ bskal pa grangs med pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ ston pa 'di bram ze mchog gi rgya mtsho'i rdul du 'brungs pa ste/ rang gi sras sangs rgyas rin chen snying po'i drung du smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab nas sems bskyed pa ni dang por bshad la/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal bar tshong dpon gyi bu dri med dpung pa 'khrungs pa'i tshe/rgyal ba mi thub rgyal mtshan la sems bskyed pa dang por gsungs shing / phung po gsum pa ltar na/ ston pa 'di tshong dpon gyi bu mngon dgar 'byungs pa'i dus sangs rgyas mdzes pa dang po la sems bskyed pa dang por bshad do/ /de dag kyang 'gal bar mi bsam ste/ kha cig snying rje chen po 'khrungs pas dag pa'i rigs sad pa dang / 'ga' zhig smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang / la la 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems dang / 'ga' zhig grangs med kyi skabs su tshogs bsags tshul ston pa'o/ /zhes mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bzhed do/ /bar du tshogs bsag ba'i tshul la/ bsags bya tshogs kyi rang bzhin/ ji srid bsag pa'i dus/96

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen 'a skong dang bams pa bzhugs/ji ltar bsags pa'i chul gsum las/ tshogs kyi rang bzhin bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i phar phyin drug ste/ rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs/ /bsod nams ye shes mtshungs pa med/ /gcig gis 'bor bar mngon mtho byed//gzhan gyi nyon slongs med par 'khor//zhes pa dang / sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi/ /gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ka ste/ /lnga char yang ni ye shes tshogs/ /zhes so/ /ji srid bsags pa'i dus la/ bskal pa grangs med gsum dang / bdun dang / bcu dang / sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa gsung rab rnams nas mang du bshad la/ grangs med kyi ngos 'dzin mdzod 'grel dang / thub pa dgongs rgyan la sogs pa ltar na/gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang / /sa ya bye ba dung phyur rnams/ /rkyang pa'i grangs su shes par bya/ /ther 'bum phrag khrig rab bkram dang / /gtam dkrigs mi zhakhrugs khyad phyin dang / /pang steng ded 'dren mtha' snang dang / khyu rigs 'od mdzes dbang po dang / /legs 'byin rtog 'gro 'byin brtul dang / /brgya brtag stobs 'khor brda shes dang / /rnam 'byung stobs mi gnyal nyul dang / /wa wol khyad khyud phyan phyin rnams/ /chen por bcas te bgrang bar bya/ /grangs med pa ni tha ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar grangs kyi gnas gzhan drug cur phyin pa'i grangs med la bzhed la/ byang sa ltar na/ bskal pa chen po re re la'ang lo dang zla ba dang skad cig la sogs pa grangs med pa zhes bya ba dang / bskal pa chen po bgrang ba las 'das pa'i grangs med pa bskal pa chen po grangs med ces bya ba gnyis las/ 'tshang rgya ba la bskal pa grangs med mang po dgos par 97

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ (zhu)bshad pa ltar na grangs med dang po dang / grangs med gsum gyis chog par bshad pa ltar na phyi ma 'dzin par bshad do/ /de dag gang ltar yang grangs med gsum du bshad pa ni mdo sde rgyan la sogs pa mang po nas bshad cing yongs su grags te rgyan las/ sa ni dang po yin par 'dod/ /'di ste bskal ba dpag med kyi/ /zhes pa dang / grangs med gnyis ni rdzogs pa yis/ /sgom pa'i lam ni mthar phyin te/ /zhes grangs med dang pos mos spyod sa dang po/ gnyis pas bdun pa man/ gsum pas sa bcu pa man thob par bzhed do/ /bdun du bshad pa ni/ rgya che rol par/ bskal pa grangs med pa bdun du dge ba'i rtsa ba thamasacad yang dag par bsgrub pa/ zhes gsungs so/ /bcur bshad pa ni/ nyan thosasde pa kha cig gi lugs yin par dul lha'i sde pa tha dad klags par bshad do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum du bshad pa ni/ dbyig gnyen la sogs pa'i lugs yin par thub pa dgongs rgyan las bshad/ de yang tshogs sbyor la grangs med gsum/ sabacu po re re la grangs gsum gsum gyis byang chub sems dpa'i sa rdzogs par bshad do/ /de ltar na'ang rab tu brtson pa khyod la dpag med dus kyang chung ngu nyid du gda'/ /zhes pa ltar brtson 'grus dang thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis/ dus yun thung ngu la yang grangs med mang po'i tshogs bzlums pa yod par gsungs pas shin tu 'jigs par yang mi bsam mo/ /grangs med gsum gyi thog ma ni/ byang chub kyi ched du dge rtsa bsags pa rnams mi mthun phyogs kyis zil gyis mi non pa'i bzang po dang / tshe rabs rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad pa'i smon lam stobs can dang / mi dge ba'i grogs kyis mos pa 98

dam pa'i chos kyi byung mu pa bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen 'a skong dang bcas pa bsu ska/bzlog kyang de'i dbang du mi 'gro bar byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba'i sems brtan pa dang / yon tan la chog par mi 'dzin cing mthong chos dang tshe rabs phyi ma la dge chos 'phel zhing mi nyams pa'i chos 'di rnams dang ldan pa ni khyad par du 'gro ba ste/ de lta bu'i chos bzhi po tshogs lam du nam thob pa nas grangs med gsum gyi mgo 'dzin pa yin te/ theg bsdus las/ bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can dang / /sems brtan khyad par 'gro ba yis/ /byang chub semasadapa' grangs med gsum/ /kun tu rtsom par mdzad pa yin/ /zhes gsungasapas so/ /chos la 'jug pa'i sgo las/ rang gi stobs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba nas grangs med dang po la 'jug par bshad do/ /ji ltar bsagasapa'i tshul ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ltar na/ sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro ba'i phung po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon par gyur to/ /de'i tshe bdag cag gi ston pa 'di grong khyer rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i rgyal po rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i sras gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod ces bya bar gyur te/ de'i btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa skyed mos tshal du phyin pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa des khye'u de skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas skyed mos tshal gyi steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs tshad med pa bzhi dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug las brtsams te byang chub kyi lam bstan/ sangs rgyas rnams kyisabasngags pa yang brjod do/ khye'u des de thos nas dad pa rab tu rnyed de de bzhin gshegs pa de 'khor dang bcas pa lo bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug tu bsnyen 99

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (4)bkur ro de nas brtsams te de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa bsnyen bkur te bskal pa grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa dang po thob par gyur to/ /de nas grangs med gnyis pa la 'jug pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag ces bya ba 'jig rten du byon par gyur to/ /de'i tshe grong khyer 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser zhes bya ba zhig tu/ rgyal po mdzes par snang ba zhes bya ba zhig byung ngo / /de'i tshe bdag cag gi ston pa 'di de'i gnang chen tshong dpon shes rab bzang po zhes bya ba zhig tu gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa des tshong dpon de byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi snod du rung bar gzigs nas/ de'i mdun gyi nam mkha' la rtsa 'phrul gyis bzhugs te snga ma bzhin du chos bstan to/ /de dad par gyur te de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa la lo stong du bsnyen bkur byas so/ /de nas brtsams te de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa la bsnyen bkur byas pas bskal pa grangs med gnyis pa mthar phyin te sa bdun pa thob par gyur to/ /de nas grangs med gsum pa la 'jug pa'i tshe/ 'dzam bu gling gi pad mo can gyi tshong 'dus zhes bya bar rgyal po dgra thul zhes bya ba 'byung ngo / /de'i dus su bram ze mar me'i bdag po zhes bya ba chos dang mthun pa zhig la bu khye'u gzugs bzang ba rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ de'i lus la 'od byung bas ming mar me mdzad ces btags so/ /de la lha rnams kyis bskul bas rkyen byas te/ dad pas rab tu byung ba na de nyid kyi nub mo mngon par byang chub par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad ces bya'o/ /de'i grags pa 100

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bsan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bca pa bzhugs/dang tshigs su bcad pa rgyal po dgra thul gyis thos nas de blta bar 'dod pas mar me'i bdag po la pho nya btang ba/ mar me'i bdag po khyod kyi sras shig mngon par byang chub bo zhes thos pas de mthong ba 'tshal na/ thugs brtse bas bdag gi drung du gshegs par ci gnang / gal te mi gshegs na bdag gi dpung dang bcas te mchi'o/ /zhes spring ngo / /de nas mar me'i bdag pos bcom ldan 'das nyid la gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis kyang gnang ste/ dgra bcom pa bye ba phrag brgyad cu dang / byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag brgyad cu dang bcas te ljongs rgyu zhing pad+ma can du gshegs so/ /rgyal po dgra thul gyis pad+ma can gyi tshong 'dus brgyan te/ grong khyer ba rnams la mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad ma 'tshong zhig ma spad cig rang rang nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa grong khyer nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la zhabs 'bring byed pa ra gyur to/ /de'i tshe gangs ri'i ngos la bram ze rin po che zhes bya ba g.yog lnga ban yod pa rig byed kyi gnas la slob dpon du gyur pa zhig gnas so/ /de'i tshe bdag cag gi ston pa 'di de'i slob ma gzhen nu sprin zhes bya ba zhig tu gyur te / bslab par bya ba'i gnas mtha' dag sku1bas nas kye mkhan po/ bdag gis rig byed lobs te rang gi yul du mchi na/ bdag gis bgyi ba ci zhig mchi zhesasmra ba dang / yon du ku rla pa ṇi lnga brgya byin cig ces bsgo'o/ /der mkhan po'i rkang pa la phyag btsal te song nas mkhan po la 'os pa'i nor rnams btsal te/ma thar gyis pad+ma can du song ba na des pho brang gi srang brgyan pa mthong nas ci 101

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)byed ces dris pa dang / mi rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhen nu khyod kyis mi shes sam/de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad/ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs pa'i phyir brgyan no/ /zhes smra'o/ khye'u sa sangs rgyas kyi sgra thos pas dad pa skyes te/sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni u dum wa ra'i me tog dang 'dra na/ bdag gis 'gron bu 'di dag gis me tog nyos te bcom ldan 'das la gtor la/ mkhan po'i nor log nas btsal lo snyam cho / /de'i tshe bram ze'i bu mo bzang len ldan/ me tog ut+pal bdun khyer te srang nas 'ongs pa na/ bram ze'i khye'u sa/ kye bu mo me tog de gang nas rnyed/ ces dris pa dang des smras pa/ che ge mo zhig na phreng ba byed pa'i khang pa zhig nas dar+sha pa ṇi lnga brgyas nyos so/ khye'u du(smras pa/ 'di dag nga la tshongs shig de ltar mi rung ngo / /slar smras pa/ 'o na khyod la gnyis zhog la/lnga la dar+sha pa ṇi lnga brgya sbyin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ 'di ci byed/ khye lus smras pa/bcom ldan 'das la gtor ro/ /bu mos smras pa/ gal te khyod srid pa'i 'chi 'pho thams cad du bdag gi khyim thabs su dam 'cha' na sbyin no/ khye'u sa smras pa / bu mo thong khyod de skad ma zer zhig khyod ni g.yengs shing rgod pa'o/ kho bos sangs rgyas kyi chos dka' ba dpag tu med pa bsgrubs pa'i bar chad ma byed cigabu mos smras pa/ gal te khyod lus la sha yungs dkar gyi 'bru tsam du bcad de gtor yang khyod kyi sbyin pa'i bar chad mi byed do/ khye'u sa smras pa/ de ltar gyur cig chu las skyes pa'i me tog de dag nga la byin cig des kyang byin no/ /de nas gzhen nus bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ba na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa mthong bas sems dang bar gyur to/ /der mi mang po dag /02

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhu sa/gis/ gos bzang po sha stag bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du bkram pa mthong nas/des bdag la gos med kyi ri dwags kyi lhags pa gding ngo snyam nas bting ngo //de nas mi dag gis 'di 'dra ba'i sems can/ dkon mchog gi drung du ri dwags kyi lhags pa 'ding ngam/ zhes 'phya zhing gzhan du 'phang ngo / /de'i phyogs kyi mtha' gzhan zhig tu song ste ri dwags kyi lpags pa btings nas ut+pal lngas gtor te/ dgongs shig bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad kun nas spyan ri dwags kyi lpags pa la zhabs bzhag tu ga the sna pa/ zhesang sems dang ba bskyed pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs nas zhabs bzhag go /de'i dus su lha rnams kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa byas so/ /de nas ral pa gser gyi mdog can bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar btings te/mar me mdzad kun nas spyan/ 'di la zhabs mi 'jog gam/ bdag lung mi ston na 'di nyid du lus skam par bya'o/ /zhes yi dam brtan por bcas pa dang /ston pas mkhyen te ral pa la zhabs bzhag nas g.yas phyogs su gzigs te/dge slong dag khye'u 'di'i ral pa la khyed rnams kyi rkang pa ma shog cig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod pa'i gnas yin te/ma 'ongs pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa dang /dga' mgur rangs te steng gi bar snang la shing tā la bdun srid du 'phags te ting nge 'dzin bye ba phrag khrig mngon du byas nas sa brgyad pa thob par gyur to/ /de ltar yang / sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la ut+pal lngas/ /gtor te ral pa 103

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (()gdan du bting byas pas/ /mi skye'i chos la bzod pa thob gyur nas/ 'i kya'i rgyal por 'gyur zhes nga lung bstan/ /zhes dang / lung las kyang gang che mar me mdzad kyis nga / /lung bstan gyur pa de yi tshe/ /sa brgyad pa ni thob gyur te/ /dbang bcu dag kyang thob par gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bzung ste brgya byin mig bzang la sogs pa'i skye ba mang du bzhes nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i mthar/ bskal pa 'di'i tshe lo nyi khri pa la grong khyer nyer ldan du sangs rgyas 'od srungs byon pa'i tshe/ bram ze'i khye'u bla mar gyur pa'i bar la bskal pa grangs med gcig tu sangs rgyas grangs med pa bsnyen bkur zhing tshogs bsags te/zla ba sgron ma las/sangs rgyas dag ni bye ba phrag khrig dang //de las lhag pa gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed/ /kun kyang bya rgod phung po 'dir bzhugs te/ /mi dbang de kun nga yis bsnyen bkur byas/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yan gyis sa bcu pa rdzogs par 'dod do/ /'di dag kyang gdul bya drang ba'i don du tshul bstan pa tsam yin gyi/ nges pa'i don du bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog ces bya bar sangs rgyas zin pa ra yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las bshad do/ /sangs rgyas pa'i tshul la/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin/ nges don du sangs rgyas tshul/ drang don du mdzad pa mdzad tshul gsum las/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin ni/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral zhing rnam par mi rtog bzhin du mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don 'bad med du 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi sku ste/ sku gsum grub pa las/ dri med de bzhin nyid dang ni/ /mi rtog ye shes ma gtogs pa/ /104

dam pa'i chos kyi byung chul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen 'a sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos gzhan ni/ /'ga' yang yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid zag med kyi yon tan dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i dbyings dag pa gnyis ldan mngon du gyur pa'i cha nas ngo bo nyid sku ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa/ /de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /zhes so/ /de nyid 'og min chen por rgyal sras 'phags pa rnams la mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i skur bstan nas/ theg pa chen po'i chos la rgyun mi 'chad par longasaspyod pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgya bcu'i bdag nyid 'di/ /theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ /thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed/ /ces so/ /de nyid gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i bsam pa dang mthun par rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad pa ni sprul pa'i sku ste/ gang gis srid pa ji srid bar/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces gsungs so/ /nges don du sangs rgyas pa'i tshul la/ 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyu ni/ dka' ba dpag tu med pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs te/ yan lag bdun ldan las/ tshogs gnyis dag ni rdzo gsapa las/ /byang chub rgyu gzhan yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /sangs rgyas pa'i dus ni/bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sangs rgyas nas gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan zhing / slar yang ston par 'gyur ba ste/ yab sras mjal ba las/ sems can rnams la thugs 105

ba chen 'od snang la /4skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)brtse zhing / /sems can yongs su smin mdzad phyir/ /dpa' bo chen po rnam par 'phrul/ /bye ba brgyad cur rgyal ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung chog pa'i 'du shes bsal/ /zhes pa dang / da dung dang po thugs bskyed par/ /de dang der ni yongs bstan te/ /da dung du yang 'dren pa khyod/ /sangasargyas mang por ston par mdzad/ /ces so/ /sangs rgyas pa'i gnas ni 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rten la don dam chos sku mngon du mdzad cing / 'jig rten kyi khams grangs med pa rnams su sprul pa'i skus cig car byang chub pa la sogs pa'i tshul ston par mdzad pa ste/ ngag dbang grags pas/ dpal ldan stug po bkod pa nyid du don dam thugs chud cing / /dga' ldan skye po'i phyir ni dam pa tog dkar gyur/ /de nas 'dir ni 'gro ba'i don du shākya'i tog gyur gang / /'chi bdag las rgyal sgyu ma kun ston de ni rgyal gyur cig /ces so/ /sangs rgyas pa'i tshul ni/ sa bcu rgyun gyi tha mar rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bag chags dang bcas pa'i dri ma shin tu phra ba rnams kyang slar mi ldog pa'i tshul du sbyangs pa'i spangs pa mthar phyin pa dang / shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i don ma lus pa mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes pa'i rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i byang chub chen po thob pa ste/ dper na rin po che rang bzhin gyis dag pa snod kyis sgrib byed bsal nas mngon sum du gyur pa lta bu ste / rgyan las/ dka' spyod dpag med brgya phrag dang / /dpag med dge ba bsags pa dang / /dpag tu med pa'i dus dang ni/ /dpag med sgrib pa zad pa'i phyir//sgrib pa kun gyis dri med pa//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid thob/ //06

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/rin chen snod ni che ba ltar/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni yang dag bstan/ /zhes gsungs so / / de ltar nges don du sangs rgyas thams cad chos kyi skur don gcig cing /drang don du gzugs kyi sku sngon gyi smon lam gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i phyir sangs rgyas rnams gcig kyang ma yin la/ mang po'ang ma yin zhing / gcig dang tha dad gang du'ang ma grub ste/ rgyan las/ zag med dbyings las sangs rgyas rnams/ /mkha' ltar lus ni med phyir dang / /sngon gyi lus rjes 'brang ba'i phyir/ /gcig min mang po nyid ma yin/ /zhes dang / tha dad rig don med phyir dang / /rdzogasadang thog ma med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gcig min dri med gnas/ /tha dad min phyir mang po'ang min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /drang don du mdzad pa ston pa'i tshul ni/ spyir thub pa la mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / grang bas la dga' ba rjes su gzung ba dang / gtso che ba nye bar bzungs nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis su tha snyad mdzad pa ltar na/ rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen//'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni//chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /gzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol ba dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'da' bar gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par bshad na/ gong du smos pa'i 107

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)bram ze'i khye'u bla ma de tshe 'phos nas dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar po zhes bya bar gyur to/ /lha rnams la chos bstan nas lha'i tshogs mang po smin grol la bkod do/ /de'i tshe 'dzam bu gling pa rnams gdul ba'i dus la babs pa na/nyid kyi bsod nams kyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi rol mo'i sgra las/ bsod nams rgya mtsho'i tshogs mnga' dran rtogs dang / /blo grosamatha' yas shes rab 'od mdzad pa/ /mtshungs med stobs mnga' smu rtsal rgya che ba / / mar me mdzad kyi lung bstan dgongs par mdzod/ /skyes mchog khyod kyi bsod nams dpal gyis ni/ /dga' ldan pho brang shin tu mdzes mod kyi/ /'on kyang thugs rje'i thugs dang ldan pas na/ /'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan du ni char pa phobs/ /ces pa la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa byung bas yang dang yang du bskul lo/ /de'i tshe gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu rnams byang chub sems dpa' mngal du 'jug pa'i lo bcu gnyis kyi gong nas bram ze'i cha byad du sprul nas 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams rig byed slob tu bcug ste/ 'di ltar mtshan dpe dang ldan na 'khor pos bsgyur rgyal lam sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes 'don du bcug go /yang da ste lo bcu gnyis nas byang chub sems dpa' lhums su 'jug go /de'i gtam rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis thos pas rgyal po'i khab kyi mjug ma bsgyur ba'i ri la gnas pa'i rang rgyal glang po che zhes bya ba rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag ste 'das so/ /yul 'khor mo 'jig tu rang rgyal lnga brgya me'i khams la bzhugs te 'das nas ring bsrel lhung bas drang srong lhung bar grags so / / de nas lo bcu gnyis lon pa dang byang chub sems dpa' 'dzam bu gling du 108

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/gshegs par dgongs nas gzigs pa lnga la gzigs te/ dus tshe lo brgya pa/gling 'dzam bu'i gling / yul dbus/ rigs rgyal rigs bud med yon tan dang ldan pa ste/ de lta bu 'dzoms pa'i dus su 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs par brtsam pa na/ lha rnams la grogs po dag chos snang ba'i sgo brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag ni rgyal sras 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe bstan par bya'o/ /grogs po dag dad pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste bsam pa mi phyed par 'gyur ro/ /dang ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste sems rnyogs ma can dang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa nas/ dbang bskur ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste mngal du 'jug pa nas mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar du gsungs nas/ gang gi tshe na dga' ldan gnas mchog na/ /'dren pa skyes bu seng ge 'chi 'pho tshe/ /lha rnams dag la tsheg tu smra ba ni/ grogs dag bag med spyod pa spang bar gyis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs shing / rin po che'i cod pan ma pham pa'i dbu la bcings nas/ grogs po dag kho bo sems can gyi don du 'dzam bu gling du 'gro ste/ khyed la ma pham nga sa chos ston to zhes gsungs pas/ lha rnams mi dga' bar gyur nas/ skyes bu dam pa khyod ni mi bzhugs na/ /dga' ldan gling 'di mdzes par mi 'gyur te/ /zhes zer zhing / byang chub sems dpa' 'dzam bu'i gling de ni deng sang 'od srungs rdzogs byed/ kun tu rgyu gnag slas kyi bu/ smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can/ mi pham skra'i lwa ba can/ kwa kyi'i bu nogs can/ gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu ste rtog ge ba drug dang / bram ze rgyus rgyal/ bram ze gnam rdegabram ze bzang ldan/ bram ze tshangs pa'i tshe/ bram ze pad+ma'i snying / bram ze dmar 109

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung mi ces bsdus/ (zhu)po ste rjes su sgrogs pa drug dang / rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod/ sbru rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur/ kun tu rgyu rab bzang / bram ze'i khye'u kun rgyal/ drang srong nyon mongs med/ lteng rgyas 'od srungs ral pa can te snyoms par 'jug pa drug dang bcas pa'i ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad kyis ma rungs par bgyis pas gshegs pa'i skabs ma lags so/ /zhes gsol pas/ de dag nga nyid kyis zil gyis mnan nus so/ /seng ge gcig gis gcan gzan tshogs rnams du ma rnam par skrag /rdo rje gcig gis brag gi rtse mo du ma rnam par 'jig /brgya byin gcig gis lha ma yin dbang du ma rnam par 'joms/ /nyi ma gcig gis mun pa'i tshogs rnams du ma rnam par sel/ /zhes gsungs nas/ kho bo ji lta bu'i gzugs sa kyis 'gro bar bya zhes dris kha pas/ la la ni tshangs pa'i gzugs kyis/la la brgya byin la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis rigs so zer yang / lha'i bu gzi brdzid dam pa na re/ rig byed nas 'byung ba bzhin glang po che'i gzugs kyisarigs so zer ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mas pa dang / rgyal po zasagatsang ma'i khyim du snga ltas brgyad byung ste/ khang pa dga' ba bya mang byung / stunang bu me tog kha phye dang / /longs spyod 'phel zhing sgra yang 'brol/ /gter mang kha phye 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /der dgun 'das te dbyid zla tha chung skar ma sa ga la babs pa'i tshes pa bco lnga zla ba nya ba skar ma rgyal nam gyi gung la dar ba'i dus su yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i glo g.yas pa nas glang po che'i rnam pas lhums su zhugs te/ gser gyi dra bas legs g.yogs spyi gtsug dmar/ /thal dkar mche ba drug dang rab ldan zhing / /dung dang kha ba dngul 110

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa 'i gru chen kha nga dang bcas pa bzhugs/mdog lta bu yi/ /glang po'i mchog gcig khong du song snyam byed/ /de zhugs na sani bdag gi lus dang sems/ /sngon chad mthong thos myong bar ma gyur pa'i/ /gya noms bde bas shin tu bde gyur te/ /bsam gtan mnyam par bzhag pa bzhin du gyur/ /zhes so/ /rmi ltas de rgyal po la smras so/ /rgyal pos kyang bram ze rnams la dris pas sras khyad par can zhig 'byung ste/ khab tu bzhugs na 'khor los bsgyur ba dang / rab tu byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar lung bstan no/ /de nas yum gyi lhums rgyal srid kyis nye bar spyad pa rin po che'i bkod pa zhes bya bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi nang thams cad phan tshun gsal ba la bzhugs te gnod sbyin gsang ba la sogs pas kyang rtag tu bsrung ngo / /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpas chos kyang bstan te/ nam gyi gung la sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams la/ phyi dro tshangs pa la sogs pa gzhan la/ nub mo byang chub semasadapa' rnams la chos gsungs so/ /ser skya'i grong khyer ba rnams kyang bde bar gyur te/ de ltar lha dang mi'i skye rgu phrag khrig phrag sum cu rtsa drug smin par mdzad cing / zla ba bcur zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyod cing bzhugs so/ /de nasabatsa' ba'i dus la babs te/ me tog kha 'bus pa la sogs pa ltas sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ba dang / yum lum+bi na'i tshal du 'byon par chas te tshal brgyan no/ /der gshegs pa dang lha du ma yang lhags te de rgyal pos mthong bas sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar bsam mo/ /de nas yum gyis pa la k+ṣa'i sdong po la phyag gis 'jus pa na/ yum gyi glo g.yas pa nas me med pa nyid du byang chub sems dpa'i sku nor bu ltar dwangs pa/ rgyan dang / na bza' dang bcas te bltams pa na/111

brtse ོ 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos tha gces bsdus/ 9)lhas me tog gtor/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis ka shi da'i ras kyis blangs/dga' bo dang nyer dga' gnyis kyis sku khrus gsol ba na/ ko'u shi ka nga thongs gsungs te/ shar phyogs su gom ba bdun gshegs te/ dge ba'i chos thamasacad kyi sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /lhor gshegs te lha dang mi rnams kyi sbyin gnasasu 'gyur bar bya'o/ /nub tu gshegs te nga ni 'jig rten 'di na phul du phyin pa'o/ /'di ni nga'i skye ba'i tha ma ste skye rga na 'chi med par bya'o/ /byang du gshegs te/ sems can gyi nang na bla na med par bya'o/ /'og tu gshegs te/sems can dmyal ba'i me bsad pa dang / bdud dang bdud kyi sde gzhom par bya'o/ /steng du gshegs te/ sems can thams cad gyen du blta bar 'gyur bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te de thams cad du pad ma bdun bdun byung ngo / /de'i tshe bkra shis pa'i ltas phyogs thams cad 'od kyi snang bas gang ba dang / yul chen po bzhi'i rgyal po la sras bzhi yang btsas/ ya rabs kyi rigs lnga brgya/ gragasa'adzin ma la sogs brgyad brgya/ 'dun pa la sogs pa bran lnga brgya/ bsngagasaldan la sogs pa rte'u khri/ rte'u mo khri/ ba lang khri yang btsas/ gling gi dbus su byang chub kyi shing skyes/ skyed tshal lnga brgya dang / gter kha lnga brgya yang byung bas/byang chub sems dpa' mtshan don thams cad grub par btags so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'od byung bas rgyal po bzhi'i bu skyes pa'i ming yang 'od la gras nas btags te/ rgyal po'i khab kyi rgyal po pad+ma chen po'i bu gzugs can snying po / gnyan yod kyi rgyal po tshangs sbyin gyi bu gsal rgyal/ ko'u sha zhi'i rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i bu shar ba pa/ 'phags rgyal gyi rgyal po mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu /12

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor la sun pa'i gru chen kha sbong dang bcas pa bzhugs/rab snang zhes bya bar btags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' bltams pa'i dus kyi 'od de ri bo kun 'dzin na drang srong nyon mongs med ces bya ba/ tsha bo me sbyin dang bcas pas mthong ste/ tsha bos smras pa/ mkhan po/ 'dir ni nyi ma thamasacad dag/cig car byung bar gyur tam ci/ /'od cig gis ni gsal bar gyur/ /drang srong gis smras pa/ nyi ma'i 'od tsha 'od 'di bsil/ /kun tu 'jug pa thub chen 'od/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od po che//lhums nas byung ba gdon mi za/ /tsha bos smras pa/ 'o na de blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o/ /drang srong gis smras pa/ da lta de lha mthu bo che rnams kyis bskor nas blta dka' bas ming btags pa na blta'o//de nas yab yum gyis bram ze rnams la mtshan bstan pas/ bram zas khyim du bzhugs na 'khor los bsgyur ba dang / rab tu byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro//zhes lung bstan to/ /rigs kyi lha mchod pa'i sar phyin pas/ shākya rnams kyi lha gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyis gzhon nu'i zhabs la phyag byas pas lha'i lha zhes btags so/ 'i kya mu cor smra ba rnams thub pa bzhin du 'dug pas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar yang grags so/ /zhag bdun nas yum che'i dus byas te sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes so/ /de byang chub sems dpas nongs pa ma yin gyi/ sras mngon par 'byung ba gzigs na yum snying 'gas par 'gyur bas byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yum gyi tshe tshad brtags nas lhums su zhugs pa yin no/ /de nas gzhon nu skye rgu'i bdag mo la gtad de/ pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma brgyad/ nu ma bsnun pa'i ma ma brgyad/ rtse rogs byed pa'i ma ma brgyad/ dri ma 'phyi ba brgyad de so gnyis kyis skyed bsrings so/ /de nas me sbyin 113

pa tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung sa ces bsdus/ 9)gyis mkhan po la smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa' ser skya'i gzhir byon nasamatshan yang gsum btags kyis/ da ni byang chub sems dpa' blta ba'i phyir bzhud do/ /des smras pa/ de bzhin bya'o/ /zhes rdzu 'phrul gyis chas pa na byang chub sems dpa'i mthus rdzu 'phrul nyams nas rkang pas grong khyer ser skya'i sgor song ste 'phrin springs pa na/ nang du gshegs shig ces smra'o/ /de zhugs pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/don ci la 'ongs/ smras pa/ rgyal chen bdag ni 'dir 'ongs pa / khyod kyi sras ni blta phyir te/ /'jig rten 'dul ba gtso bo yi/ /thub pa de ni blta bar 'dod/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ de ltar na gzhen nu nyal gyi ma sad kyi bar sdod cig des smras pa/ mnal ba nyid blta'o/ /de bzhin gyis shigades bltas pa na mig mi 'dzum par blta ba mthong nas smras pa/ rigs dang ldan pa'i rta rnams ni/ /mtshan mo'i bzhi cha nyal ba ltar/ /dgos pa don gnyer rnams kyi gnyid/ /mig la yun ring mi gnas so/ /lha bram ze rnams la bstan nam/ bstan no/ /ji skad lung bstan/ 'di ni gnyis su gyur te gzhan du min/khyim na gnas na 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal lam/ khyim nas khyim med rab tu byung gyur na/ /'dren pa gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog par/ /'jig rten 'dir ni mngon rdzogs rgyal bar 'gyur/ /zhes smra'o/ /des legs par brtags nas smras pa/sa bdag rtog pa po rnams blo 'phrul te/ /rtsod pa'i dus na 'khor lo bsgyur mi 'byung / /bsod nams mchog gi chos kyi mdzod 'di ni/ /nyes las rnam par rgyal nas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /mi gsal mtshan dang ldan pas mi'i dbang po/ /gling bzhi rnams kyi bdag po'i dbang phyug 'gyur/ /shin tu mtshan gsal thub 114

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/dbang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'di ni mi mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /zhes smras nas/ bdag nyid kyi tshe'i mtha' dang / byang chub sems dpa' mngon par byang chub pa la brtags pas/ byang chub sems dpa' lo nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhes te khab nas byung ste/ lo drug tu dka' ba spyad nas bdud rtsi rtogs par 'gyur ba mthong la/ rang nyid bar skabs der 'chi ba'i dus byed par mthong nas mig mchi mas gang ste 'dug pa rgyal pos mthong ste dngang nas smras pa/ 'di ni mthong na dga' ba yin/ bkra mi shis pa med dam/ smras pa/ gal te 'di ste rdo rje'i char/ /gnam las rab tu phabs gyur kyang / /thub chen lus la ba spu ni//gcig kyang g.yo bar mi nus so/ /bdag ni chos mdzod skyes bu mchog 'di dang //phrad nas don ma grub par 'chi gyur te/ /zhi ba ma thob rang gi nyes mthong nas/ /yid la gdung ba bskyed nas ngu ba yin/ /gang dag smras pa'i dam pa mtshungs med pa/ /'di yis chos thos 'gyur zhing thos nas kyang / /rab tu zhi ba'i pha rol 'gro de dag /skyid cing bsod nams ldan la rims nad bral/ /zhes smra'o / /de nas drang srong la bsnyen bskur byas te rang gi gnas su rkang pas song ngo / /tsha bo me sbyin la gzhon nu mngon par byang chub pa na khyod rab tu byung zhig ces bsgos te/ dus kyi chos dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas yar skyes nasashākya'i khye'u stong phrag bcu dang lhan cig tu byis pa kun gyi bshes gnyen gyi yi ge'i grwar byon te/ kye slob dpon/ tshangs pa'i yi ge la sogs pa drug cu rtsa bzhi las bdag gang la bslab ces gsungs pas/ slob dpon ngo mtshar te/ semasacan dag pa ngo mtshar che/ /bstan bcos kun la bslab gyur kyang / /'jig rten 115

'tsheg 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ 9)'jig rten rjes snyegs phyir/ /yi ge'i grwar ni byon par gyur/ /yi ge gang gi ming dag kyang //bdag gis shes par ma gyur pa//de la 'di ni byang gyur kyang //yi ge slob pa'i grwar byon to/ /zhes smra'o/ /de'i tshe yi ge'i ma mo rnams slob pa ltar brtsam pa dang / a zhes brjod pa na 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'o/ /zhes pa dang / a zhes brjod pa na chos thams cad bdag med pa'o/ /zhes pa 'khasogs pa'i sgra byung bas/ byis pa rnams kyang smin par mdzad cing / lha dang / klu dang / dri za la sogs pa'i yig rigs mtha' yas pa mngon du bstan pas skye bornams ngo mtshar bar mdzad la/ rtsis pa shākya srid grub kyi drung du byon nas rtsisadang / sho dgod pa dang / 'phong dang / rgyad kyi 'dzing stangs la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i bslab pa'i gnas thams cad kyang slob pa ltar mdzad pas slob dpon las lhag pa'i go 'phang brnyes te skye rgu rnams yi rangs par mdzad do/ /de nas gzhon nu nags rgyur song ste/ 'dzam bu'i grib ma la bsam gtan dang po nas bzhi'i bar la mnyam par bzhag pas/ phyi rol pa'i drang srong rdzu 'phrul can lnga brgyas byang chub sems dpa'i steng gi nam mkha' la 'gro ma nus te zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug go /de'i tshe shing gzhan gyi grib ma 'phos kyang de'i grib ma ma 'phos pas yab ngo mtshar te/thub chen gang tshe bltams pa dang //gang tshe 'od ldan bsam gtan mdzad/ /'dren pa 'di ltar lan gnyis su/ /mgon po khyod zhabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag byas so/ /de nas shākya rgan po rnams 'dus te 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gdung mi 'chad pa'i phyir khab mdzad par zhus so/ /byang chub sems dpas bsam pa/ 'dod pa'i skyon ni bdag gis116

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i spu chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/mtha' yas rig /'thab mo 'khon bcas mya ngan sdug bsngal rtsa/ /'dzin byed dug gi lo ma 'dra ba ste/ /me dang 'dra zhing ral gri'i so yang 'dra/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bdag 'dod ma yin te/ /bdag ni bud med tshogs dang mdzes ma yin/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin bde bas zhi sems su/ /bdag ni mi smra nagasatshal gnas par bya/ /yang de brtags nas/ 'dams dang ljan ldin khrod na pa blo rnam par 'phel/ /mi rnams gang gi nang na rgyal pos mchod pa thob/ /gang tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'khor mchog 'thob 'gyur ba/ /de tshe sems can bye ba phrag khrig 'chi med 'dul/ /sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' mkhas par gang gyur pa/ /de dag kun gyis btsun mo sras dang bcas kyang bsten/ /'on kyang 'dod pas chags med bsam gtan bde ba nyams/ /bdag kyang yon tan de dag rjes su bslab par bya/ /zhes bsams te cang mi gsung bar gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal pos smras pa/ btsun mo ji lta bu blang / gzhen nus bud med kyi yon tan yi ge la bris te smras pa/ yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis 'di dag dang ldan par bsngags so/ /rgyal pos mdun na 'don la khyod song la gang na bud med yon tan 'di dag dang ldan pa 'tshol zhig rgyal rigs bram ze'i bu mo dang / /rje'u rigs dmangs rigs de bzhin te/ /su la yon tan 'di yod pa'i/ /bu mo de ni 'dir 'on cig /nga yi bu 'di rigs dag dang / /rus la ngo mtshar 'dzin ma yin/ /yon tan bden pa chos kyis rnams/ /de la 'di yi yid dga'o/ /zhes smras so/ /des yul kun tu song bas/ shākya lag na be con can gyi bu mo sa 'tsho ma mthong nas yi ge de byin pas/ bzhin 'dzum ste/ bram ze yon tan 'di dag 117

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)bdag la kun tshang gi/des pa'i gzugs brnyan de ni bdag gi khyim thabs so /gal te gzhon nu bzhed na phyi bshol ma mdzad gsungs/ /brgya la skye bo phal dang bzhugs par gyur kyang gda'/ /zhes smras so/ /de bram zes rgyal po la gsol bas/ rgyal pos bud med 'di rdzun che bas yid ma ches te/ zhag bdun nas bud med thams cad 'dun khang du shog cig gzhon nus yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad dag sbyin no/ /zhes smras te/ dgung bdun nas gzhon nu 'dun khang du song ba na/bu mo rnams ji ltar 'ongs pa bzhin yo byad dag sbyin zhing / de dag gis kyang gzi brjid ma bzod par myur du song ngo / /de nas sa 'tsho ma 'ongs pa na/ yo byad zad de/ de 'dzum mul te/ bdag gis nongs pa ci bgyis nas/ bdag la thugs brngan sdang mdzad/ gzhen nus rngan sdang min gyi/ khyed phyis pas lan no gsungs nas sor gdub srang brgya stong ri ba de sbyin no/ /de song ba dang / bya ra ba dag gis rgyal po la/ gzhen nu sa 'tsho ma la spyan chags te bka' mchid kyang cung zad bgyis so/ /zhes smra'o/ /de nas rgyal pos shākya lag na be con can la/khyod kyis bu mo gzhen nu la byin/ zhes pho nya btang bas de na re/ bdag gisarigs chos la bu mo sgyu rtsal shes pa la gtong pa lags kyi/ sgyu rtsal mi shes pa ji ltar sbyin zhes zer ro/ /de zlas pas/ rgyal po sems shing 'dug go /gzhen nus de thos nas yab ci nongs/ 'di bka' mi stsal du mi rung / zhes smras pas/yab kyis don de bsnyad do/ /gzhen ༷ rtsal 'gran par khas blangs pas/rgyal po mnyes te sgyu rtsal 'gran par dril bsgrags so/ /de nas zhag bdun na shākya gzhen nu lnga brgya tsam 'tshogs te/ sa 'tsho ma rgyal ba'i ru mtshon du bzhag 118

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha nga dang bcas pa bzhugs/nas ral gri'i thabs dang / 'phongs dang / rgyad kyi 'dzings stangs su rgyal bsakhyer cig ces dam bcas so/ /de nas thog mar lha sbyin 'ongs pa na glang po che 'brid pa dang 'phrad de/ thal mo lan gcig bsnun te bsad do/ /mdzes dga' bos grong khyer gyi phyi rol du bskyur ro/ /gzhen nus zhabs kyi mthe bos blangs nas ra ba bdun/ 'obs bdun gyi phyi rgyang grags gcig tsam du 'phangs te/shongs chen por gyur pas glang po'i shongs zhes grags so/ /de nas slob dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen dpang du btsugs te yi ge 'gran pas gzhen nu rgyal lo/ /shākya srid sgrub dpang du btsugs te brtsis pas gzhen nu rgyal te/ srid sgrub kyis kyang mi gzugs yan chad las ma shes/ gzhen nus snying po mchog gi bar du shes so/ /de nas dga' bo kun dga' bo gnyis kyis stobs brgal ba'i phyir drung du phyin pas/ de'i lag pa reg ma thag 'gyel lo/ /lhas sbyin gyis phyin pas/ gzhen nus phyag g.yas pas btegs te nam mkha' la bskor na tha(sa la bor yang lus la mi gnod pa byas so/ /de nas shākya'i gzhen nu thams cad rub pa na/ gzhen nus reg ma thag 'gyel lo/ /de nas 'phongs 'gran pa na kun dga' bos rgyangs grag bas gnyis/ lha bang sbyin gyis rgyangs grags bzhi/ mdzes dga' bos rgyangs grags drug be con can gyis dpag tshad gnyis kyi pha rol du lcags rnga re 'ben du btsugs pa las rang rang gi la phog gis de phan chad la ma phog go /gzhon nus rgyangs grags bcu'i pha rol du lcags rnga gcig de'i drung du shing tā la bdun/ de'i pha rol du lcags kyi phag rgod gcig rnams btsugs te/ lha khang nas mes seng ge 'gram gyi gnam ru blangs te phyed krungs119

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)su 'dug pas brdungs nas mda' 'phangs pas/ lcags rnga gcig shing tā la bdun/ phag rgod rnams phug ste/ sa la zug nas mi snang bar gyur te khron pa lta bur byung bas mda'i khron pa zhes grags so/ /de nas bang dang / 'chong dang /lag rtsis dang / glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa nas/ spos sbyor gyi bar gyi sgyu rtsal thams cad la gzhon nu lhag par gyur pas be con can gyis sa 'tsho ma phul te/byang chub sems dpas kyang 'jig rten dang mthun par bya ba'i phyir sa 'tsho ma dang / grags 'dzin ma dang / legs skyes ma dang / ri dwags 'dzin ma rnamasa'akhor nyi khri nyi khri dang bcas te khab tu bzhes pa'i tshul bstan nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du de dag dang rtse dga' la yongs su spyod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dus las mi 'da' yang sangs rgyas kyis bskul ba chos nyid yin pas/ de dag gis byin gyi bas brlakhas pa'i sil snyan gyi sgra las/ sdug bsngal brgyas gang sems can mthong nas ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon dang skyabs dang gnasagyur cing / /phan byed mgon dang dpung gnyen gyur cig ces/ khyed kyis sngon gyi smon lam de skad btab/ /dge ba dpa' bo'i sngon gyi spyod pa dang / /'gro phan bya zhes smon lam dran par byos/ /'di ni khyod kyi dus dang tshod yin gyi/ /drang srong mchog rab khyim nas 'byung bar byos/ /zhes sogs kyis bskul zhing / btsun mo rnams kyi rol mo'i sgra las kyang / srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar/ /'chi mang rab 'bar 'di ni mgon med pas/ /srid las 'byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs/ /bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin/ /srid gsum mi rtag ston ma'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la blta dang mtshungs/ /120

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bsta pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/skyes bu'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ /ri gzar 'bab chu lta bur myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes sogs nas/ sngon gyi spyod de rjes su dran gyis la/ /gti mug rab rib mun pas bsgribs pa yi/ /'gro la shes rab dam pa 'od bzang ba / / chos mig dri med nyon mongs med pa sbyin/ /zhes pa'i sgra byung bas byang chub sems dpa' yang rgyags pa'i sems spangs te byang chub tu sems btang ngo / /de bzhin du lha'i bu 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kyang bskul bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i rmi lam du byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba rmis te/ 'di ni de'i ltas so snyam nas byang chub sems dpa' chags par bya ba'i phyir/ dbyid bsil/ dbyar ran/ dgun dro ba'i khang bzangs gsum byas pa'i tshe gzhen nu sus kyang ma tshor bar mngon par 'byung du 'ong ngo zhes pa'i sgra dpag tshad phyed du byung zhing / ltas mkhan kun gyis kyang / bkra shis kyi chab sgo nas mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bstan pas/ rgyal po'i sgo 'phar chen po sgra dpag tshad phyed du grags pa mi lnga brgyas 'byed cing gcod pa byas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyed mos tshal du 'byon par dgongs te/ 'dun pa shing rta sbyor cig ces smras pa dang / 'dun pas kyang rgyal po la gsol pas/ rgyal pos gzhon nu yid du mi 'ong ba mi mthong ba bya ba'i phyir phyogs thams cad nyams dga' ba byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' shar sgo nas 'thon pa dang /nyid kyi mthus lha'i sprul pa'i rgas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa gzigs te/'dun pa la/ kha lo bsgyur ba mi ring nyam chung zhing / tan khrag skam pa rgyus pags nyi tshes dkris/ /mgo dkar po rnams lus ni rab skems la/ /'khar ba 121

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ (zhu)bsten zhing mi bde 'byor 'gro su/ /des smras pa/ la/ mi 'di rgas pas zilagyis non pa ste/ /dbang po nyams shing sdug bsngal brtson stobs nyams/ /gnyen gyi skye bos brtas shing mgon med gyur/ /don bgyid mi nus nags khrod shing ltar bor/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'di ni 'di yi rigs kyi chosayin nam/ /'on te 'gro ba 'di kun la yang 'byung / /tshig 'di yang dag ji bzhin myur du spros/ /thos nas de don 'dir ni tshul bzhin bsam/ /des smrasapa / lha/ 'di ni rigs chos yul 'khor chos ma lags/ /dar la bab pa'i skye bo rgas pas 'joms/ khyod kyi yab yum nye du gnyen 'tshogs kyang / /rgas las ma thar gzhan du 'gro thabs med/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ kha lo bsgyur ba byis pa mi mkhas 'gro/ /gzhon pas rgyags myos blo ngan rgyags ma mthong /da ni slar 'gro shing rta myur du bsgyur/ /da ni rgas 'gyur rtse dgas ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs nas nang du log go /lho sgor 'thon pas na ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs te smras pa/ kha lo bskur ba nyam chung lus mdog ngan/ /dbang po kun nyams dbugs dbyung rab tu dka'/ /yan lag kun skams sto dkrugs nyam thag 'gyur/ /rang gi gcin rtug smad pa'i nang 'dug su/ /des smras pa/ lha/ mi 'di shin tu nad kyis btab pa ste/ /nad kyis nyer 'tshe bgyis pas 'gul ma thub/ /gzi brjid ma mchis stobs kyang rnam par nyams/ /mgon skyabs gling dang dpung gnyen ma mchis lags/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ nad med pa yang rmi lam rtse dang mtshungs//nad kyis 'jigs pa 'di ltar mi bzad pas//gnas 'di mthong nas skyes bu mkhas pa rnams/ /rtse dga' sdug pa'i 'du shes122

da pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ji ltar skye/ /nub tu shi ba gzigs nas smras pa/ kha lo bsgyur ba mi 'di khyogasasteg nas/ /mi dag skra bshig mgo la sa 'thor zhing / /sna tshogs tshig dag brjod cing brang brdung bas/ /kun nas bskor te 'byer ba 'di su zhig /des smras pa/ lha/ mi 'di 'dzam bu gling du gum pa ste/ /pha ma 'chis 'brang bu rnamasaslar mi mthong / /longs spyod khyim dang mdza' bshes gnyen tshogs rnams/ /spangs nas 'jig rten pha rol dag tu 'gro/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/go bas gnod 'gyur gzhon yang cir mi rung / /nad kyis gnod 'gyur nad med cir mi rung / /ring du mi gnas gson yang cir mi rung / /dga' ba la chags mkhas kyang cir mi rung / /da lta na rga 'chi ba med gyur kyang / /sdug bsngal chen po phung po lnga 'dzin na/ /na rga 'chi ba rtag 'brang smos ci dgos/ /slar log rab tu thar pa bya ba bsam/ /byang sgor dge slong gzigs te smras pa/ kha lo bsgyur ba sems zhi rab zhi zhing //mig phab 'gro la gnya' shing gang tsam blta/ /ngur smig gos gyon spyod zhi lhung bzed thogs/ /mi rgod ma khengs skyes bu 'di su zhig /des smras pa/ lha/ mi 'di dge slong zhes ni bgyi ba lags/ /'dod pa'i dga' ba spangs zhing dul bar spyod//bdag nyid rab tu byung zhing zhi bar 'tshol//chags sdang bral bar bsod snyoms spyod cing rgyu/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa / dge bar legs smra de ni nga 'dod de/ /rab byung mkhas pa rnams kyis rtag tu bsngags/ /de ni bdag dang sems can gzhan la'ang phan/ /'tsho bde nyamasamathun 'chi med 'bras bur 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nang du zhugs so/ /rgyal pos de dag mthong thos pas/ bsrung ba'i phyir ra ba dang /123

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)'obs dang / sgo brtan po btsugs/ grong khyer gyi bzhi mdor bsrung ba'i mi bzhag btsun mo rnams glu dbyangs dang rtse dgas sbyor du gzhug go /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' khab nas gshegs pa'i ltas su/ bya skad mi 'byin pad+ma rnyings/ /shing la me tog mi 'chags shing / /gling bu pi waṃ rgyud mangs chad/ /dzornga brdungs kyang sgra med gyur/ /de mthong bas rgyal po sems khong du chud cing /sa 'tsho ma la sa g.yos pa la sogs pa rmis so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rmi lam du / rkang lag gis rgya mtsho dkrugs/ sa ma la char byas/ ri rab sngas su bcuga'od kyis kun pa bsal/ gdugs gcig gis 'jig rten kun khyab pa la sogs pa rmis so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas/ yab kyis ma gnang bar rab tu 'byung ba mi rigs so snyam nas/ yab kyi drung du song ste/ bdag mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la babs kyi/ gang yang mi 'dod ma mdzad cig rgyal posakhyod ci 'dod pa'i mchog spyin gyi khab tu zhugs shig byang chub sems dpasasmras pa/ rga nad 'chi rgud bzhi med pa 'tshal lo/ /de sbyin pa'i mthu med do gzhan slongs shig byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ rga na 'chi ba'i 'jigs dang rgud par mi 'gyur ba/ /lha gcig gal te mchog bzhi 'di dag mi stsol na/ /gzhan yang mchog gcig gsol gyis rgyal po gsan du gsol/ /'di nas 'chi 'phos nying mtshams sbyor bar mi 'gyur mdzod/ /rgyal po'i bsam par/ de bdag gis sbyin par mi nus kyi/'di btsas pa'i tshe yang srid pa tha ma par bya'o//zhes smras la/ bram ze rnams kyis kyang mngon par 'byung bar lung bstan pas/nges par 'gro'o snyam nas skad chung ngus khyod kyi bsam pa rdzogs par gyur cig124

dam pa 'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcapa bzhugs/ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rang gi gnas su song ba na/ rgyal pos don 'di shākya rnams la bsnyad pas bsrung ngo zhes bgros te/ sgo bzhir shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya re/ shing rta lnga brgya re/ dpung bu chung lnga brgya re dang bcas pa bkod/ shākya rgan rabs rnams la ma gyi bzhi mdo dang sum mdor 'khod/ rgyal po'ang mel tshe byed do/ /de'i tshe gnod sbyin rnams dang / 'phrog ma'i bu rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams mchod pa'i las byed do/ /lha'i bu chos spyod la sogs pas btsun mo'i 'khor mi sdug par bsgyur ro/ /de la gzigs pas dur khrod kyi 'du shes skyes te/ e ma skye rgu dag ni sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /srin mo'i tshogs la dga' ba ji ltar rnyed/ /'dod pa yon tan med pa yon tan 'dzin/ /gti mug mun pas rab bsgrib blo gros ngan/ /dper na bya ni bya rgyar chud pa bzhin/ /nam yang 'byung ba rnyed par 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ mi sdug pa bsgom mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas smon lam 'di bzhin btab bo/ /sems can thams cad la chos kyi sgra bsgrag par bya'o/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bya'o/ /nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyel bar bya'o/ /srid pa'i mdud pa dgrol bar bya'o/ /zhes bsams nas nam phyed kyi dus su khang bzangs kyi steng du song ste sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal nas bltas pas/ brgya byin dang / rgyal chen bzhi dang / nyi zla gnyis kyang phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug pa mthong / skar ma rgyal yang shar ba mthong / 'dun pa la smras pa/ nga yi bkra shis 'di ni don kun 'grub/ /do nub gdon mi za bar don 'grub kyi/ /'dun pa phyi bskol ma byed la gor du/ /rta rgyal rgyan gyis brgyan pa nga la byin/ /des smras pa/ gang du bzhud/123

brtse chen 'od snang la /4skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)smras pa/ mngon par 'byung ngo / /'dun pas lan mang du bzlog kyang 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs gsungs te/ma bzlog par 'dun pa la rta byin zhig ces smras so//'dun pas dus ma lags so/ /zhes smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpas smrasapa / sems can rnams kyis don ni 'tshol ba na/ /byang chub rga shi med pa'i gnas thob nas/ /'gro ba sgrol zhes nga yis yun ring nas/ /smon lam btab pa de yi dus la bab/ /ces smras pa dang / lha'i bu yang dag bskul ba pos kyang /da ni mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la bab bo zhes bskul lo/ /de'i tshe lha'i bu zhi ba'i blo gros dang / brtse ba bkod pas ser skya pa rnams gnyid log cing sgra mi grags par byas/ lha'i dbang po dang rgyal chen bzhi yang ser skyar lhags te/brgya byin gyis bkra shis kyi sgo phye ste 'dun pas bsngags ldan brgyan te phul ba la chibs nas/ rgyal chen bzhis btegs te nam mkha' la byon pas/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis lam bstan/ 'od kyis mun pa bsal/ mchod pa dang rol mo dang bcas te rgyad kyi yul 'dus te phyin pa dang / rta dang rgyan 'dun pa la byin te / 'di dag khyer la ser skyar song zhig ces smras so/ /'dun pas smras pa/bdag la chad pas gcod du mchi'o/ /nga la byams pa bzhin khyod la byams par 'gyur gyi ma 'jigs shig 'dun pa phyir log ste bkod pa'i gtam rnams smras pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs kyis mya ngan yang zhi bar gyur te/ der mchod rten brtsigs pas 'dun pa slar log gi mchod rten zer ro/ /de nas mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du ral gri ut+pal mthing kha 'dra bas nyid kyi dbu skra nyid kyis bzhar ba lha rnams kyis gdan drangs te mchod rten brtsigs pas 126

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha snang dang bcas pa bzhugs/gcug phud mchod rten zer ro/ /rab tu byung ba'i tshul dang mthun pa'i gos shig rnyed na rung snyam pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha rngon pa'i gzugs su sprul pas sna bza' ngur smig phul ba blangs te/ byang chub sems dpas kyang rin thang med pa'i gos de la byin pas/ des kyang lag pa gnyis nas blang te spyi bor bzhag nas mchod pa'i phyir lha'i gnas su khyer ro/ /sa der mchod rten brtsigs pas ngur smig blangs pa'i mchod rten zer ro/ /de ltar gtsug phud gcad/ ngur smig bgos te de la rang 'byung gi bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad pas/ don grub rab tu byung ngo zhes pa'i sgra 'og min gyi bar du grags so/ /de nas bram ze rigs ldan la sogs pa'i gnas su bsod snyoms la byon pa yangs pa can du sgyur rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur slob ma sum brgya la ci yang med pa'i skye mched ston pa'i sar phyin nas slob mar khas blangs/ bslabs pas tshegs med par mkhyen te da ci bslab/ smras pa/ ci yang med do/ /byang chub sems dpas chos 'dis nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur gyi/ de bas lhag pa zhig btsal lo snyam te/ ma ga dhar byon nas ri'i rgyal por bzhugs so/ /de nas chu dron can gyi sgo nas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du zhugs te/ grong khyer pa rnams dad par byas shing / rgyal po gzugs can snying po la bsod snyoms blangs pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' mtshan gyis brgyan pa mthong bas dad de phyag btsal nas rgyal srid kyi shas phul yang ma bzhes so/ /de nas rgyal po'i khab de nyid na rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod slob ma bdun brgya la srid rtse'i sems ston pa'i sar song nas de'i slob mar khas blangs pas/ myur du srid rtse'i sems khong du chud de/ sngar bzhin brjod 127

pa can na 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 5nga gces bsdus/ 9)nas 'dis ni myang 'das su gyur ba ma yin no zhes sun phyung te song ngo / /de'i tshe ko ḍi n+ya/ rta thul/ rlangs pa/ ming chen/ bzang ldan te lnga yang byang chub semasadapa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ ri ga ya go rir gshegs so/ /der 'dod pa la dben pa la sogs pa'i chos gsum thugs su chud de/ chu bo ni ra3 na'i 'gram du byon nas/ brtul zhugasang na pas dag par 'dzin pa sun dbyung ba'i phyir lo drug tu til 'bru gcig dang / 'bras bu gcig dang / rgya shug 'bru gcig gisalo drug tu dka' ba spyad de/ dbugs rgyu ba bcad nas mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe lha'i bu kha cig gis lha mo sgyu 'phrul la gzhon nu shi'o zhes brjod pas/ lha mo 'ongs pa na/ byang chub sems pa'i lus skam pa/shi ba dang 'dra ba mthong nas nga'i skye ba tha ma 'di'o/ /zhes dam bca' yang ma rdzogs/ bram ze rnams kyis lung bstan pa yang mi bden no zhes smre sngagasa'adon pa la/ byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ nyi zla skar tshogs sa la lhung 'gyur srid/ /so so skye bo yin yang nga mi 'chi/ /de phyir 'di la mya ga khyod ma byed/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub sangs rgyas mthong / /zhes smras pas dga' ste rang gnas su song ngo / /ba lang rdzi la sogs pas kyang rna bar shing bal bcug nas snar 'byin pa la sogs byed cing / bdud kyang srog gces par gyisashig ces byams pa ltar 'chos shing glags btsal yang glags ma rnyed do/ /de nas dka' thub kyis grol bar 'dzin pa dgag pa'i phyir/ zas rags pa zosal byang chub kyi snying por 'gro'o dgongs te kha zas rags pa za'o zhes brjod pas lnga sde ma dad ste/ 'di ni stod pa/ mang du za ba/ dka' thub las nyams128

dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/pa'o zhes smra zhing wā rā ṇa sring song ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' legs skyes ma'i bran mo'i ro gos kyi ras blangs te/ lhas lag pa brdab pa'i rdzing bur brgya byin gyis bzhag pa'i rdo leb la bkrus te/ der rdzing nas dbyung snyam pa la/ bdud kyis gad pa mthon por sprul pas shing gi lha mo yal ga smad pa la 'jus te phyung nas/ shing sgrub byed kyi rtsar phyag dar khrod kyi snam sbyar rlubs shing / gnasagatsang ma'i lhas kyang gos ngur smig phul ba bzhes te spyod yul gyi grong du gshegs so/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' gzugs mdzes pas dge sbyong mdzes pa zhes grags so/ /lhas sbran te legs skyes mas ba stong gi 'o ma lan bdun du nying khur byas par/ 'bras dang 'bras bu gsar pa blugs te btsosapas de'i nang du dpal be'u la sogs pa'i bkra shis pa'i rtags snang bas dga' zhing mtshan mkhan gyis kyang bdud rtsi thob par lung bstan to/ /de nasabyang chub sems dpa' mgron du bos nas/ 'o thug sbrang rtsi can gyis gser sdod bkang ba phul ba bzhes nas nai ra3 na'i 'gram du byon te/ zas dang chos gosabazhag nas khrus mdzad pas mchod de/ khrus chu lhas khyer/ skra dang og tshom legs skyes mas khyer ro/ /chu der klus seng ge'i khri bshams pa la bzhugs te 'o thug gsol bas sku lus gser gyi gtams pa phyis pa ltar gyur to/ /der gser snod chur bor ba klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos khyer ba na brgya byin gyis blangs te sum cu rtsa gsum du khyer nas snod kyi dus ston byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bdud las rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub kyi shing drung du skyes bu chen po'i stobs kyis gshegs pas/ lha'i mthus rlung dang char gyis lam 'phyags 129

pa tsheg 'od snang las/sa skya'i chogasang tso bsdus/ 9)shing chag chag btab/ ri dang shing dang nags tshal thams cad dang bu chung btsas ma thag pa thams cad kyang mgo de phyogs su ston no/ /stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pas rang gi 'khor la do nub byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying por gshegs kyi mchod pa'i las gyis shig ces bsgos nas mchod pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul te/ byang chub sems dpas 'od bkye ste/'od kyis phog pa'i sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing / snod kyi skyon thams cad sbyangs te klu nag pos bstod do/ /de nasalam gyi gnas na ca'atshong bkra shis rtswa brnga ba la/ bkra shis rtswa 'di nga la myur du byin/ /de ring nga la rtswa yis don can 'gyur/ /dpung dang bcas pa'i bdud rnams bcom nas su/ /byang chub dam pa zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungasapas/ des kyang rtswa ku sha rma bya'i mgrin pa ltar sngo zhing 'jam la dri zhim pa phul ba blangs te khyer nas/ byang chub kyi shing la lan gsum bskor te rtswa'i rtse mo nang du bstan nas ma 'khrugs par btings pa la skyil mo krung gis zhal shar du phyogs nas bzhugs te/ sku drang por bsrang nas dgongs pa mngon du bzhag ste/stan 'dir bdag gi lus 'di skam gyur tam/ khrin rus pags pa'i tshogs rnams zhig kyang rung / /bskal mang rnyed dka'i byang chub ma thob par/ /stan 'di las ni lus bskyod mi bya'o/ /zhes yid dam brtan po mdzad de/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer bkye ste/ zhid khams dpag med snang bar byas pas byang chub sems dpa' mang po 'dus nas mchod pa byed do/ /lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' bsrung ba'i phyir phyogs bcur 'khod do/ /130

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/de nas bdud la ma sbran bar 'tshang rgya bar mi rigs so snyam nas smin mtshams nas bdud thams cad 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bkye bas/ bdud gnas thams cad snang zhing g.yos/ mog mog por byas te/ sems can shin tu dag pa bskal mang spyod spyad pa/ /zas gtsang sras pos rgyal srid dag ni rab spangs te/ /phan byed de ni bdud rtsi mngon par 'dod pas byung / /byang chub shing drung 'ongs kyi de ring sgrim par gyis/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i sgra byung zhing bdud sdig can la'ang rang gnas mun pas khyab pa la sogs pa rmis te/ rang gi 'khor rnams sbran pa na/ bu ded dpon gyis bzlog kyang ma ldog ste/ gnod sbyin grul bum lto 'phye chen po'i gzugs/ /srin po yi dwags sha za'i gzugs dang bcas/ /'jig rten mi sdug drag gzugs ji snyed pa/ /thams cad sgyu yis der sna sprul par bya/ /zhes pa ltar sgyu ma lta bu'i blo can ma yin pa rnams kyis mthong ba tsam gyis snying 'gas pa/ kha bzhin dmar la lus po ser ba dang / /lus po dmar la kha bzhin ser ba dang / /mgo gcig mgo gnyis mgo gsum ldan pa dang / /mgo stong bye ba'i bar ldan rab tu mang / /zhes pa ltar gyi lus can mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i dmag sa ya stong phrag sum cu lags te g.yas rol nas byang chub sems dpa' la dga' ba rnams kyis bzlog g.yon nas mi dga' ba rnams kyis bskul te/ phyogs rnams kun nas ri yi phreng ba dang / /ma kha' las brag dang mtshon gyi char pa dang / /rdo rje 'bar ba'i tshogs char dbab pa yis/ shwakya'i bu de thal bar brlag par bya/ /zhes zer zhing / mtshon cha la sogs pa'i char/ ser ba drag po'i rgyun bzhin du bar mtshams med par 131

nga tshe tshe na 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)phab kyang / shākya'i sras pos chos rnams rten 'byung ba/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i sems dang rab tu ldan/ /dpung bcas g.yo sgyu mthong yang nyes pa med/ /ces pa ltar byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu las/ gnod pa med cing mtshon cha rnams me tog gi char 'ba' zhig tu gyur nas lding zhing 'bab par gyur to/ /de nas bdud kyis khyod kyi bsod nams de tsam gyis thar pa ga la thob/ ces smras pa dang / byang chub semasadapas khyod kyis gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gcig byas pas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa yin/ ngas gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin du ma byas so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /bdud kyis sngon chad kho bos mchod sbyin kha na ma tho med//gtan pa med par byas pa'i dpang du khyod 'dir yod/ /'dir ni khyod la dpang po gang yang yod min pas/ /smras kyang phan pa ci yod khyod ni pham par gyur/ /byang chub sems dpas phyag g.yas gser gyi kha dog can sa la brdabs te/ tha('di 'gro ba kun gyi gnas gyur te/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu snyoms shing nye 'khon med/ /'di ni bdag gi dpang ste bdag rdzun med/ /'di la khyed ni bdag gi dpang byos shig /ces gsungs pas/ sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa'i gseb nas sa'i lha mo brtan ma lus byed phyung nas thal mo sbyar te/ skyes bu chen po de de bzhin no / khyod kyis ji skad smras pa bzhin/ /'di ni bdag la mngon sum mo/ /'on kyang bcom ldan 'das nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi dpang du gyur pa lags so/ /zhes smras te mi snang bar gyur to/ /g.yon can dpung dang bcas pa sgra de thos pas nags su seng ges sgra grags was thos pa dang / /bya rog rdo 132

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung sgyu bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru chen khang dang bcas pa bzhugs/'phangs mod la byed pa bzhin//dngangs sgrag snying 'gas thams cad rab tu bye//de nas sdig can yid ma bde nas bdud kyi bu mo rnams nyams sad du btang bas/ de dag gis kyang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te/ byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du song nas g.yo sgyu sna tshogs bstan kyang bslur ma tshugs pas sdig can yid mi dga'o/ /de'i tshe shing gi lha dpal ldan la sogs pas byang chub sems dpa' la/ khyod ni dgung zla yar gyi ngo ltar mdzes pa'o zhes sogs kyis bstod do / / gnas gtsang ma'i lhas bdud la/ sdig can khyod ni glang rgan 'dam du byings pa ltar nyam chung ba'o/ /zhes sogs kyis smad cing / lha rnams kyis(bcu drug gis bzlog kyang ma bzlog par bdud kyis dmag grangs mi phrag snyed sbran nas byang chub sems dpa' la mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phangs shing cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan yang glags ma rnyed par thams cad 'thor te zhag bdun du ma phrad do / / de'i tshe bdud mang pos byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam gyi cha stod la bsam gtan bzhi pa mngon du mdzad cing / gung thun la mngon par shes pa rnams bskyed nas nam gyi cha smad la skya rengs 'char kha rnga brdung ba'i tshod tsam na zag pa zad pa'i ye shes mngon du byas te/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de nas shing tā la bdun tsam du 'phags te lam gyi rgyud ni chad do zhes sogs ched du brjod/ la rnams kyis kyang me tog pus nub tsam gtor te mchod/ lha'i bu mo rnams kyis bstod / 'od kyis 'jig rten snang bar byas/ sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis phyag byas te ka la ping rka'i dbyangs kyis/ bdag cag ji ltar sangs rgyas 133

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)pa / / de lta kho nar khyed sangs rgyas/ /dper na mar dang ma ra nyid kyi/ /nying khu mtshungs pa bzhin du gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / nyid kyi gsung chos kyi dung gis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par mdzad de/ bsod nams rnam smin bde shing sdug bsngal sel/ /bsod nams ldan pas lha yi bsam pa 'grub/ /bdud bcom nas ni byang chub mngon sangs rgyas/ /mya ngan 'das shing bsil ba'i dngos po thob/ /ces ched du brjod de zhag bdun phrag dang po la skyil krung ma bshigs par byang chub kyi shing la gzigs/ gnyis pa la stong gsum ring du 'chags/ gsum pa la byang chub kyi snying po la spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs/bzhi pa la shar nub kyi bar du rgyang mi ring bar 'chag go /bdud sdig can gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol ba btab kyang gdul bya'i don ma zin gyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar zhal gyis bzhes/ bdud kyi bu mo dga' ma la sogasabaslur song ba na rgan mor mdzad/ bdun phrag lnga pa la yul ngan chen po byung ste klu btang gzung gi gnas su bzhugs/ drug pa la shing n+ya gro dha skyong du bzhud de kun tu rgyu rnams la/ chos thos pa dang mthong ba dang / /dben par dga' ba bde ba yin/ /srog chags 'byung po rnams la gdams/ /gnod pa mi byed 'jig rten bde/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdun pa shing sgrol rgyu'i drung du bzhugs te/ tshong pa ga gon dang bzang pos sbrang rtsi dang / skyo ma dang / bu ram shing gi nying khu dag phul ba na/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis snod ji lta bur bzhes snyam pa dang / rgyal chen bzhis gser la sogs pa'i lhung bzed phul ba ma bzhes par/ rnam srasal sngon po'i rigs kyi lhas byin pa'i rdo'i lhung bzed bzhi yod pa re re bzung ste 134

dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/me tog gis bkang nas phul bas/ bde bar gshegs la lhung bzed phul cig dang / khyod ni theg pa mchog gi snod du 'gyur/ /nga 'dra dag la lhung bzed phul ba ni/ /dran dang blo gros nam yang nyams mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te bzhes nas gcig tu byin gyis brlabs te der blangs so/ /de nas ga gon dang bzang pos ba stong gi 'o ma'i nying khu'i spris ma rin po che'i gzheng par blugs te phul ba gsol nas/ gzhed pa bor ba tshangs pas khyer ro/ /ston pas/ lha yi bkra shisadon grub cing / /phyogs rnams bkra shis byed pa des/ khyed kyi don rnams 'grub gyur cig /thams cad myur du mthun par shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i shis pa brjod de/ sbrang rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyal bar lung bstan no/ /de nas ston pa thugs las chung ngur bzhugs te/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur bas/ /mi smra nags 'dab gnas par bya ba snyam/ /zhes dgongasashing / 'jig rten kun la snying brtse mtha' yas nga / /gzhan gyis gsol ba btab la nga mi ston/ /skye bo 'di dag tshangs la dad pa ste/ /de yis gsol ba btab na 'khor lo bskor/ /snyam te 'od bkye bas/ stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyi grogs sbran te/ tshangs pa 'bum phrag drag cu rtsa brgyad dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ ye shes chen po mchog gi da skye rme 'khor bsgrubs nas ni/ /phyogs bcu dag tu 'od zer rnam par bkye mdzad de/ /ye shes zer gyis mi yi pad+ma kha 'byed pa/ /smra ba'i nyi ma de ring ci slad btang snyoms bzhugs/ /zhes sogs kyis bskul bas cang mi gsung bar gnang ngo / /135

sa tsheg 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos yang sa bsdus/ 9)slar yang chos la gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pa'i slad du thugs las chung ngu la gzhol bar mdzad do/ /de tshangs pas shes nasabargya byin sbran te/ brgya byin gyis zla ba nya ba gza' las thar pa ltar/ khyod kyi thugs ni shin tu rnam par grol/ /g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba bzhings su gsol/ /'jig rten mun par shes rab 'od dbyung gsol/ /zhes pa dang /tshangs pas kyang / kun tu 'tshal bar gyur pa mchis lags kyis/ /thub pa khyod kyis chos ni bstan du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa na/ ston pas/ skye rgu 'dod pa rnams kyis bcing / /rgyun gyis rab tu 'das pa yin/ /ngas ni tshegasachen po yis rnyed/ /de lta bsan bstan mi phan/ /zhes gsungs te thugs lasachung ngur bzhugs pa na/ slar yang tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa yon du phul te/ 'khor du ma dang bcas pas/ ma ga dha yi yul 'dir sngon ho chos/ /ma dag dri mas rjes su 'brel ba byung / /bdud rtsi'i sgo mo dbye bar mdzod cig chos/ /rdul bral dri ma med par bstan du gsol/ /zhesagasol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten la gzigs nas/ ma nges pa dang / legs par nges pa dang / yang dag par nges pa ste gsum du gnabs pa las/ ma nges pa la gzigs te/ tshang bas pa ma ga dha'i sems sa can gang su dag /skal bar ldan zhing rigs dang ldan gyur pa/ /mi tshe 'du shes rtag tu chos nyan pa/ /de dag la ni bdud rtsi'i sgo dbye'o/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas byang chub kyi shing gi lha chos sred la sogs pa bzhis chos kyi 'khor lo gang du bskor/ wā rā ṇa phyir ro/ /de ni skye bo nyung zhing grib ma chung bas gzhan du /36

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i gru chen 'a skong dang bcas pa bzhugs /rigs so/ /bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzang dag de skad ma zer cig gsungs te /thog mar 'dul sla ba su la chos bstan snyam pa dang / lhag spyod 'das te zhag bdun dang / ring 'phur 'das te zhag gsum lon par rig nas lnga sde la bstan par bya'o zhes dgongs te/ gsal ldan du song bas/ 'tsho ba pa nyer 'gro dang phrad de/ khyed dbang po ni gsal/ pags pa ni dag na/ su las tshangs par spyad/bka' stsal pa/ nga la slob dpon gang yang med/ /nga dang 'dra ba yod ma yin/ /nga ni gcig pu rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsil gyur zag pa med pa yin/ /des smras pa / dgra bcom par zhal gyis 'che 'am/ nga ni 'jig rten dgra bcom pa/ /nga ni ston pa bla na med//lha dang lha min dri zar bcas//nga yi do zla'i gang zag med/ /des smras pa/ rgyal bar zhal gyis 'tshe 'am/ bka' stsal pa/ gang zag zag pa zad rnyed pa/ /nga 'dra rgyal bar shes par bya/ /nga ni sdig pa'i chos las rgyal/ /de bas nyer 'gro nga rgyal yin/ /des smras pa/ gar bzhud bka' stsal pa/ nga ni wā rā ṇa srir 'gro/ /grong khyer dpal ldan song nas ni/ /long ba lta bu'i 'jig rten la/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i 'od bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ de bzhin du 'gyur ro zer te stor song ngo / /ston pas byang du ri ga yar/ klu lta mdzes kyis bskos drangs/ lteng rgyas dang / tsan+dan lar dang / grong khyer kha lo bsgyur rnams su khyim bdag rnams kyis bsod snyoms phul nas gaṅgā'i 'gram du gshegs pa dang / gaṅgā'i mnyan pas gru btsas blangs pas/ nga la gru btsas med gsungs te nam mkha' la gshegs so/ /gru pa des mthong nas/ sbyin gnasa'adi lta bu bdag gis ma sgral lo//zhes shin tu 'gyod de kye hud mtshar byas so//137

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)zhes smra zhing brgyal te sa la 'gyel to/ /de nas de grub pas rgyal po la gsongasate / rgyal po gzugs can snying pos de thos nas phyis rab tu byung ba la gru btsasami len par byas so/ /wā rā ṇa phyir byon nas bsod snyoms bzhes nas zas kyi bya ba mdzad de/ drang srong lhung bar gshegs so/ /lnga sdes ston pa byon pa mthong ste / dge sbyong go ta ma lhod pa/ mang du za ba/ spong ba las nyams pa de 'ongs kyi sus kyang (su bar mi bya/ ldang bar mi bya/ chos gos dang lhung bzed blang bar mi bya/ stan lhag ma 'di la 'dod na 'dug cig zer ba'i 'og khrims bcas te/kun shes kyis sems kyis khas ma blangs so/ /de nas ston pa byon pa dang / lnga sdes ma bzod par khrims dral te/ stan las langs nas/ la las bsu/ la las stan bting / la las zhabs bkru/ ba'i chu bshams nas/ khyod legs par byon tam stan 'di la zhugs shig ces gsol ba dang / ston pas gdan la zhugs nas/ lnga sde dag mgu bar bya ba'i gtam mang po mdzad de/ lnga sdes/ tshe dang ldan pa go ta ma dbang po gsal/ pags pa ni yongs su dag na/ ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du mjad dam/ bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa la tshe dang ldan pa zhes ma brjod cig khyed la yun ring por gnod pa dang / mi phan pa dang / mi bde bar gyur ta re/ dge slong dag ngas ni bdud rtsi thob bo/ /'chi ba med par 'gro ba'i lam mngon du byas so/ /nga ni sangs rgyas so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /thams cad gzigs pa'o/ /zag pa zad pa'o/ /chos thams cad la dbang ba'o/ /dge slong dag ngas khyed la chosabashad kyi/ tshur shog nyon cig nan tan gyis shig rna ba lhogs shig dang ngas138

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul ba na pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa 'i gru chen 'a stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/gdams shing rjes su bstan no/ /zhes sogs nas/ khyod kyis 'og khrims 'di ltar ma bcas sam/ che'i sogs bka' stsal pa dang / de dag gi mu stegs kyi rtags rnams skad cig de nyid la med par gyur te dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa lta bur gyur to/ /de dag gis kyang nyes pa bshags te gusapa yang bskyed do/ /de nas ston pas sku bsil nas 'di snyam du dgongs te/sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams gang du bzhugs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor snyam pa dang / sa phyogs der rin po che'i khri stong byung bar gyur to/ /der khri snga ma gsum la bskor ba mdzad de/ bzhi pa la skyil mo krung bcas nas seng ge ltar bag tsha ba med par bzhugs so/ /lnga sdes kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'chal te spyan sngar 'khod de/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las 'od bkye bas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par byas/ ltas chen po bco brgyad byung zhing / 'od de las sgra byung ba/ de mi thugs dam brtan pa ste/ /wā rā ṇa sī ri dwags nags/ /gshegs te 'khor lo bla med pa/ /shin tu med byung dpal ldan bskor//rgyal las bskal pa phrag khrig bsgrubs//chos de nyan pa gang 'dod pa//de ni rings par la gor du/ /chos nyan pa yi phyir shog cig /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i sgra grags pas/ byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang / lha'i 'khor dpag tu med pa 'dus te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab bo/ /sa bla'i lha rnams kyis chos kyi khyams dpag tshad bdun brgya yod pa sprul te/ lha rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / seng ge'i khri la sogs pa bshams nas ston pa la phul te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /de nas sngon /39

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)gzhon nu sprin mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa'i tshe/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba sogs smon lam btab pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' semasabaskyed ma thag chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zhes bya ba des/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas/ phyogs bcu dag nas sems can dam pa gang dag 'dir lhags pa/ /de dag thams cad 'jug pas bgrang bar nus pa ma lags te/ /btud cing thal mo sbyar nas zhabs gnyis la ni gtugs nas su/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor phyir shākya'i rigs la dgyes par bskul/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas de'i nub mo nam gyi cha stod la cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /gung thun la yang dag par chags par 'gyur ba'i gtam rnams gsungs so/ /cha smad la lnga sde la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mtha' gnyis po 'di dag ni rab tu byung bas 'jug par bya ba ma yin te/ 'dod pa bsod snyoms kyi mtha' dang / ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha'o/ /de bas mtha' gnyis spangs nas dbu ma'i lam gyi de bzhin gshegs pa chos ston no/ /de ni 'di lta ste 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad do/ /dge slong dag bzhi po 'di dag ni 'phags pa'i bden pa ste/ gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mo/ /de la sdug bsngal gang zhe na/ skye ba dang/ na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / phrad pa dang bral ba dang / 'dod pa btsal yang ma rnyed pa ste mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga'o/ /de la kun 'byung gang zhe na/ gang 'di yang 'byung ba sred pa dang/ dga' bas 'dod chags dang ldan pa dang / de dang 'dir mngon par dga' ba'o/ /de la sdug bsngal 'gog pa gang zhe na/ gang yang 140
