ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (3)zhus pas/ nga mchod rten bye ba bzhengs pa'i 'dam tshol ba dang / 'bum gdan 'dren du 'ong gis bsdad mi khom/ phyis 'ong srid gsungs nas/ 'dam mang po dang / 'bum dang / yi ge nyung ngu rnams gdan drangs te/ 'bum gyi zhabs na bag tsam klus ma bskur zhes grags seng/ /de nas 'dam des mchod rten la sogs pa byas te phal cher grub la/ 'ga' zhig klu'i yul du mi gshegs pa'i phyir ma mdzad de/ de phyir klu sgrub ces grags so/ /de nas li kha ra shing 'pheladu gser 'gyur mdzad de sbyin pa chen po byas/ bram ze rgan rgon gnyis la gser mang po gnang bas dad de/ rgan pos nye gnas byas/ chos nyan te shi nasaslob dpon klu'i byang chub tu gyur to/ /de nas shar phyogs pa tra be pa dang ra dhar byon nas lha khang mang du bzhengs/ dril bu lta bu'i brag gser du bya bar bzhed pa lhas bkag ste/ sgra mi snyan du gshegs pa'i lam grong khyer sa la ma nar byibangapa dze ta ga'i lag ris las rgyal por lung bstan te sgra mi snyan du byon nas na bza' shing la bskal te khrus mdzad pas/ gos de dag gis khyer ba la nga'i yin gsungs pas/ nga bdag can zer nas gtad skad/ der don byas te byon pasngar gyi byis pa rgyal por gyur te/ rin po che mang du phul bas lan du chos kyi skyes bshes pa'i springs yig bya ba gnang ngo / /slob dpon des bstan pa'i bya gedage 'dun gyi zhal lta byas/ lha khang dang mchod rten mang po bzhengs pa/ rdo rje gdan la rdo'i dra mig gi ra bas bskor/ dpal 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten gyi bkod pa bzhengs/ bstan bcos la nang rig pa la lta ba gtso bor ston pa dbum bstod tshogs dang rigs tshogs/ spyod pa gtso bor ston pa mdo kun las190

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ btus dang theg chen blo sbyong / nyan thos rigs sad par byed pa rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu/ khyim pa'i spyod pa gtso bor ston pa bshes sgring / rab byung gi smod pa gtso bor ston pa byang chub kyi tshogs/ sngags kyi phyogs la lta spyod mdor bsdus pa rgyud kun las btus/ lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa byang chub sems 'grel/ bskyed rim spel ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs mdor byas/ mdo bsre/dkyil chog nyi shu pa/ rdzogs rim ston pa rim lnga la sogs pa/ gsob rig pa'i bstan bcos sbyor ba brgya pa la sogs pa/ lugs kyi bstan bcos dmangs la gdams pa skye bo gso thig blon po la gdams pa shes rab brgya pa/rgyal po la gdams pa rin chen phreng ba/ gzhan yang rten 'brel gyi rtsis/ sposasbyor/ gser 'gyur/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo 'grel la sogs pa mang du mdzad de/de ltar lo drug brgyar bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad do/ /de'i tshe rgyal po mtha' 'gro zhen nam/ bde spyod kyi bu gzhen nu nus ldan zhes pa zhig la mas gos bzang po srub med pa zhig byin pas/ 'di ngas rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i tshe gyon no zer ba la/mas khyod kyis rgyal srid 'dzin pa mi 'ong / /yab dang slob dpon klu sgrub tshe sgrub dang bcud len stabs su byas pas grub ste slob dpon dang sgog gcig pa yin zer ba na/ des dpal gyi ri la klu sgrub zhugs par phyin te dbu slong pas chod cig gsungs te des ral gris bcad pas ma chod de/ slob dpon na re ngas rtswaku sha bcad pa'i tshe srog chags shi ba'i rnam smin yod pas/ ku shas chod gsungs nas bcad pas ske'i rtsa ba nas nga nyid bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du/ /phyin nas lus 'di la yang 'jug par bya/ /zhes pa'i sgra byung ngo / /des dbu khyer 191

nga tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)te phyin pas gnod sbyin mo zhig gis phyogs te dpag tshad gcig gi sar dor ro / / dbu dang sku lus gnyis ma nyams par lo re bzhin nyer song ste/ mthar 'byar nas bstan pa dang 'gro don mdzad ces grags so/ /de ltar yang tshig gsal las/ dbu ni don du gnyer ba 'ongs la thugs rjes dbu ni bcad de bstsal mdzad nas/ /bde ba can du rgyal ba'i sras po klu sgrub gshegs par gyur pa des mdzad pa'i/ /zhes so/ /klu sgrub kyi skad dod/ nā gā rdzuna'i/ nā ga ni klu ste lta ba ngan pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa dang / sa dang po ye shes kyi rgya mtshor skye ba brnyes pa dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rin po che'i bang mdzod lamanga' brnyes pa dang / bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi mes grub mtha' ngan pa'i bud shing bsreg pa dang / 'jig rten mtha' dag gi yid kyi mun pa sel bar mdzad pa ste lngas klu dang chos mtshungs shing / ardzu na ni srid sgrub ste gnyisasu med pa'i ye shes kyi gsung drang zhing thogs pa med pa'i mdas/ srid pa'i dgra sde ma lus pa bcom nas gdul bya lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la chos kyi rgyal srid gtod bar mdzad pa ste gnyis kyis srid sgrub dang chos mtshungs pasalnga/ sgrub ste/ tshig gsal las/ gang zhig mtha' gnyis(gnas(la gnabs bsa'/zhing / /rdzogs sangs rgyas blo rgya mtshor skye ba brnyes/ /dam chos mdzod kyi zab mo nyid ci ltar/ /rjes su rtogs cing thugs rjes ston par mdzad/ /gang gi ltaba'i me dag gis/ /da dung phas rgol gzhung lugs kyi/ /bud shing dang ni 'jigarten gyi/ /yid kyi mun rnams 'joms par mdzad/ /gang gi gnyis med ye shesagasung mda'i tshogs/ /lha dang bcas pa'i gdul bya'i 'jig rten la/ khams 192

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/gsum dag tu rgyal thabs legs mdzad pas/ /srid pa'i dgra sde ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /klu sgrub chung po /)de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungasaso / / de ltar sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu'i slob dpon de ston pa nyid kyis mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan te/ laṅkar gshegs pa las/ lho phyogs be ta'i yul du ni/ /dge slong dpal ldan cher grags pa/ /de ming klu zhes bod pa ste/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jig pa/ /nga yi theg pa 'jig rten du/ /bla med theg chen rab bshad nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa bsgrub ste/ /bde ba can du de 'gro'i/ /zhes pa dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa nga 'das nas/ /lo ni bzhi brgya lon pa na/ /dge slong klu zhes de 'bod 'gyur/ /bstan pa la ni dad cing phan/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob pa/ /rig pa rma bya chen mo ni/ /bdag nyid chen po des kyang 'grub/ /bstan bcos sna tshogs don dang ni/ /dngos po med pa'i don de rig /gang tshe lus 'di bor ba na/ /bde ba can tu skye bar 'gyur/ /de ni mthar gyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /nges pa kho nar yang dag 'thob/ /ces dang / gzhan yang rnga bo che'i mdo dang sprin chen po'i mdo las kyang lung bstan no/ /slob dpon ār+ya de ba ni/ smon lam gyi dbang gis siṅga la'i gling du pad+ma'i sbubs su brdzus te 'khrungs pa na/ de'i rgyal pos rang gi bur bzung ste cher skyes pa na slob dpon klu sgrub kyi drung du byon te blo sbyong mdzad pas rig pa'i gnas thams cad dang / phyi nang gi grub mtha' kun la mkhas par gyur to/ /de'i tshe mu stegs kyi ston pa ma khol zhes bya ba dbang phyug grub ste mngal skyes gang gis kyang mi thub pa'i mchog byin pa zhig yod pa des/ sangs rgyas kyi 193

nga tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)bstan pa la gnod pa cher byas nas phal cher mu stegs pa la btsud de/ nā len+t+ra ra phyin te der gnas pa rnams kyis rtsod par ma nus par/ dpal gyi ri ldoklu sgrub yab sras bzhugs pa la sbran bas/ slob dpon ār+ya de bas 'dul bar zhal gyis bzhes nas byon pas lam du shing gi lha mos spyan slong ba la spyan ya sbyin par btang ngo / /de nas ma khol dang rtsod pa na/ mig gcig pa 'di ci 'dra zer ba na/ drag po mig gsum ldan yang de nyid mthong ba med/ /brgya byin mig stong ldan yang de nyid mthong ba med//ār+ya de wa mig gcig po ni gang yin des//srid pa gsum po ma lus pa yi de nyid mthong / /zhes gsungs te chos kyis tshar bcad nas bstan pa la bcug ste nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur to/ /slob dpon 'disarang bzhin med pa'i don rgyas par ston pa dbu ma bzhi brgya pa/ bsdus te ston pa dbu ma lag pa'i tshad/ de la rtsod pa spong ba gtan tshags grub pa/ mdo sngagasakyi grub mtha'i rnam gzhag ston pa ye shes snying po kun las btus/ sngags phyogs la/ rim lnga'i don 'grel spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron me/ sems don ston pa sems kyi sgrib sbyong / sgyu lus ston pa bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/smin byed ston pa gdan bzhi'i dkyil chog snying po mdor gsal/ bskyed rim ston pa gdan bzhi dang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs/ de'i yan lag gtor chog rdzogs rim ston pa shing gcig gi dka' 'grel rnams mdzad do/ /slob dpon 'di yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las lung bstan te/ gzhan yang rab byung dam pa ni//siṅga la yi grong na gnas/ /'phags pa min pa 'phags pa'i ming / /pha rol rgol ba bzlog nas ni/ /mu stegs rnams kyi sngags sun dbyung / /zhes194

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen 'a stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ gsungs so/ /slob dpon klu'i byang chub ni klu sgrub kyi nye gnas rgan po de shi 'phos nas/ ma he rdzi bo zhig gi bur skyes te/ cher skyes nas ma he 'tsho ba'i dus su sngar gyi bag chags kyis slob dpon klu sgrub kyi spyan sngar 'ongs te/ grub pa nga skyo bas sgom zhig slobs dang zer/ khong rang ma lhar bsgom du bcug pas lo 'ga' nas drung du byung ste/ nga'i rwa 'di sgo la thug nas mi bde zer/ 'o na de dor la mdun na mi dkar po zhig sgoms gsungs/ de ltar byas pas gsal bar byung ste dngos grub gang 'dod 'dri ba la/ grub pa la 'dri yi byas te 'di ltar bzung bas ji skad bya zer/ khyod rang nga'i snying la zhugs zhes smos shig gsungs/ de skad byas pa tsam gyis rang la thim ste bden pa mthong ngo / /de nasarab tu byung ste mtshan klu'i byang chub bam klu'i blor btags/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug dbang dang rgyud dang gdams pa rnams gnang ste tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pas deng sang gi bar du yang dpal gyi ri la bzhugs par grags se / / slob dpon des dkyil chog nyi shu pa/ sbyin sreg rnam gzhag rim pa lasamatha' rnam 'byed/ rig pa khong bsnga rnams mdzad do/ /slob dpon dpa' bo ni/rgya gar shar phyogs su bram ze'i sdigs su skyes te sgra tshad la mkhas par bslabs/ de'i ma nang pa yin pas nang pa la gzung bar 'dod kyang / pha phyi pa yin pas mu stegs kyi grub mtha' la bcug ste/ dbang phyug bsgrubs pas mngon sum du mthong ste ci 'dod zer ba la phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba 'dod do byas pa sa mngal skyes kyis mi thub par gyur cig ces pa'i mchog dang sgra tshad kyi shes rab thod rgal ba zhig dang / sgra tshad kyi rtsod pa la mkhas pa'i sring mo paṇ+ḍi ta dang 195

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos5nga gtses bsdus/ 9)rne tso paṇ+ḍita gnyis dang / thod le kor paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa sa la bsgyur ba tsam gyisartsod pa'i yi ge rang bris su 'ong ba zhig ste bzhi byin nas/ de bzhis ma thub na nga rang snying la zhugs la byin gyis rlobs zhes khas blangs so/ /de nas rgya gar shar phyogs dang lho phyogs kyi nang pa rnams la nga dang rtsod pa byed dgos/ khyed rgyal na nga chu bo gaṅgār 'chi/ nga rgyal na nang pa'i gtsug lag khang dang chos rnamasabasregs nas nga'i rjes su 'jug dgos zer te rtsod pas kho rgyal nas ma la ngasa'adi ltar byas so zhes smras pas/ ma'i bsam pa la 'di nang pa'i parnying ta zhig gis tshar bcad nas nang pa la bcug na snyam ste/ bu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rta'i lus tsam la rgya gar shar dang lho na rta'i rna ba tsam yang med/ de gnyis na nang pa'i paṇ+ḍita mkhas par grags pa yang med/ de dag las rgyal bas khyed mkhas par yang mi che/ bstan pa rdzogs pa dang / paṇ+ḍita mkhas pa yul dbusanā len+d+ra na yod pas de dag las rgyal na mkhas par 'gyur ro zhes smras pas/ kho nga rgyal te yul dbus su phyin nas bud med cig la nā len+d+ra gang na yod ces drisapa na/ mo na re blun po nā len+d+ra zer ba yin zhes smras pas/ 'di ni la nye ga no snyams te sems khong song / nā le spror phyin nas sngar bzhin smras pas/ nang pa rnams gros byas te 'di mdo nas bstan pa nyams par byed par lung bstan pas 'o cag gis mi thub kyi/ dpal gyi ri nas slob dpon klu sgrub yab sras spyan drangs pa'i long yod par bya'o zer te/ zhag sum cu na rtsod dus byas pas/ khosakyang gzhan zhig sbran par go ste/ khyod rang dang rtsod kyi phyi nang gi 'grul chod zer nas kho sgo la nyal te 'grul bcad nas dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol 196

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la can pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ba'i mgo la dbyug gus rdeg cing bgrang bar byed do der slob dpon yab sras spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya ma thar bas zhu 'phrin gyi yi ge shin tu khur dka' khur gyis lus dub khyu mchog rnams ni khyod la gsol 'debs na/ /kye ma rma med nyid du rol pa 'ba' zhig gis ni gcigs byed dam/ /'di na nus ldan gzhan med 'khor lo bying ba can gyi shing rta myur du drangs/ /lta zhing 'dug gam yun ring gnas kyang 'di ni khyod kyi khur yin phrag la longs/ /zhes pa bris nas gtor ma'i steng du bzhag ste mgon po la gsol ba btab pas bya rog gcig gis yi ge khyer nas slob dpon yab sras kyi drung du yi ge sleb pa dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis gzigs te/ mu stegs rta dbyangs kyis bstan pa mes par byas yod pa 'dug pas de bzlog pa'i phyir 'gro'i/ /gsungs pa na/ 'phags pa las/ bdag phyin la 'dul lo/ /zhes pas/ 'o na nyams sad do gsungs nasaslob dpon gyis phyi pa'i grub mtha' bzung / 'phags pa lhas nang pa'i grub mtha' bzung ste rtsod pas 'phags pa lha lan gsum rgyal te/ mu stegs ngan pa de khyer byas nas mchil lham 'phangs so/ /der 'gyod pa skyes pas de la nyes pa med khyod kyis kho thul ba 'dug pas song zhig gsungs nas 'ongs pa'i lam du shing gi lha mos spyan slong ba la spyan byin nas/ nā len+t+ra ra phyin te chu len la nga 'ongs so gyis byas pas/ dge 'dun rnams de su yin brtag dgos zhes chu lug mig gang me long gi nang du blugs te skur btang bas chu de khrus byas ma god par zlog byung bas slob dpon yin par shes te/ chu len gyi chas su rdzus la byon zhus pas/ de ltar byas nas nang du byon pa'i tshe/ chu len gyis kho la phyag bya 197

ba chen 'od nga las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)dgos pa la slob dpon gyis kho'i mgo la rdog pa bzhag ste byon nas dge 'dun gyi gral la bzhugs pa na/ khros bgrangs pas lhag ste sngon med pa'i mgo zlum de gang na yod zer/ mgo zlum ske'i steng na yod ces gsungs pas/ bye'u gcig chang bar bzung nas 'di shi'am ma shi zer ro/ khyod la rag las zhes gsungasapas/ them pa'i steng na 'dug ste nga phyi'am nang na 'dug zer/ khyod kyi spyod lam la rag las zhes gsungs pas lan med do/ /de nas sring mo dang ne tso dang thod le kor rnams kyi gnyen po dge bsnyen ngo tsha med pa dang byi la dang mar nag rnams sta gon byas te sang nyin rgyal po dang slob dpon dang rta dbyangs rnams kyi khri bshams/ kho'i khri'i steng gi char mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sna tshogs bzhag go /de nas khri la so sor 'khod pa na kho na re/ mig gcig pa 'di ci smra zer ba la slob dpon gyis/ drag po mig gsum ldan yang de nyid mthong ba med ces sogs gsungs pas/ khos ral pa btegs te mig gcig bstan pa dang / slob dpon gyi zhabs mthil gnyis nas mig re re bstan no/ /der khyod kyis nga'i rtsod zla mi yong lha sring mo dang zhe tso dang thod le kor rnams kyi lan thob cig zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis/ dge bsnyen dang byi la dang mar nag rnams btang ste pham par byas so/ /de nas kho rang dang rtsad pa na dang po kun gyis go yang ji zhig na grub mtha' shin tu phra bar gyur te rjes brjod pas/ rjes brjod ma zin/shags byed pas shags ma phyed/ rgyal pos kyang tshar gcod ma shes pa dang / kho na re/ blun spyang la 'dri'o zer nas/ ba lang rdzi la dris pas slob dpon rgyal zer ba dang / kho na re/ rdzu 'phrul 'gran pas khyed rang nam mkha' la dkyil 198

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bsnan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha smong dang bcas pa bzhugs/'khor bris/ ngas bsub/ yang na ngas 'bri khyed rang subs zer ba la/ kho la 'brir bcug nas slob dpon gyis bsubs so/ /de nas yang na nga mkha' la 'phur/ yang na khyod 'phur zer ba la/ khyod rang 'phur gsungs pas/ kho 'phur ba na slob dpon yum chen mo'i sku che ba zhig tu sprul nas/ pus mo'i lha nga'i bar kho phyag gis zal mo bkab ste da 'phur gsungs pas 'phur ma nus so/ /de nas dbang phyug snying la zhugs te byin gyis rlobs par khas blangs pa yang mi gtsang ba'i rdzas kyis 'khor ma nus pas/ lhas mang po'i ngor bslus so zhes smre sngags bton nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du 'gro'o snyam ste nam mkha' la bros pas slob dpon gyis shin tu mtho bar zin nas/ da khyod 'di nas yar song na rlung spu gri can gyis lus dum bur gtub bo gsungs pas/ de yod par cis shes zer/ ral pa gcig chod la phangs dang gsungs te khos de ltar byas pasaskra dum bur song bas kho 'jigs te 'gro ma nus/ der slob dpon gyis khrid cas 'ongs te ral pa bregs shig gsungs pas/ kho na re/ ral pa mi 'breg nga rang gaṅgār 'chir 'gro zer bas/ sde snod mang po ba cugs pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig tu bcug ste bzhag pas/ kho skyo ste glegs bam rnams bltas pas rang gi lta ba nor bar go rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad pa'i sdig pas dmyal bar skye bar shes nas bya ba ma yin pa byas pa la 'gyod de nyes pa lce 'dis byas pa yin pas lce gcod zer te/ skye tshangs nas spu gri blangs pas de ltar byed ma bde ba nas/ do nub rmi lam du sngar byas la 'gyod pa skyes pas sdig pa 'byang la/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la zhugs nas rgyu 'bras sdig pa 'byang la/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la 199

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)zhugs nas rgyu 'bras ston pa'i bstan bcos brtsam na sdig pa 'dag go zer ba rmis pas/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag sogs bltas te las 'bras ston pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/ ār+ya de ba bla mar bsten nas rab tu byung gdams pa zhus te nyams su blangs pas dngos grub brnyes nas thub pa'i bstod tshogs dang / skyesarabs dang / byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i man ngag gnyis/ mi dge ba bcu dang dge ba bcu bstan pa/ rtsa lhung gi gzhung / gso dpyad yan lag brgyad pa la sogs pa bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad do/ /slob dpon 'di yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las lung bstan te/ dge slong mang du thos pa ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung 'gyur ba/ /ma khol zhes kyang bya ba ste/ /nga nyid kyi ni bstod byed pa/ /ji ltar yon tan bzang po ni/ /ji lta bzhin du brjod par 'gyur/ /kun nasasems ni rab dwangs shing / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan la dad/ /sgrub dka' sngags ni rab bsgrub cing / /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi de bzhin no/ /yon tan ldan zhing tshul khrims ldan//zhes pa nas/thams cad mkhyen pa'i byang chub thob//ces pa'i bar gyis lung bstan te/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs rta dbyangs/ dpa' bo/pha khol/ ma khol/ ma ti tsi tra la sogs pa mang du yod par grags so/ /'di'i sngon gyi lo rgyus ni/ ston pa 'khor mang po la chos gsungs pa'i tshe dbu la bya rog gi bya thal btang bas 'khor rnams the tshom skyes te ci'i ltas lags zhes zhus pas/ ston pas bya rog 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus phyi rol pa'i ston pa rta dbyangs zhes par gyur nas/ bstan pa la gnod pa chen po byed ba'i ltas so/ /200

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/zhes lung bstan to/ /de'i tshe 'khor de na byang chub sems dpa' lag na pad+mo can zhes bya ba zhig gis phyi rol pa de bdag gis btul nas nang pa'i bstan par 'jug par gyur cig ces smon lam btab cing / ston pas kyang de ltar gnang ste de ni slob dpon 'phags pa lha'o/ /slob dpon zla ba grags pa ni/ yul lho phyogs sa ma nar 'khrungs te/ skye ba lnga brgyar 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs shing / mdo rgyud kyi don la sbyangs pa/ klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par rtogs te/ de kho na nyid kyi don thugs la gzhol bas kun rdzob kyi snang ba thams cad rdzun par mnyam zhes gsungs pa na gzhan dag gis/'o na dngos po'i ba la 'o ma 'byung ba ltar ri mo'i ba la 'o ma 'byung ngam zer ba la/de bzhin no gsungs te ri mo'i ba las 'o ma bzhos so/ /don dam du stong par mnyam zhes gsungs pa na/ 'o na rdo'i ka ba 'di stong pa yin nam zer ba la de bzhin no gsungs te rdo'i ka ba la phyag rgyab pas thal byung du mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pas gzhan gyi bden zhen bzlog par mdzad do/ /spyir rgya gar na mu stegs kyi rgol ba tshar gcod nus na phyi rol du chos 'chad cing / de mi nus na nang du 'chad pa yin pa las/ slob dpon 'dis phyi ru chos 'chad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi nā len+t+ra ra byon pa dang gdan 'dzoms te/ chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pas slob dpon 'dis tsan+d+ra go mis dris pa'i lan thams cad thogs med la btab/ tsan+d+ra go mis spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku zhig la dris shing lan rim gyis btab pas/ slob dpon 'dis der song ste phag nas nyan pas rdo sku nyid sprul skur mdzad de tsan+d+ra go mi la slob cing 'dug pa gzigs nas nang du 201

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)byon pas sprul sku zhal btul te/ 'phags pa nye ring mnga' 'am/ khong la zhalaston pa ltar bdag la'ang bstan du gsol/ zhes sa sde khres sa jotsugs te gsolab btab pas mtshan mo rmi lam du byon te/ khyod 'jam dpal gyis byin gyisabarlabs pa'i mkhas pa yin pas byin gyis brlabs mi dgos/ tsan+d+ra go mi la ngasacung zad byin gyis rlabs pa yin gyi de skad ma zer bar song gsungs/ gnyid sad nas de ltar lags kyang zhal ston par zhu zhus pas zhal mngon sum du bstan pa na bdag gi spyi bor bzhugs la sems can thams cad kyis mthong bar mdzod cigaces zhus pas/ ngas sems can thams cad kyi drung du song kyang de rnams rang gi las kyis bsgribs pas mthong bar mi 'gyur gsungs/ cis kyang bzhugs shig zhus nas spyi bor khyer te grong khyer ba rnams la nga'i spyi bo na 'phags pa spyan ra gzigs bzhugs/ thams cad phyag dang mchod pa gyis zhes smras pas/ la langani ci yang ma mthong / la las ni khyi ro mthong / phal che bas ni chos mang po bshad pas rlung smyos yin zer/ chang 'tshong ma zhig gis zhabs tsam mthong bas kyang thun mong gi dngos grub tsam thob ces grags so/ /slob dpon des dbu ma rigasatshogs dang bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa/ 'jug pa rtsa 'grel/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba la sogs pa mdzad do/ /rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i lo rgyusani / ngo mchar can gyi gtam bdun zhes grags te/ rgyal srid rab spangs grub pa brnyes/ /gtsug lag gnyis kyi phyogs las rgyal/ /rab byung bden gzigs ②'phrul ldan/ /ngo mtshar bdun ldan de la 'dud/ /zhes pa ltar te/ slob dpon 'di nyid yul lho phyogs kyi rgyud du rgya~X di 'jam dpal go cha zhes bya ba'i sras ni

dam pa 'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ba'i go cha zhes bya bar 'khrungs te/ theg pa chen po'i rigs la gnas pas dge sbyong dang bram ze dang rgan pa la gus shing / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams la byams pa / 'phongs pa dang mgon med pa rnams la brtse ba la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la thugs gzhol ba'i ngang nas/ rig pa dang sgyu rtsal thams cad la yang mkhas par gyur te/ sang nyin rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba'i do nub rin po che'i khri bshams pa na/ rmi lam du khrid de la 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzhugs nas/bu gcig 'di ni nga yi stan yin te/ /nga ni khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/khyod dang nga nyid stan gcig la 'dug pa/ /'di ni tshul dang mthun pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa rmi ba dang / sang nyin yum gyis chu dron mos khrus byed du bcug pa na chu'i drod mi bzod pa gzigs nas/ bu snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal srid bzung na nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis mi dge ba spyad de phyi ma ngan song du 'di bas che ba'i sngag bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na 'jig rten gyi bya ba la snying po med kyi lhar phyogs bha ga la'i yul du song zhig der 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas rgyal srid la chags pa spangs te rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa chibs nas nyin zhag du mar bza' ba dang btung ba yid la mi byed par dam pa'i chos dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen yid la byed cing song bas/ bha ga la'i nags mthar slebs te ngal bas chu 'thung bar brtsam pa na/ bu mo zhig byung ste de ni dug chu yin pas ma 'thung zhig zer nas bdud rtsi'i chus tshims par byas so/ /de la khyod gang nas 'ongs dris pas/nags tshal 'di yi dbus na bdag gi bla ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin grub 203

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)pa zhig bzhugs te de'i spyan snga nas 'ongs so zer ro/ /de thos pa dang / dbulapos gter rnyed pa ltar gyur te de ston cig ces smras nas/ song ba na/ sku gsung thugs dul zhing zab pa'i spyod lam dang ldan pa'i bla ma de nyid gzi byin dang bcas te bzhugs par mthong nas gus pas phyag byas te/ rta mchog rgyan gyi brgyan pa phul nas 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gdams pa zhus pas/ de kyang gnang ste lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du bsgrubs pas 'jam pa'i dbyangs mngon sum du gzigs te grub pa brnyes so/ /de nas yul dbus kyi grong khyer du spyod pa'i brtul zhugs la song zhig ces bla mas gnang ba ltar gshegs te/ ma ga dha'i rgyal po'i sku srung mdzad cing 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi phyag mtshan shing gi ral gri shubs dang bcas pa gcig bzung nas chos kyi mthus phyir rgol ba rnams zil gyis mnan cing / skye rgu thams cad bde bar mdzad pa na mtshan mi g.yo ba'i sde zhes grags shing bkur sti chen po thob pa na/ phrag dog can dag gis ma bzod par/ 'di la ni mtshon cha shing gi ral gri las med pas rgyal po'i sku srung ji ltar nus brtag 'tshal lo zhes smras pa dang / thams cad kyis mtshon cha rim gyisabaltas pa na/ bdag gi ral gri blta bar mi bzod ces gsungs kyang nan gyisaskul bas/ 'o na dben par byon la spyan gcig phyag gis bkab ste gzigs shigaces smras nas phyungs pas de'i gzi brjid kyis rgyal po'i mig ya gcig sa la lhungs te/ g.yog dang bcas pa skrags nas skyabs su song ba las/ mig shul du mig bcug nas mthong bar byin gyis brlabs pas thams cad dad par gyur to/ /de nas spyod pa'i brtul zhugs la ga/0 4 du song ste/ 'brud ma pho ba'i tshig

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'a sun pa 'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/mas 'tsho bar byed pa na/ mi zhig gis 'byud ma dor ba'i zeg ma slob dpon gyi zhabs la 'thor bas lcags sreg la phog pa bzhin khol bar mthong ste/ de'i tshe ba ti bi ha ra'i rgyal po'i sar phyi pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta bde byed ces bya ba 'ongs nas nang pa dang rtsod cing rdzu 'phrul 'gran nas su pham pa de/ rgyal ba de'i bstan pa la 'jug dgos so zer nas/ rgyal pos nang pa rnams la bsnyad pas 'brud ma 'dor mi de na re sgo drung na rnal 'byor pa 'di ltar byed pa zhig 'dug pa des bzlog par nus sam zer te/ de btsal nas gsol ba btab ste zhal gyis bzhes pa na/ rgyal po la zhus nas/ skye bo mang po 'dus pa'i dbus su khri chen po bshams pa la/ phyi nang gi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams 'khod nas grub mtha' la brtsad pas slob dpon rgyal lo/ /yang mu stegs pa rnams kyis bar snang la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bris pa na/ slob dpon gyis chu bum pa gang ras yug gnyis mi rnams phyogs dben par sta gon gyis shig gsungs nas/ zad par rlung gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ dkyil 'khor dang mu stegs pa dang / rgyal po la sogs pa'i mi rnams kyang rlung gis khyer te ljon shing rnams 'gyel zhing phyogs thams cad mun par gyur to//de nas slob dpon gyi smin mtshams nas 'od byung nas/ rgyal po dang btsun mo la lam bstan/ gos dang bral zhing rdul gyis g.yogs pa la chus bkrus/ ras sar pa g.yogs nas mes bsros te bde bar byas shing / mu stegs kyi lha khang rnams bshigs nas nang pa'i bstan pa la btsud pas da lta'i bar du yang mu stegs pham pa'i yul zhes grags so/ /de nas nā len+t+ra'i gtsug lag khang du byon nas mkhan po rgyal ba'i lha las rab tu byung ste/ mtshan zhi ba'i lha zhes bya bar btags shing /205

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)sde snod gsum la thos bsam mdzad nas/ shin tu gces pa'i don rnams phyog gcig tu bsdus pa'i bslab pa kun las btus dang / mdo kun las btus dang /spyod 'jug rnams mdzad cing nang du yang dag 'jog la gtso cher brtson par mdzad do/ /de ltar sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu brtson pas mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' yang / gzhan dag gis de ltar mi shes par phyi'i kun spyod la dpags te za nyal 'chag gsum las gzhan mi byed pas bhu su ku ba zhesazer zhing brnyas te 'dis rab tu byung ba'i bya ba 'khor gsum gang yang mi byed par dge 'dun gyi nang du 'dug par mi rigs pas brtags la sun dbyung ngo / /zhesabagros nas/ cho 'phrul gyi zla ba la gsung rab 'don pa'i re mos slob dpon la zhus pas/ ci yang mi shes so zhes gsungs kyang nan gyis bsgo ba zhal gyisabazhes pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol du skye bo mang po 'dus pa'i dbus su mchod pa dang bcas pa'i seng ge'i khri mthon po bshams pa la spyan drangs te bzhugs nas/ sngon drang srong gis gsungs pa grags zin pa zhig 'don nam/de'i rjes su byung ba sngar ma grags pa zhig gdon zhes gsungs pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur te ma grags pa zhig 'don par gsol ba btab pas/ spyod 'jug gsungs te/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /ces pa la sogs pa'i tshe bden pa bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du gzigs shing / 'phags pa 'jam dpal yang mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa skye bo mang pos mthong nas shin tu dad par gyur te/ skyes bu dam pa 'di ni blo gros mi zad pa'o/ /zhes kyang grags so/ /de nas bsngo ba'i le'u gsungs pa'i tshe ṭ+wāṃ 6 'jam dbyangs dang bcas pa nam

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la can pa'i gru chen 'a smong dang bcas pa bzhugagamakha' la 'phags nas sku mi snang bar gyur kyang / gsung thos pa'i sgo nas gzhung rdzogs par gsungs te/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud so ma na tha dang nye bar byon pa na/ ya mtshan can gyi lta ba 'dzin pa kun tu rgyu lnga brgya tsam gnas pa las zhag bdun gyi bar du rlung las chen po byung bas 'tsho ba chad de nyon mongs par gyur nas/ sus 'tsho ba sgrub nus pa de dpon du 'bur zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis bsod snyoms byas pas 'bras chen lhung bzed gang yod pa ting nge 'dzin gyis mang por byin gyis brlabs nas thams cad tshims par mdzad de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la btsud do / / de bzhin du sprang po stong tsam yang bkres pas nyen te shi la khad pa la 'tsho ba sbyar zhing chos bstan te bde ba la bkod do/ /de'i shul du nā le rgyur paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis gzhung yi ger bkod de/ kha che ba rnams kyis le'u dgu blo ka bdun brgya yod pa bzung zhing / yul dbus pa rnams kyis le'u bcu spro ka stong yod pa bzung ste ma mthun pa dang / bslab pa kun las btus pa dang / mdo kun las btus pa'ang blta zhes gsungs pa'i bstan bcos gnyis po'ang ma rnyed par/ gzungs thob pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis kyis phyin nas zhus pas/ gzhud gi tshad yul dbus pa rnams kyis gzungs pa ltar yin la/ bstan bcos gnyis po kho bo'i spong khang gi gdung seb na paṇ+ḍi ta'i yi ge phra mo bris pa zhig yod pas ltos shig ces rjes su bstan cing / de dag gi bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i lung yang gnang ste bstan pa la phan pa rgya cher mdzad do/ /slob dpon des rang nyid so skyer zhal gyis bzhes kyang shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros kyis 'phags par bshad cing / dze ta ris/ 'jam dbyangasasprul pa zhi ba lhas/ /zhes sprul par bshad la/ bi bhu ti tsa spros/ rgyal ba'i bstan 207

brtse chen 'od snang las/skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (()la bdag nyid che/ /skyes bu mang po byon mod kyi/ /zhi ba lha yis mdzad pa 'dra'i/ /nyams dang dgongs pa can mi rnyed/ /ces gsungs so/ /thogs med sku mchedabyon tshul ni/ chos mngon pa la dgra lan gsum byung ba'i dang po mu stegs kyi rgan mo zhig na re/ nang pa'i gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra las 'gem zhes pa zhig snang ste/ 'o skol greganod mi gnod brtag par rigs so zer nas brtags pas/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin gyis mchod pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sgra chen cher sgrogs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtog sde 'di brdungs pas/ /mu stegs 'chal ba'i klad pa rnamapar 'gem/ /zhes par rig nas dmag drangs te bsnubs so/ /de nas cung zad 'phel nas yod pa'i tshe dbus kyi rgyal pos stag gzig gi rgyal po la na bza' srub med pa zhig skyes su bskur te de'i snying khar rkang rjes 'dra ba zhig yod pas/ngan sngags byas so zer nas dmag drangs nas bsnubs so/ /de nas yang cung zad 'phel ba'i tshe nang pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig tu phyi pa'i sprang po gnyis slong du 'ongs pa la chu bkrus gtor bas khros te nyi ma bsgrubs nas nang pa'i gtsug lag khang dang gsung rab mang po bsregs nas bsnubs so/ /de'i tshe bram ze mo gsal ba'i tshul khrims zhes pa'i bsam pa la/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba mngon pa la dgra lan gsum gyis bsnubs pas/ 'di dar bar byed pa la gzhan yang mi snang / bdag kyang bud med du song bas mi nus kyi/ lus la bu bskyed la dar bar byed du gzhug go snyam ste/ rgyal rigs dang 'dus pas thogs med dang / bram ze dang 'dus pasadabyig gnyen byung nas/ btsas pa na lce la gi waṃ gis a 'bri ba la sogs pa blo rno ba'i cho ga yang byas te cher skyes pa/ ṭ+wāṃ pha'i las gang yin zhus pas/ ma na re/

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa 'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de'i phyir ma bskyed kyi blo sbyong gyis la bstan pa dar bar gyis shig gsungs nas/gcung kha cher slob dpon 'dus bzang gi drung du byon/ gcen gyis ri bya rkang gi phug tu byams pa bsgrub tu byon te/ lo gsum tu bsgrubs pas mtshan ma ci yang ma mthong bas skyo ste phyir thon pa na/ rgan po zhig shing bal gyi 'dab mas lcags kyi sdong po la khab byed pa mthong nas/ khab ji ltar 'byung zhes dris pas/ snying stobasaldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /bsgrub na mi 'grub gang yang med/ /dka' yang brnag pa ma dor na/ /ri bo rnams kyang thal bar rlog /zer bas/ yang lo gsum bsgrubasate 'thon pa na chu thigs kyis brag zad pa mthong nas yang lo gsum bsgrubs nas sngar bzhin 'thon pa na bya sgros brag zar pa mthong nas yang lo gsum ste/ lo bcu gnyis su bsgrubs kyang mtshan ma ma byung bas skyo ste 'thon nas phyin pa na/ khyi mo khog smad 'bus gang ba ro stod zug cing za ba zhig mthong nas/ de la lhag par snying rje skyes te/ bsal na 'bu 'chi/ ma bsal na khyi mo 'chi bar dgongs nas/rang gi lus las sha bcad la der 'bu rnams bsal snyam ste grong khyer a tsan+t+ra ra byon te gseg shang steng bar bcug ste/ gser gyi spu gri g.yar nas rang gi lus las sha bcad/ 'bu phyag gis blang na ni shi yi dogs te spyan btsum nas ljags kyis blang bar brtsam pa na khyi med par rje btsun 'od dang bcas par mthong nas/kye ma yab gcig bdag gi skyabs/ /ngal brgyas 'bad kyang 'bras ma mchis ci phyir char sprin rgya mtsho'i dpung / /gdung bas bsregs te skom tshad 'bebs/ /bdag gis de tsam bsgrubs na rtags kyang ma byung bas thugs rje re chung / zhes 'khangs pas rje btsun gyis/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang / /sa bon mi rung mi 209

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)'khrungs ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang / /skal ba med nga sa bzang mimyong / /nga dang po nas yod de khyod rang gi las kyi sgrib pas ma mthong ba yin da ltasnying rje chen po skyes pas/ las sgrib dag nas mthong ba yin te/ de ltar yin par/khyod rang nga phrag gong du khyer la grong khyer ba rnams la ston zhig gsungs na bstan pas mthong ba su yang ma byung bas yid ches so/ /der khyod ci 'dod gsungab la/ theg chen dar bar zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ nga'i chos gos la 'dus shigagasungs nas dga' ldan du byon te mi lo lnga bcu'am lnga bcu rtsa gsum mam/ sde'i sna mchan las zla ba drug zer te/ lha'i gro skad gcig bzhugs nas/ yum gyi mdo dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa chen po dang / theg chen gyi mdo sde mang po dang /de dag gi don ston pa'i bstan bcos byams pa'i chos lnga rnams gsan te mi yuladu byon nas rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga dang / de'i don bsdus pa sdom gnyi brtsams/ byams chos lnga yang yi ger bkod de/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang / yum gyi don ston pa de nyid rnam nges/ rgyud bla'i 'grel pa/ dgongs 'grel gyi 'grel pa sogs mdzad cing / sa gsum pa mngon du mdzad de/ don gsal gyi 'grel pa chos shes kyis mdzad pa las/ slob dpon thogs med sa gsum pa 'od byed brnyes kyang dbyig gnyen 'dul ba'i don du sems tsam du ston no zhes dang /sems tsam rgyan gyi 'grel pa las/ thogs med ni sa gsum pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa 'a'o zhes gsungs pas so/ /slob dpon 'dis dgung lo phyed dang nyis brgyar bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad nas mthar thug thob par lung bstan te/'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ thogs // 0ces bya'i dge slong ni/ /bstan bcos de

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul ba pa 'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa 'i gru chen kha sdong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ni don la mkhas//mdo sde nges don drang ba'i don//rnam pa mang po rab tu 'byed//'jig rten rig pa ston bdag nyid/ /gzhung 'byed ngang tshul can du 'gyur/ /de yi rig pa grub pa ni/ /su la'i pho nya mo zhes brjod/ /de yi sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /blo ni bzang po skye bar 'gyur/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas bya'i phyir/ /mdo yi de nyid don sdud byed/ /lo ni brgya dang lnga bcur 'tsho/ /de lus zhig nas lha yul 'gro/ /'khor ba rnams su 'gro ba na/ /yun ring bde ba rjes myong nas/ /bdag nyid chen po mthar gyis de/ /byang chub thob par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes so/ /dbyig gnyen gyis kha cher slob dpon 'dus bzang gi drung du dgra bcom pa bzhi ldan dang / rgur po la sogs pa mang pos mngon pa sde bdun dang lung gi don bsdus par grags shing 'od ldan las/ nyer sbas kyis mdzad par yang bshad pa'i bstan bcos bye brag tu bshad pa chen po dang / mngon pa sde bdun la sogs pa bslab pas tshegs med par mkhyen nas rgya gar du byon par bzhed pa'i tshe yul de'i sho gam srung ba'i gnod sbyin gyis lan gsum gyi bar du bzlog kyang nor ni med/chos blo la yod pas dbral du ma btub pas btang ste nā le jir byon pa dang /gcen gyis bstan bcos mang du brtsams pa'ang gsan nas/ kye ma thogs med nags su lo/ /bcu gnyis bar tu ting 'dzin bsgrub/ /ting 'dzin ma grub glang chen gyi/ /rgyab khal longs pa'i grub mtha' brtsams/ /zhes theg chen gyi gang zag dang chos la bsting zhing bskur par 'debs pa ga rten gyis gsan nas/ log sgrub don min du 'gyur bar dgongs te/ de bzlog pa'i phyir slob ma gnyis/ sa bcu pa dang / blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa gnyis 'dzin du bcug nas gcung can song 2/1

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)la srod dang tho rangs thon zhig ces gsungs pa ltar bsgrubs pas/ gcung gisagasan te/ srod la theg chen 'di rgyu bzang la 'bras bu g.yel ba 'dra gsungs/tho rangs rgyu 'bras gnyis ka bzang bar 'dug pa la ngas bskur ba btab pas lte 'dis lan pa yin pas gcod gsungs nas spu gri btsal bas khong gnyis kyis/ljags gum mi 'tshal/ de'i sgrib pa sbyang thabs gcen la mnga' bas der gshegs so/ /zhes smras te byon no/ /der chos mang du gsan zhing 'bel gtam mdzad pa'i tshe gcung spobs pa shin tu myur bar byung / gcen cung zad bul pa'i lan bzang po byung ba la de'i rgyu zhus pas khyod ni skye ba lnga brgyar paṇ+ḍi tar gyur pas skyes stobs kyi shes rab che ba yin/ nga la de lta bu med pas yi dam zhig la 'dri zhing lan 'debs pa yin gsung / de bdag la bstan par zhu byas pas/ rje btsun la zhu yi gsungs nas zhus pas khyod so so skye bo yin zhing dang po theg chen la bskur pa btab pas tshe 'di la mthong ba'i skal pa med kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir theg chen gyi mdo 'grel mang du rtsoms/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal thon/ phyi ma la mjal gsung / de nas gcen la lhag par dad/ nga yi phu bo klu dang 'dra/ /nga ni char sdod bya dang 'dra//klu yi rgyal pos char phab kyang //bya yi bre bar song ba med//ces zer ro/ /de nas byams pa'i gsung yang bsgrubs shing mngon pa mdzod brtsams te/ skyes dang bcas pa 'dus bzang la springs pas/ de'i slob ma dag gis lo dang grag la sogs pa 'di rnams/ 'o skol gyi grub mtha' la zur za ba 'dra zhes smras pa na kho bstan bcos rtsom pa la mkhas pas tshig rgyan yin zer te shin tu mnyes nas/ 'grel pa mdo ༵༵ mthun pa yang byas so/ /dus phyis rang

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/'grel mdzad de bskur bas/ rtsa ba sun 'byin gyi 'grel pa 'di lung rigs gis tshar bcad de pham par byas la/ kho nyid kyi lag pas bsub tu gzhug dgos gsungs nas bstan bcos lan gyi phung po'ang brtsams te rgya gar du 'byon par chas pas dbyig gnyen gyis gsan nas/ slob dpon bye brag tu smra pa'i grub mtha' la byang ba yin pas bzlog kyang dka' la bzlog kyang dgos pa med pas rang byung gi mchod rten bltar 'gro zhes bsgrags te bal yul du 'gro'o snyam pas byon no/ /de'i rjes la slob dpon 'dus bzang rab tu byung ba'i 'khor gos ngur smig gi 'od kyis nam mkha' dmar por 'gro ba tsam dang bcas byon te nā len+t+ra ra zhi bar gshegs so/ /slob dpon dbyig gnyen bal yul du byon pas hang ngu zhes pa rab byung gi cha byad la sdom khrims mi bsrung ba chang gi bum pa thogs pa gzigs pas/ bstan pa nub 'dug gsung zhing / thugs skyo bas rnam rgyal bzlog te btan nas sku 'das te mchod rten brtsigs pas da dung yod par grags so/ /de ltar rigs mchog tu gyur pa bram ze'i rigs las rab tu byung ba'i dge slong /'bum sde dgu bcu go dgu'am brgyad cu'i don thugs la mnga' zhing / brgyad stong pa la rgyun du zhal 'don mdzad pa'i slob dpon des/ bka' 'khor lo dang po'i dgongs 'grel mdzod rtsa 'grel/ bar pa'i dgongs 'grel yum gyi gzhung 'grel pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad/gzhan yang sa bcu pa/ blo gros mi zad pa/ ga ya go ri/ chos bzhi pa'i mdo/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs/ chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed la sogs pa bka' bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa mang du mdzad do/ /slob dpon 'di yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las lung bstan te/ lho yi phyogs su bram ze ni/ /yi ge dang po ba 213

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gyung gces bsdus/ (()bstan pa/ /ston pa'i bstan pa de gtso byed/ /mchod rten kun dga' ra b.raganas//ston pa'i gzugs brnyan yid 'ong ba'i//sa ni rgya mtsho gnyis mthar thug/thams cad kyi ni rgyan du byas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon de la slob ma ra bas mkhas pa bzhir grags pa'i mngon pa rang bas mkhas pa slob dpon sgo brtan ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen bha ga sni ha ra bya ba na 'bru mar gyis za pasabakang ba'i nang du bzhugs nas/ 'bum sde brgyad bcu zhal 'don mdzad pa'i tshe de'i gdung khung na phug ron zhig rgyun du yod pa de re zhig gi tshe shi ste mtha' 'khob ḍa ma zhes bya bar dmangs rigs zhig gi bur skyes ma thag nga'i slob dpon gang na bzhugs zhes 'dri ba la/ slob dpon su yin byas pas dbyig gnyen yin zer nas cung zad skyes pa dang / phas slob dpon can du bskyal bas slob dpon gyi yi ge'i phyi mo nas bzung rig pa thams cad mkhas par bslabs so/ /chung ngu'i dus nā len+d+ra na sgrol ma'i rten bzhugs pa'i phyag tu sran ma'i phud phul la gzod za snyam ste/ kha cig phul bas 'dril nas kha byung / yang yang phul bas 'dril te 'phags mas ma gsol bar rang za ba mi yong snyam nas zad zad phul yang 'dril bas yi chad de ngus so/ /der 'phags ma'i zhal dngos su bstan te/ ngu mi dgosabyin gyis brlab kyis gsungs/ de nas mkhyen rab thogs med du gyur te/ rten de la sran ma'i sgrol ma zhes grags so/ /slob dpon de la dkon mchog brtsegasapa'i le'u bzhi bcu zhe dgu yan chad thugs la mnga' zhing 'grel pa yang mdzad ces grags la/ gzhan yang mngon pa gong 'og dang / rab tu byed rma sde brgyad kyi 'grel pa la sogs pa mdzad do/ /deX/ rdo slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi sbyin bdag

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/rgyal po ha ri shas/ slob dpon chos grags la da lta su mkhas dris pas/ mkhasapar rgyal pos byas pa ye/ /btsun pa yon tan 'od kyang ste/ /bstan bcos kun gyi sung 9pang )gcig la/ /slob dpon blo gros brtan pa nyid/ /gsungs skad do/ /mkhas pa'i grags pas kun khyab cing / dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma las lung bstan to/ /tshad ma rang bas mkhas pa slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po ni/ rigs bram ze la gnas ma bu'i mkhan po zhig la rab tu byung ste/ tha snyad kyi gtsug lag la sbyangs pa mthar son nas/ mkhan po la spong ba bsam gtan gyi man ngag zhus pas/ brjod du med pa'i bdag sgoms shig gsungs nas bsgoms pas bdag ma rnyed de/ de phyi nang gi sgrib g.yogs kyis bsgribs sam snyam nas/ phyogs bzhir mar me chen po spar/ lus gcer bur phyung / mig bgrad de phyogs bcur bdag btsal yang ma rnyed do/ /de'i tshe spyod lam de ltar byed pa mkhan pos thos te ci'i phyir de ltar byed dris pas bdag 'tshol lo zhes smras pa na/ nged rang gi grub mtha' sun 'byin par 'dug pas song zhig zer ba dang / mkhan po de nyid rigs pas sun dbyung nus mod kyis 'on kyang 'os ma yin snyam nas/ rim gyis byon te/slob dpon dbyig gnyen can byon nas spyir theg pa gsum dang / khyad par rnam rig pa'i grub mtha' la mkhas par sbyangs te/ mdzod dang yon tan mtha' yas par bstan pa'i 'grel pa mdzad cing / dmigs brtag la sogs pa tshad ma'i bstan bcos thor bu ba brgya rtsa brgyad brtsams pa 'thor ba lta bur gzigs nas/de thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa/ tshad ma'i mdo kun las btus brtsam par bzhed de phyogs glang phug ces pa'i brag ngos la thod le kor bris/ tshad mar gyur 215

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal te/ /tshad mar bsgrub phyir rang gi gzhung kun las/ /btus te sna tshogs 'thor rnams 'dir gcig bya/ /zhes mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' bris pas sa g.yos/ 'od gsal/ sgra grags/ mu stegs pa'i ston pa rnams kyi byin pa reng bas pa la sogs pa ltas khyad par can du ma byung ba de'i nye logs na yod pa'i mu stegs kyi ston pa nag po thub rgyal zhes bya bas mngon shes phra mos brtag pa na de'i mthur shes te/phrag dog gi dbang gis slob dpon bsod snyoms la gshegs pa'i shul du phyin te/lan gnyis kha bsubs kha pas/ gsum pa bris nas mjug tu/ ngas bris pa'i tshig bsabacad 'di 'phyi ba su yin/ ku re dang kyal ma'i phyir yin na dgos pa chen po yod pas ma 'phyi/ phrag dog gi dbang gis yin na blo la yod pas dbyi bar mi nus/rtsod par 'dod na lus snang bar gyis shig brtsad par bya'o/ /zhes bris pas/yang bltas sngar bzhin byung ste kho 'ongs pas brtsad par bya'o/ /zhes pa mthong nas der bsdad do/ /slob dpon bsod snyoms 'bor te byon pa dang / phrad nas bstan pa rgyan du btsugs te brtsad pas/ kho lan gsum gyi bar du pham par byasanas/ da khyod nang pa'i bstan pa la zhugs gsungs pas kho khros nas kha nas me spar te slob dpon gyi yo byad thams cad bsregs/ slob dpon yang 'tshig la khad par byas pas thugs skyo ste ngas sems can thams cad kyi don bya snyam mod kyi 'di gcig pu'i don yang mi nus par 'dug pas rang don zhi bde mngon du bya'o snyam nas thod le kor nam mkha' la 'phangs te 'di sa la babs ma thag sems bskyed btang snyam du bsam pas/ de sa la // sdubs par 'jam dpal dngos su byon te/

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la tsan pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/bu ma byed ma byed theg pa dman dang phrad las blo gros ngan skye ste/ khyed kyi bstan bcos 'di la mu stegs tshogs kyis gnod par mi nus te khyod kyis sa ma thob kyi bar du dge ba'i bshes su nga 'gyur gyi/ phyi ma'i dus na bstan bcos kun gyi mig gcig tu ni 'di 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas rjes su bzung ngo zhes grags so//rnam nges kyi ṭīk+ka chos mchog las/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po ri phug dben pa zhig na sgom pa la brtson pas gnas pa na/ gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu 'khor ba la yid 'byung nas sems can gyi don las gzhan du phyogs te gcig tu grol bar 'dod pa na/ skad cig de la 'phags pa 'jam dpal byon nas/ bu skye bo ngan pa dang rjes su mthun par sems bdar khri ra )bas gzhan dbang du 'gyur te/sems can kun la phan par nus pa'i sems yod bzhin du ci'i phyir btang snyoms su byed ces gsungs pa dang / lan du bcon ldan 'das 'khor ba ni bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal du ma dang ldan pas bsran par mi nus la sems kyang dam pa ma yin pas skye bo la dga' bas g.yo bar spyod cing / khyed mthong lam bdag la byin gyis ma brlab na de la ci zhig bgyir mchi/ zhes gsungs pas lan du/ bu ji srid sa ma thob kyi bar du khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni nga nyid do zhes gsungs te mi snang bar gyur te zhes 'byung ngo / /slob dpon 'di 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dang po yi ge na zhes pa/ /lho'i phyogs su yang dag brten//bdag nyid chen po sngags zlos ldan/ /nges par byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur//zhes gsungs shing dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma las kyang lung bstan to/ /des tshad ma kun las btus rang 'grel dang bcas pa brtsams shing / de'i slob ma dbang phyug 217

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)sdes 'grel bshad kyang mdzad do/ /slob dpon chos kyi grags pa ni/ sto phyogasargyal dbang gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya bar mu stegs kyi bram ze'i rigs su skyes te/chung ngu la sgra legs par 'byongs nas/ zhang po mu stegs kyi ston pa gzhen nu legs ldan la mu stegs kyi rab tu byung ba'i ca'/blangs pas/ ngan du smras te bsgrad do/ /der mu stegs thams cad pham par byed pa zhig bya'o snyam ste/ nang pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas sbyangs pa mdzad cing / slob dpon dbang phyug sde la tshad ma kun las btus tshar gsum nyan pas/ gnyis par slob dpon lasakyang mkhas par gyur te slob dpon yang shin tu mnyes nas/ khyod kyis nga'i grub mtha' nor ba rnams phyogs sngar gyis la kun las btus la 'grel ba rtsoms shig ces rjes su gnang ngo / /de nas slob dpon chos grags kyis grangs can gyi grub mtha'i gsang tshig shes pa'i ched du zhang po'i chung ma'i g.yog byas nas mgu bar byas nas/ grub mtha'i gnad 'dri dgos byas pas 'dod pa spyod pa'i tshe 'dri yi/ khyod rang yid la zungs zer nas de bzhin byas pas legs par shes so/ /de nas mkhas pa yod na rtsod par byed do/ /zhes dril bsgrags pas/ phal cher yul gzhan du bros/ rtsod pa byas pa rnams rigs pas tshar bcad de chos kyis lam la bkod nas/ gal te chos kyi grags pa yi/ /smra ba'i nyi ma nub pa na/ /chos rnamasaganyid log yang na shi /chos ma yin rnams da gdod longs/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas slob dpon rim gyis grong khyer dang ljongs rgyu zhing / mthar rgyal po me tog rgyas pa'i sgo drung du phyin pa na/ rgyal pos da lta su mkhas dris pas/ shes rab can gyi mchog ni phyogs kyi glang po ste/ /tsa/ ṭā mi brjod pa rnams par dag /snyan ngag

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i sru chen kha nga dang bcas pa bzhugs/dpa' bo las byung sdeb spyor mkhas/ /me tog kun tu rgyas pa longs spyod ldan//phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nga min su/ /zhes gsungs pas rgyal po na re/ dharma kirti yin nam zer/ de skad du'ang grags gsungs pas rgyal pos gdan drangs te/sbyin bdag byas/ rab tu byed pa sde bdun dang / rnam 'grel gyi le'u dang po'i rang 'grel mdzad de/ bstan bcos rnams mkhas pa'i grwar 'grims pas phal cher gyis ma shes/ la las shes kyang phrag dog gis nyes zhes bsgrags te khyi mjug la btags pas/ slob dpon na re/ khyi grong dang srang kun tu rgyu ba bzhin bstan bcos kyang dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon 'di yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las lung bstan te/ yi ge dha zhes sdom brtson nyid/ /lho'i phyogs su rnam par bsgrags/ /pha rol rgol ba bzlog nas kyang / /de bzhin sdom brtson sngags kyang 'grub ces gsungs so/ /slob dpon des paṇ+ḍi ta lha dbang blo la 'grel pa rtsom par bka' gnang bas lan cig brtsams te gzigs phul bas chus bkrus/ yang brtsams pas mes bsreg phyin brtsams nas phul bas 'phrosadang / tshig zur gyis mtshon pa'i don rnams ma byung bar 'dug ste/ dngos bstan gyi don tsam byung 'dug gsung ngo / /de'i slob ma shākya blos 'grel bshad byas/de'i slob ma rgyan mkhan pos spur la lung blangs te 'grel pa mdzad/ ya ma ris rgyan la 'grel bshad byas so/ /slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma phar phyin rang bas mkhas pa 'phags pa rnam grol sde ni/ gtsug lag du ma'i bdag po/'phags pa ku ru kul+le pa'i sde pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bangs kyi dpon po sarab tu dga' ba thob pa ste/ des sangs rgyas la mngon sum du nyan nas mngon 219

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa nyi khri lnga stong pa dang sbyar ba nyi khri snang ba mdzad/ btsun pa rnam grol sdes nyi khri rnam 'grel mdzad do/ /slob dpon seng ge bzang po ni/ rgyal rigs las rab tu byung ba/ phyi nang gi gru mtha' thams cad la mkhas pa/ khyad par du yum gyi don la ring du goms pa zhig ste/ des rang gi mkhan po rnam snang mdzad bzang po la byams pa'i sgrub thabs zhus nas bsgrub pas rmi lam du dge slong gur gum gyi mdog can spyod lam shin tu mdzes pa zhig rmis te/ shar phyogasakha sa pa ṇir song zhig ces lung bstan to//sad de der song na zhag gsum du bsnyung gnas byas te rmi lam brtags pas rmi lam na o tan ta pū ri bi ha ri'i gas la'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ sprin phung thug po zhig gi bseb na lha'i bu lus sprin gyi bseb nas byung nas mchod pa byed pa mthong ste ci byed dris pas/ rje btsun byams pa brgyad stong pa gsung ba la mchod pa byed pa yin zer nas ring du bltas pas/ rje btsun zhal gser gyi mdog can spyi gtsug mchod rten gyis sprasapa/ phyag g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa tsam zhig mthong nas phyag dang mchod pa byas te nyid kyi bstan bcos la 'grel pa mang du mchis na/ gang gi rjesasu 'jug par bgyi zhus/pas/ thams cad kyi gzhung legs par rtogs la 'thor ba bsdus te khyod kyis phyogs gcig tu rtsoms shig ces gnang ba thob bo sad de mchod pa byas nas bstan bcos brtsams pa'i sbyin bdag btsal ba'i phyir shar nas nub tu byon pa na/ rgyal po sa skyong gis yum 'chad pa la slob dpon seng ge bzang po mkhas par thos te/ gdan 'dren btang ba'i pho nya dang phrad nas gdan drangs te/ nyi khri bsdus don le brgya~X ṭ+wāṃ/ brgyad stong 'grel chen/ don gsal

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i thu chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/'grel pa/ bsdus don rtogs par sla ba/ sher phyin sgom pa la sogs pa mdzad/ces grags la/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ dpal ldan chos skyong gis sbyin bdag byas nas/ tsha ba gsum gyi gtsug lag khang du byas par bshad de/ dpal ldan chos skyong ni sa skyong gi yab mes yin par yang grags so/ /de'i slob ma sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ rang gi slob ma gu ṇa mi tras bskul nas bsdus 'grel brtsams/ gsang 'dus la lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi mdzad do//slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma 'dul ba rang bas mkhas pa yon tan 'od ni/rgya cher 'grel las/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po/ bram ze'i btsun pa yon tan 'od bdag dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i chos 'dul ba bdud rtsi'i nying khus shes rab kyi dbang po rgyas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' dam pa nan tan snying por sgrub pa/ zhes byung ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa des/ lo bzhi brgyar bzhugs nas 'du spru ba'i mdo/ de'i rang 'grel/ dme sha tam/ byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u'i 'grel pa la sogs pa mdzad cing / mdo rtsa la chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis rgya cher 'grel mdzad de/ de yon tan 'od kyi slob mar yang kha cig 'dod do/ /slob dpon shākya 'od ni/ ma ga dhar bzhugs pa'i mkhan po bsod nams grags pa dang zhi ba 'od kyi slob mar 'od ldan las bshad cing / des 'dul ba sum brgya pa dang rang 'grel 'od ldan mdzad do/ /sgra'i lo rgyus ni/ thog mar sum cu rtsa gsum du/ sarba dzñā zhes pa'i sgra mkhan zhig byung / des lha'i dbang po brgya byin la bslab ste legs par shes nas/22 /

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (4)in+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa mdzad/ de la drang srong phur bus bslab nas lha'i bu rnams la bstan pas lha'i bla ma'am sgra mkhan zhes btags te/ de nga rgyal che bas/ lha'i dbang pos phur bu rgya mtsho las chu bum pa gang len du btang nas/ de nas ku sha'i rtses chu thigs gcig blangs te/ sgra yi bstan bcos rgya mtsho tsam/ kho bos shes pa bum chu tsam/ khyod kyis shes pa chu thigs tsam/ /zhes smras pas kho yi mug ste sgra mi 'chad par sems pa na/ dbang pos/ 'on kyang rang gis ji ltar shes pa ston cigaphan thogs par 'gyur/ zhes bsnye dbas sngar gyi dam bca' ba dang mi 'gal ba'i ched du dus bzang bzhi bsrungs nas/ de las gzhan la bslab par khas blangasate / tshes brgyad slob dpon nges par 'joms/ /bcu bzhi la ni slob ma 'joms//gnam stong la ni rig pa 'joms/ /tshes gcig la ni thams cad 'joms/ /zhesazer ro/ /dbang pos brda sprod de 'dzam bu'i gling du'ang re zhig dar bar gyur to//de'i rjes su bram ze pā ṇi ni byung ste sgra bslab par 'dod nas ltas mkhan la lagaris bstan pas/ sgra mi shes par 'dug zer ba na mtshon rnon pos lag ris bri te / slob dpon btsal bas ma rnyed nas/ ma hā de wa bsgrub pas zhal bstan te rtsi'adod zer ba la/ sgra shes par 'tshal lo/ /zhes smras pas/ lhas/ a i u zhesasogs brjod de byin gyis brlabs pas sgra thams cad shes zhes grags so/ /nang pa rnams spyan ras gzigs bsgrub pas shes par 'chad pa de lung dang mthun ska'ajam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ bram ze'i khye'u pā ṇi ni/ /nges par nyan thos byang chubatu / / nga yis lung bstan byas pa yin/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bdag nyid che/ /de yang de yi sngags grub bo/ /zhes gsu/sdu shing / laṅkar gshegs pa las/ sgra byed

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bca pa bzhugs/pa ni pā ṇi ni/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /de pā ṇi byā ka ra zhes bya ba sh+lauka nyis stong yod pa zhig mdzad/ de la klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bus ma hā bha ṣa zhes pa'i 'grel pa blo ka 'bum yod pa zhig mdzad de shin tu dar ro/ /dus phyis klu sgrub kyi sbyin bdag rgyal po bde spyod la btsun mo sgra shes pa zhig yod de rgyal pos khrus byed pa'i tshe de la chu gtor bas/ ma mo da ka siñtsa zhes pa bdag la chu ma 'thor zhes smras pas/ rgyal pos 'phral skad kyi tshig dang sbyar nas til gyi la du bslang zer bar go ste/ bran mo zhig la til gyi la du bskur bas/ saṃ sla ta'i skad cung zad kyang mi shes pa'i rgyal po ba lang lta bu 'di dang 'grogs pa bas shi ba sla'o snyam ste lcebs par rtsom pa na/ rgyal posangs kyang slob ces spro ba sring ngo / /de'i tshe rgyal po'i shad po dbang phyug go chas/ rgyal pos slob dpon mkhas pa yang rnyed par dka'/ rnyed kyang yun ring du mi shes pas rgyal srid kyi bya ba 'chor/ de bsabadag gis 'dod pa'i lha bsgrub ste shes par byas nas rgyal po la tshegs chung ngus bslab bo/ /zhes smras te/ gzhon nu ga rti ka bsgrub pas zhag bdun nas mthong ste/ci 'dod zer ba la/ sgra shes par 'tshal lo zhes smras pas/ sirnyo war+ṇa sa ma sna ya/zhes pa nas/ mtshams sbyor rkang pa lnga/ ming le rkang pa drug kun bshad rkang pa bzhi bshad pas rlom sems skyes te/ des 'tshal lo zhes smras te/ lha'i byin gyisabarlabs dang rang gi bag chags sad pas legs par shes so/ /de nas bstan bcos 'di'i ming ci snyam nas/ de wa shasta nā ma gi ho zhes smras pas/ ka wā pa gu tra zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal po la bslabs pas myur du shes te/ btsun mo'ang mgu'o/ khung zad ma rdzogs pa kun bshad rkang pa bzhi dang krita rkang pa 223

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)drug dbang phyug go cha dang bram ze mchog sred kyis gzhan nas kha bskangs te mdzad ces grags so/ /paṇ+ḍita grags 'byor gyis de'i 'grel pa slob phan mdzad/bgrod dkar seng ges dur sing mdzad/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍita byu tras kyang 'grel pa mdzad/ slob dpon spyan gsum 'bangs kyis dur sing la 'grel bshad mdzad/slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi ni/ shar phyogs lha ga lar 'khrungs shing / gzhen nu tshwamakhas par gyur te/ bha ren+t+ra'i rgyal po'i bu mo tā ra zhes pa dang lhan cig bzhug pa na lan cig gi tshe/ g.yog mos rje mo la tā ra zhes 'bod pa gsan pas/ mo dang yi dam gyi mtshan mthun pa mi rung dgongs nas 'byon pa ra chas pa dang / rgyalapos thos te nga'i bu mo dang lhan cig mi 'dug na gaṅgā la skyur cig zer nas bskyur ba na slob dpon gyis sgrol ma la bstod pa mdzad pas/ sgrol mas chu dbus su gling sprul te zhal bstan nas byin gyi brlabs pas/ ding sang yang tsan+d+ra gling zhesagrags so/ /de nas nya pas bsgral te bha ren drar byon pas rgyal po'ang dad cing / mthar gyis nā le rgyur byon te/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas chos 'chad pa'i sar gdugs zhig khyer te phyin pa na/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas pha gi nga la rtsod pa byed 'dod par 'dug dgongs nas yon tan ci shes dris pas/ sgra pā ṇi shes/'jam dpal mtshan brjod shes/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa shes gsungs pas/slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi yin nam gsungs pas/ de ltar grags so gsungs pas/'o na dge 'dun gyis bsu ba byed pas/ re zhig phar thegs shig gsungs pa na/nga dge bsnyen la dge 'dun gyi bsu ba mi rung byas pas/ shing rta'i steng du 'jam dpal bzhugs/ de'i rgyab tu khyed ba//sa shig 'jam dbyangs la bsu ba byed

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mi'i 'jug pa'i thu chen kha sgong dang bams pa bzhugs/pa'i lugs su bya'o gsungs nas de ltar byas dus/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa sho lo ka bcu bzhi yod pa zhig mdzad pas 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal nas/ nga la de tsam gyi yon tan 'dug gam gsungs nas dbu yon mdzad pas 'jam dbyangs dbu yon ma zhes grags so/ /rtsod pa mdzad dus tsan+d+ra go mi la 'phags pa'i sku gcig gis slob cing 'dug pa/ zla grags kyis gzigs nas 'phags pa nye ring ma mdzad gsungs pas phyag mdzub kye re bzhugs pas/ spyan ras gzigs mdzub kyer mar grags so/ /yang rgan mo zhig gis slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi la nor bslangs pa na / slob dpon gyis sgrol ma'i sku zhig la gsol ba btab pas/ phyag gdub la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan mang po gnang bas sgrol ma rgyan med ma zhes grags te / yi dam gyis rjes su bzung ba'i lo rgyus mang du yod do/ /de nas sman dpyad la sogs pa'i bstan bcos phran mang du brtsoms pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhal nas/ theg chen gyi bstan bcom mang du rtsoms shig gsungs nas/ zla ba sgron ma'i 'grel pa dang / sdom pa nyi shu pa dang / sku gsum la 'jug pa la sogs pa mdzad do/ /de'i tshe slob ma rgyal rigs kyi dge slong zhig babs nas sdig pa sna tshogs spyod pa gzigs pas de 'dul ba'i phyir du/ slob spring / tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo/ yi ge'i mdo/ byings mdo/ nyer bsgyur/ u ṇa/ sub dang ting la sogs pa mdzad nas gas lo/ /dus der slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba tshigs bcad du byas pa legs pa zhig gzigs te / rang gi byas pa'i bstan bcos mi legs par dgongs nas bsnub bo snyam ste khron par bskur ba dang /225

brtse chen 'od snang las/skya'i chos 'gu pa gces bsdus/ (()'jig rten dbang phyug gis khyod kyis lhag bsam gyis byas pas phan che bar 'gyur gyis thon cig gsungs nas bston te khron pa de la tsan+d+ra khron pa zhes gragasashing / de nas chu 'thungs pa rnams blo rno bar 'gyur ro zhes grags so/ /slobadapon de'i shad po chos 'bangs kyis tsan+d+ra pa la 'grel pa sho lo ka stong phrag drugayod pa zhig mdzad/ de la rat+na ma tis 'grel pa 〈 ka stong phrag bcu gnyis yod pa zhig mdzad/ de la paṇ+ḍita zla ba gang pas 'grel bshad kyi bshad pa sho lo misum khri drug stong yod pa zhig mdzad do/ /de nas paṇ+ḍita rā dza shrīs ka tsan gnyisarka'i don bsdus pa zhig mdzad/ dus phyis paṇ+ḍita 'e tis bod la phan pa'i sgra smra sgo mtshon cha mdzad do/ /gzhan yang snyan dngags dang / zlos gar dang / sman dpyad la sogs pa'i lo rgyus ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi malas/ dge slong klu sgrub ces bya ba ma lus yon tan 'byung khungs sems can kunal phan thogs pa/ /slob dpon blo brtan ces bya gcod byed tshe yi grub pa stong phrag bcu dang bcas pa rnams/ /zhes dang / dge bcu'i lam gyis grub par gyur pa 'phags pa lha dang lu ba'i na bza' rta dbyangs dang //phyogs kyi glang po gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa zla ba pad+ma pad+ma'i myu gu zhes/ /ma 'gong bha sa la yi rtogasapas rgyal po ma lus nag po in+d+ra bhu ti dang / /zhes pa dang / ye shes ming can rdorje dril bu lag btung dag kyang de bzhin thod par chang 'thung zhing / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dngarus pa'i rgyan cha chang snod cang te'u ster ba nag po'i ming can no/ /zhes gsung so / / gzhan yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang / mgon po mngon 'byung dang / snyi rje pad dkar la sogs pa'i mdo rgyud 2//sa nas bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/pa'i sdom brtson dang / rgyal po dang / khyim bdag la sogs pa mang po lung bstan te byu/ de dag gis kyang 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas/ bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa'// // gsum pa bod du dar ba'i tshul la/ snga dar gyi rnam gzhag phyi dar gyi rnam gzhag de dag gi tshe chos sgyur ba'i tshul gsum las/ snga dar la/ spyir bod du mi'i 'gro ba dang po byung tshul ni/ lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod pa'i 'grel par/ sngon rgya gar du skya seng bu lnga dang / dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis 'thab pa'i dus ru pa ti zhes bya ba'i rgyal po dmag stong phrag gcig dang bcas pa bud med kyi chas su zhugs te ri gangs can gyi bseb tu bros pa las 'phel ba yin par bshad cing / bod kyi gtam rgyud las/ spre'u dang brag srin mo las chad par 'dod de rgyas par gzhan du blta'o/ /bod kyi rgyal brgyud ni/ kha cig ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi sras lnga tshigs yin zer/ kha cig gzugs can snying po'i sras chung ba stobs chung gi sras lnga tshigs yin zer/ kha cig bad+ma la'i rgyal po 'char byed kyi bu mig mas 'gebs sor mo dra bas 'brel ba zhig byung bas skrag ste/ zangs kha sbyar du bcug nas gaṅgā la bskur ba zhid pas rnyed de gsos/ de cher skyes pa na sngar gyi gtam bshad pas skyo ste gangs ri'i phrag tu bros pa na rim gyis lha ri yol ba'i khar byung ste/ btsan thang sgo bzhir thon pa na bon po rnams dmu thag dang dmu skas la 'ongs pas na lha yin zer/ khyed su yin dris pas btsan po zer/ gang nas byon dris pas nam mkha' la mdzub mo bsgreng ching skad ma go nas/ 'di kho bo cag gi jo bo bya'o zer te/227

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)shing gi khri la bzhag nas mi bzhis gnya' ba la khur bas ming gnya' khri btsan por grags te rgyal po snga shos yin no//de dang deng khri btsan khri bsrib khri dang //gdags khri ye khri khri khung btsan po ste/ /yab sras rim bzhin gnam gyi khri bdun yin/ /de la sras gsum sha khri nya khri dang / /bya khri zhes bya spo rong phyogs su bcugs/ /bya khri spyan drangs spu de gung rgyal zer/ /rgyal srid nyams pas bar gyi lteng gcig lo/ /yab sras de gnyis ring la gdol bon dar/ /de nas rim bzhin nges legs go rub legs/ tag legs 'brong zhing legs dang e lha/ legs/ /gnam zi legs te sa yi leg bas drug yin/ /lde gnam 'phrul ba'igazhung lde lde dman 'bum/ /lde snol nam dang de bzhin lde snol po/ /lde se snol nam lde se snol po dang / /lde rgyal zhes bya logs kyi lde brgyad yin/ /de nasarim bzhin tho lo sa btsan dang / khri btsan gnam dang khri sgra spungs btsan dang /khri rje thog btsan bzhi la btsan bzhir grags/ /de ltar nyer drug sngon gyi rgyal po yin/ /zhes so/ /thog btsan gyi sras kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan sa pho 'brug la bltams nas/ des dgung lo drug cu bzhes pa me mo yos kyi lo/ pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi rtse na bzhugs pa na nam mkha' nas za ma tog gcig babs pa kha phye bas mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ spang kong phyag brgya pa / gser gyi mchod rten/ tsi rgyu ma ṇi'i kol phor rnams byung ba ngo ma shes kyang /yid du 'ong ba'i ming gnyan po gsang bar btags te mchod pas slar yang drug cu ste yongs sdom dgung lo brgya nyi shu thub cing / rgyal srid mnga' thang cher 'phel bas dam pa'i chos kyi dbu ba/sdu shing / de'i rmi lam na mi rabs lnga na

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul ba na pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i sru chen kha sbong dang bcas pa bzhugs/'di'i don shes pa 'byung zhes lung bstan te de yan chad chab srid bon gyis bskyangs so/ /de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan dang / de'i sras 'brong gnyan lde māde'i sras stag ri gnyan gzigs te/ dmu long zhig skyes pa rgyal sar ston nas gnyan po gsang ba mchod pas spyan bye ste stag ri la gnyan 'gro ba gzigs pas de ltar grags so/ /de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan dang / btsun mo 'bri za thod dkar gyi sras mtshan dang ldan pa zhig me mo glang la bltams te/ mtshan khri lde srong btsan du btags/ phyis srong btsan sgam por grags te dbu la a mi : wa bzhugs pa dar leb rgan gyis dkris te lo bcu gsum pa sa mo glang la rgyal sar ston/ mtha'i rgyal phran thams cad dbang du bsdus te skyes 'bul/ 'phrin yig klog go /de'i tshe bod la yi ge med pas thon mi sa sto ṭa 'khor bcu drug dang bcas pa kha cher yi ge slob tu btang / paṇ+ḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge la sgra bslab nas bod du byon te/ bod kyi skad dang bstun nas gsal byed sum cu dang/ a li bzhir bsdas te lha sa'i sku mkhar ma rur kha che'i yi ge dang bstun nas bod kyi yi ge mdzad/gsum rtags kle sogs pa sgra'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad/ rgyal posakyang 'tshams bcad de bslabs so/ /de'i tshe mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ spang kong / mdo sde dkon mchog sprin rnams bsgyur te/ bod 'bangs rnams gshe ba gsan yang dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas te chos la bkod pas grong btsan sgam por grags so/ /de nas rgya gar lho phyogs nas tsan+da sprul gyi snying po las rang byung du byon pa'i spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal spyan drangs/ bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i sras mo bal bza' khri btsun khab tu bzhes pas des jo bo mi 229

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)bskyod rdo rje/ byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsan+dan gyi sgrol ma rnams spyan drangs/rgya'i rgyal po thang rka'u dzung gi sras mo kong jo bzhes te/ des jo bo shākya mu ni gdan drangs/ de nas khri btsun gyis gtsug lag khang bzhengs 'dod kyang bzhengs su ma btub par kong jos rtsis byas pas bod kyi sa gzhi srin mo gan bskyal du 'gyel ba 'dra 'di mnan dgos par gzigs nas/ dpung pa g.yasagayon dang / rkang pa g.yas g.yon la bka' tshal/ khra 'brug gtsang 'gram/grum pa rgyang ste ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang dang / gru mo g.yas g.yon dang bus mo g.yas g.yon la kong po bu chu/ lho brag mkho mthing / ka brag khyams sprin dge rtsa )pra dum rtse ste mtha' 'dul bzhi/ lag mthil g.yas g.yon dang / rkang mthi'asagayas g.yon la byang mtshal gyi rlung mnon/ khams kyi glang thang sgron ma/ mang yul byams sprin mon bum thang / spa gro skyer chu la sogs pa lha khang mang po bzhengs nas gdod 'o thang mtsho la rdo mkhar brtsigs nas shing gis phub/ klu'i 'dam pas zhal zhal byas/ ra la sa bkal nas brdal te 'khrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ slo 'bur byang mar bzo rgyu spungs pa las jo bo bcu gcigazhal rang byon du byon no/ /de nas rgyal pos rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar byon nas lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ kong jos ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de'i tshe rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sar/ bram ze shaṃ ka ra/ bal po shri la mas rgya nag gi ha shang ma hā de wa che/ thon mi sa sto ṭa/ rnyarma ko ga lha lung rdo rje dpal rnamasakyis chos ci rigs su bsgyur te srol gtod do/ /rgyal po de ni thugs rje chen po'i sprul par grags te/ li yul 2〉 btsun pa gnyis kyis 'jam dpal

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/bsgrubs pas nam mkha' las sgra byung ste khyed gnyis dang 'jam dbyangs las 'brel med/ khyed gnyis kyi lha spyan ras gzigs yin/ de da lta kha ba can gyi rgyal khams na rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas yod pas der song zhig ces grag go / de thos ma thag bod du 'ongs nas lha sa dang nye bar sleb pa na/ rgyal pos khrims phog pa yin zer ba'i mi'i ro mang po mthong bas/ log lta skyes/ phyir bzlog par brtsams pa na rgyal pos mkhyen nas 'tshol mi btang bas brnyed de/drung du sleb pa na rgyal pos dge tshul gnyis la phyag mdzad de/ khyed gnyis ci la 'ongs dris pa na/ sngar gyi gtam bsnyad pas/ rgyal pos dbu'i la thor phud do/ /a mi khru wa'i zhal bstan nas/ ngas rgyal srid byas nas sems can la phan btags pa kho na las/ gnod pa byas pa med/ bod kyi mi rnams 'dul dka' bas drag po'i sprul pa byas pa yin gsungs pas/ de gnyis yid ches te chos kyi gdams pa zhus nas phyir song ngo zhes grag go /rgyal po des lo drug cu rtsa dgur rgyal srid mdzad de/ gya gnyis pa sa pho khyi la btsun mo gnyis dang bcas 'khrul snang gi bcu gcig zhal la thims par grags so/ /de'i tshe kong jo'i zhal nas/rgya'i dmag 'ong bas lha shākya mu ni ra mo che nas gdan drongs la zhabrul snang gi glo 'bur du sbos/ sgo la zhal zhal gyis la 'jam dbyangs bris shig gsung ngo / /de nas blon po rnams kyis kyang zhal chems ltar lha gnyis brjes so/ /srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo bod mo zhig la sras gung song gung btsan/ de'i sras mang srong mang btsan/ de'i sras 'du song mang so rje'am blo nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ de'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tsho me ste/ des lha sa mkhar brag 'ching phu 231

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)gnam ra/ mdo smad li chu brag dmar rka chu/ brag dmar mgring bzang 'phang thang ka med/ ka chu dpal 'byung la sogs pa bzhengs/ slob dpon sangs rgyasagasang ba dang/ sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gangs ti se na bzhugs pa spyan drangasangapas ma byon/ bran ka mu la ko kha dang / gnyag dzña na ku mā ras mdo sde las brgya pa / gser 'od dam pa rtsis dang sman dpyad la sogs pa bsgyur te chos kyi srol 'a po gar+sā do/ /de ltar na/ tho tho ri dang khri gzha bzung btsan dang / /'brong gnyan lde ru stag ri gnyan gzigs dang / /gnam ri srong btsan srong btsan sgam po dang / /gung srong mang srong 'dus srong mes ag tshom/ /gung srong yab kyi sngon 'das phyed yin phyir/ /skyid pa'i rgyal rabs phyed dang bcu zhes zer/ /zhesabya'o/ /rgyal po de la btsun mo drug byung ba las/ rgya'i rgyal po'i sras mo gyim shing kong jos lha shākya mu ni btsal nas mchod pa byas pas/ sras mtshan ldan zhig lcags pho rta la 'khrungs te 'phang thang du rgyal po la bstan par chas pa na/ bu sna nam zas phrogs nas sna nam gyi bur byas te/ mtshan khri srong lde btsan zhesagrags so/ /'di ni srong btsan sgam pos rgyal rabs lnga nas rgyal po lde'i ming can gyis bstan pa'i rtsa ba rab tu byung ba'i sde 'dzugs par 'gyur bas de la nga'i dbon sras 'bangs dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa dang bkur sti chen po gyis shig tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i bde legs 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa blon po mgar gyis zangs ma'i glegs bu la yi ge bris nas dkor mdzod du bcug go /zhes grags pa de dang dus 'grig go /des chung ngu'i dus rgya yi yul du sang shi la sogs pa mi bzhi chos tshol du btang bas ha shang mngon 232

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i gru 'a kha nga dang bcas pa bas lta/shes can gyis bod kyi pho nya 'phags pa byang sems kyi sprul pa zhig 'ong ste 'di 'dra'o zhes 'bag byas so/ /sleb pa na rgya'i rgyal pos bsnyen bkur byas/ ha shang zhig dang bcas pa brdzangs te/ bod du sleb pa na mes ag tshom 'das/ khri srong lde btsan chung bas blon po rnams kyis chos khrims bshig ste/ chos byed pa sprug par byas/ shākya mu ni rgya'i yul du bskyal bar brtsam pas/ mi sum brgyasam theg par bye thems su sbas/ lha sar bshas ra byas so/ /de'i tshe blon po sna nam khri thog rje thang la 'bar rgyab gas nas shi cag gru skye ngas rgyal 'gongs skams nas shi bas/ lha bye 'og tu bcug pas lan zer nas/ dre'u gnyis kyisabateg ste mang yul skyid grong du bskyal/ mkhar brag dang 'bring bzang gnyis bshig go /de'i tshe sang shing sleb chos brag la sbas so/ /de nas khri srong lde'u btsan lo bcu gsum lon pa chu pho rta la rgyal sa bzung ste/ yab mes kyi le'u tshe'i gtam mdzad pa na chos kyi gtam byas te/ chos sbas pa blangs nas gzhan du gsol bas dad par gyur te bsgyur zhig gsungs nas paṇ+ḍi ta a nan+da la sogs pas bsgyur bar brtsam pa na nang blon ma shad grom pa skyes la sogs pas bkag go / der blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyis sang shi dang / sba gsal snang mang yul du brdzangs pas gsal snang gis mang yul du ma bsdad par rgya gar du phyin nas rdo rje gdan dang nā len+d+ra la mchod pa byas/ bal yul du mkhan po bo dhi satwa dang mjal te mang yul du spyan drangs nas gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ sems bskyed nas bod du 'byon par zhus pas lung bstan bzhin zhal gyi bzhes te bal por gshegs te/ gsal snang gis chos bslabs te 'ongs nas pho brang rlung 233

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)la mis su rgyal po dang mjal te/ chos kyi bka' mched byas/ bo dhi satwa'i lo rgyus bsnyad pas/ khyod yib cig ngas shad nya bzang khad kyi gsol du bzhug go gsungs nas/ shad nya bzang dang / 'gos khri bzang la sogs pa chos la dga' ba'i blon po rnams la chos byed par gsol ba btab pas/ nya bzang na re/ ma zhang dbang che la chos la gnag pas mi 'grub mchi zer/ 'gos na re thabasabagyi bar rngo mi thogs/ kho bo'i gting gnon klad kyis mdzod cig zer ro//rgyal blon chad byas te/ 'gos kyis blo brton nas/ ma zhang grom pa skyes gson por dur du bcug ste kha pha bong gis bcad do/ /de nas gsal snang bo dhi satwa spyan 'dren du btang / lang gro sna ra dang / gnyer stag btsan stang gzigs dang sprang rgya ra legs gzigs gsum bsu ru btang / mang yul du mjal nas/ lang gro sna ra dang / a tsarla der bzhag ste/ pho brang du rje la zhe sa phul bas zhang blon rnams na re/ sto bal gyi ban sngags byed mi byed brtag dgos zer te/ sang shing dang / seng gang lha lung gzigs dang / mchims me lan gsum btang bas skad ma go ste/ kha che ā na snyi la lo ts+tsha bcol nas ā tsarla ci 'dra dris pas/ bzang po zhig ste thugs 'khrig mi 'tshal zhus pas spyan drangs nas/ yon mchod zhal 'dzom pa'i tshe/ ā tsarlas rgyal po la sngon smon lam btab pa dran nam zhes lan gsum gsungs pas/ 'ol ci dran lags te bsgom yun thung bas mi gsal zhes zhus so/ /mkhan po'i zhal nas chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram na mchod rten chen po zhig bzhugs pa la dad pas zhig gsos dang / phyag dang bskor ba byas shing rgyal po khyod kyis yul mtha' 'khob ༷/ pa'i chos ma dar ba'i phyogs su rgyal

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen 'a skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/por gyur te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab/kho bos de'i tshe rab byung gi sdom pa 'dzug pa'i mkhan por gyur cig ces byas so / / zhes pa 'di tsam zhig sba bzhed las 'byung zhing / yig tshang 'ga' zhig tu slob dpon pad+mas gdug pa can 'dul ba'i sngags 'chang du gyur cig ces dang / ye shes dbang pos spyan 'dren pa'i pho nyar gyur cig ces smon lam btab zer ro/ /de lta bu'i sdom brtson dam pa 'di ni shar phyogs za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'byungs nas nā len+t+ra'i thams cad yod smra ba'i sde pa'i mkhan po ye shes snying po las rab tu byung zhing / rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas par gyur te/ nā le rgyu'i mkhan po mdzad cing / rgol ba ngan pa tshar bcad de/ mkhasapa'i grags pas khyab par gyur to/ /de'i tshe lho phyogs nas bram ze'i bu mu stegs kyi rig byed la mkhas pa zhig gis/ phyi pa dang nang pa gnyis da'i rgol ba rnams pham par byas te/ da nā le spror song la mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho pham par byas na/'gran zla dang bral bar 'gyur ro snyam du sems shing mkhan po'i bzhugs sar rim gyis 'ongs te bltas pas mkhan po mi snang zhing / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku gser gtso ma'i mdog ltar 'bar ba zhig bzhugs pa mthong ste phyir 'ongs nas gzhan la dris pas mkhan po de nyid na bzhugs yod zer/ slar log nas bltas pas sngar gyi de'i sa na mkhan po bzhugs par mthong ste/ shin tu dad par gyur nas rtsod pa'i bsam pa dor te/ gus pas zhabs spyi bor blangs shing bstan pa'i sgor zhugs so zhes grags so/ /mdor na 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gnyis su med pa'i sdom brtson dam pa 'dis dgung lo brgya phrag mang por bzhugs nas nā 235

brtse chen 'od snang las/gci'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (()len+d+ra dang / rgya gar shar phyogs dang rgya nag la sogs par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa legs par bskyang ste/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis kha ba can pa rnams la thugs rjes gzigs nas rim gyis phebs te pho brang rlung tshubs su zla ba bzhir dge ba bcu/ khams bco brgyad rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi chos bshad pas/bod kyi lha srin 'khrugs te/ yar lung 'phang thang na mes ag tshom gyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang yod pa sham pos chu thog phab nas khyer/ dmar po ri'i rtse la yab mes kyi sku mkhar yod pa thang lhas thog phab nas bsgyel/ bstan ma bcu gnyisakyis sad ser dang mi nad phyugs nad la sogs pa btang bas bod 'bangasarnams rgya gar gyi a tsa ra'i rjes la 'dre srin gdug pa can 'ongs nas bkra mi shes pa mang po byung ngo zhes zer/ de nas mkhan po la re zhig bal yul du bzhud la / slar spyan 'dren btang bas de dus 'byon pa zhu byas pas kho bos sngon gyisasmon lam rdzogs par byed pas slar yang 'ong gi bod kyi lha srin 'dul ba'i phyir slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha wa spyan drangs nas mi ma yin btul te/ gdod kho bos rab tu byung ba'i sde 'dzugs pa'i mkhan po bya'o zhes yon mchod lkog tu glengs nasamakhan po bal yul du bskyal lo/ /de nas re zhig nas sang shing la sogs pa sum cu mkhan po spyan 'dren du btang / gsal snang rgya yul du chos tshol du btang pas/ rgya'i ha shang na re da zla drug zhag drug na 'phags pa rta skad kyi sprul pa 'di 'dra zhig 'ong zhes 'bag byas shing / sleb pa dang rgya rjes bya dga' sbyin/ ha shang la sgom lung blangs te 'ongs nas sleb pa na rgyal po la skyes phul lo/ /mkhan po da dung spyan ma 'drongs pas khyed song ༷༷ gsungs te/ bal por phyin nas spyan

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/drangs te brag dmar 'gring bzang du pheb nas rgyal po dang mjal lo de nas slob dpon pad+ma spyan 'dren pa la gsal snang dang / seng gang lha lung gnyis la g.yog sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms lte dzñā na sirnyi/ mchims shākya pra wa/ brang ti dza ya rak+ṣi ta/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge rnams btang bas slob dpon gyis mkhyen nas mang yul du 'byon pa dang mjal te/ lo rgyus rnams zhus pas kho bo yang de kho na'i phyir 'ongs pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ lam na yod pa'i mi ma yin rnams dam la 'dogs shing rim gyis gnam chu tshan khar phebs pa'i tshe/ nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba'i chu khol ba yin te/ kho bos cung zad phan par bya'o gsungs nas thugs dam mdzad pas/ chu khol ba chad de thugs dam grol nas bzhengs pa'i tshe sngar bzhin song bas/ rnal 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu cung zad grub pa yin te/ sems can gyi sdig pa stobs chen gyi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu 'gog par dka' gsung / de nas stod lung mdar phebs nas 'di na chu mi 'dug pa gsungs te/ gseg gshang btsugs pas chu byung ste lha chu khar grags so/ /de nas mkhar nag 'dul ba'i phyir brag la rdo rje sems dpa'i sku bzhengs nas rim gyis zur mkhar gyi mdar phebs te/btsan po dang mjal ba'i sar rdo rje'i mchod rten lnga bzhengs so//de nas brag dmar du phebs te khye'u dang bu mo gtsang ma la pra 'bebs pa'i cho ga mdzad/ 'jig rten skyong pa bzhi la gdug pa can khug cig ces bka' bsgos te/bka' nan drag po bstsal bas/ rang rang gi nyes pa khas blangs te phyin chad mi byed par dam bcas nas slar yang 'ching bu'i dben gnas su/ mi ma yin 237
