brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)rnams la bka' bsgos te/ bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas so/ /yig tshang kha cig na has po ri la chag phebs te/ btsan po dang mjal nas mal gro'i phur byon nas lha srin rnams dam la btags zer ro/ /de nas slob dpon bsam yas su spyan drangs te sa chog mdzad/ bo dhi sa twas sa dpyad mdzad de/ o tan ta byu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad nyi zla zung / mtha' lcags ris bskor ba'i bkod pa mdzad de/ sngon la ar+ya pa lo'i gling bzhengs/ lha rnams bod kyis mi la dpe byas so/ /btsun mo che ba tshe spongs zas khams gsum zangs khang gling bzhengs/ pho yod za rgya mo btsun gyi bu tshal gser khang gling bzhengs/ 'gro sa byang chub sman gyis dge rgyas bye ba gling bzhengs te legs par tshar nas mkhan po bo dhi satwa la sogs pas rab gnasamadzad nas/ lo bcu gsum du dga' ston byas so/ /de'i tshe thams cad yod k+ṣiṃba'i sde pa'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs te bod la btsun pa btub mi btub nyams sad pa'i phyir sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ste/ de la rgan gsum ni dba' rat+na rak+ṣi ta rin chen bsrung ba zhes bya ba bod yul du btsun pa byung ba la snga ba yin no/ /dzñā nas rak+ṣi ta ye shes dbang po bsrung ba ste/ dam pa'i chos 'byin pa'i mkhan po bod la bka' drin che ba yin zhing / sangs rgyas kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' rta skad ces par lung bstan pa yin no/ /ra sne rgyu rak+ṣi ta rin chen dbang po bsrung ba gsum mo/ /bar pa ni glang khams pa su ga ta wa me rak+ṣi ta bde bar gshegs pa'i go cha bsrung ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhon gsum ni pa gor be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta rnam par snang mdzad dī// ba dang / 'khon nā gen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta klu'i

dam ru 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen la stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/dbang po bsrung ba/ gtsang de len+d+ra rak+ṣi ta lha'i dbang po bsrung ba dang gsum mo / / de dag la ka ba dpal brtsegs bsrung ba la sogs pa lo tsā ba che ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyis blo sbyangs shing / de rnams la lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pa lo sto ba stong rtsa brgyad kyis blo sbyangs mdzad do/ /zhes sngon gyi bka' chems kyi yi ge rnying pa las byung ngo / /de nas slob dpon pad+mas ngam shod kyi bye ma ni'u sing du bsgyur ba dang / gtsang po sbubs su 'dzud pa la sogs pa mdzad par byas te btsan po khrus bsil ba'i phyir bar snang la lha rdzas kyi chus gang ba'i bum pa len pa la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phul sna tshogs bstan pas bdud blon rnams 'khu 'khrig zos nas/ slob dpon dkrongs par chad pa la/ btsan po thugs ma bde bar dmag mang po bcas pas mon bod kyi mtshams su bskyal zhing / de'i tshe slob dpon dkrongs par bskos pa'i gshan pa rnams mtshon bzung bzhin par rengs par gyur te/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas bod kyi lha srin lan gsum dam la btags dgos pa da dung lan gcig ma grub pas/ rgyal brgyud dang chos byed kyi tshe srog dang chos la bar chad 'ga' re 'byung bar 'dug nga'i dngos gzhi'i gdul bya bod na med/ srin po 'dul du 'gro gsungs nas bzhud de/ spyir bod yul du zla ba bco brgyad bzhugs pa yin bya ba sba bzhed na snang zhing / de bas lhag pa'i lo rgyus mi snang ngo / /de nas mkhan po nyid dang / bi ma la mi tra/sangs rgyas gsang ba/ sha sdi gar+bha/ bi shud dha sedha la sogs pa/ lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun/ chos kyi snang ba/ ban+de nam mkha'/ sgra rin chen sde/ rnam par mi rtog pa la sogs pas sgra bsgyur lo tsā gling du chos bsgyur/ sngags 'chang dharma kirti 239

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)spyan drangs te yo ga rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du dbang bskur/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍita dzi na mi tra dang / dwa na shrī la la sogs pas rnam dag khrims khang gling du khrims 'phog pa/ rgya'i ha shang la sogs pas mi g.yo bsam gtan gling du bsam gtan byed/ bde sbyor tshams pa'i gling du brda spyor/ dkor mdzod pe to gling du nor 'jog be+e ro tsa na'i gling du chos 'chad pa la sogs pas bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa dar bar mdzad de/ 'brug gi lo pho brang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i bstan bcos sgra bsgyur gyi ban+de dpal brtsegs dang / ban+de klu'i dbang po la sogs pas bod khams su dam pa'i chos bsgyur ro 'tshal gyi mtshan byang bam po dang sho lo na'i grangs du mchis pa gtan la phabs nas dkar chag tu bris so/ /de nas mkhan po'i zhal nas rgyal po khyod kyi mnga' 'og tu rab tu byung ba mang bar 'dod na nga'i lus 'di has po ri'i shar du kha shar phyogs su ston la shog cig rab byung rnam dag nyung shas cig 'dod na nub phyogs su zhog cig bod yul 'dir mu stegasami 'byung yang / chos lugs dag ma dag gnyis su gyes nas rtsod par 'gyur bas/ de'i tshe nga'i slob ma ka ma la shī la spyan drangs la/ rtsod pa byed du chug cig des rtsod pa chos phyogs su zhi bar 'gyur/ zhes lung bstan to/ /des bdag cag gis spyan 'drong ba dka' bas phyag yig ga ga zhu zhus pas ka ma la shī la khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bod kyi rgyal pos gdan 'dren pa byung na cig kyang byon cig gal te ma 'ong na nga'i slob ma'i dam tshig med do/ /zhes pa'i phyag yig bzhag nas rtas phra rgyab pa'i rkyen gyi/ ṭ+wāṃ bar gshegs so/ /mkhan po gshegs

ngam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/nas ye shes dbang po rgyal tshab du bskos te bstan pa bskyong ba'i tshe/ nyang ting nge 'dzin bzang po dang / nyang sha mi la sogs pas mi gus shing bskur ba btab pas/ thugs skyo nas bros te mkhar chur bsgom du gshegs nas dpal dbyangs slob dpon du bskos te chos ston pa'i tshe/ rgya nag ha shang byung nas kho'i chos lugs bstan pas chos 'di bya sla zhing phan yon che zer zhing dkon mchog mchod pa dang sde snod la thos bsam dang lus ngag gi dge sbyor 'phro bcad de/ bod phal cher kho'i chos lugs byed/ dpal dbyangs dang dba' rat+na la sogs pa nyung shas shig mkhan po'i chos lugs byed pas lta spyod ma mthun zhing btsan pos ā tsarla bo dhi sa twa'i lugs bzhin gyis shig gsungs pas/ tan min pa rnams khros te/ chu khri rnon po gsor zhing btsan po min pa ril gsod zer bas/rgyal po thugs ma bde nas ye shes dbang po lan gsum 'bod du btang bas phyi ma la khugs te/ rgyal po bdag rgug mi 'tshal/ mkhan po'i zhal chems la dkor mdzod na zangs ma'i glegs bu la bris pa 'di ltar bdog zhus pas rgyal po bsnyel sos te/ slob dpon ka ma la shī la spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya btang ba ha shang gis tshor nas/ yum rgyas pa la sogs mdo sde zab mo rnams spyan drangs te 'khor rnams la bshad pa bslabs/ bstan bcos la chos bya mi dgos nyal bas chog ces ston pa bsam gtan nyal chog 'khor lo/ de la brtsod pa spong ba bsam gtan gyi lon dang yang lon gnyis byas/ de rigs pas bsgrub pa lta ba'i rgyab sha lung gis bsgrub pa mdo sde brgyad cu khungs sogs byas/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel rang gi lta spyod dang 'gal bar rtogs nas rdog pas dril 241

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (4)lo / / de'i tshe me shes dbang pos mkhan po'i dgongs pa 'di bzhin yin snyan du gsol bas/ btsan po dgyes te/ khyed nga'i a tsarla zhes gsungs so/ /de nasaka ma la shī la byon pa dang / bsam yas kyi byang chub gling du btsan po gung du bzhugs/ ha shang g.yas su 'khod/ 'khor brnye lan ka dang / rdzo mo byang chub sman la sogs pa mang du byung / ka ma la shī la g.yon du 'khod/ 'khor be+e ro tsa na la sogs pa nyung shas shig byung / btsan pos gnyis ka'i lag tu me tog phreng ba re gtad nas khyed gnyis shags gyis la gang rgyal ba la pham pas me tog gi phreng ba phul cig pham pa de 'dir ma bsdod cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / ha shang na re gzhi la yong snga ba yin pas 'dri'am lan gdab ces zer/ ka ma la shī las khyed nyid kyis dgongs pa ltar shags gsungs shig ces byas pas ha shang na re las dge mi dge spyad na mtho ris dang ngan song du 'gro bas 'khor ba las mi thar zhing / sangs rgyas thob pa la sgrib pa yin/ sprin dkar nag gang gisakyang nam mkha' la sgrib pa dang 'dra gang zhig ci la yang mi sems ci la yang mi bsam pa de 'khor ba las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /ci la yang mi sems/mi rtog mi spyod pa ni mi dmigs pa yin pas/ de ni cig car du 'jug pa'i lam sa bcu pa dang 'dra'o/ /des na khyod kyi chos lugs 'di spre'u shing rtser 'dzeg pa dang 'dra bas/ rim gyis pa zhes bya/ nged kyi chos lugs 'di khyung nam mkha' nas shing rtser 'bab pa dang 'dra ste/ yas babs dang cig char zhes bya'o/ /zer ro / / de nas slob dpon gyi khyod kyi dpe mi 'thad de/ khyung nam mkha' la slo bur du 'dab gzhog rdzogs nas shing rtse ༷bab bam/ 'on te brag la tshangs bcas

dam pa'i rlos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i rgyu chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/nas rim gyis gyi 'dab gzhog rgyas nas shing rtser 'bab/ dang po mi srid la phyi ma ltar na rim gyi ba'i dper 'gyur ro/ khyod kyi dpe nor ba ma zad don yang nor te / mi rtog pa bsgom pa de ci/ rnam rtog phyogs gcig bkag pa tsam yin nam/mtha' dag bkag pa yin/ dang po ltar na gnyid dang brgyal ba la sogs pa'ang mi rtog par thal lo/ /phyi ma ltar na mi rtog pa bsgom pa'i tshe mi rtog pa bsgom snyam pa'i blo sngon du gtong dgos sam mi dgos/ dgos na de nyid rtog pa yin pas rtog pa mtha' dag 'gog pa'i dam bca' nyams so/ /mi dgos na sems can thams cad la bsgom skye bar thal lo/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa lung dang rigs pas sun phyung bas/ rgya nag mkhan po spobs pa med par gyur to/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'khor kun gyis kyang mchid bshags thob cig /ces gsungs pas/ ha shang 'khor dang bcas pas lan smra bar ma nus te/ me tog phreng ba slob dpon la phul nas pham blangs so/ /de'i tshe co me me la sogs pa mya ngan skyes te rang gi dbang po brdungs te shi zhes grag go/ de nas btsan pos lta ba klu sgrub kyi lugs bzung / spyod pa chos spyod bcu dang pha rol tu phyin pa slobs/ ha shang gi lugs byed na chad pas bcad do/ /zhes bka' yig sum cu mdzad nas mdo khams dang / bod dang dkor mdzod gsum du re re bzhag ste/ ha shang rgya'i yul du brdzangs dpe rnams bsdus te gter du sbas so/ /ha shang gi lham rtsod pa'i grwar lus pas/ bod kyi bstan pa'i mjug tu nga'i chos lugs shig 'byung ngo //zhes zer ro/ /dus phyis ha shang gi shan pa mi bzhis slob dpon ka ma la shī la'i mkhal ma mnyes te dkrongs/ ye shes dbang po kham gyi zas spangs te gshegs/243

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)btsan po yang dgung lo nga drug pa shing mo glang la gshegs te 'jam dpal gyi sprul par grags so/ /de'i sras mu khri btsan po gzhen nu la gshegs/ mu tig btsan po thar pa la gshegs/ mu ni btsan pos rgyal srid lo gcig dang zla ba dgu mdzad nas/ bsam yas su mchod pa chen po bzhi btsugs/ bod 'bangasaltogs phyug lan gsum bsnyam/ bcu bdun pa la yum gyis dug btang nasa'adas so/ /de nas gcung khri lde srong btsan sad na legs 'jing yon du gragasapa lo bzhi pa la rgyal srid gtad de/ des dkar chung lha khang bzhengs/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra/ ka ma la shī la dzñā na se na/ bal po hūṃ ka ra rnams dang / 'khon klu'i dbang po/ rma rin chen mchog ye shes sde/ bran kha nam mkha' gtsang de byin rnams kyis lo tsā byas te chos mang du bsgyur/ chos grwa dang sgom grwa mang du btsugs te/ bod 'bangs rnams bde ba la bkod do/ /de la sras gtsang ma/dar ma/ ral pa can gsun mam/ lha rje lhun grub/ khri chen po ste lngar yang grags la/ gtsang ma rab tu byung / dar ma lo rgan yang rang rgyud ngan pas semasacan la gnod kyi dogs nas/ rgyal srid ma gtad par khri btsug lde btsan ralapa can phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par grags pa de me mo byi ba la 'khrungs nas dgung lo bcu gnyis pa me mo bya la yab 'das te rgyal sar byon/ pho brang 'on cang rdo'i rgya phibs dgu thog can bzhengs/ sngon yab mes kyi ring la/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa dang / ye shes dbang po dang / zhang rgyal nyan nya bzang dang / blon khri gzhesasang khri/ dzñā de wa ko ṣa dang / lce khri 'brug dang / bram ze a nan+ta la sogs pasachos kyi skad bod la ma grags pa ma/ sdug cig byung zhing / rgya dang li dang / za

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen kha nga dang bcas pa bzhugs/hor la sogs pa sna tshogs nas bsgyur bas/ pod mi 'dra ba mang pos chos bslab dka' ba gzigs nas/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po a tsarla dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / shi len+d+ra bo dhi dang / da na shī la dang / bo dhi mi tra dang / bod kyi mkhan po rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang / dharma tā shī la dang / lo tsā ba mkhas par chud par dzñā na se na dang / dzā ya rak+ṣi ta dang / rat+nan+t+ra shī la la sogs pas theg pa che chung las byung ba'i bod kyi skad du bsgyur cing / ming du btags pa rnams dkar chag tu bris pa nam du yang gzhung lugs de las dza na du )pa bsgyur cig kun gyi bslab tu rung bar gyis shig ces bka' bstsal te/ sngar bsgyur pa rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab cing / bkas bcad rnam pa gsum mdzad de/sde pa gzhi thams cad yod smra las gzhan dang gsang sngags rnams ma bsgyur cig ces bkas bcad/ tha na bre dang srang dang zho la sogs pa'ang rgya gar dang mthun par bcos rab tu byung ba re re la'ang 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun dbul/dbu thod gdan du bting /zhabs spyi bor len no/ /rgya la dmag drangasate bcom nas dbon zhang 'dums byas pa'i yi ge lha sa'i rdo ring la bris so/ /lo nyi shu rtsa lnga rgyal srid bzung ste/ 'dzam bu'i gling sum gnyis la dbang mdzad do//der rab tu byung ba la chab srid phul bas sdig blon rnams khros nas chos khrims bshig par lkog chad byas te/ lha sras gtsang ma mon yul du sprugs/ btsun mo ngang tshul ma dang / brnye chen po dpal gyi yon tan nal bsham zhes phra ma bcug ste brnye chen po bkum/ btsun mo lcebs btsan po dgung lo so drug pa lcags mo bya la dbas rgyal to re dang / co ro legs sgra gnyis kyis zhal ltag par bstan 245

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)te dkrongs so/ /de ltar na khri srong lde btsan mu ni btsan po dang / /de gcung sad na legs dang ral pa can/ /mu ni sku tshe thung phyir phyed yin pas/ /shin tu skyid pa'i rgyal rabs phyed bzhi yin zhes smras so/ /de nas btsan po glang dar ma 'u dum btsan po so dgu pa lcags mo bya'i mjug la chab srid gtad the'u rang dbas rgyal to re nang blon du bskos/ blon sna rnam rgyal tsha khri bzung la sogs pas chos khrims dang 'gal ba mang du byas/ lo paṇa gyi chos bsgyur ba'i grwa gzhig 'on kyang rdo la rab gnas ma grub par lus so/ /de nas btsan po'i thugs la gdon gsol te/ lha shākya mu ni bye thems su sbas sgo la zhal zhal byasanas btsun pa chang 'thung ba'i ri mo bris te bzhag po ti mchod cha rnams brag dang mun khung du sbas/ paṇ+ḍita rnams rgya gar du log lo tsā ba la la grongs/ la la bros/ rab tu byung ba kun phab/ la la rta zhen pa'i stegs byas/ btsun pa'i rtags bor du ma 'dod pa kun mda' gzhu dang rnga shang bskur nas rngon pa la btang / mi nyan pa rnams bsad de dbus gtsang gi rab tu byung ba'i bstan pa ming tsam yang med par byas so/ /de'i tshe chos khrims dang rgyal khrims gnyis ka brlag par byas pas lkog tu gsang nas nyams su len pa ma gtogs dngos su chos rnal ma bya sa med par chad pas gcod pa byung ngo / /de nas ring zhig na mer pa'i brag la/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje bsgom mdzad kyin yod pas bstan pa nyams pa tshor te/ btsan po la snying rje khyad par can skyes nas/ rta dkar po la sol ba phye mas byugs/ ber nang dkar la phyi gnag pa gyon/ lcags mda' lcags gzhu khyer nas/ lha sar phyin ༵ 4༷nga / btsan po sdong bsil la mig mang

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bsna pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ rtse yin yod pa la yid ma bde nas rdo ring gi yi ge klog gin yod pa'i sar phyin pas/ mgon po nag po byung zer/ zhe sa byed pa skad byas te/ lcags mda' rgyab kyang zer/ mdung bsnun kyang zer te gang ltar yang rgyal po dkrongs te/ nga bdud ya gzher nag po bya ba yin/ rgyal po sdig can bsod na de ltar bsod pa yin/zer nas bros so/ /lha sar btsan po dkrongs so ra mda' rgyugs zhes bos nasabadas pas/ mi nag mtsho la rta gshan/ ber phyi nang zlog ste gyon nasang lha gnam thil dkar po bya ba yin zer zhing bros pas/ nam sros nas ma zin te/rgyal po sdig can la lha ma yin gyis las kyi chad pa phab nas dkrongs zer lo//yongs bsdom rgyal sa lo gcig dang zla ba gcig bzung ba mjug tu zla ba drug tshul ngan bstan pa bsnubs te chu pho khyi la dkrongs so/ /de nas lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes mngon pa kun las btus/ 'dul ba 'od ldan/ rkarma sha tam rnams khyer te khams su byon no/ /glang dar ma'i btsun mo chen mo'i sras yum brtan de'i sras khri lde mgon po/ de nas rim bzhin/ mgon gnyen/ nyi 'od dpal mgon/mgon spyod tsha nam ye shes rgyal mtshan/ mnga' bdag khri pa lha btsun sangs rgyas bo dhi rā dza/ mnga' bdag mgon po'o/ /mgon yi dza' nor sras bzhi ste/ lha btsun sngon mo/ lha ka gdams pa/ dbang sde'o/ /de'i sras lnga ste/ lha snyug grum pa / 'od lde mgo dge bo/ /brtan pa seṅge 'o/ /'od lde'i sras lha zhi ba 'od/de'i sras 'od khri'o/ /de dang dge bo'i sras bkra shis lde gnyis kyis/ rje sa skya paṇ+ḍita bsam yas su spyan drangs chos 'bor chen po mdzad/ btsun mo chung ma'i sras 'od srung chu mo phag la 'khrungs/ rgyal sar ston te drug cu rtsa gsum pa shing 247

brtse chen 'od snang las/skya'i cho 'gung gce bsdus/ (4)mo glang la gshegs/ de'i sras dpal 'khor btsan chu mo glang la zhakhrungs pa sum cu pa la yab 'das te/ rgyal srid lo bco brgyad bzung nas gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs/ so gcig pa chu mo lug la 'das so/ /de la sras gnyis te bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang / skyid sde nyi ma mgon no/ /che bas rgyal srid —bzung ste de la sras gsum/ dpal sde/ 'od lde/ skyid lde/ smad kyi lde gsum mo dpal lde mang yul gung thang du phebs/ de nas 'od zer lde/ sde spyod lde/ dbang lde / btsan lde/ lha mchog dbang phyug lde/ skyob lde/ mgon lde/ gtsug lde 'dis/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs pad bsten cing glang gi las thabs bcu gsum mdzad/ bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs pa sogs bstan pa la srid zhu cher mdzad do//'od lde'i sras khri chung / de nas rim bzhin 'od skyid 'bar/ g.yus can jo dga'/ khri dar ma/ rnal 'byor/ jo 'bag shākya mgon te/ des pho brang gnasachung du/ rje sa paṇa spyan drangs te chos 'bor bskor/ gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i 'khor lo mdzad do/ /skyid lde'i brgyud pa mus 'ja' nyang stod sogs na yod do/ /nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su byon pu rangs su sku mkhar nyi bzung brtsigs te chab srid bzung / de la sras gsum gyi che ba dpal gyi mgon gyisangamang yul bzung / bar pa bkra shis mgon gyis shad zhung dang pu rangs bzung /chung ba lde btsug mgon gyis mon yul bzung ste/ stod kyi mgon gsum mo//bar pa'i sras lha srong lde ste srong nge dang / 'khor re grags so/ /dar masabasnubs pa nas 'di yan chad la khyim pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig gisagasang sngags kyi lam nyams su blangs pas rgyal pos ma rig pas chad pa ma 248

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la sug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/phog ste/ rgyal po 'das nas rang rang gi bu dang slob ma dag la cung zad bstan pa las/ phyis rim gyis 'phel nas lag len bon po dang bsres nas gyer bsgom byed/ rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ma shes par sgra ji bzhin du bzung nas sbyor sgrol la sogs pa log spyod sna tshogs byed/ gtsug lag khang gi gnyer pa sham thabs gong ba can gyon pa la/ ming gnas brtan dgra bcom pa zer bas byed/sdom pa bsrung zer nas dbyar zla gsum tsam bzhi sna yud la bsrungs/ dgag dbye byed zer nas de nas mi bsrung / sems bskyed dang dbang bskur gyi bka' tsho nub/ gshin po'i dge ba la klog re 'don pa na dmar po 'di nag po 'dis chad pa 'dra zer ba tsam byung ngo // /// gnyis pa bstan pa phyi dar gyi rnam gzhag ni/ dar mas bstan pa bsgrub pa'i skabs der 'jad kyi khyel mi gtsang rab bsal/ bo dong ba g.yo dge 'byung / stod lung pa dmar shākya mu ni gsum chu bo ri na bsgom zhing yod pa na/btsun pa khyi ra byed pa mthong ste/ gtam dris pas/ rgyal pos bstan pa bsgrub par thos nas 'dul ba'i dpe dre'u khal gcig bkal te stod phyogs la bros nas mnga' ris brgyud/ hor yul du phyin/ der bstan pa dar bar bya snyam pa la/dar bar ma nus te mdo smad tsha mtsho nas tshur byung ste me lung rdo rje'i brag ra an chung gnam rdzong ngam/ dan tig shel gyi yang dgon yang zer/ de na bsgom nasayod pa'i tshe bon po'i rigs las dang skal bar ldan pa mu zu gsal 'bar zhes bya ba dad nas rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ gtsang gi mkhan po g.yos slob dpon mdzad nas rab tu byung zhing mtshan dge ba rab gsal du btags/ phyi bang thugs 249

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)rab che bas dgongs pa rab gsal du grags so/ /de nas lo ga cig nasabasnyen rdzogs zhus pas/ dge slong lnga ma tshang bas mi 'ongs gsungs pa dang /sngar lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje dang / dge slong gsum glang thang na 'dug pa mthong ba btsal te dpal gyi rdo rje dang mjal nas zhus pas/ ngas rgyal po bsad pasakha skong mi 'ong gi ngas btsal gyi gsungs te/ rgya'i ha shang ko wang dang gyim bag bya ba gnyis btsal te btang ngo / /de nas sngar gyi mkhan slob gnyis kyis mkhan slob byas/ dmar gyi gsang ston byas/ rgya'i dge slong gnyis kyis kha bskong byasate lnga'i tshogs kyi bsnyen rdzogs byas so/ /gzhan yang mkhan slob de dag lasagrum ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / bsnub byang chub rgyal mtshan sogs khams pa mang pos kyang rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul ba dang mngon pa la sogs pa'i bshad pa yang mnos/ de nas lo lnga lon pa dang / mdo smad na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yod pa'i gtam thos te dbus nas klu mes tshul khrimasashes rab/ 'bring ye shes yon tan/ sba tshul khrims blo gros/ rag shi tshulakhrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes blo gros te lnga/ gtsang nas mgur mo rab dga' ba/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug shab sgo lda'i tshang btsun shes rab seṅge /mnga' ris pa 'od brgyad spun gnyis/ bo dong ba u pa de dar ba dang lnga ste/ mi bcus khams su phyin nas gtsang la bka' drin zhus pas nga rgas nas mkhan bu mi skyong bas/ bla chen po la zhus gsungs nas zhus pas nga bsnyen rdzogs byasanas lo lnga las mi 'gro bas mkhan po mi btub gsungs pas/ gtsang na re dmigs bsal la btub pas gyi/ 5/sungs nas/ bla chen pos mkhan po/

dam pa'i chos kya byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/gtsang dang g.yos las slob dang gsang ston/ dmar dang ha shang gis kha skong byas te thams cad rig rdzogs byas so/ /de nas bla chen gyi zhal nas/ lo ston mthu che bas bstan bsrung gyis/ klu mes btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ tshang btsun blo sno bas ston pa gyis/ 'bring skos mkhas pas gnas gzhi bzung gsung ngo //de nas klu mes kyis grum ye shes rgyal mtshan la 'dul ba mnyan zhing bzhugs/byin pos yar yong pas sba dang / rag shi gcung po gnyis phu bo bsu ru 'ongs pa dang glang thang du mjal bas gcung gnyis dad de lo ston dang phu bo gnyis la rab tu byung ngo / /de'i phyir lo klu mes kyis bla chen po la bdag dbus gtsang du 'gro bas mchod gnas zhig zhu byas pas bon po'i zhwa 'obs zhus gser btab pa zhig gsol 'phro la gnang ste 'di gyon la nga rjes su dran pa gyis gsungs yar byon te lcags mo lug gi lo thams cad dbus su 'dzoms pa dang / sngon mkhas btsun gyi gdan sa lha sa yin yang chad pa gcod pa'i sa yin pas/ 'gro ma nusang ra bsam yas su byon te/ klu mes kyi ka chu bzung / sba mched kyis dbu tshal dang dbu rtse bzung / rag shi mched kyis dge rgyas bzung / 'bring gi thangs khang bzung ngo / kha cig klu mes la dbu rtse phul bas ma bzhes par spyi mchod du bzhag zer ro/ /de nas gnas gzhi so sor brtsigs na bstan pa dar rgyas che bar dgongs nas/ klu mes kyis la mo phya re'u brtsigs/ de'i mkhan bu gru mar tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis sol nag thang chen/ zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis rgyal dang ra 'tshag rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis yer pa ba rang dang/ de nas bzad kyi lding ba/ chu shul gyi na'o/ spus te lto gong / yol thang / lab so gral ma 231

brtse chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gces brdzus/ (zhu)thang / kha reg spe cig gtsang du gzhu'i kun ra/ tsha mig rnams mched do/ /glan ye shes shes rab kyis rgyal sar snang brtsigs/ de dag las mang du mched do//'bring gis ngan lam chen mo brtsigs/ de nas dar chung dang snye thang brag sna bzung / de'i lam stegs su brang ra mo che brtsigs te mang du mched do/ /sum pa ye shes blo gros kyis 'gros thang du dme ru brtsigs te zhig nas med/ sum dang rtog gis skyid shod du g.yu sgro khang dmar brtsigs te rtog la thims nas med do / / sbas yung nga skur brtsigs/ de nas lan pa rta bros bzung / de'i mkhan bu mal sems dpa'i shes rab kyis stod lung tsha thog brtsigs/ thag ma lha khang dang mon gra bzung ngo / /sba'i gceng gis gye re mtshar sna'i mda' grong lha khang brtsigs/ bzhos chang khang bzung / rag shi bka' tshal dang len pa spyil bu bzung /rag shi gcung gis dge rgyas bzung ngo / /gzhan me tsho la sogs pa sba rag gnyis kyi bye brag yin la sba rag gnyis so sor byas na/ dbus kyi sde pa bzhi yin no/ /gtsang pa lnga pos re zhig bsam yas su bzhugs/ de nas gtsang du byon te/ lo ston gyis rgyan gong brtsigs de la mkhan bu nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ba las rgya shākya gzhon nus la stod mar la thang brtsigs/ de las mang du mched/skyo shes rab rdo rjes don mo ri brtsigs/ stag lo gzhon brtson gyis stag lo lha khang brtsigs/ a mes zhu cig mas 'phrang dang brag dmar bzung / 'dar rdo rje rin chen nam shākya yon tan gyis gzus so bzung / li blo gros gzhon nus jo mo brtsigs/ klag byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis chu mig brtsigs/ dga' shes rab bla mas snyems brtsigs/ rngog ye shes 2 6 2 gnas kyis spangs mkhar lha lung

dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i zu chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/brtsigs/ spun gsum bzung / glang btsun byams pas 'o ma phug brtsigs/ kri gang dang gtsang 'phrang bzung / 'go ba g.yung drung gis smre lha khang bzung / de'i mkhan bu lce btsun sher 'byung gis zha lu brtsigs/ slar rgya gar du byon nasasdom pa skyar nas blangs te/ shul du 'go bas zha lu bzung / de la ka bzhi gdung drug la sogs pa mched do/ /skyi ye shes dbang pos shangs kyi mkha' lung / gye re glang ra dang mu shangs kyi ro skams brtsigs/ de las nyung gis dbu lung sogs mang du mched do/ /shangs ston chos 'phags kyis bya rgyus bzung / kong po thar pa rin chen la mkhan bu bzhi byung ste gzungs ston 'phan grags kyis sgra'i lce 'tshams dang rgyang mkhar stag lung / lte btsun dkar pos ang yig g.yung ston 'jad ga re'i ba hor/ shab rtsas shab rtsa'i lha khang brtsigs/ ston gyi mkhan bu dbon pa rnam gsum gyis 'khris kyi kha bcad dgon pa/ khro ston brtson 'bar gyis shangs rna ra/ sa rbad btsun chung gis grang chung / rgya ston ar+ya de was sgo ru sna / shākya gzhon nus sa phug spang gi 'khris/ shad btsun bsod grags kyis bya rgyus/ gzhen nu 'byung gnas kyis rgyang mkhar thur la/ lte btsun dpal gyi ye shes kyis 'byung kun ra bzung ngo/ /de rnams re re las kyang mang du mched do//tshong tsho la tshong btsun shes rab seṅge brtsegs kyis yang dben dang rtsis lha khang /de'i nye gnas sba btsun blo gros yon tan la gtad/ de'i mkhan bu yol chos dbang gis rkyegs gnas rnying / yol thogs 'bebs kyis lcang ra/ stag pa jo btsun gyis lce dpe bzung / tshong btsun la nyan tsho phul ba mkhan bur blo gros bzang po dang khams pa rin chen bzang po la gtad/ rwa la phyug mtshams dgra 253

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (3)bcom gyis ngur smig phul/ khams pas rang cag mkhar bzung / tshong btsun lastag tshal gyis bya chos mkhar po che thul ba mkhan bu rgyal bu tshul le dang / kong po yi 'byung la gtad rgyas brang thang brtsigs/ kong pos mu'i gnas po che brtsigs/ kong btsun la smon gro phul ba mkhan bu mar pa ye shes rdo rje la gtad/ des bran ma sgang po brtsigs/ de'i mkhan bu sne'u bo grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rang mkhar phug bzung / mar pa'i mkhan bu snyi ba chen pos dong phyugasabazung / tshang btsun gyi mkhan bu shad pa tshab khrong pas gser gyi sgong sgrogagaser gyi brag shong btsan mo sda this/ rtsis kyi yang dben bzung / de'i mkhan bu sba dge mthong gis rong ba do/ stag tshal mkhar po che/ ra sogs 'tshar la/ rgyan mkhar rkyang 'jur rnams bzung / 'a zha mgo bo che'i bu 'a zha ye shes g.yung drung gis khams su phyin nas bla chen po'i mkhan bu kre bo mchog bla bya ba la bka' drin zhus pas/ ngas chu gtor btang la 'ong gi gsungs nas bka' drin nod long med par mkhan po 'das/ ngas chu gtor btang nas 'ong gi zer ba tsam lo sdom pa thob par byas nas/ de la dge tshul chu gtor mar grags/ des mkhan po byas nas sna nam bre bdas/ 'o yug mda'i ra sha de'i lam stegs 'khor re khang 'khor/ lhan gyi dre shong / stag gi gnas po che rnams bzung ngo / /'di yan thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad// /// gnyis pa rtsom 'phro kha bskang ba ni/ dge tshul chu gtor mar gragasaga' zha ye shes g.yung drung gi mkhan bu she'u snye snam pa'i mkhan bu sog tshul khrim bla mas so thang bzungs/ de'i mkhan ༵ /ngas 'dul 'dzin gyis stag gi spen can

dam pa'i chos kyi byung spyo pa bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/bzungs/ de'i mkhan bu gnubs rin chen grags kyis khu lung lha gral bzungs/ra sha nas 'u yug gsal sgang bzung ste/ de rnams la 'a tsho zer/ yang 'dre gzhen tshul gyis khams su sdom pa len du phyin pas/ khams kyi khri mkhar snar bla chen po'i mkhan bu ya zi bon ston bya ba dang mjal nas bka' drin zhus pas/ der bas zer nas sdom pa sbyin long med par 'das pa dang / /des bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa thob pa yin te/mkhan po na re der bas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas der bas kyi bsnyen rdzogs su grags/ chu gtor ma dang der bas ma la mi 'thad pa'i cha bzhag pa yang snang ngo / /des rta nag phu'i bya tshang bzungs/ de nas shangs kyi bye phug bzungs/ bya tshang nas mched pa 'jad kyi gnas brgyad byung / de tsho la 'dre tsho zer/ de ltar mi bcas phyin yang/ dbus kyi sum pa dang /gtsang gi 'o brgyad spun gnyis las mched pa med pas mi drug tu grags shing / 'a 'dre gnyis de rnams la ma gtogs so/ /de ltar mi bcus sdom pa ma blangs kyi bar/ dbus gtsang du rab tu byung ba dang/ nyan bshad med pa lo bdun cu lhag tsam byung zer ba dang / brgya lhag tsam byung zer ba sogs mang du yod/ gang na'ang bla chen po la mi bcus sdom pa blangs pa sogs la/ bstan pa'i me ro smad nas blangs pa zhes zer ba dang / lda rigs sna stod nas dar shing rgyas pa byas zer/ de ltar gnyis las stod nas dar tshur 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ro//de ltar gong du bshad pa ltar dbus gtsang gi rab byung phal cher/ bla chen gyi mkhan brgyud las byung la/ mkhan brgyud rnying pa 'di phyis kyang mang du byung ste/ zhi ba mtsho dbas rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ gtsang rab gsal/ bla chen po'am/ 'ga' zhig las/ dbas rat+na/255

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos nga tso bsdus/9)g.yo dge 'byung /bla chen po zhes 'byung zhing /de'i mkhan bu dbus gtsang gi mi bcu yin pa ltar ram/gzhan bar du yod pa gang ltar yang rung /tshong btsun shesarab seng ge byang chub gzhon nu/byang chub rgyal mtshan/'jang pa ston skyabs/'jang pa gzhen byang /rtsi 'dul ba 'dzin pa bde ba can pa ye shes mgon/byang sems rin chen mgon/rgyal sras thogs med sogs dang /klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/sne pho grags pa rgyal mtshan/'bre rgyalaba'abar/bya 'dul brtson 'grus 'bar/zhes snar thang pa'i so thar sdom brgyun las 'byung yang /bya 'dul gyi rnam thar las/'bre rgyal ba 'bar las rab tu byung zhing /khyung rin chen grags las bsnyen par rdzogs par bshad pas/klu mes/yam shung rgyal ba 'od/grwa pa mngon shes/khyung rin chen grags/bya 'dulartsi pa gzhon nu seng ge gro ston bdud rtsi grags/mchims nam mkha' grags/ze'u grags pa shes rab/mchims blo bzang grags pa/mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen grub pa shes rab la sogs te/snar thang pa'i brgyud yig 'di las/zhi ba 'tsho/dbas rat+na/dmar shākya mu ni/li rin po che namamakha' skyongs/g.yo dge 'byung /bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/spo gong ye shesagayung drung /grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/klu mes shes rab tshul khrims zhes 'byupango / / bla r+ṣa pos bstan pa'i me ro smad nas blang tshul jo bo rje la zhus pas/soso skye bo la de lta bu'i phrin las mi 'ang 'o)ming /sa thob pa zhig yin nges gsung zhing /'dis mdzad pa'i mdo mar bya ba de jo bos gzigs pas/bod kyi 'di lta bu ga la shes/paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa // snang gsungs nas mnyes skad do////

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul ba na pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs// gnyis pa stod nas bstan pa ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ nyi ma mgon gyi sras che ba dpal gyi mgon gyis mang yul bzungs/ chung ba sde btsug mgon gyis zhang zhung bzungs/ bar pa bkra shis mgon gyis yab kyi sku mkhar nyid bzungs nas pu hrangs/ slo bo/ dol po/ gu ge ya tshe la sogs pa la mnga' mdzad/ de'i sras 'od kyi rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras thong nge dang 'bor re/ srong nge rab tu byung ba lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces bya/ khong gi yab mes kyi gdung bsab cing sems can la phan gdags dgongs nas mnga' ris stod kyi/ byis pa lo bcu gsum las mi gzhen mi rgan pa rnams bsags nas/ chu tshod dang dbyug gu dang / gzhung 'dzin pa dang / gzhung gi don rnams la/ rim gyis blo rtog tu brtson nas/ de rnams kyi nang nas blo rab tu gyur pa'i shes rab can bdun/ yang g.yog bdun/ blo dang gros yod pa bdun te/ nyi shu rtsa gcig la gser mang po bskur nas/ kha che'i yul na mkhas pa rin chen rdo rje zhes bya ba yod pas de spyan drongs/rgya gar shar phyogs na/ dharma pā la zhes bya ba yod pas de spyan drongs/ nub phyogasaka ru na paṇ+ḍi ta nor bu gling pa bya ba yod pas de spyan drongs shig dbus 'gyur 'chang na/ paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā wa li bya ba yod pas de la 'dus pa rnam gnyis bya ba'i chos mu stegs kyis kyang brtsod par mi nus pa yin/ de shes par gyis shig de nyid 'dus pa la kun dga' snying pos 'grel pa yod zer bas de shes par gyis shiganor bu gling pa dang / dharma pā la gnyis la las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i rgyud dang / de'i 'grel pa slob dpon dpyid kyis mdzad pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha sum brgya bzhi bcu pa slob dpon rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad pa yod zer bas de shes 237

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)par gyis shig dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog yod zer ba dang / rin chen rdo rje la dus 'khor dang /rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud 'grel yod zer bas tshol shogagazhan bi kra ma shī la na paṇ+ḍita brgya rtsa brgyad/ mkhas pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis/'gran zla med pa sum cu rtsa bdun gtsug gi nor bu lta bu gcig 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan lta bu brgyad/ khams gsum gyi spyan lta bu gnyis yod zer bas/ de rnam las gang byung re/ rab gser la ma brtsegs par spyan ci 'drongs gyis/ 'bring gdams pa ci thob gyis/ tha ma yang paṇ+ḍita chos gang mkhas pa dang / gdamasangag gang mkhas pa rtsad chod la lung zhus/ dpe long ba gyis la shog byas te btang / gu ger tho ling gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i bkod pa mdzad pasasapra mkhan po na re/ brtsigs kyang lo brgya na 'jigs par 'dug zer/ 'o na bzhag gam gsungs pas/ lo brgya po de bstan pa la nan ltar phan pa zhig 'ong ba 'dug zer ba la/ 'o na bzhengs rin chog dgongs te/ bsam yas ji lta ba la/khyad par shar phyogs su gser gyi mchod rten chen po zhig bzhengs pas/ nyi ma shar ba'i tshe de'i 'od nang na yar phog pas lha khang thams cad gser gyi mdog tu lhag ger 'char bas mtho ling gser khang du grags pa bzhengs/ phyis dbus su thebs nas bsam yas gzigs pa na/ nga'i yab mes bod tshang ma la dbang bsgyur ba'i phyag rjes las/ nga mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal phran zhig gi sug las mi chung bar 'dug gsungs/ rgyal srid gcung gi sras lha sde la gtad/ kho rang yangasras gsum rab tu byung ngo / /rgya ga 3 8 brdzangs pa de rnams las bcu dgu shi

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa ba khugs/nas bod la phan thogs pa lo chen dang de'i g.yog lo chung gnyis las ma byung ngo /// lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po ni/ lcags pho rta'i lo la mnga' ris su 'khrungs/ lo bcu gsum pa la mkhan po ye shes bzang po las rab tu byung / kha cher lan gsum byon te bla ma mang du bsnyen/ bod du yang paṇ+ḍita mang po spyan drangs/ dgung lo zhe dgu pa la pa ṇ+ḍi ta zla 'od bzang po dang / bhi na se dang / ka ma la rak+ṣi ta las bsnyen par rdzogs/ lha sde btsan gyi bla ma mdzad/ pu hrangs kyi gzher gyi gnas gzhi phul/ gtsug lag khang mang po bzhedas/ sngags khamatshan nyid kyi gzhung lugs mang po mkhyen/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos dbang sgrub thabs lag len mang po bsgyur/ lha bye ba phrag gcig bsgom pa/ gtor ma brgya rtsa bye ba phrag gcig tsha tsha bye ba phrag gcig yan lag bsnyen pa bye ba phrag gcig bzlas pa bye ba phrag gcig ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bye ba phrag gcig mtshan brjod saṃ zhu ta'i skad du 'bum phrag gcig bod kyi skad du 'bum phrag gcig gzhan yon byin te 'bum phrag gcig rnams bston/ yo ga'i bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ sku che'i smad la jo bo rje bod du byon pa dang mjal/ sgrub pa mdzad pas dngos grub brnyesate / dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa brgyad pa me lug la khā tse ling gir du mya ngan 'das pa 'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe nam mkha' gang ba'i lha rnams kyis rol mo rgya chen po dkrol ba dang / me tog gi char babs pa la sogs pa skye bo thams cad la mngon du gyur/ gdung gtan nas ma byung / ring bsrel 'ol ma se'i mdog lta bu shin tu dmar ba gsum byung ba yang ji zhig ltar 'brug lta bu'i sgra chen po dang bcas te nam mkhar song ngo / /lo chen de la me dge ba'i blo gros sogs slob ma bsam 259

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (3)gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ bstan pa la shin tu phan che'o/ /paṇ+ḍita dharma pā la zhes bya ba rgya gar shar phyogs pa snyan pa'i grags pa can de/ bal po'i rten khyad par can rnams bskor ba la byon pas paṇ+ḍi ta tshad pas bsnyung ba la/ gangs ri mthong sar byon na phan zer nas tshur byon pa lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis spyan drangs nas mnga' ris su byon/ lo chen gyis kun dga' snying po'i lugs kyi yo ga rnams gsan/gser 'khar sder gang phul bas ma bzhes/ khong gi mkhan po mdzad nas/ dge slong swā dhu pā la dang / jo bo gu ṇa pā la dang / dge slong pradzñā pā la gsum bsnyen par rdzogs/ pradzñā pā la las zhang zhud pa rgyal ba'i shes rab kyis bsnyen par rdzogs nas bal por byon/ 'dul 'dzin pre ta ka la phyag len bslab/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi dzñā na shrī dang / kha che'i paṇ+ḍita su bhu ti sharnyi dang / paṇ+ḍita sa man+ta shrī dzñā na dang /kha che'i mkhan po nar ma de wa rnams las 'dul ba'i gzhung du ma gsan nas me dge blo sogs kyis bsgyur zhing bcos nas bshad pa'i slob ma zhing mo che ba byang chub seng ge sogs byung ste de dag la stod 'dul zhes zer ro/ /lha bla mas sku tshe'i smad la jo bo rje'i snyan pa gsan nas spyan 'dren pa'i 'dun pa drag po mdzad nas/rgya brtson 'grus seng ge spyan 'dren par btang kyang spyan ma 'drongs/ lha bla ma mtha' 'khob tu gser 'tshol ba la dmag du ma dang bcas te byon pa gar log gis shes nas dmag btang / 'thab pas pham nas lha btsun brtson du bcugadabon lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis dmag byas na sems can gzhan la gnod kyis drogs nas/ gser gyis bslu bar brtsams pa'i rin la sku gshegs/dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su zhal chems bzhin nag tsho lo tsā ba btang nas jo bo 260

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul ba min pa'i rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru chen 'a skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/spyan drangs/ de nas 'brom ston la sogs pa'i dbus kyi dge ba'i bshes ga nyen rnams kyis dbus su spyan drangs te chos mang du gsungs shing bka' gdams kyi slob brgyud spel te dar rgyas su mdzad/ khyad par du byang chub kyi sems kyi nyamasalen la shin tu phan par byung ngo / /de'i sras rtse lde'i ring la me pho 'brug gi chos 'khor zhes bya ba dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sde sdod 'dzin pa phal cher bsdus nas chos 'khor mdzad/ de'i sras dbang ldes rngog lo rgya gar du 'byon pa'i gser gyi mthun rkyen sogs bstan pa'i zhabs tog mdzad do// /// rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab ni/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi gcung chos skyabs kyi sras su/ sa mo phag gi lo la gcings/ mdo sde rgyan shogasargyugs gcig la zin pa sogs mkhyen rab shin tu che/ lo bcu bdun gyi bar la khu bo sogs la bsten nas gsan sbyang mdzad/ de nas lo bcu bdun gyi bar kha cher byon te gsan sbyangs mdzad/ de dus mtha' 'khob zhig tu slob dpon chen po ḍom+bhi he ru ka mngon sum du zhal gzigs nas/ mkha' spyod du 'dong gsungs te stag gi 'phongs stegs su skyon/ nam mkha' mthon por slebs pas/ bod kyi thad gzhan pas ngam nag pa kun pa'i gling lta bur gzigs nas/ ma gi gang lags zhus pas/ bod rmongs pa'i gling ngo gsungs/ brtse ba mi bzod pa zhakhrungs/mkha' spyod du mi 'gro bar der 'chad nyan btsugs te blo gros kyi snang bas de dag nyin mo bzhin gsal bar bya'o snyam nas dam bcas nas slob dpon la gsol bas legs so gsungs te sngar gyi sar babs ces gro lung pa'i gsungs las byung / so lnga pa la bong du byon nas gtso cher gsang phu dang gzhan lha sa bsam 261

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung 0ces bsdus/ (zhu)yas sogs su chos dar bar mdzad/ bo dong du paṇ+ḍita 'bum phrag gsum pa dhi ra pā la bstan skyong mjal du 'khor dge slong sum brgya dang bcas te byon pa'i tshe/khu'i slob ma ra khri bzang gis bzhengs pa'i rong ngur smig na brang ti dar ma snying po bzhugs pas/ lo tsā ba'i dge slong re re la brang tis kho rang gi slob ma dge slong bcu gsum bcu gsum bsnyen bkur byed du bcug ces grags/ rngog los slar bal yul du'ang yug cig byon zhing / lo bcu bdun du bod du 'chad nyan mdzad pas/ rma khas btsun grwa pa rim pa bzhin/ khri tsho gnyis dang sum stong dang / /zhesadang / zur chos pa'i grangs kyang / rgyan dang chos mchog 'ar pa lnga bcu/ rnam nges 'chad pa nyis brgya dang brgyad cu/ lung chos smra ba stong dang brgyad brgya ste/chos smra ba nyis stong dang brgya sum cu tsam zhig 'dus/ 'gyur mang po mdzad pa'ang shin tu bzang la/ 'gyur mdzad pa'i grangs tshad/ dam chos bsgyur la mnga' brnyes pas/ /rgyal yum gnyis dang bstan bcos gzhung / /'bum phrag gcig dang khri phrag gsum/ /stong phrag bdun ni lhag bcas bskur/ /zhes te tshigasabacad rnams gro lung pa'i gsung ngo //skyes bu chen po de dgung lo lnga bcu nga gcig pa / sa mo glang gi lo la bsam yas dang nye ba'i bar lam du sku gshegs/slob ma'i gtso bo zhang tshes spong ba chos kyi bla ma/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ khyung rin chen grags/ 'bre shes rab 'bar te sras kyi thu bo bzhi/ gangs pa shes gong bu rwa can/ sham po me dig me lhang tsher/ dmar rgas la/ rngog skya bo / tre bo mchog gi bla ma la sogs te/ dngos brgyud kyi slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pas bod kyi lung pa nyin mo lta bu/ 6/dzad do/ /gangs pa she'u dang khyung gnyis

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i thu chen kha nga dang bcas pa bzhugs/ma'i dngos slob stod lung rgya dmar ba byang chub grags/ de'i slob ma sgyu pa chos kyi seṅges phrin las rgya cher spel/ 'di dag dbu ma la rang rgyud pa'i srol 'dzin par mdzad do// //pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags ni/ 'phan yul du 'khrungs/ gzhen nu la kha cher byon te lo nyi shu rtsa gsum sbyangs pa mdzad slar dbus su phebs/ sha ra bsdu sdod grogs mdzad de dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i srol ches cher rgyas par ma sad da// 'a//brog mi lo tsā ba ni/ lo chen rin bzang las lo nyer gsum tsam gyis gzhen zhing / chu mo sbrul lor mang mkhar du sku 'byungs/ bod kyi rgyal po smad kyi sde gsum po grom pa lha rtser bzhugs tshe/ rgyan gong du lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug la bka' stsal te/ mkhan po rgya shākya gzhon nu/ slob dpon se ye shes brtson 'grus/ gsang ston nyang rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i dge slong bdun/ dge tshul gnyis/ dge bsnyen gcig dang bcu spyan drangs te grom pa rgyang du dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa'i dus su rab tu byung ba sum brgya tsam 'dus pa'i nang nas 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes/ stag lo tsā ba gzhon nu brtson 'grus/ ling gzhen nu gsum/ mkhan slob rgyal po dang bcas pas rgya gar du chos slob tu btang / bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin pas 'dul ba/ bstan pa'i snying po yin pas phar phyin/ bstan pa'i nying khu yin bas gsang sngags slobs shig ces bkas rab tu gdams pa las/ 'brog mis mkhas pa sgo drug dang dpa' bo rdo rje las mdo rgyud kyi za/ /na blangs/ khyad par phyis ga ya dha ra bod

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)du byon pa la gser srang lnga brgya phul te kye rdor rgyud gsum ra li/ a ra li bzhi la sogs pa'i rgyud dang / gsung ngag rin po che'i bdud rtsi bzhes nas bstan pa spel ba'i slob ma'i gtso bo man ngag tshar ba gsum/ rgyud tshar ba lnga/ grub pa thob pa bdun sogs byung / gsung ngag rin po che sogs kyi bstan pa la bka' drin che/ bla chen 'dis rgya bal du lo bcu gsum tsam bzhugs/ dgung lo nga gnyis pa chu lug lo ga ya dha ra dang mjal nas lo gsum du gsung ngag gsan cing / drug cu re gsum yan la 'chad nyan spel mar mdzad de bstan pa spel/de nas chos dbyings su ma gshegs bar sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad de/ brgyad cu rtsa lnga par sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'byon par bzhed pa la/ rten ༷brel cung zad tsam gyis bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes sa / / yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus su paṇ+ḍi ta smyo ti dang phra la ring ba bya ba gnyis bal po bad+ma ru tse bas gdan drangs 'ongs pas/ lo tsā ba bal por pho log gis shi ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis pos bod skad mi shes pas dbus gtsang na mar 'khyams te/ smyo tis rta nag tu lug rdzi mdzad/ phyis dpyal se lo tsā ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sman lung du spyan drangs te chos zhus/ khams su byon nas 'dan slong thang du mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad pa btsugs/ phyis bod skad mkhas par gyur te/ gdan bzhi dang 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi skor sngags don rnams gzigs la sogs pa rang 'gyur mang po mdzad/ phyis ling chu gser khab tu byon te smra sgo brtsams so/ /paṇ+ḍita phra la ring bas rong pa chos bzang la 264

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i gru chen kha sdong dang bca4pa bzhugs/grong 'jug byas pas/ rong pas chos mang po dol shes su byung ba yin no/ /mnga' bdag 'od sdes kyang pu rnye shrī spyan drangs so/ /de'i sras rtse ldes kyang kha che dzñā na shrī spyan drangs te/ khyung po chos brtson gyis lo tsā byas nas rgyud rdo rje rtse mo dang / sbyong rgyud dang / tshad ma rnam nges dang / de'i ṭi ka khong nyid kyis mdzad pa la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /gzhan yang tsan+d+ra rā hu la spyan drangs te/ lo tsā ba ting nge 'dzin bzang pos tshad ma kun las btus la sogs bskur ro/ /'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis rgya gar du lan gsum byon/ paṇ+ḍita grub pa brnyes pa bdun cu don gnyis la chos zhus/ khyad par du zhi ba bzang po dang sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po la sogs pa bsten cing / gsang 'dus 'phags skor/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ gdan bzhi/ ma hā ma ya/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis kyang dus 'khor/sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi/ bde mchog la sogs pa bsgyur/ /lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis kyang rgya gar du lan gsum byon/bla ma nā ro mi tri/ zhi ba bzang po/ pham thing pa la sogs pa bsten nas/ gsang 'dus/ bde mchog kye rdo rje/ ma hā ma ya/ gdan bzhi la sogs pa'i man ngag mang po zhus te sgrub rgyud kyi slob ma shin tu dar ro/ /zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyis kyang / paṇ+ḍi ta kha che dgon pa ba dang / te dza de ba dang / sar hi ta bha dra la sogs pa bsnyen nas/ yo ga dang /gtsug tor dang / phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang gi skor dang / rnam thos sras dang /spyod 'jug gi 'grel chen dang / ba/ 6/chog gi skor la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus (zhu)gnyan dar ma grags kyis rgya gar du 'o1 bcu gnyis bzhugs te/ paṇ+ḍita ma ti bsten/ paṇ+ḍi ta pu rnye shrī gdan drangs te spyod 'jug 'grel chen dang /sgrol ma dang / chos skyong la sogs bsgyur ro/ /khyung po rnal 'byor ram shangs pa gdu gu par grags pas rgya gar du bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro chi gu sogs dang / bod du'ang grub thob rā hu la gup+ta chos sgo skyel du byon pa sogs las ni gu'i chos skor/mgon po phyag drug pa dkar nag sogs gsan nas dpal ldan shangs pa bka' rgyud/ brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun sogs byon no/ /khams pa dpal chen zhwa los a bha ya dang rtsa mi sogs bsten te sbyor drug da/ / mgon po 8spe bzhi pa dang / dur khrod bdag po sogs dar bar mdzad —rā / mig rdo ༵ / snar/ lo/ grags dang / spong zho gsal ba grags dang /rtsong ka mi nyag rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags rnams kyis paṇ+ḍi ta a bha ya ka ra gusta bsten nas/ dus 'khor/ phreng ba skor gsum/ thub pa dgongs rgyan/ man ngag snye ma la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis paṇa chen bal po pe nya ba sogasalas thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi bsnyung gnas dang / dbu ma chen po //lha gsan nas dar bar mdzad cing bla ma 'di mthar gar song cha med du kre bo lo tsā ba shes rab daX gyis kyang paṇ+ḍi ta de ba bsten nas

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul ba na pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen kha skong dang bca pa bzhugs/ gnad kyi zla zer la sogs bsgyur ro/ / ba ri rin chen grags kyis paṇ+ḍita don yod rdo rje spyan drangs te/ don zhags dang / bsrung ba lnga dang / rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms kyi skor dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /4 klog skya shes rab brtsegaX kyis kyang mtshan brjod dang / sgrol ma'i skar dang /de/lha ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ༵la pa zlo /shā ṭ+wāṃ/ga/sa pas bde ma7 dang / sgrol ma nyi ma sbas pa'i ༵ /lda pu/ dī ṭ+wāṃ/ lo/ chung grags 'byor shes rab kyis bde mchog gi skor dang phyag rdor 'khor chen sogs bsgyur cing / slob ma dmar chos kyi rgyal po / sa chen kun dga' snying po/ 'brog ra ba dngos grub shes rab sogs byung /phyis la stod shrī'i gad logs su bug sgo 'dag chal gyi sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad de/ sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /'brog shes rab grags kyis kha cher byon te/ paṇ+ḍita zla ba mgon po spyan drangs te/ dus 'khor cha lag rgyas pa dang / rdo rje snying 'grel/ phyag rdor bstod 'grel la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /ba regs thos pa dga' dang / rma ban chos 'bar dang / mtshur lo tsā rnams kyi rgya gar phyag na rdo rje bsten nas/ phyag rgya chen po grub pa'i skor dang /snying po'i skor dang / do ha skor gsum dang / do ha mdzod dang / mi tri ba'i bde mchog la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ / 267

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (()dpyal kun dga' rdo rjes bal po hang ngu dkar po bsten nas/ paṇ+ḍita stong nyid ting nge 'dzin spyan drangs te/ man ngag mang po zhus so/ /rwa rdo rje grags kyis bal po thugs rje chen po bsten nas/ dgra nag ge byed skor gsum dang / he ru ka mngon 'byung gi rgyud la sogs pa bsgyur ra/dbo/ na po rwa chos rab kyis paṇ+ḍita sa man+ta shrī spyan drangs te/ dusa'akhor/ phag mo mngon 'byung dang mgon po mngon 'byung la sogs pa bsgyur ro//shad shes rab bla mas kyang / paṇ+ḍita a mo gha badz+ra spyan drangs te/ dgra nag gi skor rgyas par bsgyur ro/ /rgyus smon lam grags kyis kyang / paṇ+ḍita gzhan la phan pa bsten te/sdom 'byung bsgyur ro/ /zha ma seng rgyal gyis kyang / paṇ+ḍi ta nor bzang srung ba la sogs pa bsnyen nas/ tshad ma kun las btus rtsa 'grel bsgyur ro/ /yar 'brog gi mar pa do ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis kyang / bde mchog gi rgyud 'grel sgrub skor rgyas par bsgyur ro/ /dpyal chos kyi bzang pos rgya gar du lo bcu bzhugs/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa/ ni ka laṅka la/ bde mchog dang / gshin rje gshed dmar gyi skor rnams zhus te bsgyur/ kha che shākya shrī la dge tshul byas so/ /khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis thog mar/ shrī dza gat+ta mi tra a na rnya zhes pa me tra dzo zhi zhes pa spya/ 6/ngas te/ bde chen ral gcig skor/

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i spu chen khan nga dang bcas pa bzhugs/sems nyid ngal gso'i skor dang / bsten pa'i gru la sogs pa bskur ro/ /de nas kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta bud dha shrī dzñā na spyan drangs te/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma dang / rgyal ba'i lam 'jug dang / thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /de nas kha che shākya shrī bha dra spyan drangs te dpyal chos bzang gis/ nā ro 'grel chen bsgyur te de'i bshad bka' man ngag dang bcas pa gnang / paṇ+ḍita de la 'khor paṇa chung / bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra dang / dā na shī la dang / bal po /gha shrī dang / su gha ta shrī la sogs pa dgu byon te/ bi bhu ti dang /dwa na shī las bod du yun ring po bzhugs te/rang 'gyur yang mdzad do//byams pa'i dpal gyis 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud bsgyur/ de'i bshad bka' nod/rdo rje phreng ba dang / bde mchog la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ kha che paṇa chen de las sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa bsnyen rdzogs mdzad nas/ bal po saṃ gha shrī dang bcas pa las sgra bslabs te/ paṇa chen dang dā na shī la las rnam 'grel bslabs te 'gyur bcos kyang byas te/ mkhas pa chen por gyur nas chos ma dag pa rnams sun phyung ngo / /paṇa chen la byang chub dpal dang rdo rje dpal gnyis kyis bsnyen rdzogs byas te gdan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs bzung ngo / /de nas brgyud de paṇa chen gyi mkhan brgyud kyi bslab pa 'dzin pa mang po byung ngo / /paṇa chen gyisasrin po rir rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur rdzogs par mdzad de dbang bka' da bar 'phel lo/ /chag dgra bcom gyis kyang / rgya gar du byon nas rgyal ba'i lam 'jug la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /de'i dbo/ hūm̐ chag chos rje dpal gyis rgya gar du byon

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)te / ra wen+da dang / rat+na rak+ṣi la sogs pa grub thob mang po bsten/ gtsug dgu'i rgyud bsgyur/ 'gyur bcos mang po mdzad do/ /shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bal por byon/ /paṇ+ḍita la : ka ra spyan drangs te/ snyan ngag me long dang/ dpag bsam 'khri shing dang mi g.yo ba'i rgyud dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang bya ba bsdus pa la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /thar pa lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bal por lo bcu bzhi sbyangs pa mdzad/ ri kun dga'i mdo la sogs bcu gsum tsam paṇ+ḍita a /spya dza // drangs te bsgyur ro/ /gzhan yang gzhi 'gyur dang bsgyur bcos mang dpang blo gros brtan pas kyang tshad ma kun las btus kyi 'grel pa rgyal dbang blos ༷dzad pa dang / dus 'khor gyi bshad sbyar snying po snang ba la sags pa zlo // ༵/ tsā/ ba wo po ni/ shab kyi sgom gnas su/ yab brag ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang / yum bsod nams 'bum gyi sras su lcags pho stag la sku bltams/ khro phu sems dpa' chen po bsod nams seng ge zhes pa kha rag sgom chung pa'i sku'i skye bar grags pa dang / tshad ma'i skyes bu la sogs pa yongs 'dzin mang po bsnyen/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita chen por gyur/ yab dang lhan cig dbus gtsang du grwa bskor mdzad pas pha ston bu ston du grags/mtshan dngos rin chen grub yin/ dgung lo so gcig pa la sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ zha lu gser khang ༵ /dan drangs nas phrin las rgya chen po

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor la jug pa 'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/bskyangs/ zha lu ri phug btab/ ri phug tu tshogs pa brgya drug cu dang / mthil du sum stong brgyad brgya re 'dus/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal la gdan sa gtad nas/ ri phug tu thugs dam mthar phyin/ sgra'i 'grel pa dur sing la sogasasagasung rab kyang mang du bsgyur/ bka' 'bum pu sti sum cu so gsum bzhugs//lhang lo spyan lnga pa shing pho 'brug gi zla ba drug pa'i nyer gcig la ri phug tu sku cha gas /pa/nga/ lo'i snag dbon lo 'a byang chub rtse mo la stong zur tshor byon/mkhas grub chen por gyur/ ka lā pa'i 'grel pa slob phan/ rje nyid kyi slob ma grwa pa nam mkha' bzang po dang bcas pas bsgyur ro/ /dus phyis snyigs dus kyi skad gnyis smra ba chen po zha lu lo tsā ba chen po rin chen chos skyong bzang pos gzhi 'gyur dang 'gyur bcos mang du mdzad/ /mdor na bod du dam pa'i chos dar bar mdzad pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta bod du byung ba ni/mkhan po shān+ta rak+ṣi ta bod skad du zhi ba'i 'tsho/ pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / sngagasa'achang dharma girti dang / bi ma la mi tra dri med bshes gnyen dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / bsam yas kyi rab gnas mkhan shā lta gar+bha zhi ba snying po dang /bi budha sidha rnam dag seng ge dang / kwa ma la shī la pad+ma'i ngang tshul dang / rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa dang / bram ze shaṃ ka ra dang / bal po shī la mnya dang / bram ze a nan+da dang / da lnga mi tra dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / /dzi na mi tra rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi lha'i dbang po byang chub/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi tshul khrims dbang po byang chub/ dwa na shī la dang / bo dhi mi tra dang / mu ni 'a thub 271

ba chen 'od snang la /sa sbya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/ (zhu)pa'i go cha dang / sarba dzña de wa kun mkhyen lha dang / bi bya ka ra pra bha rig byed 'od zer dang / shurnya ka ra wa dad byed go cha dang / pad+ma gusta pad+ma sbas pa dang /mu lha mi tra grol ba'i bshes gnyen dang / bud dha shrī sharnyi dang / bud dha pā la sang bas rgyas kha bskyang dang / dharmā pā la dang / pradzñā pā la dang / su bha ṣi ta legalopar gsung pa dang / pradzñā wam dang / di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na mar me mdzad ye shesate jo bo rje dang / de'i dbon po dwa na shrī dang/ 'e ti dzñā na kirti dran pa'i ye shes grags pa dang / phra la ring ba dang / sdo n+ya shrī legs(par rigs pa'i dpal dang / kha che dzñā na shrī dang / tsan+d+ra ra hu la dang / dhi ra pā la bstan skyong ste 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / a tu snye da sha mi nyams khol pa dang / su ma ti kirti blo bzang grags pa dang / a ma ra tsan+d+ra dang / thig le bum pa dang / gzhen nu bum pa dang / ka na ka warma dang / dam pa rgya gar dang / dzā ya a nan+da dang / ga ya dha ra dang / don yod rdo rje dang / zla ba mgon po dang / stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rje dang / ye shes rdo rje dang / shes rab gsang ba dang / ma hā dza na dang / wa la tsan+d+ra dang / mas ka la khyu dang / su ga ta shrī dang / rkarma badz+ra dang / dzā mā ri dang / be+e ro tsa na badz+ra dang / mañdzu go ṣa dang / sur+ya kirti dang / pradzñā shrī dzñā na dang / ga ga dha ra dang / nor sbas dang / sa man+ta shrī dang / ni ska laṅka de ba dang / dza ga〉 tra a nan+da dang / bud dha shrī dzñā na dang /shākya shrī bha dra dang / bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra dang / dwa na shī ldodang / saṃ gha shrī dang / longs spyod rdo rje dang / rat+na shrī dang / bal po ma hā pa na dang / bal po badz+ra kirti dang / bal po kā ya shrī dang / bal po grags pa dpal dang / ku mā ra dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal dang / su sgyi kirti dang / bi na 272

dam pa 'i cho kyi byung tshul ba na pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ ya shrī dang /shī la shrī dang / maṅga la shrī dang / bi ma la shrī dang / dar pan ā tsa r+ya dang / dza ya de wa dang / la ka ra dang / rat+na shrī dang / ā nan+da shrī dang / rā hu la shrī dang / bla ma zangs gling pa dang / kirti paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa byon no/ /dus phyis ni paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen dang / lo kot+ta ra sogs re re tsam las mang po byon pa mi snang ngo / /lo tsā ba snga snga ba thon mi sa sto tra dang dharma ko ni dang / rdo rje dpal dang /bran ka mu la ko ṣa dang / gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra dang / sba ye shes dbang po dang /ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang / 'ba' khri bzher song shi ta dang / sbrang rgya ra legs gzigs dang / seng ge lha lung gzigs dang / sba dmang rje gsal snang dang / sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms dang / lce dzñā na sid dhi dang / mtshimasashākya pra wa/ brang ti dza ya rak+ṣi ta/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge dbus mañdza shrī/rtsangs de len+d+ra rak+ṣi ta/ bran ka mu ti da pa gor be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ 'khon nā gen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta/ me rin chen mchog rtsangs pa la'i bu rin chen legs grub dharma a lo ka dang / dran pa nam mkha' dang / dgra bcom rin chen sde dang / rnam par mi rtog pa dang / shākya 'od dang / lce khyi 'brug nyang khams pa go cha dang / dzñā de wa go ṣa dang / shad rgyal nya no nya bzang dang / 'gos chos grub dang / stong tsa a tsar+ya dang / dharma ta thi la dang / klu yi rgyal mtshan dang / dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi ta dang /rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang / ye shes sde dang / dza ya ra khyi ta dang / mañdzu shrī wam dang /rat+na rgyu shī la dang / bzang skyong dang / lha'i zla ba dang / dpal gyi lhun po dang /dpal 'byor dang / ye shes snying po 2)/ / rgyal ba shes rab dang /shākya bshes

ba chen 'od snang la /sa ci'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)gnyen dang / dge ba dpal dang / legs kyi sde dang / gnubs nam mkha'i snying po dang / yi ge pa dgon gling rmā dang / gzhen nu srung ba dang / nam mkha' skyong dang / rin chen bzang po dang / grags 'byor shes rab dang / 'bro seng dkar shākya 'od dang / rngog legs pa'i shes rab dang / lha bla ma zhi ba 'od dang / rgya brtson 'grus seng ge dang / nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba dang / khu dngos grub dang /chos kyi shes rab dang / mar thung dad pa shes rab dang / me dge ba'i blo gros dang / ga rod tshul khrims 'byung gnas dang / shākya blo gros dang / 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang / khyung po chos kyi brtson 'grus dang / stag lo tsā ba dang /mgar chos kyi bzang po dang / she'u badz+ra de ba deng / ra bzhi bshes gnyen dang /rngog blo ldan shes rab dang / zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab dang / gnyan dar ma grags dang / zu dga' ba rdo rje dang / gyi ljang dbu dkar dang / chos kyi yon tan dang / chos kyi rin chen dang / 'brog mi shākya ye shes dang / lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros dang / 'gos khug pa lha btsas dang / gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer dang / klog skya shes rab brtsegs dang / mal gyo blo gros grags dang / rtsertsa ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / rong pa chos bzang dang / yol lcags rdo rje dbang phyug dang / mang 'or byang chub shes rab dang / rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags dang / khye'u gad pa 'khor lo grags dang / spong zho gsal ba grags dang / ding ri chos grags dang / rgyus smon lam grags/ pa tshab nyi ma grags dang / ba ri rin chen grags/ 'bro shes rab grags dang / rwa rdo rje grags dang / kre bo shesarab dpal dang / bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / ba reg thos dga' dang / rma ban 274

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul ba na pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa 'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/chos 'bar dang / mtshur dbyig gi rgyal mtshan dang / mtshur dbang nge dang /dpyal kun dga' rdo rje dang / dpyal kun dga' grags dang / mar do chos kyi dbang phyug dang / chos kyi snying po dang / dam chos kyi ye shes dang / phyugasamatshams dbang phyug rgya mtsho dang / tshul khrims yon tan dang / khye'u gad pa yon tan dpal dang / bsod nams bzang po dang / sum pa dpal mchog rdo rje dang /nyi ma rdo rje dang / khu dge bsnyen rne tso dang / klog skya gzhen nu 'bar dang / lha ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / byang chub 'byung gnas dang / glan chos kyi blo gros dang /cog gru ting nge 'dzin bzang po dang / shes rab ye shes dang / rig pa gzhon nu dang / gzhon tshul dang / khu mdo sde 'bar dang / shes rab brtson 'grus dang /g.yung drung 'od dang / bsod nams rgyal ba dang / cog gru shes rab bla ma dang /cog gru mya ngan med pa'i dpal dang / la ching yon tan 'bar dang / bsod nams mos pa dang / dge tshul khyung grags dang / tshul khrims brtsegs dang /lha btsun pa dang / lha btsan po mu ni rā dza dang / rngog burnya pā la dang / rgyal lo tsā ba dang / sbal rdo rje rgyal po dang / lha rin po che dang / lha chos kyi rin chen dang /kyu ra tshul khrims 'od zer dang / dge slong bya'i gdong can dang / dpyid lo tsā ba dang / phur bu 'od dang / pa tshab tshul rgyal dang / shes rab legs dang / nag tsho dar ma grags dang / mar pa blo gros bzang po dang / se lo tsā dang / zla ba grags pa dang / gnyal mi ye shes chos dang / chos kyi zla ba dang / dge slong shes rab skyabs dang / nag tsho shes khar ba rgyal mtshan dang / 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs dang / gnyan pa bsod nams dang / ba ri chos grags dang / yong po 275

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)lo tsā dang / gzhen nu shes rab dang / 'gar shes rab 'byung gnas dang /'jam dpal gzhon nu dang / shes rab 'od zer dang / lce dga' ba dpal dang /ye shes 'byung gnas dang / shākya brtson 'grus dang / rwa chos rab dang / lo btsun chung rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / zham dge bsnyen seng rgyal dang / lte bkra shis dang / chag dgra bcom pa dang / dpyal chos bzang dang / gnubs byamasapa'i dpal dang / sa skya paṇ+ḍita dang / chag chos rje dpal dang / dpyal shesarab 'od dang / zhang grub pa dpal dang / glo bo shes rab rin chen dang / lho brag dar seng dang / mi mnyam bzang po dang / shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / shong blo gros brtan pa dang /khams pa blo gros rgyal po dang / 'dan ma tshul seng dang /ra sa gzhen brtson dang / shu skye grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / dpang blo gros brtan pa dang / legs pa'i blo gros dang /bu ston lo tsā ba dang / sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal dang / byang chub rtse mo dang /nam mkha' bzang po dang / shes rab dpal dang /rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang /thugs rje dpal dang / dpal sding lo tsā grags pa'i mtshan can dang / snar thang lo tsā ba sang ga shrī dang / lo tsā ba skyabs mchog dpal dang / stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen dang / ngag dbang dang / mañdzu shrī dang / 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/ zha lu lo tsā ba legs pa rgyal mtshan/ chos skyong bzang po dang / chag lo rin chen chos rgyal dang / sa lo 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams dang /lo chen rat+na bha dra sogs mang du byon no/ /de dag gis ni sgra bsgyur lo paṇa ji ltar byon tshul yin la/ /'khor lo gsum dang ngo mtshar mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum 276

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha nga dang bcas pa bzhugs/ la sogs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa'i bod kyi mkhas grub rnams dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rnams byon tshul la/ chos rgyal mes dbon la sogs snga ma rnams ci rigs par bshad zin la/ gzhan rnams skabs su gang babs su 'chad do// /// de la bod kyi bstan 'dzin rnams kyi bka' srol la bka' phyag sa dge sogs mang du snang ba las/ bka' gdams pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po jo bo lha gcig gis bka' srol te/ de yang jo bo la bod du slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ rgya gar du ni/ dbu lta bu'i slob ma bo dhi pa/ spyan lta bu rat+na ka ra/thugs lta bu sa snying / phyag g.yas lta bu bshes gnyen gsang ba/ phyag g.yon lta bu dbu ma seng ge'am dharma ka ra ma ti sogs dang / bod na mnga' ris stod du lha btsun byang chub 'od dang / lo chen rin bzang / nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/me dge blo sogs dang / gtsang du ling lo tsā ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes rong pa 'gar dang 'gos khug pa lhas btsas se ston sgra gcan 'dzin/ bzang gzhen nu 'bar sogs dang / dbus su khu rngog 'brom gsum sogs dang / lho brag tu chag blo gros 'bar ram khri mchog dang / btsun pa dge skyong sogs dang /khams su phyag rdor ston pa zhes pa phar phyin gyi ṭiska khams lugs su grags pa mdzad mkhan dang / rnal 'byor pa chen po lung a mi byang chub/ dgon pa ba 'dzing sgom dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ gsang phur sku yal ba'i rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje ste gsum dang / chag khri mchog bzhi la jo bo'i rnal 'byor pa bzhi zer/ khri mchog ni mkha' spyod du byon no/ /gzhan yang bod kyi che rgu thams cad 277

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)kyi bla mar gyur to/ /slob ma de rnams kyi nang nas/ khu rngog 'brom gsum slob ma'i mchog yin cing / khu'i mtshan ni brtson 'grus g.yung drung ste phyag rdor gyi sprul pa yin/ yar lungs kyi lha sdings sogs su phrin las bskyangs/ rngog gi mtshan ni legs pa'i shes rab ste 'jams dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin / 'disagasang phu btab/ 'brom ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa ste sgrol mas lung bstan bka' babs thugs kyi sras/ mtshan dngos rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas te mdo las kyang dge bsnyen chos 'phel zhes lung bstan/ 'di ni bka' gdamasakyi pha rgan te/ nyi zla lta bur grags pa'i jo bo yab sras zhes pa'i sras de 'di lags so/ /'brom gyis byang ra sgreng btab/ slob ma'i mchog sku mched gsum dang / kham lung pa sogs byon pa las/ sku mched gsum ni/ spyan rasagazigs kyi sprul pa phu chung pa gzhen nu rgyal mtshan gyis gtso bor sgrub pa mdzad/ bka' gdams thams cad rten 'brel gyi khrid du bsdus nas gsungs/pha bong kha pa zhes bya ba'i slob ma byon/ phyag rdor gyi sprul pa spyan snga tshul khrimasa'abar ni rten bzhengs dang sgrub pa gnyis gtso bor mdzad/ spyan snga bka' rgyud la bka' gdams gdams ngag pa zer/ 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul pu to garin chen gsal gyis/ skyes rabs/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ byang sa/ mdo sde rgyan/ spyod 'jug bslab ba yis te 'di dag la/ skyes tshoms dad pa'i gzhung /sa rgyan ting nge 'dzin gyi gzhung / spyod btus spyod pa'i gzhud zer/ de lta bu'i bka' gdams gzhung drug tu grags pa la 'chad nyan mdzad/ gnas la sogasapa la bdag 'dzin mi mnga'/ 'khor dge 'dun stong phrag du ma 'dus pa tshe 'di 278

dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshur bstan pa'i rgya 4 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ blos btang ba yang byung / 'phags pa'i gnas brtan yan lag 'byung gi rnam 'phrul yin yang gsungs te bka' gdams kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad po yin cing / brgyud par bcas pa bka' gdams gzhung par grags so/ /pu to ba'i slob ma bod na shes rab che bar grags pa'i sha ra ba yon tan grags sam zhang rom po ba zhes kyang zer ba dang / sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul par grags pa'i glang thang pa rdo rje seng ge ste 'di gnyis thugs sras nyi zla lta bu'i bu chen yin/ gzhan yang thugs sras brgyad du grags pa/ gtsang gi ram sding ma pa 'byung gnas rdo rje dang / snang gi gres lhas pa g.yor gyi 'bem no bu chung ba/ rog dmar zhur ba/ dol pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ dge bshes yar gad pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs yin/ des be'u bum sngon po mdzad de/ pu to ba'i gsung la zin ris su byas pa yin/ dpe chos dang babs gcig be'u bum la don stengs pa dang / lha 'bri sgang pa sogs kyis 'grel pa mdzad/ yang gnyal gyi glang bya ra ba dang / gnyos brag gor ba gnyis/ dbu ru'i bya 'phrad pa dang /brag dkar ba gnyis te brgyad do/ khrub pa gzhen nu 'od dam pho brang sdings pa yang zer ba 'dis pu to ba'i gsung gi zin ris dpe chos rin chen spungs pa mdzad/ brag dkar bas rgyas su btang zhing 'khrugs pa sdebs/ rta nag lte sgom shes rab rdo rjes rgyas su btang zhing 'grel pa bzang po mdzad/ de'i gtam rgyud rnams 'gro mgon dpal yis mdzad pa yod/ snar thang mkhan po gro mo che ba dpal ldan bdud rtsi grags kyis kyang dpe chos 'grel pa mdzad/ 'di mchimasanam mkha' grags kyi bla ma yin/ sha ra ba'i slob ma rnam spyod mtshungs med shā 279

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'a chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)ri'i bu bzhi ni/ byang chub sems kyi bka' babs 'chad dkar ba ye shes rdo rje/'di las brgyud de blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid 'byung / man ngag gi bka' babs stabs ka ba dar ma grags/ gzhud bshad kyi bka' babs 'od 'jo ba gzhen nu yon tan te 'dis ra sgreng gi gdan sa mdzad/ longs spyod kyi bka' babs rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje'am shar pa phyi mar grags pa rnams dang /yang shar pa'i slob ma drag shos gtum ston blo gros grags gtsang la 'byon dus shar pa'i gsung gis/ bu khyod la kha ta gzhan bya rgyu med tshul khrims mgo thon dgos/ de la dge 'dun bzhi sde tsam dang 'grogs dgos/ gsung ba la bsten nas snar thang btab/ kha cig nyi ma 'dul 'dzin bu chen du 'dod/ rgya ston lcags ri ba dang zhang zhung pa mdo sde pa sogs glang thang pa'i slob ma'o/ /dol pa dmar zhur ba'i slob ma don stengs pa sogs yin/ pha bong kha pa'i slob ma rgya ma sangs rgyas dbon ston gzhen nu 'byung gnas/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas skal ldan shing rtar grags pa ste 'dis rgya ma rin chen sgang btab/ rnal 'byor pa lung a mi byang chub kyi sras mang ra brtson 'grus 'bar ram snyug rum pa yang zer ba dang / mtha' bzhi brtson 'grus 'bar gnyis/ snyug rum pa'i slob ma dwags po lha rje bsod nams rin chen sogs yin/ dgon pa ba'i slob ma ka ma pa shes rab 'od zer dang / sne zur pa ye shes 'bar te/ sne zur pa 'di mi g.yo sngon po'i grub thob yin zhing 'di nas brgyud pa'i mi g.yo ba'i chos drug yod/ nag tsho lo tsā ba'i slob ma rong pa phyag sor ba ste/ 'dis jo bo'i dngos slob brgyad dang nying slob gnyis ste bcu la thug lag sor dgon par bzhugs/ brgyud 280

dam pa'i chos gyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ par bcas pa la bka' gdams 'og mar grags shing nag tsho'i bka' rgyud kyang zer snga mo'i dus su me tsho byang chub rdo rje bu bzhir grags pa dus phyis rong pa la dad nas chos zhus pas rong pa'i bu bzhir grags pa bya 'dul dang /dpal chen rdor gzhon dang / 'chad ka gsum ga'i slob ma rnal 'byor byang seng sogs seng ge'i mtha' can bzhir grags pa byon te/ rtsis pa gzhon seng / rje rngo chos seng / ka ba ston seng rnams so/ /rnal 'byor byang seng gis 'phan yul gro sa btab/ gzhan yang rtsa rung rin chen skyabs dang / khams pa rdor rgyal dang / gtsang nag pa sogs mang du byon no/ sha bo sgang pa pad+ma byang chub sku mched gsum ga'i sras so/ /jo bo'i slob ma yer pa'i shad btsun nam/ 'ol rgod pa ye shes 'bar yang zer te/ 'di pu to ba'i bla ma yin/ dgon pa ba'i slob ma 'dzid sgom dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dang / sba sgom bsod nams ye shes gnyis da'i slob ma kha rag sgom chung dang / yang pu to ba'i slob ma 'phan sgom gung rgyal zhes pa skya ming yin/ chos ming tshul khrims rgyal ba zer ba sogs dam pa mang du byon/ bka' bsdams zer ba'i yi ge'i brda la bka' bsdams zer ba yod/ phyi nas bka' gdams su grags/ snga ma ltar na rnam thar gtsang ma'i bka' khrims bsdams pa'i don dang / phyi ma ltar na bka'i gdams pa nyams su len pa'i don no/ /da lta bka' gdams pa zer nas grub mtha' zur 'byer mi snang yang / sa dge sogs thams cad kyi nang du thim nas gdams ngag phal cher ma nub par gnas so/ // phyag rdzogs la sogs pa ni/ phyag rgya pa 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur 281

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)la / rdzogs chen pa ni bod 'dir gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis su phye ba'i snying ma'i gdams pa ste/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yin la/ slob dpon 'di dang sgrub thabs mtsho skyes mdzad mkhan gcig par 'chad pa'ang yod mod/ rdo rje gdan pa'i grub thob brgyad cu'i bstod pa na so sor yod pas mi gcig go /rnying ma 'di la bka' gter gyi lo rgyus rnams las/ lo rgyus mi 'dra ba du ma 'byung bas dag ma dag dbye dka' bar snang zhing / bu ston chen pos kyang btang snyoms su mdzad/ lhad zhugasapa'ang cung zad yod mod/ shin tu khungs btsun pa'ang mang po yod par shesapar bya'o/ /grub pa brnyes pa'ang sngon gyi dus su rje 'bang nyer lnga sogs dang /so zur gnubs gsum gyi sngags 'chang mang du byon zhing / 'di'i lo rgyus zhisapa dag pa rnams deb sngon du blta'o/ /gzhan yang 'brog mi nas brgyud pa'i lam 'bras/ mar pa nab brgyud pa'i bka' rgyud/ pha dam pa nas kha brgyud pa'i nibyed/ khyung po nas brgyud pa'i ni gu/ sma ra ser po nas brgyud pa'i pho gcod/ ma gcig lab sgron nas brgyud pa'i mo gcod/ dus 'khor bde kye gsang gsum/yo ga sogs bod 'dir bstan pa yongs rdzogs byon tshul shes par bya'o/ /de la lam 'bras sogs byung tshul 'og nas 'chad la/ // mar pa'i bka' brgyud phyag rgya pa ni/ lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gro kyis rgya gar la lan gsum byon/ bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad sogs bsten/ gtso bo nāro mi tri yin/ bde kye gsang gsum gdams ngag mang po bcas thugs su chud/rje rang gi sras dar ma mdo sde la grong 'jug gi bka' babs kyang / gzhen nu 282

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/la sku 'das/ bka' chen bzhir grags pa/ dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge la 'pho ba'i bka' babs/ gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor la rgyud kyi bka' babs/gtsang rong gi me ston tshon po la 'od gsal gyis bka' babs/ gung thang gi mi la ras pa la gtum mo'i bde drod kyi bka' babs so/ /gzhan yang slong ma mang du byung ngo / /bka' babs snga ma gsum gyis bde kye sogs kyi bshad pa'i bka' bzung / mi las sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa spel lo/ /mar pa ni dgung lo gya bzhi pa la sku gshegs so/ /'di shing pho byi lo yin gsungs shing grwa pa mngon shes can dang dgung mnyam mo/ /rje btsun mi la ni/ lcags 'byug la gung thang gi rtsa ru sku bltams/ ba ri lo tsā dang dgung mnyam yin zer/ gzhen skabs mthu'i sgo nas dgra btul/ dgung lo so brgyad nas zhe bzhi'i bar mar lo'i drung du dka' ba spyad de zab don gyi snying po blangs/ zhe lnga pa nas rdzong drug sogs su sgrub pa gzhan don kho na mdzad do/ /brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi pa yos lo rta zla'i bcu bzhi la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ 'di la 11ba ma bsam gyis mi khyab kyang /gtso bo nyi zla lta bur ras chung rdor grags dang / dwags po lha rje'o/ /zla ba de lta bu'i ras chung pa ni/ rgya gar du byon nas lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor gyi 'phros spyan drangs 'ja' lus grub cing ras chung snyan rgyud du grags pa sogs snyan rgyud kyang spel lo/ /nyi ma lta bu dwags po lha rje ni/ gnyal gyi snye ba lung du sa mo lug la sku bltams/ gzhen nu'i dus su lha rje mkhas par mkhyen/ rang lo nyer drug pa la mar yul blo ldan las bsnyen par rdzogs shing dbang chos mang du gsan/ mang ra ba brtson 'grus 'bar sogs la bka' gdams gsan/ rang 283

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)lo so gnyis pa'i tshe rje mi la don gcig bzhes pa dang mjal te zab chosagasan/ bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres thugs nyams su bzhes shing yig cha yang mang du mdzad/ dwags la sgam po'i dgon pa btab/ bka' rgyud kyi 'byung khungs che shos yin/ 'di don lnga pa bya lo chu stod zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i snga dro gshegs so/ /'di'i slob ma dwags po sgom tshul/ phag mo grub par grags pa khams pa rdor rgyal/ grub thob dbu se/ bha dom ras pa ste rgyud 'dzin gyi bu chen bzhi/ dwags po sgom tshung / rmog cog pa/ gsal stong sho re/ bla ma 'ol kha ba ste thugs sras bzhi/ gzhan yang dwags po 'dul 'dzin la sogs pa mang du byon no / / brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo ni phag gru nyid do/ /dwags po ni sa chen las lo bcu gsum gyis bsgros so/ /phag gru dang / dbu se'am dus gsum mkhyen pa/gsal stong sgom sho gsum la khams pa mi gsum zer/ phag gru dang dusagasum mkhyen pa gnyis lcags pho stag la bltams/ sa chen las lo bco brgyad kyis gzhen/ phag grus bco brgyad pa la dbus su byon/ stod lung rgya dmar las dbu tshad gsan/ nyer lnga pa la zul phur bya 'dul gyis mkhan po/ rgya dmar gyis slob dpon/ ar gyis gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs shing mdo la sbyangs/ de nas gtsang du byon/ las stod pa dkon mchog mkhar dang/sa skya pa chen po sogs bsnyen/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad bshad mdzod mar grags pa mdzad/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan las sems bskyed dang / dmathachos rgyal las bde mchog sogs gsan/ phyis dwags po rin po che'i zhabasapad bsten/ dgung lo zhe dgu pa la phag grur phebs/ 'jag spyil rin po cher 284

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bsnan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/lo bdun bzhugs/ grwa pa brgyad brgya la gdugs thog lnga brgya byung zer/ re gcig pa lcags pho stag zla ba bdun pa'i nyer lnga la gshegs so/ /de la slob ma'i mchog mos gus mthar thug stag lung pa bkra shis dpal/ rtogs pa'i mthar thug rna phu ba gling ras/ shes rab mthar thug par phu ba/ nus pa mthar thug 'chan phu pa ste bka' babs bu chen bzhi/ par phub 'di phyu pa'i slob ma yang yin/ gzhan yang skal ldan ye shes seng ge rtogs ldan mi nyag sgom rin/grub thob lhag re se bo/ kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung bzhi la gdams pa'i bu bzhi zer/ 'bri gung skyu ra rin chen dpal/ chos rje lha 'bum pa/ chos rje rgyal tsha / ban dha phug pa/ ro gcig rtogs pa phyed dang bzhi zer te/ brnya phug pa la jo mo yod pas phyed zer ro/ /de sogs mang du yod kyang gtso bo gling ras/ 'bri stag gnyis/ khro phu pa dang bzhir 'dus so/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa'am dbu se ni / bcu drug lon tshe rngog lo'i slob ma kye'o mchog bla dang / chag seng ge grags las rab tu byung / mtshan dpal chos kyi grags pa zer/ nyi shu pa la stod lung ser thang du byon/ rgya dmar dang phywa pa las dbu tshad/ shar pa las bka' gdams/ pa tshab las rigs tshogs/ sa skya pa'i thugs sras gshen rdor seng las lam 'bras rgya lo dang a seng las sbyor drug sogs gsan/ mal 'dul 'dzin las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sum cu pa la dwags po'i sras su gyur/ brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa la gshegs so/ /slob ma ni 'gro mgon ras chen sogs byon no/ /skye med zhang brtson 'grus grags pa chu mo yos la byon/ dwags po sgom tshul dang rga lo sogs bsten/ tshal gung thang sogs btab/ rdzu 'phrul gyis rgya'i dmag 285

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)bzlog don gcig pa chu mo glang la gung thang gi 'bum mo che bzhengs/ bang rim gsum pa'i tshe zhi bar gshegs so/ /gling ras sa pho spre lo la byon/ rgyal ba lo dang / sum pa sogs bsten/ zhe gcig pa la phag gru labs lhan cig skyes sbyor gsan pas chu bo gaṅgā tshun na lta ba bzang bar grags/ dbyar zla gsum phag grur bzhugs/ bud med sngon mo zhig gis mdo rgyud kyi lung gnang bas mdo rgyud rang dbang du 'grel ba'i spobs pa thob/ bka' 'gyur thugs la bzhugs/ti lo pa'i sprul par grags/ mkha' 'gro ma lngas rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rgyu gos chen la sku rnams thag las bton pa phul ba da lta yang rna phu chos lung na yod zer/ gling ra kyi mtshan pad+ma rdo rje yin/ re gcig pa sprel lo dbyar zla'i nyer brgyad la gshegs/ gling ras kyi slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ gtsang pa rgya ras ye shesardo rje'o/ /stag lung pa ni chu pho khyi la g.yang stong bong rar byon/ bco brgyad pa la rab tu byung / nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la phag grur byon te lo drug bsten/ so dgu pa lcags mo byi lo la stag lung du phebs/ tshogs pa stong phrag 'dus/ re dgu pa rta lo mgo zla'i tshes bcu dgu la gshegs/ dbon brgyud rnams kyis khams kyi ri bo che la sogs pa phrin las rgya cher 'phel lo/ /'bri khung pa ni khams 'dan yul dpal thang du chu mo phag la byon/ stag lung pa las lo gcig gis gzhon/so lnga pa la zhang sum mdo pa kye bo ye shes rdo rje las bsnyen par rdzogs/ tsogazhen nu nas phag gru bsten/ gdan sa lo gsum mdzad de 'gro don cher ma byung / phyis so bdun pa la 'bri gung du phebs/ 'bri gung ni mi lhag sgom rin rme gyis btab kyang 'gro don cher ma byung / sku 'da' ba'i tshe nga 'das ma thag byang 286
