dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/chub sems dpa'i sprul pa zhig 'byon par 'dug pas de gdan sar gdan drongs gsungs nas 'das so/ /de nas rje 'dis 'bri khung gi gdan sa bskyangs/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po zhes/ snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab/ tshogs pa lnga khri lnga stong brgya nyer lnga 'dus/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi sku'i skye ba yin pa'i gtan tshigs mang po yod/ dgongs gcig la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/ dgung lo don lnga pa me mo glang lo zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la sku gshegs pas slob ma gnyis kyis tshogs pa la zhal ston par gsol ba btab pas 'od gsal las bzhengs te nyi ma gnyis su chos gnang nas nyer bdun la gshegs so/ mchod pa gang la 'dzin zhus pas nyer lnga la zungs gsungs so/ /de'i thugs sras spyan snga gragasapa 'byung gnas kyis gdan sa mthil dang 'bri gung gnyis ka bskyangs/ rje 'di'i ring la 'bri gung khri tsho bco brgyad du grags pa byung / 'di nyid rje btsun grags pa chos dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshogs dpon la chos rje sa paṇa gyis spyan drangs zhes kyang zer ro/ /'bri gung pa'i dgon gnas dang chos brgyud ni/da lta yang ma chad par yod do/ /gling ras kyi thugs sras gtsang ba rgya ras ni/lcags mo sprul la nyang stod du byon/ rje btsun grags pa las lo bcu bzhis gzhon 'brug ra lung gi dgon pa btab/ 'brug pa zhes yongs su grags/ nā ro pa'i sprul par grags/ slob ma'i mchog dbon sras dang / rgod tshang pa dang /lo ras la sogs pa mang du byon/ rgod tshang pa nas mched par stod 'brug dang / lo ras pa nas mched par smad 'brug dbon sras sogs nas mched 287

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)par bar 'brug ces grags/ de lta bu'i rgya ras ni dgung lo nga gcig pa dbo zla ba'i nyer lnga la gshegs/ dgongs rdzogs la khri tsho bco brgyad 'dus zer ro/ /da lta yang dbon brgyud dang chos brgyud ma chad pa gnas pa nyid do/ /lcags pho stag la ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan ding rir byon/ lo brgyad stobazhugs/ dwags po bka' brgyud dang lam 'bras zha ma lugs sogs 'a/nyams len mdzad/ /slob ma'i gtso bo yang dgon pa/ 'chims nam mkha' grags gnyis/ gzhan yang dpyal lo/ khro lo/ chag lo gnyal lo ste lo tsā chen po bzhi'o/ /deb sngon las/ ko brag pa sa paṇa dang gung mnyam pa yin zer ro/ /'brug pa'i thugs sras rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje ni/ sa mo bya la lho brag tu byon/ lo bcu dgu pa la rab tu byung / gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhabs zung zla gegasum bsten/ kong po nas dza la ra'i bar gyi gnas rnams su sgrub pa dang gzhan don kho na mdzad/ bdun cu bzhes pa sa pho rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum la gshegs/ slob ma'i mchog rang las lhag pa gcig rang dang mnyam pa brgyad sogs byon pa las/ rang las lhag pa yang dgon pa yin la/ mnyam pa brgyad ni/ rten 'bred rang dang mnyam pa yi ring pa/ sgrub tshugs rang dang mnyamapa phug ri ba ri khrod gling pa/ mos gus rang dang mnyam pa spyi dkar pa/ snying rje rang dang mnyam pa ma 'dun pa/ zhen log rang dang mnyam pa gang pa shākya bshesaganyen/ dag snang rang dang mnyam pa nam mkha' rdo rje/ dka' spyad rang dang mnyam pa g.yam mo ring gi shākya ras pa/ brtul shugs rang dang mnyam pa grub chen u rgyan pa dang brgyad do/ khro lo'am gnubs byams pa'i dpal ni/ phag gru 288

dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/pa'i dngos slob rgyal tsha rin chen mgon dang / de'i dbon po kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung gnyis yod pa'i kun ldan ras pa'i dbon po yin/ 'di rab tu byung ba'i mtshan tshul khrims shes rab yin/ paṇa chen bud dha shrīs byams pa'i dpal du mtshan gsol/ paṇa grub rnam gsum spyan drangs/ byams pa'i rnam 'phrul du grags lnga phu byams chen bzhengs pas byams pas byams pa bzhengs pas byin rlabs shin tu che zhing kha che paṇa chen gyis rab gnas mdzad do/ /kun ldan rasapa'i slob ma ma cig ri ma nyang lug skyes zhes pa la bu gcig skyes pa skyes bu dam pa zhig byon par shes nas gso skyong mdzad pas lce sgom rdzong par grags/mkha' skyong brag la zhes kyang bya/ sa chen gyi dngos slob rgyal tsha tal phu pa dang /ma gcig ri ma sogs bsnyen/ nyi zhur brag tu lta ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i don skyong bas mkha' skyong brag pa dang / rta nag gi rdzong la bsgoms pas lce sgom rdzong par grags/ man ngag rin spungs dang / dpe chos rin spungs kyi 'grel pa dang / me long skor gsum sogs mdzad/ slob ma 'brom ston lha rin la sogasapa byung / spyir lce sgom la lce sgom 'gar mo rdzong pa dang / lce sgom 'phags srasal sogs pa du ma yod do/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas sum stong sum brgya dang so drug 'das pa'i so bdun pa shing pho byi lo la/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra 'khor paṇa chung dgu dang bcas te bod du phebs/ de'i tshe ko brag pasalo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ khro los sogasum/ sa los nyi shu rtsa gsum/ rgod tshang pasabargya drug lon/ des na jo bo rje bod du byon pa'i shing pho rta lo nas lo brgya dang lnga bcu 'das pa'i nga gcig pa shi/ 8rdo byi lo paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du byon pa

ba chen 'od snang la /skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (4)yin zhes bya'o/ /'khor paṇa chung dgu ni/ dbu phar la mkhas pa su ga ta shrī/ sngags 'dul ba la mkhas pa dza ya dad ta/ sgra dang mngon pa la mkhas pa bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra/ tshad ma la mkhas pa dwa na shī la/ tsan+d+ra la mkhas pa saṃ ga shrī/ mngon pa gong 'og la mkhas pa su ma ti gar+bha/ byams chos la mkhas pa dzi na gubha/ spyod 'jug la mkhas pa ma hā bo dhi/ dus 'khor la mkhas pa kā la tsan+d+ra rnams so/ /de yang kha che khri stan gyi bye brag dza sho bha ra zhes par shing mo glang gi lor paṇa chen 'di nyid sku bltams/ lo bcu pa la bram ze lak+ṣa rnyi ra la sgra rig gsan/lo dgu nas nyer gnyis kyi bar tshangs spyod dge bsnyen mdzad/ nyer gsum pa la mkhan po su kha shrī bha dra de ba dpal bzang po las rab tu byung / nyer dgu'i bar kha cher bzhugs/ sum cu par yul dbus ma ga dhar byon/ mkhan po shān+ta ka ra gup+ta ste zhi ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa dang / da sha bha la dang / gsang ston dha bar ka sogs bco brgyad las bsnyen par rdzogs/ drug cu bzhes pa'i dze khro lo so gsum lon pa zhig gis byi ba'i lo mchu'i zla ba la spyan 'dren du byon te/rgya gar gyi be+eḍūr+ya'i tshong 'dus su phebs/ shākya'i bstan la shākya'i sras bltamasashākya'i mtshan/ /zhes sogs kyi zhu yig rten dang bcas pa phul/ ba yi shā ra bya bar paṇa chen dang mjal/ paṇa chen gyi gsung gis/ lo tsā ba 'di chos mang du shes pa lha chen bzhengs pa stobs yod pa'i yar rgan zhig yod bsam pa la na tshod gshon nur 'dug chos bsgyur ba'i lo tsā ba yang mi phod/ sgrub thabasa'aga' byin la 'o skol dpon slob phyir ldog gsung / paṇ+ḍi ra dza ya shrīs dpon slob rnams lo tsā ba'i gzugs la brnyas 'dug pas 'bel ba'i gtam dris 290

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhu sa/shig ces skabs dbye lo tsā bas paṇa chung dgu la dri ba mi 'dra ba gnyis gnyis byas pas/ paṇa chen rab tu dges te/ spyan drangs pa'i rngo thogs/ paṇa chung rnams la'ang 'do li byas te rim pas spyan drangs/ chu mig tu khro phu bas bsu ba'i bkod pa dge 'dun drug cu/ bar gdugs rol mo sogs drug cu drug cu dang bcas pas khro phur spyan drangs/ de'i tshe sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/ yab dpal chen 'od po phag lo la sku gshegs nas gshegs rdzongs kyi sku skal rkyang 'dur du 'bul bar phebs pa'i lam bar chu mig tu chos rje dang mjal/ tshad ma chos mchog gi bstod pa sogs mdzad pa yin zer/ khro phur byi lo dbyar gnas mdzad tshul shing len pa brgyad brgya byung / brgyad stong pa sogs gsungs/ lo tsā bas dar zab kyis thun yon de ma chag par phul/ lho brag pa byang chub dpal la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / dbus nas 'bri gung pas spyan 'dren pa'i cha rkyen mang po slebs/ slas mo cher phebs/ rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i rten mchod rnamasazhal phye/ mchod pa gzab par phul/ gtsang so ba bsod nams mdzes kyis mjal/ bdag bsnyen par rdzogs nas lhung ba ma byung ba la brten pas tshul khrims bsrung ba'i dge ba bsngo bar zhus pas/ dbu zhwa zul gyis phud/ thal mo sbyar nas/ bsngo rgyu bzang ba 'di lta bu rgya gar na yang dkon gsungs nas bsngo ba mdzad/ glang lo dbyar gnas slas mo cher mdzad/ dgag dbye thon nas chu mig ring mor byon/ rgyan gong gnas su rdo rje dpal la bsnyen rdzogs gnang /gzhu snyen mo'i nang la byon/ mtshur phu nas stod lung brgyud de jo bo rnam gnyis la mchod pa phul/ mtshur phu'i skye/ ṭ+wāṃ rnams la/ khyed kyi dgon pa na sangs

ba chen 'od nga la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)rgyas thod pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i sku gsum snang ba khyed kyis ngo ma shes gsungs/ sku gsum ni/ bde mchog yab yum go bzlog shākya thub pa sprul sku la yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor gyi lha dang gsum mo/ /de nas srin po rir stag lo dbyar gnas mdzad/ byams chos 'khrid dang rigs tshogs rnams gsungs/ me mo yos la sol nag thang po cher phebs/ bstan rtsis mdzad pa na/ smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /tshes brgyad nam dgung mnyam pa la/ /zla ba ri bo la nub tshe/ /thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /de rjes lo ni stong phrag gcig /bdun brgya dang ni lnga bcu dang / /zla ba gnyis dang zla ba phyed/ /de bzhin nyi ma lnga rab 'das/ /zhes sogs bshad/ 'o na rang lugs kyi bstan rtsis dang ches ma mthun no snyam na skyon med de/ paṇa chen gyi bstan rtsis kyi 'das lo'i thog ma ni/ tho btsun grub rje dang bde byed bdagapos byang chub chen po'i sku bzhengs dus kyi me mo sbrul nas bzung ba yin no/ /de nas byang ra sgreng du byon pa'i yar lam 'bri khung pas spyan drangs kyang gdan gcig pa dang bka' gdams pas gegs byas mjal du ma ster zer ro/ /nyisade sa pho 'brug gi lor gtsang du phebs/ nyang smad rgyan gong du sa paṇa la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / gsang ston spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od ni shing pho byi lo pa ste de'i tshe re lnga pa yin/ sbrul lo dbyar gnas rin chen sgang du mdzad/ rta lo'i dbyar gnas sa skyar mdzad/ lug lo'i dbyar gnas shang lug gu gdong du mdzad/ lha btsun gung thang pa la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / sprel lo'i dbyar gnasakhro phur mdzad de/ chu pho sprel lo bre zla ba'i tshes gsum nas bcu gsum gyi bar 292

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/du khro phu byams chen gyi rab gnas mdzad/ rim gyis khro phu nas mnga' ris su phebs te/ bya lo'i dbyar gnas pu rangs su gnang / shing pho byi lo la kha cher phebs te/ lo nyer dgu tsam zhig tu bstan 'gro'i don mdzad/ dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa sgrog zla ba'i tshes lnga la zhi bar gshegs so/ /chu mo phag la rong pa rgya lo byon/khams pa rgya lo'i skye bar bzung nas rgya lo zer/ khams pa rgya lo ni sa chen dang phar slob tshur slob yin/ dpyal lo'i drung du rgya yig la sogs pa sbyangs/brgyad cu pa la gshegs so/ /'di'i slob ma ni 'phags pa rin po che/ khro phu rin po che lho pa grub ye/thang ston lo tsā ba grags rgyal/ man lung pa chen pa'o/ /man lung pa bsod nams dpal 'di nyid sku lus de nyid kyis po ta lar byon/chu mo bya la yang dgon pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po las stod lho'i 'bri lung par bltams/ bla ma'i mchog ni rgod tshang pa/ sa paṇa/ ko brag pa/ 'bri gung spyan snga rin po che dang bzhi'o/ /slob ma'i mchog ni lo ras chos skyong dpal dang dar ma rgyal mtshan gnyis spyan snga rin ldan dang / zur phug pa rin chen gnyis te bzhi'o/ /zur phug pa'i sras ni 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ste yang dgon pa'i sku skye ru byed do/ /yang dgon pa zhe drug pa rta lo nam mthong gi tshes bcu dgu la gshegs so/ /yang dgon pa'i sku skye shangs 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang nas 'ba' ra ba'i chos brgyud byung ngo / kha che paṇa chen bod du byon pa'i shing pho byi lo na me pak+ṣi byon/ sa paṇa las lo nyer gnyis kyis gzhen dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma spom brag pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ hor rgyal pos kyang spyan drangs/ mes bsregs chu la bskyur mtshon gyis btub kyang 293

ba chen 'od snang las/tsho skya'i chos 'byung ge bsdus/ 9)gnod pa ma byung bas zhabs tog byas zer/ brgyad cu pa lug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la gshegs so/ /'di ni sar ha'i sprul pa yin la/ 'di'i sku skye brgyud du byon pa ni/ dme rang byung rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ de bzhi gshegs pa mthong ba don ldan/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ mi bskyod rdo rje ste mi mi pak+ṣi nas mi bskyod rdo rje'i bar sngar bdun byon zin pa yin la/ dus gsum mkhyen pa ni skal bzang gi sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge'i rnam 'phrul yin par bshad la/ rkarma pak+ṣi sar ha'i rnam 'phrul du bshad kyi/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku skye yin zhes(ma bshad pas/ ska smra zhwa nag pa zhes bya ba'i thog ma ni na pak+ṣi nas ngos 'dzin dgos par sems la/ 'on kyang ga me pa zhes pa'i mtshan 'dogs ni/ dus gsum mkhyen pas smad du dam po gnas nang bar du rkarma lha steng / stod du mtshur phu'i dgon pa btab pa nas karma pa zhes mtshan 'dogasapar gsal bas dus gsum mkhyen pa la dme pa zhes pa'i sgra bshad du yod pa tsam zhig yin no snyam du sems so/ /zhes mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho gsung ngo / /de lta bu'i rkarma pak+ṣi'i slob ma ni/ rje u rgyan pa/ rkarma zhwa dmar can/ zhwa ser can/ zhwa khra can la sogs pa'o/ /sprul sku zhwa dmar pa tshul khrims dpal ba ni me pho byi lo la bltams/ te lo pa'i slob ma khol po dga' zhes pa'i sku skye yin zer ro/ gangs pa bka' brgyud ni/ khyung po rnal 'byor zhes pa khams khyung po nas chad/ snye mor sku zhakhrungs/ stag lo pa yin/ rgya gar du lan bdun byon/rdo rje gdan pas kyang dbu sgra gcod pa ming spo ba dang rab tu byung ba sogs mkha' 'gro mas ma gnang ba la/ phyis glang ri thang pa snang ba mtha' yas su gzigs294

dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa sa yis/nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ lo brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs/ shangs zhang gzheng gi dgon pa btab pas shangs pa bka' rgyud du grags thugs sras las stod pa dkon mchog mkhar dang rmog lcog pa sogs khri tsho brgyad yod par grags/rmog lcog pa nas brtsam brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun sogs dang / dkon mchog mkhar gyi rje sa chen dang / 'bro shes rab 'bar yang bsten shes rab 'bar ni nyang stod pa yin/ yol chos dbang las rab tu byung zhing de'i gdan sa skyongs/che ba bcu ldan gyis las stod pa dkon mchog mkhar la gdan sa gtad/ las stod pa 'dis lo she bzhugs/ 'di nas bzung ste gnas rnying pa'i gdan rabs /ma~X kā/khor/ lo'i byon tso la/ thog mar brgyam ldan 'das kyis dpal ldan 'bras spungs su/ dus kyi 'khor lo bzhengs te/ byang sham+bha la'i rgyal po zla bzang 'khor bcas sogs la dus 'khor rtsa rgyud sogs rgyud sde mang po gsungs so/ /zla bzang nas bzung ste chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyis sham+bha lar rgya cher spel/ phyinas ci lu pa dang / du bzhabs pa sogs kyis 'phags yul du spyan drangs/ sems 'grel skor gsum du grags pa ni/ kye rdor la rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ bde mchog la phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i phyag rdor stod 'grel/ dus 'bor la rigs ldan pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa'i 'grel chen dri med 'od de gsum mo/ /'di rnams kyi chos skad kyi babs dus 'khor dang mthun/ bod du ni kha che zla ba mgon po dang / sgra ston gnam la brtsegs kyis rgyud 'grel bsgyur/ phyis kyang ra 2 9 /3shong sogs 'gyur gyi bye brag mang ngo / /

ba tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ (4)man ngag sbyor drug ni/ dpal chen rgya lo dang / grub chen yu mo yab sras sogasamang pos spel/ phyis bu dol la sogs pas dar rgyas su mdzad pa'o/ /bu ston pa bshad zin/ jo nang kun spangs pa ni la stod byang gi 'dab shar du byon/ nyang stod rkyang 'dur gyi gdan sa mdzad/ de bzhag nas ri khrod rnams su thugs dam mdzad pas kun spangs su grags/ jo mo nang rgyal gyis dgon gnas phul nasajo mo btab/ rje 'di chos rgyal 'phags pa sogs kyi slob ma yin pas jo nang yang sa skya'i dgon lag yin/ de nas byang sems rgyal yi/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho sogs byon/ dol bu pa shes rab rgyal mtshan ni/ mnga' ris dol bu ban tshang du byon/ skyi ston dang / mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho sogs bsnyen/jo nang gi gdan sa mdzad/ gzhan stong gi grub mtha' btsug sku 'bum chen mo bzhengs/ chos kyi mdzod rdol te/ lhun po bzhengs pas rgya mtsho rdol ba snyam/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i slob ma jo nang phyogs rgyal ba yang mnga' ris dol bur byon/ jo nang dang ngam ring gnyis na'i gdan sa mdzad/ /༈ ngam ring pa ni byang pa bdag chen twa wen chen po nam mkha' bstan pa dang rje 'dis dzom ring gi bla brang dang 'du khang sogs btab/ de nas bzung ste ngam ring gi gdan rabs rnams byung ngo / /kun mkhyen dol bu pa'i slob ma kun spang chos grags pa ni/ sa skya'i bla brang khang sar chen mo'i dbon brgyud g.yas ru byang gi dpon chen yon btsun chen po grags pa dar gyi gcen/ dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sras te/ dpang lo/ dpal ldan seng ge/ bu dol la sogs pa'i mkhas grub mang du bsten/ bzang ldan/ 'ga' rong / chung kha ba 296

dam pa 'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i spu cher kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/sogs chos grwa du ma btab/ bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa cher mdzad do/ /sa bzang ma ti pa ni mdog dpang por du byon/ dol bu pa dang/ kun spangs pa dang /dpang lo sogs bsten/ bzang ldan gyi mkhan po thog ma yang mdzad/ mkhas shing phrin las rgya che ba yang byung / dben gnas dga' ldan sa bzang gi dgon gnas yang btab/ de'i gdan sa sa bzang 'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros/ de'i gdan sa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po sogs byon no/ /lcags pho stag la grub chen u rgyan pa rin chen dpal lho nas lhums su byon/ bcu drug pa la rgod tshang pa las dge bsnyen mdzad/ bo dong rin rtse/ bcom ldan ral gri/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal sogs las mdo phyogs gsan go lung pa'i gcung po yang yin/bo dong rin rtse las bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /rgod tshang pa las gdams pa gsan pas sgro 'dogs cho de/ shrī rdo rje rnal 'byor mas pusti gcig gnang ba mid pas mdo rgyud la thogs pa med/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i u rgyan sogs dgu ru byon/dgung lo go gnyis pa lcags mo bya lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshe nyi shu la gshegs so / / slob ma'i mchog dme rang byung rdo rje/ grub thob tsha chung pa/ rtogs ldan g.yag mgo ba/ rtogs ldan zla seng dang bzhi'o/ /rtogs ldan tsha chung pas sgyud kra nas lha sar nyin re la phebs/ rgya khab brgya dus re la gsol nas ba spu'i bu gar dus gcig la 'don/ rtogs ldan bla seng sku 'da' khar/ bu ston rin po ches gsol ba btab te lo gsum bzhugs zer ro/ /yang bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra nas ko brag pa la brgyud pa'i sbyor drug kyang yod do/ /dus 'khor gyi byung tshul rgyas par/bu'i dus 'khor gyi chos 'byung dang / chag lo rin chen chos rgyal gyi dpag 297

ba chen 'od snang la/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)bsam snye mar blta'o/ // gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugasabyon tshul ni/ gdung brgyud rin po che 'di thog mar 'od gsal lha'i nang du/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs rje'i zlos gar/ spyi ring g.yu ring / g.yu stseste gnam lha mched gsum byon pa nas bzung ste/ g.ya' spang skyes kyi bar la gnam lha'i brgyud par grags/ 'dis srin po skya reng khrag med btul/ chung ma g.yas 'brug si li ma khab tu bzhes pa las sras gcig 'khrungs pa srin po dang 'khon pa'i bar du skyes pa 'khon bar skyes su grags/ de nas bzung ste 'khon rigs su grags pa byung / nges pa'i don du spang bya ma rig pa'i dgra las 'khon pa ste/ gdung brgyud rin po che rnams la phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa dang /spyan gyi rdzi ma 'khrub tshul mi phal pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yod pa'o/ /'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos sa skya'i dgon gnas btab pa nas bzung ste 'khon sa skya par grags/ des na brgyud pa gcig la mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /gnam lha mched gsum nas 'khon dpa' bo che'i bar gyi gdung brgyud lha rigs ngang tshul bzang zhing mthu che ba bsod nams kyi dpal dang ldan pa / phal pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa 'ba' zhig byon la/ dpa' bo che'i sras 'khon nā gen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta ste/ bod skad du/ 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba zer/ 'di mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho las sgra sgyur sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba'i shes rab che shos de yin/ sad mi mi bdun zhes pa bod du rab tu byung ba bzhusami btub nyams sad pa'i ched du mdza/ 8 ltar grags so/ /klu'i dbang po

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhug /srung bas slob dpon pad+ma sogs brten/ de nas bzung ste 'khon rog shes rangatshul khrims kyi bar du gdung brgyud rnams gsang sngags rnying ma thugs su bzhes/ dge mtshan dang ldan pa 'ba' zhig byon no/ /'khon dkon mchog rgyal po ni/ shing pho khyi la sku 'khrungs so/ /'di ni thugs rab che zhing sa dpyad dang /lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / sngags mtshan nyid thams cad la shin tu mkhasapa yin no/ /re zhig na 'bri 'tshams su 'bro yis gson shing byed pa la gdan 'dren byung / der byon nyin zhug sbrel ma'i bar du rtsed 'jo dang ltad mo byed pa mang po 'dug pa'i nang na/ sngags pa mang po dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi mgo brnyan gyi 'bag gyon/ phyag mtshan so sor bzung / lus la dar gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan nas ma mo ral pa can gyi rngams stabs dang bcas te 'chams pas ltas mo che bar byung / de rnams kyis khrom thog yang chod zer/ tshur 'khor/yul du phebs/ bla ma gcen la 'di ltar 'dug ces zhib par zhus pas gcen gyi zhal nas/ da ni gsang sngags 'chol ba zhes bya ba'i dus byung ba yin/ da phyin chad bod sngags rnying ma rnams la bsten nas grub thob tshad ldan mi 'ong /rang re la yod pa rnams dbang che bas/ a po rgyad pos dpe cha dang lha rten gsang sngags kyi lag cha thams cad gter du sba'o/ /nga ni na so gos khyod gzhon pa yin pas/ gsang sngags gsar 'gyur zab mo yod par 'dug de yang mang mkhar mu gu lung na 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes bya ba shin tu mkhas pa yod 'dug pas de tsa na song la slobs gsung / bra mo lung du mchod rten chen po gsum bzhengs/ sngags rnying ma'i lha rten dpe cha/ lag cha thams cad der 299

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)bzhugs su gsol/ de dus chos skyong gi 'khru ldog dang cho 'phrul byung bas/ rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor thams cad dang / seng ldeng gi phur pa bco lnga/ skyer phur cha gcig dkar mo nyi zla nyid kyis dngos su zhal bstan nas 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims la gnang ba'i gtor chog dang man ngag sogs thog cig bton nas gcung po la gnang / dus gtor ma chag par gyis gsung ngo / /de nas 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po 'dis 'brog mi'i drung du byon/ gsang sngags phyi 'gyur rnams la sbyangs/ gzhan yang 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kha che'i paṇ+ḍita hang ngu dkar po/ me lo tsā ba rin chen mchog 'dzin pa lo tsā ba la sogs pa mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang du bsnyen/ g.ya' lung chu skyar du ci rig sa bzhugasabra bo lung du dgon chung gcig btab/ lo 'ga' bzhugs/ sa skya gog por grags so/ /dus zhig gi tshe ri rtse nas gzigs pas dpon po ri shin tu mtho ba la / de skor gyi ri thams cad kyi bskor zhing mgo bo btud pa lta bu/ g.yasalogs dkar zhing snum pa seng ge 'gying ba 'dra ba chu g.yas bskor du 'bab cing rgyun ma chad bar 'gro la/ bkra shis kyi rtags brgyad dang / rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun gyis phyogs kun nas bskor ba'i sa dpyad phun sum tshogs par gzigs te/ der dgon pa btab na sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang /'gro ba mang po la 'phral dang yun du phan par dgongs nas der phebs/ sa de'i bdag po zhad zhung gu ra ba dang / lha mi grong bdun/ phal pa na grong bzhi rnamasal / 'dir dgon chung zhig btab na yong bam zhes dris/ dbang che bas jo bo gdong nag pa la yang zhus te/ khyed rnams la rin ci 'dral gsungs pas/ khong 300

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/rnams rin mi dgos dgon pa 'debs par zhu zer kyang / phyis tshun la brtan dgongs nas/ khong rnams la rgod ma dkar mo gcig mo gos khra bo cha gciganor bu rtags gzi 'chong spel ma phreng ba gnyis/ khrab gcig rnams rin la sprad/ mon grog man chad/ 'bal grog yan chad dbang bar byas/ de nas bla ma dkon mchog rgyal pos shing pho khyi nas dgung lo bzhi bcu tham pa bzhes pa'i dus/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum stong nyis brgya dang zhag ma drug 'das pa bag yod ces pa chu mo glang gi lo la/ sa dkar logs kyi dbus su sa skya'i rmangs bris/ bla brang shar gyi sa cha 'di la dgon pa'i mthil byas nas btab yod do/ /'ga' zhig tu dkon mchog rgyal po bzhi bcu zhe drug bzhes dus sa mo lug gi lo la btab zer 'dug yongs su grags pa la dkon mchog rgyal po shing pho khyi la 'khrungs/ bzhi bcu pa chu mo glang la sa skya btab nas lo sum cu tham pa gdan sa mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu re dgu bzhes pa la chu pho rta'i lo dbyug gu zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la gshegs so/ /zhal ta la nga'i phung po ril por zhogs shig dang / nam gnas kyi bar dgon sde 'dir klu nad dang mdze dang pho la sogs/ mi su la yang mi yong gsungs/ de bzhin du sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i phyir gser 'bum du byas pa gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi rgyud rim rnams bang rim la bkod pa 'dug go /bla ma dkon mchog rgyal po dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa dgu bzhes pa chu pho sprel lo la/ gu ra ba'i bu srin jo mo shad mo la sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po chu pho sprel lo la sku 'brungs/ 'di rdzo bo lha gcig gis slob ma byang sems sbyin pa dpal gyi sku skye ste spyan ras gzigs dbang 301

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)phyug gi rnam 'phrul yin/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la yab sku gshegs te/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags kyis gdan sa mdzad cing bka' drin chen pos bskyangs te/ gzim khang rnying mar 'jam dbyangs bsgrubs pas phyi'i bar chad bsal te sgrol ma'i shas gzigs/ nang gi bar chad bsal te mi g.yo ba'i zhal gzigs te/ zla ba drug nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs te zhen pa bzhi bral la sogs pa'i phar phyin gyi gdams pa zab mo bka' drin bstsal/bcu gnyis pa la rong ngur smig tu brang ti dar ma snying po la mngon pa gsan brang ti de ni khu ston gyi slob ma spa khri bzang 'bar gyi slob ma yin/ de nas lo tsā ba'i dngos slob khyung rin chen grags dang mes lhang tsher la dbu tshad/ khu'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan sku mched la gsang 'dus dang mgon po zhal gyi chos skor/ skyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar la kye rdor/ gung thang pa mal lo la bde mchog dang mgon po'i man ngag gsan/ pu rangs lo chung la bde mchog sogs gsan te/ rang lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa lcags pho byi lo gung thang nas 'cham mgon sa skyar phyag phebs/'cham mgon 'di ni/ tho btsun grub rjes ma hā bo dhi'i sku bzhengs pa'i dusabazhengs pa yin/ de'i tshe bla ma shad ston dgung lo re brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe byi lo de nas lo ngo bzhi'i bar du shad ston la gsung ngag zab mo'i bka' drin nos te/rang lo so gnyis pa chu mo yos bu'i lo sgrub pa'i lung sbyin/ ngo mtshar ba'i dzu'aphrul gyi ltad mo bstan/ rang lo zhe bdun pa sa pho stag gi lo/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub chen bi ru pa gtso 'khor lnga'i zhal gzigs te/ de yang dus de tsam na rgya gar 'phags yul du slob dpon chen po a bha ya ka ra la/ sbyin 302

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i spu chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/bdag rgyal po shing brtan can bya ba yod de/ /de la glang po che mang du yod pa'i nang nas glang po che'i mchog tu gyur pa/ nyi ma 'char byed ces bya ba spyo nas mi dang sems can mang po gsod cing /rdo rje gdan gyi lcags ri bskyel/ gtsug lag khang mang po la gnod pa byed du byung / de gdul ba'i phyir nub phyogs so ba na tha nas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir wa pa rdo'i sku las bzhengs te byon nas glang po che la phyag gi thal mo bsnun nas btul te spyo ba las sangs par byas/skal ldan kyi 'gro ba 'ga' yang rjes su bzung / khyad par tshur lam sa skya la phebs nas/ sa chen la chos gsungs pa yin/ de yang 'jam dbyangs brag khung du grags pa'am rdo rje gdan du zla ba gcig bzhugs/ lam so dang phyogs so sor mtho btsug sa chen gyis gsol rnams skyes cing chos gsan pa ni/ chos sgo bskyel du byon te/ spyir rgyud sde bdun cu don gnyis kyi man ngag khyad par lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi la sogs pa ste/ mdor na gsung ngag nye brgyud kyi gnad zab mo'i bdud rtsi ngoms par gsol/ dus de'i tshe khams pa rdo rje rgyal po gsang phur phywa pa chen po'i spyan sngar slob gnyer la byon/ring zhig gnas der bzhugs stabs cung zad ma bde/ sa skyar kun dga' snying po'i drung du phebs nas lam 'bras zhus/ brag phug gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad/der sa bad cig brus pas chu mig gting ring zhig byung / khams pa rdor rgyal gyi grub chu zhes grags/ gsung ngag gi khrid tshar gzhud gi bshad pa mdzad pa la mi mang po yod pa'i tshe/ rje mi la yab sras bcu gcig tsam gyis phyi rol nasamagur ma bzhes pas/ sku tshe sngon gyi las 'phro dang bag chags sad pas/rdor 303

ba chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)rgyal dad gus chen po langs nas khag gi bzhengs te phyi bzhin 'gro bar dgongs pa la/ sa skya pa chen pos rnal 'byor pa glu len pa la ya mtshan rgyu med/sdod gsungs pas/ bla ma'i bkar song bas sa la bzhugs tsam na/ mi la'i zhal nas/ da rang dngos kyi bu ga cig yod pas tsha bor song gsung / sa chen gyi zhal nas/ phyi nang lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad nga las byung yang /chos brgyud mi la res pa'i 'dzin par 'dug gsung / rang lo lnga bcu pa lcags mo bya lo gzhung gi gdams pa'i bco brgyad kyi bka' yang grol te/ mdo khams kyi khams pa a seng gis zhus pa'i ngor/ gsung ngag thog mar bka' bstsal/gzhung bshad a seng mar grags pa yi ge bkod/ rgyud man ngag zab mo'i bdud rtsi spel/ sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba drag bstan/ slar re bdun pa sa phog stag dbyug pa zla ba'i tshe bcu bzhi la sku 'bum rnam rgyal du grags par chos dbyings su gshegs/ bde ba can/ po ta la/ u rgyan/ byang gser mdog can bzhi na/ sku'i bkod pa bzhis skal ldan gyi don mdzad cing da lta yang bzhugs skad/ phag gru ba'i rnam thar na bde ba can/ byang yu ta ra/ gser mdog can gsum na sku'i bkod pa gsum bstan te bzhugs pa 'di rang ngo mtshar che skad do / / slob ma'i mchog ni/sing ga gling gi rnal 'byor pa/ byang chub sems dpa' stag sgom pa kyi 'bar te mchog thob pa gsum/ rje btsun chen po/ zhu byasadangos grub/ rga ston rdo rje grags/ sgom pa 'od zer grags/ nags sgom pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'tshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa/ mang chung ma ste bzod thob bdun/ gzhan rtogs pa ldan pa 3)rgyad cu byon/ 'o na rje btsun rtse mo mi

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/'dren pa ji ltar zhe na/ de ni bla ma chen po dang ngo bo gcig pas so sor ma phye/zhes mkhas pa dag gsung ngo / /gzhan yang gzhung bshad gces par 'dzin pa'i thugs sras bcu gcig tshig rkang rnam par 'grel ba'i thugs sras bdun/phyogs kyi mkhas grub chen po bzhi/ zhes bya ste/ zhu byas kyis sdebs pa'i bstod pa las/ zab don yongs su rdzogs pa'i slob ma ni/ /pho brgyad mo gsum dag la yi ger gdams/ /zhes/pa ltar/ kham bas pa a seng / 'u/ pa zhu byas/ klog skya jo sras chos grags/ thugs sras gnyan phul chung ba/ gtsug tor rgyal po mtshan dngos bsod nams rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ zangs ri phug pa/ khams kha pa sga thengs/ gnyag zhi ra ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan te pho brgyad/ sras kun dga' 'bar gyi yum jo mo lcam phur mo/g.ya' lung gi jo mo 'a 'u ma/ mang mkhar gyi jo mo mang chung ma ste jo slo gsum/rnam 'grel bcu gcig ces grags pa ni gang zag 'di bcu gcig la gdams pas na/ gzhan du yid g.yo bar ma byed cig gnyis pa ni/ gzhung bshad mdzad pa'i dngos slob ṇa ro brnye/ stong sgom byang chub shes rab/ mi nyag dzñā na dz+wa la/ zhu brag dmar ba/ shad ze dmar ba/ 'u yug gi g.yar sbu ba ma/ phag mo gru pa'o/ /phyogs kyi mkhas grub bzhi ni/ la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar/khams pa rga lo/ ne tshe sbal ston/ gshen rdo rje seng ge'o/ /mdor na spyir mdo rgyud kyi snying po dang / sgos bla chen 'brog ma'i rgyud man ngag bcud kyi snying po 'dzin pa ni/ dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po 'di kho na ste/ ji skad du/ ma dros ye shes zhabs las rgyun bzhi'i bla ma ni/ /rgyal po rigs dang snying po snang ba'i 305

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 2 nga gces bsdus/ 9)mtha' can te/ /rigs dang snying po zhabs las 'bar ba 'bar ba'i mtha'/ /rgyun bzhi 'dzin pa'i bla chen de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa ltar 'brog mi lo tsā ba ma dros pa'i mtsho chen po las/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ se ston kun rig mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ khyin lo tsā ba 'od kyi snang ba ste/ gaṅgā la sogs pa'i chu bo chen po bzhi dang 'dra ba'i rgyud man ngag gi rgyun babs/ bla chen sa skya pa chen po'i thugs kyi sdod du nye bar bzung ba yin te/ de yang rgyun thog mtha' gnyis ni/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos/ 'brog mi dang / khyin gnyis char la dngos su gsan pa mdzad cing / de nyid la bla chen sa skya pas dngos su gsan pas grub/ rgyun bar pa gnyis ni/ se las shad ston chosa'abar dang / mnga' ris pa las sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar gyis gsan la/ de nyid la sa chen gyis dngos su gsan pas grub pa yin no/ /yang sa chen nyid kyisabir wa pa'i zhal gzigs pa'i dus mon grog nas 'bal grog gi bar nga dbang gsung / sa dkar po rgyab yol gyi tshul du mdzad pa ni/ sa skya'i dan logs da lta mkhar las kyis khengs pa la blta ba yin gsung zhing / rtsa 'phrul gyi bkod pa bstan tshul ni/ dol po tshar dar dge 'dun sum cu la lam 'bras kyi 'khrid bskyang ba/ 'bring 'tshams su zhang shes rab bla mas lha khang brgya rtsa bzhengs pa'i thog ma sgron lha g.yu thog gi lha khang la/ nam mkha' dri med kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas rab gnas mdzad pa/ gung thang bla chen mal gyi nye gnasamadzad nas bde mchog gi chos skor gsan pa/ zangs rgyud 'brog pa'i gseb tu lam 'bras gsungs pa/ sa skyar byon bzhud mdzad cing gdan sa mdzad nas306

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya yong 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ chos gsung ba/ shab sgo mdar chos gcor bskor ba ste/ de ltar drug po 'di lo zla ba dus tshod gcig tu mdzad nus pa/ sku'i bkod pa du ma bstan te gdul bya'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa yin no/ /yang bla chen sa skya pa'i zab chos kyi gtso bo lam 'bras la lugs srol ji tsam yod ce na/ bla chen 'brog dang gyi jo las brgyud pa'i lam 'bras gnyis las gyi jo lugs dang gcig dang po las 'phel ba la bla chen 'brog gi sku sras in+d+ra dang rdo rje las brgyud pa'i lam 'bras/ thugs kyi sras 'brom de ba'i lam 'bras dang gnyis te gsum/ ser mkhar chung pa nas 'phel ba la rab 'bring gsum du yod pa'i 'bring du thob pa zham pa nas 'phel ba la/ pho rgyud mo brgyud bsres brgyud dang gsum/ pho brgyud la yang rje khum bu ba chos rgyal nas se sgom grags rgyal/ rje mal gyo ba sogs las 'phel ba'i slob brgyud dang / sras zha ma tsan+d+ra nas spang rje nyi ma grags las 'phel ba'i sras brgyud de gnyis/ mo brgyud la yang / zha ma'i slob ma nyang sgom las/ smon dkar ba ston g.yung / dbon po shes tshul gsum las 'phel ba'i lugs gsum ste/ pho mo'i lugs lnga dang brgyad/ bsres brgyud las/ zha ma pho mo bsres pa dum bu ko brag pa'i lugs/ zha ma pho mo gnyis sa lugs dang gsum bsres pa cha gan gyi lugs/ 'brog mi lugs dang gyi jo lugs bsres pa jo nang kun spangs kyi lugs/ lam 'bras spyor drug rdzogs chen gsum bsres pa las stod dbang rgyal gyi lugs te/ bsres rgyud bzhi dang bcu gnyis/bka' rab tu thob pa shad gi brgyud ni/ sa lugs la snga bu dang phyi bu ba gnyis/snga bu la phag gru lugs dang / gces sgom lugs gnyis/ phyi bu la nye brgyud 307

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)ring brgyud gnyis te sa lugs bzhi dang bcu drug 'brog rdzo sras gnyis/ zhang ston mched gnyis te bzhi'i gsung gi gces mdzod/ bsdas pa mang lam zhig po'i lugs dang bcu bdun/ se ston las tha mar thob pa jing chub ye shes kyis zhang phug pa la gdams pa'i lugs dang bco brgyad do/ /de dag re re la ji ltar 'phel tshul mang bas ma bris so/ /de lta bu'i bla chen sa skya pa chen po la sras bzhi 'brungs pa'i yum chung 31sa jo lcam phur mo la sras gcig 'khrungs pa/de bzhi char gi che shos kun dga' 'bar zhes bya ba mi thub zla ba'i sku skyer grags/ gzhon nu nas ma ga dhar slob gnyer la byon/ rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā bcasapa na khong las thugs rab che ba med ces grags/ slob gnyer phul du byung ste rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur/ bod du byon par bsam pas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis la sku gshegs so/ /bla chen gyi jo mo ma gcig 'od sgron la rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo chu pho khyi la byon/ sku 'byungs ma thag tu rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi sgo la 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa bsod nams rtse mo sa skyar 'khrungasazhes pa/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis yi ger btab/ sku shin tu mdzes shing mtshan dpes spras/ nga ni byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa'o/ /zhes gsung zhing /dus thams cad du skyil krung gis bzhugs/ lo gsum pa la 'jam dbyangs kye rdor sgrol ma gsum gyi zhal gzigs/ bcu drug pa yan la rgyud man ngag gi sgro 'dogs chod/ de nas rje btsun grags pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshe/ khyod saskyar sdod/ nga dbus phyogs su phyin gyi gsungs nas gsang phu ne'u thog tu/ phywa pa chen po'i drung du phebs/ snga phyir lo 3 0 8 bzhugs/ dbu tshad sogs mtshan

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ nyid kyi phyogs la mkhas par gyur/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa sa mo yos la sa skya'i gdan sa bzung / chu mig rdzi khar lha khang ka ba bcu drug gi sa phyi chos ra dang bcas pa mdzad/ nyer bdun pa me mo phag la chos la 'jug pa'i sgo brtsams/ gdul bya skal ldan la/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na pad+ma bir wa pa gsum gyi dag pa'i snang ba bstan/ rje btsun 'dis sa mo yos nas lcags mo yos kyi bar lo bcu gsum sa skya'i gdan sa mdzad/ de nas chu pho 'brug gi lo la gdan sa'i mthil gcung grags pa la gtad cing / chu mig rdzing khar bshad sgrub la gtso bor mdzad/ lha khang gi mtha' skor du/ gsung ngag nyams len dge 'dun brgya bdun cu la spang gi spyil po mang du btab/ bsgrub pa la bzhugs so/ khong pas rgyud gsum man ngag du ma/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa gsungs/ lan gcig gi tshe tshal gung thang nas yongs pa'i grwa pa gcig g.yu brag pa chen po ni/ 'khon bsod nams rtse mo'i shes rab la/ mi nga'i sgrub tshugs sgar na/ lus 'di kho na bde ba can du phyin chog ste gsung gin gda' zhes zhus pas/ gzhad cing khong la smon mi dgos ces zhal kur mdzad/ lo bcu'i bar du rgyud gsum/ gsung ngag dag dang bcas pa'i bshad pa dang /dpon slob kun gyis sgrub pa la nan tan byas pas lam 'bras la brten pa'i grub mtha' stogs pa mang du byung / de nas dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe gcig la/ chu pho stag gi smal po zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig chos nyan gyi slob bu ka pa li thogs pa brgyad cu tsam gyi dbus na chos gsung 'phro la/ chos khri'i steng nas sku de nyid/la'i rol mo dang bkod pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas te bde ba can du 309

'tshe run 'od snang 'a /sa 'a chos pa gcas bsdus/9)gshegs so//phyi bzhin du slob bu dang skye bo thams cad kyis phyag dang /gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson par byas so//rje 'dis mkha' spyod du byon tshul la gsung sgros mi gcig pa du ma 'byung ste/rje pas mdzad pa'i gsol 'debasagadung dbyangs ma'i mchan las/tshes bcu'i dgong rje btsun sku mched sogasakyis tshes bas mchod pa mdzad/nangs par rje pas byon pas/na bza' sbu gu thibs se sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod la bzhud/gdung dbyangs kyisagasol ba drag tu btab pas na bza'i sbu gu nas bung ba'i skad lta bus lung bstan khyad par can byung zhes sogs bshad do//rje btsun grags rgyal yab bla chen dgung lo nga drug pa'i sras/me mo yos la sku 'khrungs/gcen dang lo drug gi khyad/dgu lo brgyad pa la byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan las tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen zhus/sha dang chang gtan mi gsol/lo bcu pa la sgrub thabs mtsho skyes gsan/bcu gcig pa la gsungs pas/bshad pa gnad zin rgya che bsakun gyis ya mtshan du gyur/de'i phyi lo rgyud gsum gyi po ti gsol ba'i rnal lam byung bas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid thugs su chud/rang gi yab dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i bar bsnyen/de nas yab dgung du bskyod/rje pas gdan sa mdzad tshul/dgung grangs bcu gnyis pa dang /bcu gsum pa dang /nyer drug pa la bzung zer ba mi 'dra ba du ma 'dug kyang /don ni bskyoganyis pa la sa chen gshegs/rtse mo dbus la byon grab mdzad cing rje 'di gdan sar bzhugs pa dang /bcu gsum pa nas rje rtse mo dbus su byon tshar nas rje 'dis gdan sa bskyong ba dang /nyer drug pa la rje rtse mos gdan sa'i0

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ khur thams cad phog nas rje rtse mo nyid bshad sgrub la chig dril mdzad par mngon no/ /dbu rtse rnying ma 'debs pa'i tshe gur nas gsungs pa'i sa chog mdzad/ sa bskos pas byi bas bsags pa'i mdzod 'bras dkar dang nas mang po byung bas rten 'brel legs gsung / lha khang gi nang du thub pa'i gser sku sogs dang / pad chen gyi nang sogs su 'dod rgyal gyi 'khor lo mang po bzhugs su gsol/ de'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa'i mkhas grub 'du ba dang / rgya bod hor la sogs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad dbang du byas pa yin gsungs/ yab dang gcen gnyis la gcung sogs gshegs pa la lo paṇa mang po spyan drangs pa'i chos 'khor rgya chen po mdzad/chos mthun gyi dge 'dun brgya rtsa bsnyen bkur rgyun du mdzad/ thog mar bde ba can du byon/ de nas byang phyogs gser mdog can du 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas su gyur nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes par zhal gyis bzhes/ nga drug pa chu pho khyi lo snye mo ru 'tshams kyi gtsang kha dgon par mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po'i ngang las/ bla ma sa chen gyi sku ye shes kyi snang ba bstan te lam 'bras shin tu nye brgyud ces grags pa brda don gsal ba'i bka' drin mchog tu nos/ rang lo bdun cu pa me pho byi ba'i dbo zla ba'i tshes bcu gnyis la sku rum gzim khang du dag pa'i zhing du gshegs kyi bar du bstan pa'i bya ba kho na mdzad pa'i sras kyi dam pa ni chos rje sa paṇa nyid yin la / grags pa'i mtha' can bzhir grag bas pa ni dkar shākya grags/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ ṇa ro brnye gshin rje grags/ gsal ba dbang phyug grags311

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)dang bzhi'o/ /grags pa'i mi brgyad ces grags pa ni snga ma bzhi'i steng du/ graston blo gros grags/ rga ston bsnyed rtsi grags/ lde ston dkon mchog grags/sa ston 'jigs med grags dang bzhi la 'jog par sems so/ /gur rgyan zhusacipa'i mi bzhi ni/ mu tshu byang chub grags/ btsang ston brtson 'grus grags/ lha thog yon tan zung / rigs ldan shes rab rin chen dang bzhi'o/ /rig 'dzin gyi sdom brtson chen po bzhi ni/ jo sras lcags kyi rdo rje/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po/ rtsis 'dul gzhen nu seng ge khams kyi 'ji ston dge slong ngo / /'jam pa'i dbyangs bzhi pa 'khon dpal chen 'od po ni/ rje sa chen dgung lo lnga brtso nga dgu lcags pho rta'i lo smin drug zla ba'i nyer lnga la sku zhakhrungs/ rang gi yangalo dgu'i bar du bsten/ dbang dang rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa thugs su chud/ rje btsun rtse mo dgung lo sum cu so gsum bzhes kyi bar dang / gcen grags pa rgyal mtshan yang rang gi dgung lo lnga bcu nga bzhi bzhes kyi bar du bsnyen/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi chos tshul du ma dang / lung rtogs kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa la mnga' brnyes/ phyag rjes su chu mig rdzing khar gcen rtse mos bzhengs pa'i lha khang la g.yu thog dang / gser gyi gan ji ra/ nang gi lha ri bang rnams mdzad/ dpal chen 'dis rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi phyag phyi dab zhabs tog yun ring du bsgrubs te/ lung dang nang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan phu'akhadu byung ba la dbang 'byor zhing / dgung lo lnga bcu nga bzhi bzhes pa'i dus chu monaphag gi lo/ zla ba lnga pa'i nyer gcig gi tshe/ 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa yin gyi rdzo skye spyi la grags shing snang ba tsam gyi da~X du byas nas/ gcen gyi sngon la dgub

dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa ba khugs/ du gshegs/ phrin las dang mdzad pa mtha' yas pa yin no/ /dpal chen 'od po dang yum khra phu ma nyi khri lcam la sa skya paṇa chen dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo khra zla ba'i nyi shu drug la bltams dpal ldan don grub tu mtshan gsol/btsas ma thag tu saṃ : ta'i skad gsungs/ rgya bod la sogs pa'i yig ris mang po ma bslab par thugs su chud/ bco lnga yan la rje btsun chen po'i drung du sa skya gong ma'i gsung bcud mdo sngags kyi zab gnad yongs su rdzogs/ bcu dgu pa la ku mud bzhad pa'i dus kyi 'od gsal chen po'i ngang las a byi'i 'bum pa'i drung du mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen la chos mngon pa mdzod dang / kha che paṇa chen de nyid la chos zab mo rdo rje'i glu la sogs pa legs par nod/ rgya gar shar phyogs su phyogs kyi glang po'i gdan seng ge'i khri la 'khod de/ glegs bam gzhal du med pa'i lde mig bzung / pad dkar bzhad pa'i dus kyi mdangs rab tu rgyas pa'i tshe 'phrang du zhu don rdo rje skyabs la byams chos sogs lung gi skor/nyi shu pa la rkyang 'dul ba me bya byang brtson dang / gtsang nag pa'i dngos slob tshur ston gzhon seng la bod pa sgres po las brgyud pa'i tshad ma'i chos skor/gzhan yang phywa pa'i seng chen brgyad kyi zheng tshan )brtsegs pa dbang phyug seng ge la bod la grags pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i chos ji snyed pa/ spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od la/ bod la grags pa'i zhi byed rdzogs chen gtsor bka' gdams la sogs pa'i gdams ngag ji snyed pa khong du chud/ nyer gsum pa shing pho byi lo la gtsang chu mig tu kha che paṇa chen dang mjal/ paṇa chen de nyid dang / de'i slob bu rgya gar shar nub gung gsum na sgra la mkhas par grags pa'i saṃ ga shrī ste dge 3/3

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ 9)'dun dpal/ su ga ta shrī ste legs par gshegs pa'i dpal dang / dwa na shwe 'khaste tshul khrims sbyin pa la sogs pa snga phyir bsten te/ bod rgan po'i sgros kyisam bslad pa'i lha rgyan gyi bshad srol las byon pa'i tshad ma la sogs pa'i rig gnas che ba lnga/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod zlos gar rtsis te rigaganas chung ba lnga ste/ rig gnas bcus bsdus pa'i zab bcud thams cad chos sgo skyel du byon pa'i sgo nas legs par bshad pa nos te paṇ+ḍi ta zhes snyan par grags/ paṇa chen dbus 'khor/ rje nyid kyis nyi shu rtsa bdun bzhes pa'i sa pho 'brug gi lo/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis bzhengs pa'i nyang smad rgyan gong sgogatsug lag khang du/ kha che paṇa chen gyis mkhan po/ spyi lhas pa byang chub 'od kyis las slob/ don mo ri pas gsang ston gyis te bsnyen par rdzogs/ sa paṇa gyi sku bltams pa'i lor rje btsun rtse mo 'ja' lus su gshegs pas zhal mi bdud rtsi dngos su ma thob kyang / rang lo so lnga pa'i bar du/ grags pa'i la〉med bsnyed rtsi ngom par gsol/ khyad par lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgonas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnad rang sar 'grig ste sa dang po'i yon tan mchog du brnyes/ nyid kyi lo gsum pa la kha che paṇa chen slar kha cher bzhud/ lkolnga pa la rje btsun chen po bde ba can du gshegs/ so brgyad pa tsam gyi tshe/ gyobod kyi ngan rtog gi brag ri 'joms par byed pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcosarigs gter zhes grags pa de yang brtsams/ lnga bcu rtsa gsag tsam gyi che legs bshad kyi sbrang rtsi spel ba'i dga' ston bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas parabyed pa'i sdom gsum rab dbye'i nyin byed kyang shar/ lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa'i rtse 314

dam ri 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 'phags pa wa ti'i dri'i gtsang khang dang 'dabs 'byor ba'i dpal gyi gnas su/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa'i phas kyi rgol ba ngan pa drug lung rigs kyis tshar bcad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bcug gang gi snyan pa'i rnga sgra gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ma shong ste/ rgya dkar nag dang hor bal gyi ljongs thams cad gang bar byas/ drug cu rtsa gsum pa'i tshe stobs kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba rgya nag mthil gyi rgyal po go dan gyis bsod nams kyi mgron du spyan drangs/ drug cu rtsa lnga pa me pho rta'i lo pho brang chen po ling chu rtser gdan phebs/rgyal pos nyams sad pa'i phyir sgyur ma'i dri'i gtsang khang khang phran gyis bskor ba'i gtsug lag khang sgyu 'phrul gyi bar spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus brtan par bzhugs su gsol te/ byang phyogs sprul pa sde'i gtsug lag khang zhes phyogs kun tu snyan par grags/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po la slu sa chen po dar byung / rgyal po 'khor bcas dga' ste yid rab tu g.yos/ bdun cu pa'i bar du rgya nag po'i yul du bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel/ lcags pho smal zla'i bcu bzhi'i tho rangs sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdus/ sku skye ba phyi ma mkha' la spyod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i gar gyis rol/ de nas gnyis pa'i tshe shar phyogs mu mu nir/rgyal po nyi ma stobs 'phel gyi sras dam par gyur te sa lam phal cher bsgrod/de nas gsum pa'i tshe mngon dga'i zhing du bde bar gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas longs sku'i cha byad sku mdog gangs ri'i mdog can/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can rin po che'i rgyan dang / rab tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis bklubs pa dag pa'i 'khor 'bum gyis bskor ba'o/ /paṇa chen 'dis 315

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)shes bya rig gnas lnga'i sgo phye ste rig pa'i gnas la blo kha cung zhig phyogs pas/bod kyi gzhen nu blo gsal dag la paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa'i mtshan can gyis kyang kha ba can 'di dkar por byas pa ma yin nam/ de yang phyi dar la lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sku ngo la me lo tsā bas tshad ma la bshad pa cung zad mdzad cing / khyung po grags seng gis tshad ma bshad de tshad ma rnying ma zhes pa'i bstan pa cung zad dar/ de rjes rngog lo chen pos tshad ma rgyan dang chos mchog gtso bor ston pa dzhaitshad ma gsar ma zhes bya ba'i bstan pa spel/ de nyid kyi dngos brgyud kyi slob gdag gis rang bzos sgro btags pa'i tshad ma'i bstan pa ha cang dar che ba'i tshe/dag ma dag gi rab dbye legs par phye ste sde bdun gyi snying po gsal bar ston pa'i tshad ma rigs pa'i gter zhes bya ba'i sgo nas tshad ma'i bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin shar ba yin zhes/ rig gnas gzhan la yang des mtshon te shes par mdzod cig sa paṇ+ḍita 'di'i slob ma'i mchog rtogs pa'i brgyud 'dzin tshogs grub dbon gsum/ man ngag gi brgyud 'dzin lho dmar rnam gnyis/ bshadapa'i brgyud 'dzin shar nub gung gsum/ sdom phrug bsgres pa dpal bzang po bcu gsum/ gzhen pa rgyal mtshan mtha' can bsnyen/ lo tsā ba chen po bzhi/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po bzhi/ mkhas btsun gyi thugs sras bzhi/ sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ sbas pa'i grub chen bzang tsha bsod nams rgyal po/ de dag kyang rim pa ltar/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal gtsang skyer phur lcags pho rta la byon/ chos rje pa lo bcu gsum bstan/ go brgyad pa lagashegs/ sa paṇa las lo nyer brgyad kyis gzhone/ grub thob yon tan dpal316

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bca pa bzhugs/stag sde ngam ring du byon/ se mo tshe ras pa zhes grags/ dbon po 'phags pa rin po che sa paṇa gyis nga bzhi bzhes pa'i shing mo lugs la ngam ring glu khung du byon no/ /tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa la la nyan zhad gsum zhes grags/ la ru ba bsod nams bzang po stag rtse la ru gser khang du byon/bco brgyad pa la 'phags pas rab tu byung / shar pa rdo rje 'od zer la rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ phyis spyi'i se mo rang grub thob yon dpal la lo gsum gsung ngag gsan no/ /nyan chen bsod nams bstan pa las stod byang mdog rje rong dbyig mkhar du chu pho rta la byon/ tshogs sgom pa lo bcu gsum bsten/ lo go drug bzhugs/ tshogs sgom pa las61 bcu gnyis kyis gzhon no/ /lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal lho pa drug pa yin/ sku shin tu bsgres ba nas byang ngos su brda don gsal ba'i tho snying zhu ba la byon/ dmar chos rgyal/ pu rangs lo chung gi dngos slob dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbon brgyud yin/ chos rje pa lo brgyad bsten/ shar nub gung gsum gyi shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas dang / shar pa rdo rje 'od zer te sku mched gnyis/ nub pa la 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge de'i dbon nyi thog pa kun smon/ de'i ka chen khang gnyan shad gsum/ zur khang pa dang bzhir grags pa'i khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ gnyan dar ma ye shes/ shad mdo sde dpal/ zur khang pa dkar shākya grags/ gung pa la skyo ston dri med de thams cad sa paṇa gyi dngos slob yin/dkar shāka ni gtso bor grags pa yin no/ /sdom 'phrug bsgres pa bcu gsum ni / tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal bzang po/ rin po che skyob pa dpal bzang 317

ba chen 'od snang la /gci'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ 9)po / lho pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po/ shad rgyal ba dpal bzang po/zhang mdo sde dpal bzang po/ phyag ru pa seng ge dpal bzang po/ grub snying gardo rje dpal bzang po/ sdong ston shes rab dpal bzang po/ jo gdan byang chusadapal bzang po/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal bzang po/ skyo ston dri med dpal bzang po rnams so/ /jo gdan byang chub dpal ni chos rje'i slob ma shin tu yin/kha che paṇa chen gyi slob bu yin pas chos rje pa'i sdom phrug tu cung zhig mi rigasapar 'dra'o/ /'on kyang rje kun mkhyen kyi ṭiska ltar bgrang ba'o/ /gzhen pa rgyalamatshan gyi mtha' can bdun ni/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ khang 'od zer rgya'angamatshan/ dga' ldan pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gsol ja ba 'dul ba rgyal mtshan/'u yug pyod pa la gyi rgyal mtshan/ yar lung pa shākya rgyal mtshan/ yar lung ga byang chub rgyal mtshan rnams so/ /de yang yar lung pa byang chub rgyal mtshan ni/chos rje'i rnam thar tshigs bcad ma rgyas pa rtsom pa po yin la/ rnam thar bsdu pa rtsom pa po yar lung ba grags pa rgyal mtshan yang bsnan nas rgyal mtshan mtha' can brgyad ces bya'o/ /lo chen bzhi ni/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ sgrobo lo tsā ba shes rab rin wo/ rong pa rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ zhang lo tsā ba grungapa dpal dang bzhi'o/ /chag lo ni/ chag dgra bcom gyi dbon te me sbrul lo tshwabyon pas sa paṇa las lo bco lngas gzhon no/ /zhang lo 'di kha che paṇa chen rtsislob ma yin la gtso bor ras chung snyan rgyud kyi brgyud pa la bzhugs pa de'o/ /yar lung pa rgyal tsha lung gi dbang phyug zhad bya ru ba ar+ya de ba/ lu phu ba bsoganams rin chen/ glang ra ba kun 3 1 /la mtshan te sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nga

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 'a po bzhin/ /mkhas btsun r+ṣa po bzhi ni/ bo dong rin po che brtson 'grus rdo rje/ gtsang nag phug pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzad pa ring mo dbang phyug te ra ba byams pa mgon po dang bzhi'o/ /bo dong rin po che ni/ lcags pho sprel lo pa ste sa paṇa las lo bco brgyad kyis gzhen/ gtsang nag phug tu mkhas pa yongs grags gsum byung ba'i/ gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge ni phywa pa'i seng chen gcig yin/ gtsang nag phug pa thugs rje seng ge ni/ jo nang kun spangs zhang gi slob ma ste/ bar do 'phrang sgrol mdzad pa de yin/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer ni thog ma sa paṇa la dgag pa mdzad pas 'jam dbyangs mi dges pa'i rnam par bstan/ bshags pa byas te chos rje khu dbon gyi thugs sras su gyur pa'o/ /rje sa paṇa gyi mkhan po kha che paṇa chen gyi sdom rgyun ni sa paṇa nyid nas brgyud pa ma chad par yod 'dug cing / jo gdan tshogs pa nas brgyud pa ni deng sang gi grub mtha' thams cad la khyab par snang ngo / /des na bod 'dir sde pa bzhi ka la yod smra gcig pu yin zhing / 'di la mkhan chen zhi 'tsho nas brgyud pa'i mkhan brgyud rnying pa dang / kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i mkhan brgyud gsar pa zhes grags pa'i kha che paṇa chen mnga' ris nas kha cher phebs dus/ jo gdan gtsang so ba byang rdor rnam gnyis gnas kyi slob dpon du bzhag khong gnyis kyis dge 'dun gyi sde so sor btsugs/ dge 'dun gang pa dang tshogs mo che ba zhes zer la/ de gnyisalas mched pa la bye ma rdzing bu pa dang / chos lung pa zhes zer te/ jo gdan tshogs sde bzhir grags so/ /stod 'dul gyi sdom rgyun sngar byung snang zhing / da lta 319

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos na gung gce4bsdus/ (4)yang yod med brtag par bya'o/ /chos rje pa'i gcung po zangs tsha bsod namasargyal mtshan ni/ yab dgung lo sum cu so lnga bzhes pa'i sras/ yum nyi khri lcam dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum/ shing pho 'brug gi lo sku 'bum rnam rgyal du bltams/chos rje pa dang lo khyad gnyis las med/ gzhen nu nas thugs byams pa dang snying rje'i bdud rtsis yongs su gang / spyir rig pa brtul zhugs dang / sku shegashin tu che/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun bzhes pa'i dus/ nyang stod nas nyang rma'abring zhes bya ba dbus gtsang kun na rtsal che ba yin zer ba gyad 'gran du yod/slob dpon gyisangs mi thub gsungs kyang ma nyan/ sgra la 'jus te spe ga byas/slob dpon gyis kho lan bdun gyi bar bskor zhing sa la bzhag pas kho zung khaskyengs te bros pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud mang du snang / rgyud 'bumaphal cher dang / yum rgyas 'bring sogs gsung rab du ma thugs la mnga'/gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i tshul la mkhas shing rgya che/ mgon po lcam dral kyangaji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bka' nyan te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rnam dpyod blo gros chen po can/ /brtul zhugs mchog ldan gsang sngag 'dzin/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dis phyag rjes su dbu rtse rnying ma bzhengs pa/ grom pa stod/ grom pa smagastag tog mang dkar/ shab stod shab smad/ rta nag sogs su grong dang gzhis/'dings pa/ khab so dang ko 'di'i 'brog gzhig dang / zi thang gi tshong 'du btsugs shing / dus mdos/ sgrub mchod sogs dpal ldan sa skya'i chos 'jigarten rnams dar rgyas su byung ba 'di'i mdzad phrin las byung ba yin no/ /gzhag320

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/yang sa skya dan gyi lcags ri nang dang bar pa btab pa yin te/ dang po/ mon grog la 'bos g.yon/ 'bal grog la g.yas/ dpon po ri'i rtse mo la byang /kha'u gtsang po kha zam pa byas te/ lho dang sa dkar logs thams cad khongs su chud pa zhig byed gsungs pa la/ kun gyis de tsam brang khang gis mi khengs/'tshams pa gcig mdzad 'tshal ces zhu phul bas/ 'o na mda' rgyang gis snyogs pa zhig byed gsungs nas/ ja bra ma nas mda' 'phangs pa'i gru bzhi nas lcags ri bcad/ 'di'i khongs su 'dre gdon gyis mi tshud/ spyo 'bogs la sogs pa'i nad ngan pa mi la mi yong / srung ba'i 'khor lo dang mtshungs pa yin/'dis bla ma chos rje dang yi dam kye rdo rje 'jam dbyangs dbyer mi phyed pa'i dgongs pa zab mo dang dag pa'i snang ba shar/ nga 'di nas phyogs rgyud kyi spang ri chen po zhig gi mgul du skyes te/ dag pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig sngagasalam gyis rjes su 'dzin/ nga rang yang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ lam zab mo nyams su blangs te sal ma gyi yon tan yar bsgrod nus pa 'dug gsungs so/ /'di dgung lo nga drug pa'i sa mo phag rgyal zla ba'i nyer gnyis la mdog stod kyi pag rir gshegs zer ba dang / nga bdun pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i nyer gsum la gshegs zer ba cung mi 'dra ba 'dug pas dpyad do/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa ni/ slob dpon zangs tshas tshogs bdag bsgrub pas dngos su yongs nas/ khyod la 'dzam bu gling na bsod nams che ba'i bu gcig sbyin gyis zer/ ding ri glang gor na sa ston ri pa zhes bya ba'i dge slong sgres po spyan ras gzigs dang gsung gleng mdzad dī rdog yod pa de spyan drangs nas yum gyi

'a khug 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)lhums su bzhugs su gsol/ bltams dus chos rje sa paṇa jo bo shākya mgon gyis yar lung du spyan drangs nas phebs/ sman grong na chos gsung gin yod pa'i skabs su/ zangs tsho'i btsun mo ma gcig kun skyid la sras po 'byungs zer ba'i gtam snyan skyel bas sleb/ chos rje'i gsung gis/ gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yod/ lug 61 la skyes pas de'i ming 'phags pa lug skyes ces thogs zhes zhal skur mdzad/ da phyin chad bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir mgon po lcam dral la gtor ma 'dzugs dgos te/ klu mes kyi dgon gnasayin pas thang po cher bya yi gsungs der phebs/ thang po che'i dbu rtse rnying mar gtor ma btsugs pa da dung yang yod do/ /yang dgung lo gsum pa la sgrub thabs mtsho skyes thugs las gsungs pas/ tshogs pa kun gyis ya mtshan du 'dzin/ 'di ni nges par 'phags pa'o/ /zhes phyogs kun tu grags pas de tshun chad 'phags pa zhes grags so/ /dgung lo bzhi pa la chos rje'i phyag phyir skyid grong du phebs/ glang ri pa'i dge 'dun sgres po zhig dang mjal bas nga'i nye gnas bkra shis grub byung / khyod khams bzang ngam zhes gsungs/ khos bla mar shes pas zhabs la 'jus so/ /brgyad pa la skyes rabs thugs nas gsungs/dgu pa la chos rje pas chos 'khor chen po mdzad dus brtag gnyis gsungs/tshogs kyi gtam bshad mdzad pa thams cad ngo mtshar te bod kyi mkhas pa thams cad 'jigs nasang rgyal chag cing / phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i grags pas steng kun khyab par gyur/ dgung lo bcu pa shing pho 'brug gi lo la chos rje pa'i phyag phyir byang ngos su byon/ lha sa jo po'i drung du chos rje pas322

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i thu chen kha thong dang bcas pa bzhugs/mkhan po dang / zul phu ba'i mkhan po na bza' phred gsol gyis slob dpon mdzad nas rab tu byung nas skyor mo lung pa'i mkhan po shes seng las dge tshul gyi bslabs bya la sogs pa mang du gsan no/ /bcu bdun pa lcags mo phag la hor yul du chag phebs te/ chos rje la mnga' ba'i phyi mtshan nyid/ nang gsang sngags kyi yon tan phal che ba thugs su chud cing / sa paṇa yang thugs shin tu dgyes te/ gsol gyi lhung bzed dang shākya thub pa'i gser sku/ gsung rab/phyag dpe la sogs pa mang du gnang / slob ma'i tshogs thams cad kyang sprad cing / khyod kyis bstan pa dar rgyas su 'gyur ba'i bya ba dang / sems can mang po'i don bsgrub pa dus la babs pas/ sngon gyi dam bcas pa dran par gyis shig ces gsungs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang/ bstan 'dzin mtha' dag gi bdag por bsgos te/ chos dung dkar po rgyang grags kyang gnang / de'i tshe chos rje sa paṇa dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ bco brgyad pa la chos rje'i dgongs rdzogs sogs legs par bsgrub/ bcu dgu pa chu mo glang gi lo la hor rgyal po se chen gan gyis pho brang hwa tur spyan drangs/ lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pas rgyal po thugs rab tu phrogs te/ rgyal pos zhus pa'i ngor/ rgyal pos gtsos pa'i skal ldan gyi gdul bya lnga phrag lnga la dges pa rdo rje'i smin byed dbang bskur/ ti shi'i mtshan gsol/ dbang yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum phul/ khri skor bcu gsum ni/ lho byang gnyis/ chu zha gnyis/ lha shangs gnyis te gtsung la drug g.ya' phag gnyis/ rgya tshal gnyis/ 'bri stag gnyis sa te dbulol drug yar 'brog khri skor dang bcu gsum yin no/ /'di nas bzung ste bod 323

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung mi ces bsdus/ 9)khams thams cad dpal ldan sa skya pas lugs gnyis kyis bskyangs so/ /de nas lo nyer gcig pa rgya hor yul gyi mtshams su mkhan po snye thang pa grags pa seng ge las slob jo stan bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gsang ste yar lung pa byang chub rgyal mtshan sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs/ slar so gcig pa shing mo glang la dpal ldan sa skyar phebs te/ de'i tshe bod dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshesaganyen che rgu thams cad kyis bsu ba seng phreng la phebs/ shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bstod pa spel legs kyis snyan ngag phul/ 'bel ba'i gtam gyis bka' mchid mchog tu bstsal/ de dag kun gyi nang nas las stod pa shākya bshes gnyen dang / dbus kyi 'bro'u rin po che gnyis la mchog tu dges ba thob/ ces kyang zer/ dbus gtsang khams gsum kun chos dang zang zing gi 'byor pas bde ba la bkod/ slar so gsum pa la gong nas spyan 'dren gyi gser yig pa slebs pas shar la phebs/ de'i tshe gsol gzim mchod gsum/mjal yig mdzod gsum/ thab 'dren gdan gsum/ rta skya gnyis/ mdzo khyi ste las tshan bcu gsum bkod pa gnang / bcom ral gyis/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bka' phyag sprin gyis bsgribs/ /zhes sogs kyi zur za'i zhu mchid phul/bstan la 'phel 'grib 'byung ba'ang rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes sogs kyi bka' mchid bstsal/ so bzhi pa sa pho 'brug la dpon chen shākya bzang pos khri skor bcu gsum bskul/ de yang 'phags pa rin po che dbus kyi gyi re lha khang du pheb dus bla ma'i gsung gis/ mi la nye gnas go chos pa byung 'dug gsungs pas/ sku rgyab na dpon chen yod pas thos te sems thog tu lci bar gyur/ de ma 324

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha sbong dang bcas pa bzhugs/khad gye re lha khang gi phyi'i rgya khyon gyi thig tshad blangs/ 'di rgya mthongs su chud pa'i lha khang rtsig zer nas lha khang chen po bzhengs te/ rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs/ dbang yon du rgya'i mi yur chod/ bod chol kha gsum phul/ chol kha gsum ni/ dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod gon gyo mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad gling kha rta'i chol kha zer/ 'ga' zhig mal yul mtsho/ gu ge g.ya'/ pu rangs gangs kyis bskor bas stod mnga' ris skor gsum chol kha gcigagatsang la g.yas ru dang g.yon ru gnyis/ dbus la dbu ru dang g.yo ru gnyis te dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i chol kha gcig tsha ba sgang /bo 'bor sgang /smar khams snang ste smad mdo khams snang gsum chol kha gcig yin zer/ slar zhe gcig pa la dpal ldan sa skyar phyag phebs/zhe gsum pa me mo glang la rgyal chen gyis sbyin bdag mdzad de/ gtsang chu mig ring mor dge 'dun khri phrag bdun la/gser/ ja gos dar sogs kyis mchod nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ zhe drug pa 'byug lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer gnyis la bde bar gshegs zer ba dang / bcu pa'i nyer gnyis kyi snga dro gza' nyi ma dang skar ma me bzhi 'phrod pa'i tshe gshegs zer ba'ang 'dug pas dpyad do/ /'di nyid la slob ma'i mchog man ngag gi bka' babs zhang dkon mchog dpal dang / dge slong kun blo gnyis rgyud kyi bka' babs dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal dang dga' ldan pa kun bsod gnyis/ mgon po'i bka' babs dam pa kun dga' grags/mnyes pa'i mchod g.yog twe shi grags 'od/ glo chen sangs rgyas sras ri phug pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ bro lung pa kun smon dang bzhi'o/ /nus pa'i bdag nyid ske 325

ba chen 'od snang las/gci'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ 9)gcung phyag na rdo rje dang / rgyal po jim zhin gnyis so/ /gzhan yang che ba'i bdag nyid shar pa dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen/ shar pa kun dga' seng geshar pa 'jam dbyangs/ gzhi thog pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ khang gsar ba twe shi sa~Xrgyas dpaX/ gnyan tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ cha gan dbang phyug rgyal ma ༷ /dri pa'i/ gcung po 'gro mgon phyag na ni/ yab zangs tsha/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga drug bzhes dus kyi sras/ sa mo phag la bzhi thog tu sku 'khrungs/phyi de byi ba'i lo la yab zangs tsha dgung du gshegs/ 'di dgung lo bdun pa dang 'phags pa dgung lo bcu gcig pa mnyam du chos rje sa paṇa gyi phyag phyir hor yul du phebs/ de nas rim gyis 'phags pa'i phyag phyir rgya yul du'ang byon/ 'dis sems can shi ba gso nus pa sogs rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de yang sman tshe btul nas tshur phebs dus chos rgyal 'phags pa'i drung du snga dro gcig khong phyag la byon pa'i tshe/ khong gi thugs rgyal gcog pa'i phyir rdo rje dril bu nam mkha' la bzhag nas/ khyod byon nam zhes gsungs pas/phyag nas mda' gzhu skar khung gi nyi zer la bkal nas phyag phul se chen rgyal po'i steng gi nam mkha' la bya rgod 'phur ba/ rgyal po'i dbu thog tu dud 'gro 'phur ba ma legs zhes gsung / hor rgyal pos kho gnam gyi bya yin pas sus khrims byar med smra ba la/ khrims byar yod gsungs nas mda' gcig 'phangs pas/ bya rgod bsad nas ro de sal lhung byung / hor rgyal pos/ chosarje sa paṇa dang phu bo sangs rgyas dngo sdu khyod 'dra'i sdig can gsungs pas/

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhug /de lta na btang ngo zhes gsungs te/ phus btab pas bya rgod 'phur ba sogasapa'aphrul bsam gyis mi khyab/ sa chen rgyal pos bod 'bangs spyi'i dpon la bskos/ shes su bcug nas ming dang dam kha byin/ gdung brgyud 'dzin mkhan byed zer nas khong rang gi sras mo me ga lhun bzang 'dun ma gnang / 'dis bod spyi la lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi bar dbang byas/ bstan pa dar rgyas dang /sems can bde skyid kyi dpal la bkod/ rtsa dgu pa me mo yos bu'i lo/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gnyis la dpe khang gzim khang du bde bar gshegs so/ /bya pho zla ba'i tshes gcig la gshegs zer ba'ang 'dug go /yang skabs 'dir 'di dpyad de/ lha rigs 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud 'di/ rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul sa skya pa zhes kyang grags/ sa skya pa'i 'jam dbyangasabadun brgyud ces kyang grags/ de rnams la 'gal 'du med cing tshig don so sor bshad na/ dang po rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul du grags pa ni/jo bo mar me mdzad 'brong ngu la rtser phebs/ dbon bo ri'i ngos la 'brong gnyis 'dug pa ma 'ongs par ma hā kā la gnyis kyis phrin las mdzad par lung bstan/ phyag 'tshal sgang du phebs/ sa dkar logs la phyag mchod rgyasapar mdzad/ rnyi yig bdun dang hūṃ gcig 'dug pa 'jam dbyangs bdun dang phyag rdor gcig ste brgyad kyis 'gro don spel bar lung bstan/ de'i don sachen spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yin par bshad zin la/ sa chen gyi srasa'akhon ston kun dga' 'bar/ rje btsun sku mched gnyis/ gcung dpal chen 'od po/ rje sa paṇa/ zangs tsha bsod //sa rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa rin po

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chog 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)che rnams lha yig bdun gyis mtshon pa'i 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud yin/ hūṃ yig ni 'gro mgon phyag na rdo rje ste/ de ltar rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul kyi don gnas so/ /'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud 'dren tshul la gsung sgros mi 'dra ba du ma 'dug na'ang 'di bzhin bshad pa mang / 'o na 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud las gzhan pa'i gdung brgyud gzhan rnams 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa min nam zhe na/ gdung brgyud gzhan rnams kyang 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin te/ sa skya pa chen po'i mnal lam du/ gdan gyi log la sogs pa thams cad 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang zhing / khyad par de dag gi dbus na 'jam dbyangs kyi sku che ba bdun tham pa/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa mnal lam du byung / de spyir sa skya 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa'i mkhas pa mang po dang / 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud 'byon pa'i rtags su 'dug gsungs/ rgyu mtshan des gdung brgyud de rnams kyi nang nas ngo mtshar che ba bdun zhig 'bur dod dmigs bsal mdzad pa yin la/ gzhan thams cad kyang 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar du go bar bya'o/ /phyag na'i sras dharma pā la rak+ṣi ta yab gshegs te zla ba drug nas sa pho 'brug gi zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga la byon/ 'phags pa nyid las gsan pa mthar phyin/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa se chen gyi tī shi mdzad/ phywa pa dang chos rje pa sogs kyi ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i shel gyi mchod rten khyad 'phags bzhengs/ nyi shu pa la kri maṇ+ḍal du sku gshegs/ 'di la sras rat+na bha nā stan pa'ang dgung lo brgyad la 'das

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/so / / yang zangs tsha'i sras slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan me bya la byon/ hor rgyal po'i mchod gnas mdzad/ nyer dgu pa glang lo la rgya yul du 'das/ zhe gnyis pa yos kyi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu la shing kun tu 'das zer ba'ang 'dug go /yang zangs tsha'i sras slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas ni/ ma cig rdo rje gdan la sa pho khyi la byon/ hor rgyal po hu dkar che bya ba'i tī shi mdzad/so bdun pa shing khyi zla ba bcu gcig po'i tshes bcu bzhi la ljangs yul du gshegs so/ /bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ni/ yab slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas nyer lnga bzhes pa'i dus yum ma cig khab smad ma las mang mkhar khab smad du byon/ bcu drug pa la 'phags pa dang mjal bas mi res pus mo la 'bab gsung zhing lung bstan/ bcu dgu pa la 'phag bas pa gshegs/ nyer gcig pa la gong du byon kyang snyan phra'i stabs kyis so lnga'i bar sman tsher 'byon dgos shar/ tī shi grags 'od pa dang a gnyan dam pa sogs kyis legs lam gyis so drug par twe shi thob/ gdung brgyud spel dgos kyi lung bud/ lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa 'phags pa'i dus bzhin bskyangs/ 'dis dgung lo zhe gnyis yan gdung spel mdzad pas sras bco lnga sogs byon/ zhe gsum pa la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ re gsum pa shing byi la bzhi thog tu bde bar gshegs so/ /de'i sras kyi gtso bo ti shi kun blo yan la bla brang so sor gyes pa med pas gdan sa spyi la dbang bsgyur ba'i gdung rabs zer/ kun blos sku mched rnams la bla brang so sor bgos nas gnang ste nyer dgu la gong du gshegs/ de yang mkhas btsun na/lha /gas sku mched la bzhi thog bla brang

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gce0bsdus/ (4)gnang ba nas bzung ste bdag chen chu mig pa'i bar bzhi thog bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud byon/ stu shi kun dga' legs 'byung sku mched la lha khang bla brang gnang pa nas bzung ste khams 'dam thog gi bdag chen kun legs sku mched kyi bar du byon pa rnams lha khang bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud yin/ twa wen kun dga' nyi ma sku mched la rin chen sgang bla brang gnang ba nas bzung ste/ bdag chen rgya gar ba sku mched kyi bar byon pa la rin chen sgang pa zer ro/ /da ltar bla brang de gsum gyi brgyud pa mi snang ngo / /yang / sa'i len dbang kun dga' legs pa lcam sring la dus mchod bla brang gnang ba nas bzung ste/ da lta gdan sa gong 'og gnyis na bzhugs pa rnams ni dus mchod bla brang pa'i brgyud pa ste rgyun mi 'chad par 'byon pa'i phrin las can no/ /de yang sa skya btab nas lo bzhi brgya dang bcu drug 'das pa sa mo bya lo la rtse gdong gi chos sde srid gsum rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' bkra shis kyis btab bo/ /'di dag gi rnam par thar pa rgyas par ni 'jig rten na rigs rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa shākya'i rigs kyi gtam bsnyad na bsod nams chen po thob par mdo las bshad pa ltar/ kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di'i yang lha rigs 'khon gyi rabasabasnyad na bsod nams che bar dgongs nas mkhas grub mang pos mig cha mang du mdzad/ dus nyis de thams cad kyi legs cha gcig tu bsdus pa dpal ldan sa skya pa sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i gdung rabs ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod ces bya bar blta bar bya'o/ /de ltar na choXṭ+wāṃ sa paṇa khu dbon gnyis kyis bod

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa ba lunas/khams thams cad dmag khral las gsum las bton te lo grangs brgya lhag tsam zhig gi bar du lugs gnyis kyis bde bar bskyangs te/ de yang chos rgyal 'phags pas hor rgyal po se chen go be la'i bla ma mdzad cing / bod chol kha gsum phul te dpon chen nyer lnga rim pa bzhin bskos nas/ bla mas chos kyi bya ba mdzad cing chos dang mthun pa'i 'jig rten gyi bka' gnang / dpon chen rnams kyis khrims kyi bya ba mdzad pa byung / hor rgyal pos bod thams cad saskya pa'i chos lugs byed dgos pa'i lung 'bud gsung pa la 'phags pa nyid kyis/ de ltar byas kyang kun slong dang chags sdang gi rgyur dgongs te rang rang gi chos lugs la bshad sgrub byed pa legs gsungs nas de ltar du byed pa'i 'ja' sa bsgrags/ 'phags pa dgung lo nyi shu tsam la bod phyag tu phul ba nas dgung lo zhe drug pa'i bar 'dzin bskyong mdzad/ lcags 'brug nas lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo glang lo'i bar du/ slob dpon dharma pā las lo bdun/ shar pa 'jam dbyangs gzhi thog pas lo bco brgyad/ bla ma bdag nyid chen pos lo bcu dgu/ bar stong lo gsum/ mkhas btsun chen pos lo bcu dgu/ bla ma dam pas lo gsum gdan sa mdzad nas khri skor bcu gsum bskyangs/ de nasame phag gi lo la ta dbon blo gros rgyal mtshan gdan sar byon/ lo gsum pa saglang la dbus phyogs/ ta'i gi tu byang chub rgyal mtshan pas bzung / de nas lo drug pa shing pho rta'i lo nas gtsang gi sa phal che ba yang si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bzung nas/ sa glang nas lo brgyad cu gya bdun pa shing yos kyi bar dbus gtsang gi mthil phal che ba sde 13 sdug mo grub pas bskyangs/ byang dang

brtse chen 'od snang la /gci'i chos la rgyu pa gce bsdus/ (4)rgyal mkhar rtse sogs khol bu rang rang gi dpon gyis bskyangs/ shing yos lo la rin spungs nor bzang gis bsam grub rtse bzung ste/ de nas brtsams gtsang gzhung phal che ba rin spungs pas bskyangs/ sde pa sgar pa don yod rdo rjes dbus gzhung yang bzung / shing yos nas brgya dang lnga pa shing mo glang nas gtsang pa zhing gshegs tshe brtan rdo rje yab sras kyis bsam grub rtse bzung nas gtsang gzhung phal che ba la dbang mdzad/ de na bang zhe gcig pa shing sprul la dmi bstan srung pas 'phan yul du dmag bteg de nas lo drug pa lcags khyi la dme phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis yar rgyab gzhung bzung / chu pho byi ba'i lo nasabyang dang rgyal mkhar rtse sogs gtsang gi sa'i cha thams cad phyag tu bzhes/ sa rta'i 'e nas dbus thams cad phyag tu bzhes nas mtha' dmag lhags pa rnams lan du mar bzlog ste bod thams cad la dbang mdzad/ de'i sras karma bstan skyong dbang po'o/ /de nas byang phyogs sog po'i rgyal po o rod sgo bzhi rgyal po'am mtshan gzhan bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos bod khams thams cad phyag tu bzhes/ rje btsun phyag na pa smo'i rnam 'phrul rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho la mchod gzhis su phul te dga' ldan pho brang mchod yon gyi chu pho rta lo nas bzung ste sa thams cad chos bzhin du skyong ba 'di nyid do/ /de dag gi ring la bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i skyes bu dam pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang phal cher sngar bshad zin cing / da dung yang grags che ba rags pa tsam brjod na/ /zhi byed sogs ni dam pa sang sdus bod du lan lnga byon pa'i/ lan lnga

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/pa ding rir gdan phabs nas 'gro don mdzad pa'i dus skabs kyang / ga ya sgo ra bod du byon pa'i skabs 'di tsam yin par mngon te/ de yang dang po mgrin thang la sgo nas rtsa rir byon/ gnyis pa kha che nas mnga' ris su byon/ gsum pa bal po nas byon pa na yar lung gi sma ra ser po dang mjal te/ de dang 'grogs te gtsang du skyo bsod nams bla ma dang / sma ra ser po la gcod skor gnang / bzhi pa sha 'ug stag sgo nas dbus su rma so dam gsum sogs kyi don mdzad/ lnga pa ni de nas rgya nag tu byon lo bcu gnyis bzhugs nas de nas slar ding rir chag phebs so/ /de yang dam pa nas brgyud pa'i gcod skor la/ pho gcod mo gcod gnyis las/ dang po ni sma ra ser po nas brgyud pa dang /gnyis pa ni ma cig nas brgyud pa la zer ro/ /ma cig ni grwa pa mngon shesalas rab tu byung zhing / dam pa dang skyo bla ma gnyis char la gsan no/ /zhi byed kyi skor la brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum gyi dang po ni/ dam pas kha che dzñā na gu ༅ la gsungs pa'i zhi byed sgron ma'i skor gsum la sogs pa ste/ dam pa dang kha che ba gnyis das ong po lo tsā ba la bshad pa dang / yang kha che bas bu rangs lo chung / des dmar chos rgyal la bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bod du lan bzhi pa byon dus/ dam pa rma dang/ so dge 'dun 'bar dang / rkam ye shesargyal mtshan gsum la bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa ding rir lan lnga pa me mo glang la phebs nas/ dam pa 'char chen 'char chung dam pa kun dga' sogs la bshad pa'o/ /des na ding rir phebs pa'i me glang de/ ga ya bod du byon pa'i lcags sprul las lo bzhi'i gong gi me glang de /sdu yin pa 'dra snyam mo/ /

ba chen 'od snang la /sa sbya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)sto da ni dgon gnas dang skyes bu dam pa dag bcas byon tshul/ bstan pa phyi dar la sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo sum stong brgya dang don lnga 'das pa'i don drug pa chu mo lug la lam 'bras pa'i gdan sa'i thog ma mang mkhar mu gu lung zhes pa rje 'brog mis btab/ dgon gnas 'dir rje ga ya dha ra byon te bod du lan gsum phebs pa'i dang po yin/ 'phrog la gsung ngag sgo skyel mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni 'gos kyis spyan drangs te kye rdor rgyud gsum dang gsang 'dus sogs spel/ gsum pa ni gyi jos spyan drangs te gtsang kha rag phyogs su zab chos gnang zhing / zha lugs pa dag lan bzhi byon pa'i dang po lo tsā ba gzhen nu shes rab kyis spyan drangs zer ro/ /'di la mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ lwa ba dmar po/ sprin gyi shugs can sogs zer/ chu sprul la bltamasashing rang lo sum brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs te/ chu mo lug gi lo kha rag thod bu'i yang dben du 'od kyi gong bu'i 'pho ba 'da' kha ma'i sgo nas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /de nas sa mo glang la dge ba'i bshes gnyen mu tra chen pos bo dong e btab/ 'dir paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa sogs kyis chos 'khor bskor bar bshad/ de nas sum stong brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa drug 'das pa shing pho 'brug la lam 'bras pa'i gnas se khar chung byon/ de nas sum stong nyisabargyar slebs pa'i me mo lug la byang ra sgreng byon 'brom rang gi lnga bcu rtsa gnyis lon tshe ra sgreng btab ces bya'o/ /sum stong nyis brgya dang bzhir son pa'i lcags mo phag la gsang phu ne'u thog gi chos sde byon/ de nas sa skya'i rjes su snga rim du brjod na/ chu mo bya la // 4thang gtum ston blo gros grags kyis

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/btab/ 'dir mchims dang rigs ral la sogs pa'i mkhas btsun mang po byon/ sa pho stag la skal ldan ye shes seng ges phag gru btab/ zhang brtson 'grus grags kyis tshal gung thang btab/ 'bri khung gi thog mar sgom rin gyisagazhi tsam dang rgyas par 'jig rten mgon pos btab/ lo rtags sa phag yin zer ro/ /lcags pho byi lo la stag lung chos rje bkra shis dpal gyis btab/me lug la zang zang yi ring bde legs rgyal mtshan gyis btab/ ngam rings bzang ldan sogs bshad zin/ bka' lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab kyis rdzong chos sde btsugs/ ngam rings kyi mkhan po'ang mdzad/ rtse thang ni lcags yosal twa si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis btab la twa si 'dis khri skor bcu gsum la dbang bsgyur/ sne'u brag tog gzhis ka rin spungs/ bsam grub rtse sogasabatab/ me sprul la mdog gzhi dgon grub chen bud dha shrīs btab/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar rnams ni glegs bam du bsgrigs nasabazhugs pas 'dir ma spros so/ /'das lo nas sum stong lnga brgya bzhi bcu rtsaganyis pa sa mo glang la 'brog ri bo dge ldan byon/ 'debs mkhan rje blo bzang grags pa ste/ de yang me mo bya la mdo khams su byon/ chos rje bla ma lasazhe lngas gzhen/ re mda' ba dang theg chen pa las rim bzhin lo dgu dang brgyad kyis gzhon/ 'di nyid lo bdun pa la mdo khams pa don grub rin chen las rab tu byung/ don grub rin chen de ni bcom ldan rigs ral gyis bu chen mdog stod rig pa'i seng ge'i slob ma yin zer/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la dbus gtsang du byon/ gra sa bde ba //5 du snye thang pa bkra shis seng ge la sa
