dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'a sun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo sho lo ka bcu bzhi ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa sho lo ka bcu gsum/ rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa sho lo ka bcu gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rims nad zhi ba/ mig nad zhi bar byed pa sho lo ka brgyad/ 'brum bu'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungasasho lo ka bcu/ gshad 'brum zhi bar byed pa sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa sho lo ka bco lnga/ bu mang po bton pa sho lo ka bcu gsum ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ stong 'gyur gyi gzungs sho lo ka bdun/ye shes ta la la sho lo ka nyi shu/ 'od zer dri med sho lo ka brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa dpal gyi lhun po'i 'gyur/ shes pa thams cad mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten/ rten 'brel gyi chos zhib mo sho lo ka bzhi bcu/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba / rten 'brel snying po/ rin po che bdar ba/ gtsug tor 'bar ba/ sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ bskor ba bya ba gnyis/ yon yongs su rdzogs pa gnyis/thos pa 'dzin pa/ shes rab bskyed pa gsum/ klu'i dbang po'i 'gyur/ sho lo ka brgya lobs pa/ stong lobs pa gsum/ mi brjed pa/ phyag bya ba/ gos brgya thob pa/ pad+ma'i spyan/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ skran zhi ba/ ma zhu ba'i nad 'byang ba/ sdang ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ sdig pa thamasacad zhi bar byed pa/ khro ba zhi bar byed pa/ khro ba zhi ba/ tshig btsan pa/ bdag bsrung ba/ yid du 'ong ba/ mgrin pa snyan pa/ don thams cad grub pa/ lasagrub pa/ dug thams cad zhi bar byed pa/ bcings pa las grol ba/ bdud sgrag par byed pa/ rma 'byor bar byed pa/ :sdo zug rngu zhi bar byed pa/ mkhris pa'i

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)nad gzhom pa/ bad gan gyi nad sel ba/ k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba/ rims nad srog chags kyis mi tshugs pa/ mchog thob pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa rnams kyi gzungs/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi snying po/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gzung bar 'gyur ba/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu 'thob par 'gyur ba/ tshad med pa bzhi thob par 'gyur ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa gzung bar 'gyur ba/ phal po che gzung bar 'gyur ba/ sdong po bkod pa'i snying po gzung bar 'gyur ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po gzung bar 'gyur ba/ so so 'brang ma gzung bar 'gyur ba/ lang dar gshegs pa'i mdo thams cad klags par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i gzung la sogs pa 'di dag mdo sde'i nang nas phyung ba yin pas rgyud dngos ma yin yang gzungs phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir sngar gyi rgyud 'bum rnams su bris/gzhan yang gzungs phran mang po de dang 'dra'o/ /sprin chen po dang / sprin chen po klu thams cad kyi snying po ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhusapa sho lo ka sum cu/ jo bo rjes spyan drangs pa'i tshogs kyi bdag po'i rgyud dngosagrub 'byung ba/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po sho lo ka bcu drug nor bu bzang po'i gzungs sho lo ka bco lnga klu'i dbang po'i 'gyur/ nor bu bzang po'i rtogasapa ba ri'i 'gyur/ gza' rnams kyi yum sho lo ka drug cu/ de'i gzungs/ nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs sho lo ka brgyad cu rtsa drug nor rgyun ma'i rtogs pa/ gar mkhan mchog gi rtogs pa snga phyi gnyis rab sdo /zhes gnyen gyi 'gyur/ dpal nag po

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bca0pa bzhugs/chen po'i rgyud phur bu 'od kyi 'gyur/ nag po chen po'i gzungs sho lo ka phyed dang bdun/ lha mo nag mo'i gzungs sho lo ka bcu gsum/ nag po chen po'i gzungs rims nad thams cad las thar bar byed pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ lha mo nag mo'i bstod pa/ de'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ ro langs 'dun pa'i gzungs sho lo ka brgyad cu rtsa dgu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ su ru pa'i gzungs sho lo ga ye shes skar mda'i snying po/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i gzungs/ kha 'bar ma dbugs 'byung ba'i gtor chog sho lo ka nyi shu/ yi dwags kha nas me 'bar ma la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs sho lo ka 'jur 'gegs la chu spyin pa'i gzungs sho lo ka ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mchil ma dang / snabs dang / lus kyi dri ma dang /dri chen dang dri chu rnams yi dwags la sbyin pa'i gzungs ba ri'i 'gyur/ chos spyod thams cad kyi man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud dge tshul khyung grags kyi 'gyur/ 'di rtsod pa can du grags kyang / nag tsho lo tsā bas rgyud yang dag tu mdzad pas yang dag go zhes kha cig go /'dir phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ rdo rje mchog bde bar bsgrags pa/ bu mo u ma de ba/'od zer sgrub pa/ snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi gzungs bam po gcigarigs sngags kyi rgyal mo kun nas 'di sho lo ka bzhi bcu/ lag na rdo rje gsang ba'i ming brgyad po/ gsang sngags kyis yongs su bskor ba dang bcas pa sho lo ka nyer gcig nor bu bzang po'i snying bo sho lo ka bcu/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 3( lo ka sum cu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sho lo ka nyi shu /spya rnams btsal lo/ /'dir kha cig

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)gis gser 'od dam pa/ rin po che'i tog dkon mchog ta la la/ mtshan mo bzang po/ la dus pa wo po/ rdo rje snying po/ nyi ma'i snying po kun tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa la sogs pa bris pa ni nor ba yin te/mdo dang rgyud ma 'dres par phye ba'i dkar chag dag tu mdor bshad pa'i phyir ro / / sher snying dang tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'ang yin mod kyi sher snying la sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa snang ba'i phyir dang / /tshul brgya lnga bcu pa sngagasasu 'chang ba'i 'grel pa yod pas sngags su'ang mi 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa bam po drug dang sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud bam po bcu gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ gshin rje'i gshed khro bo rnam par rgyal ba pra khog snang rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma ste gsum/ rigs ral na re/ 'di gsum bod kyis byas zer ba mi bden te 'grel ṭīka khungs ma rnams su 'di dag gi tshig mang po drang ba'i phyir ro zhes zer te brtag pa'i gnas so/ /dam tshigs gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'di rnams bya ba dang rnal 'byor gyi cha gnyis ka dang ldan pas gnyis ga'i rgyud ces rin chen bzang po'i sngags log sun 'byin du bshad do/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dpal de nyid bsdus pa rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa bam po dgu rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje rtse mo gzhon nu tshul khrims 3rdo 'gyur/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ par rgyal ba'i rgyud bam po gnyis/ ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud bam po gnyis rgyal ba mtsho dang rin chen mchog gi 'gyur/ sbyong rgyud kyi brtag pa phyogs gcig pa chag chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud dum bu bzhi hor khong bsab pa dang bcas pa rin chen bzang po dang lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyi 'gyur te ji skad du/ lo tsā chen po rin chen bzang po yis/ /dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud 'di bsgyur ba la/ /bar bar dpe ma rnyed nas ma 'gyur nas/ /bdag gisa'abad pas dpe btsal rnyed pa'am bsgyur/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud cung ma tshang ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa/ gsang ba nor bu'i thig le rnams kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/'jam dpal sku dra/ 'dir mgon po kun snang btsal lo/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud la gsum ste/ rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa shes rab kyi rgyud/ thabs shesarab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud do/ /dang po la/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa rin chen bzang po dang chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/rgyud phyi ma le'u bco brgyad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje phreng ba lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyi 'gyur/ dgongs pa lung bstan rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa khu dngos grub dang tshul khrimasargyal ba'i 'gyur/ lha mo bzhis zhus 'e ti'i rang 'gyur/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud gnyis su med pa ma bem pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba chos kyi blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'di 389

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (3)la chag chos rje dpal la sogs pa bod kyis 'di lhad yod par smra ste/ gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi lung nā ro 'grel chen dang rin chen bzang po'i sngags log sun 'byin du drangs pa rnams/ 'di bas chung ba'i gnyis med rnam rgyal yang dag cig yod kyi/ 'di rgyal po ba lung bas byas so zhes zer ro/ kha cig 'di la sku ti'i rang 'gyur yod pas yang dag yin no zhes zer te brtag go /thams cad gsang ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di slob dpon shān+ti pas rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba yin no/ kha cig bla med du 'dod do/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyi skor ni/ dgra nag gi rgyud tshul khrims rgyal ba dang / dar ma grags dang / rwa rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo lasathams cad grub par byed pa/ gzhen nu gdong drug gi rgyud dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtogs pa bdun pa rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ 'jigs byed skyo lugs pa rtog pa gsum pa dang / rtog gcig ma dang gsum du 'dod do/ /gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rgyud grags pa rgyal mtshan dang shong blo brtan gyi 'gyur/ mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul dra ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum 'dul rtsa ba'i rgyud dang rgyud phyi ma gnyis 'gar chos bzang gi 'gyur/ 'di slob dpon dza ba ri pas rnal 'byor chen por bkral ba yin no/ /phyag na rdo rje gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje be con can gyi rgyud/'di klu sgrub la sogs pas rnal 'byor chen por bzhed ces zer ro/ /phyag na rdo rje me lce'i rgyud dge tshul khyung grags ṭ+wāṃ 'gyur/ 'dir 'grel pa mdzad pos

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha nga dang bcas pa bzhugs/rnal 'byor chen por bkral bas bod ma yin no zer ba mi bden no zhes kha cig go /rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po'i rgyud grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'di 'grel pa mdzad pos rnal 'byor chen por bshad pas bya ba'i rgyud du byas pa nor ba yin no/ /ral pa gcig pa'i rgyud kyi rtogs pa byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ mgon po mngon par 'gyung ba chos rab kyi 'gyur/ mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba 'khor lo grags kyi 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa shes rab kyi rgyud ni kye rdo rje'i skor la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud thun mong ma yin pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ rgyud mang po'i bshad rgyud thun mong ba dpal sa myu ṭi rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa rnams shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog gi skor ni/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bshad pa'i rgyud a bhi dha na rin 'a bzang po dang chos kyi brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa gnyis 'gos kyi 'gyur/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dharma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ sdom pa 'byung ba rgyus smon lam grags dang blo brtan gyi 'gyur/ khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba la chings yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur/bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ye shes rdo rje'i rang 'gyur/ grags pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa chung ngu byang chub shes rab kyi 'gyur/ phag mo mngon par 'byung ba rtsa ba'i rgyud dang rgyud phyi ma gnyis ji gyo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/phag mo mngon par 'byung ba bshad pa'i rgyud khu dngos grub kyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur/ 'bum phrag gsum pa las byung ba'i ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i sgyu ma chen mo dharma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ bde 391

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)mchog ra li'i rgyud la/ dpal gsang ba rdo rje/ gsang ba gcod pa/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ nam mkha' chen po/ mkha' 'gro ma dra ba'i sdom pa/ rin chen phreng ba/ dam tshig chen po/ stobs po che/ ye shes gsang ba/ ye shes phreng ba/ ye shes zla ba/ zla ba'i phreng ba/ rin chen 'bar ba/ nyi ma'i 'khor lo/ ye shes rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba/ gsang ba me 'bar/ gsang ba bdud rtsi/ dur khrod rgyan/ rdo rje rgyal po/ ye shesabasam pa/ chags pa'i rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro sdom pa/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba/'jigs byed rnam 'joms/ me'i phreng ba/rdo rje grub pa/ dra ba sdom pa/ stobasachen ye shes rgyal po/ dur khrod kyi rgyan med du byung ba rnams shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ ra li sum cu rtsa gnyis su grags na yang 'di las gzhan ma zlos pa mi snang la/ 'di dag ga ya dha ras 'brog mi dang gnyos lo tsā gnyis ka la bshad pa'i rgya dpe can yin pas bod kyis byas zer ba mi bden no/ /phyag rgya chen po thig le rkam chos kyi ye shes dang phyugs mtshams dgra bcom gyi 'gyur/ cha mthun snying po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ye shes thig le/ de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma rnams dpal shes rab gsang ba'i rang 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba'i mdzod dge blo'i 'gyur/ 'di rnams rnal 'byor rgyud yin te shārnyi pas der bkral bas so zhes zer ba mi 'thad de/ rdo rje gur las/gsang ba mdzod dang rdo rje bdud rtsi las byung ba/ /'khor lo bde mchog gur dang phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud chen rnams su grags pa yin/ /zhes pas so/ /rnyogs pa med 19/2rdo rje a ra li/ ri khi a ra li rnams

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ phyag rgya chen po thig le la sogs pa 'di dag kye rdo rje'i cha mthun gyi rgyud du kha cig 'dod do/ /dpal sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / rgyud phyi ma la lha rin po che'i 'gyur/ rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma 'e ti'i rang 'gyur/rdo rje gdan bzhi rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ marnya ang sa/ gdan bzhi las sbyor ba'i rab tu byed pa/ ma hā mā ya'i rgyud rnams 'gos kyi 'gyur/rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud gnyis ji gya'i 'gyur/'dir he ru ka rol pa bal po shī la kirti'i rang 'gyur de btsug mod kyi/ de yang dag tu mi 'dug pas dor bar bya'o/ /dpal zla gsang thig le rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sgrol ma dngos grub brten par gzigs pa'i rgyud me ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ 'di rgyud 'bum du ma chud/ sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pa sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa bdun/ 'di nyi ma sbas pas rnal 'byor chen por bshad/ dpal de kho nyid rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud sho lo ka sum brgya brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa'i rgyud/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lhan cig skyes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud rnams rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzā na kirti'i rang 'gyur yin/ zhes pa 'di rnam dag go /gsum pa thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud ni/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa phan yon dang bcas pa bam po gcig rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dus 'khor gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan pa 'bro shes rab grags kyi //// dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus rgyud rwa

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ /()chos rab kyi 'gyur/ spyir 'di la 'gyur bcu bzhi yod/ rgyud phyi ma rgyud kyi snying po dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ dbang gi rab tu byed pa 'bro'i 'gyur/ bkol ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu ji gyo'i 'gyur/ yang bkol ba'i rgyud lte spyang rol pa dang / rdo rje glu gar dang / bla ma'i yon tan yongs su gzung ba dang gsum/ 'di rnams kha cig ma dag par 'dod do/ /de ltar rgyud bzhi brgyar gnyis kyis chad pa yod do / / gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum dang / sngar bshad pa'i mdo sngags de dag gi dgongs 'grel la sogs pa bstan 'gyur du grags pa dang / bod kyi chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa la sogs pa'i bstan bcos rnams kyi dkar chag gzhung mang du dogs pas ma bkod cing bu ston chos 'byung sogs su blta bar bya'o/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag thub bstan rin po che/ /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams//byon tshul yid ches nges par bshad pa yi/ /dge bas bstan la mos pa mthar phyin shog /dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen las/ yid ches bskyed pa'i ched du bstan pa'i byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /gang gis dus gsum dus med nyid rtogs kyang / /gang la skyes dang 'jig pa'i tshul bstan nas//gang zhig yid 'byung brtson 'grus skyed byed pa'i//gang 'dir bstan pa'i gnas tshad la sogs 'chad/ /spyi don gsum pa brtson 'grus bskyed pa'i ched du bstan pa'i gnas tshad bshad pa la/ bstan pa gnas pa'i gzhi/ bskal pa'i rnam gzhag bstan pa'i gnas tshad dngos/ brtson 'grus bskyed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan no/39//nga po ni mdo las/ 'jig rten ni rnam

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bca0pa bzhugs/ pa gnyis te/ snod dang / 'du byed kyis bzung ba'i sems can no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar snod kyi dbang du byas na gnyis te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu mi mjed kyi rnam gzhag bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni mdo las/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gangs chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag gi mthil gyi snying po la 'dug pa / sangs rgyas kyi sku'i dbyibs ltar snang ba/ sangs rgyas kyi phyag la gnas pa dang mi mthun pa dang / mi mthun pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho lta bu'i rdul snyed kyi sku'i dbyibs su 'dug pa sha stag gis bskor ba ste/ de yang gangs chen mtsho'i dbyibs spos chu'i rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul phra rab snyed kyis bskor ba'i dbus ma ni/ zi 'bru yid du 'ong ba phyogs kun nas rin po che 'bar ba'i 'od zer snang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed kyis bskor ba mang po steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ thams cad kyi 'og ma ni/ dpal 'byung ba'i gser snang ba zhes bya ba/ rdo rje rin po che g.yogs pa na/ sangs rgyas tshul khrims dag pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab snyed 'phags shing rdul phra rab kyis bskor ba/ zhing khams sbos sna tshogs kyi pad ma'i dpal zhes bya ba seng ge'i dbyibs lta bu/ mu tig gi bla resabris pa na/ sangs rgyas seng ge'i 'od zer mchog 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na zhing rdul gsum gyis bskor ba'i zhing khams rin po che rgyun kun tu snang ba/ spos kyi rlung gi sa mtshams can/ me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ nor bu bzang po nyi ma'i sprin gyis khyab pa zhes bya ba na/ sangs rgyas 'od zer dri ma 395

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)med pa'i ye shes kyi dpal bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na zhing 'od sna tshogs yid 'ong zhes bya ba/ rdo rje'i brag gi mtsho la 'dug pa/ pad+ma'i dbyibs can rdo rje ches 'bar bas brgyan pa zhes bya ba na/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'od zer stobs brtson 'grus mtha' yas dag par 'byung ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na zhing khams 'od shin tu bkye ba'i me tog sil ma'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba grwa du ma'i dbyibs can de na/ sangs rgyas spos kyi 'od zer dga' ba'i stobs rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na zhing khams dge ba sna tshogs kyi rnam pa zhes bya ba na/sa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rgyan gru bzhi dbyibs can gtsug gi nor bus bres pa na/sangs rgyas kun tu snang ba'i 'od kyi dbang po bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na zhing khams rgyan gyi 'od zer me tog shin tu rgyas pa khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbyibs can kha dog sna tshogs kyi gos dang mu tig gis bres pa de na/ sangs rgyas dga' ba rgya mtsho'i shugs yon tan grags pa'i dbang phyug 'od zer bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na zhing khams yang dag par 'byung ba'i gzi brdzid ces bya ba sgra stong pa'i sa mtshams can nor bu sna tshogs pa'i pad+ma la 'dug pa mig 'phrul gyi dbyibs can me tog gi dra bas g.yogs pa na/ sangs rgyas grags pa rgya chen po'i ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na zhing khams sgra dbyangs rab tu sgrogs pa zhes bya ba na/ yid bzhin rgyal po'i 'khor lo'i shing gis mtshams can/ tshangs pa'i lus kyi dbyangs ltar 'dug pa/ seng ge'i sprin rin po ches bres pa de na/ sangs rgyas mtshan gyi gzi brjed thub pa med pa'i zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng / ༷nga khams rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/

dam pa'i chos byi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'a sub pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ mu tig gi srad bu 'chad pa rin po che'i rgyan gyi sa mtshams can/ nor bu'i rgya mtsho la gnas pa/ kun nas zlum po'i dbyibs can/ spos dang nor bu kha dog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa de na/ sangs rgyas chos kyi rgya mtsho kun gyis 'phags pa'i rgyal po bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na zhing khams sa mtshams mdog rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba na/ rdo rje pha lam ltar sra ba'i mtshams can zla ba khams pa'i dbyibs ltar de na/ sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i yon tan chos nyid tshad med pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na zhing khams snang ba'i mdog ces bya ba/ 'od zer brgyas kun tu snang ba'i sa mtshams can/ spos chu'i rgya mtsho me rtag gi klong can gyi gangs chen mtsho la rab tu gnas pa/ me tog 'khyil ba'i dbyibs can gos sna tshogs kyi sprin gyis g.yogs pa de na/ sangs rgyas tshangs pa'i dbang po'i dpal bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab snyed 'das pa na/ mi mjed ces bya ba sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu gsum gyi rdul shin tu phra rab snyed kyi zhing gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i rdo rje'i gzhi'i sa mtshams can/rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sna tshogs can gyis shin tu bzung ba/ pad+ma'i dra ba la gnas pa kun nas zlum po'i dbyibs can nam mkha'i khyon du lha'i khang pa can gyis brgyan pa 'di nyid yod do/ /de na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad 'di bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rdul med pa'i 'od ces bya ba zhing rdul bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed kyi zhing gis bskor ba rin po che'i rgyan gyis sa mtshams can 397

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)nor bu'i gos sna tshogs kyi rgya mtsho la gnas pa rdo rje'i dbyibs can sprin mtha' yas pas g.yogs pa de na sangs rgyas chos dbyings shin tu 'phags pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na zhing khams 'od sna tshogs yid du 'ong ba'i mar me zhes bya ba na stobs gzhan gyis thub pa med pa kun tu snang ba'i dpal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /zhes sogs kyi zhing khams brgya phrag brtsegs pa'i gzugs tshad sangs rgyas kyi mtshan sogs gsungs so/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing gi tshad rnams ni 'phags pa a tsa la'i rtogs pa/phal po che'i mdo dang / lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba rnams su shes par bya'o/ /bzod dka'i zhing 'di nyid kyi gling bzhi pa kho nar yang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ston pa 'di'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ don thams cad grub pa/ go ta ma/ shākya thub pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ drang srong dam pa/ seng ge'i nga ro/ mu stegasa'adul ba/ dge sbyong chen po/ rgyal ba dam pa/ rnam par snang mdzad te stong phrag bcur bshad do/ /zhing khams 'di dang 'dabs chags su/ 'jig rten gyi khams shar phyogs na gling bzhi bsrung ba/ lho phyogs na gling bzhi bzod par dka' ba/ nub phyogs na gnyen ldan/ byang phyogs na gling bzhi seng ge yod ces bya ba dang / byang shar na rnam par bsags pa/ shar lho na dga' ba/ lho nub na snying po dam pa/ nub byang na sa bzang po/ 'og phyogs na 'od 'phro can/ steng phyogs na nor 'dzin zhes bya ba yod do/ /zhing der yang ston pa thub chen 'di'i mtshan tshul khrims ldan zhes bya ba la sogs pa khri phrag tu gsungs la/ zhing khams de dag re rer yang mtshan gyi 3 9 snangs stong phrag bcu bcur shes so/ /

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'phun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de ltar bye ba phrag brgya pa'i gling bzhi pa rnams su yang mtshan stong phrag bcu bcur gnas so/ /zhes dang / mi mjed 'di dang 'dabs chags su de dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams shar phyogs na khebs pa dang ldan pa/ lho phyogs na lhag pa/ nub phyogs na rdul gsal ba/ byang phyogs na rnam par 'byung ba / byang shar na 'pho byed/ shar lho na phan pa zhes bya ba/ lho nub na kun tu bzang po/ nub byang na yongs su dga' ba/ 'og phyogs na mi chen po/ steng phyogs na dbyangs sgrogs zhes bya ba yod do/ /de na dpa' bo'i rgyal mtshan/dpal 'byung ba/ thams cad kyi bdag po sogs su shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang /gzhan yang phyogs bcur sangs rgyas kyi zhing chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i mtha' klas par yongs su shes so zhes bshad do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ mi mjed kyi rnam par bzhag pa dang / snying po lta bur gling bzhi/ ri rab/ nyi zla/ lha rnamasakyi rnam gzhag mi'i gnas dang bcas pa/ 'di shin tu rtogs sla ba'i phyir bye brag tu bstan pa la/ dang po ni/ mdzod las/ gling bzhi pa dang nyi zla dang / /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ /stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ /bar ma'i 'jig rten khamasayin no/ /de stong la ni stong gsum mo/ /mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ gling bzhi/ ri rab/ nyi zla/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'thab bral dga' ldan nas brtsams te tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar stong la ni stong spyi phud ces bya'o/ /stong chung ngu'i 'jig rten gyi khams de stong la ni stong gnyis pa bar ma/ stong gnyis pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams so/ /de dag 399

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ lta )stong la ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams yin te/de thams cad kyang grub sde gcig pa'i tshul gyis so/ /'byung ba yin zhes pa chags pa yin no/ /de rnams kyang ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul ni/ yon tan rin po che bsdud pa las/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu'i phung po brten/ /de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba brten/ /sems can khams la spyod pa'i rgyu ni 'di 'dra'o/ /zhes dang / de la snod gyi 'jig rten gyi/ /gnas par 'dod pa'i 'og dag gi /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rngams su ni/ /sa ya drag 'bum grangs med do/ /zhes pas/ sems can rnams kyi las kyi dbang spos 'og tu nam mkha' la brten pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor grub ste/ kha dog sngo skya rngams su ni dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum/ rgyar ni grangs med do/ /mtshan po che'i rdo rjes kyang gzhig par mi nus par sra ba yin la/ de'i steng du chu ste rngams ni bcu gcig dang /stong phrag dag ni nyi shu'o/ /de ltar sems can spyi mthun gyi las las/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor de la sprin gser gyi snying po can 'dus nas char gyi rgyun gnya' shing tsam babs pas/ chu'i dkyil 'khor 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang / stong phrag nyi shu'o/ /de'ang kha cig las kyi dbang gis/ dper na bza' ba dang btung ba ma zhu ba long khar mi lhung ba bzhin no zhes zer/ gzhan dag spyang gi tshul gyisa'adzin to zhes te/ sa sder 'og gzhi dang / logs na gnas pa'i rlung gis/ chu de rnams thur dang thad dar mi 'dzag go zhes gsungs/ 'di gnyis ni stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa gcig yin la/ gzhan sa gzhi ri gling la sogs pa so so ba zhig yi/ spyas dang / yang rlung gi dkyil 'khor la

dam pa 'i chos kyi byur tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha slong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 'phangs kyi tshad gsungs nas/ rgyar grangs med ces gsungs pas/ 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa zhig yin zhing / chu'i dkyil 'khor dang gser gyi sa gzhi sogs la rgya 'phangs kyi tshad gsungs pas so so yin no zhes kyang gsung ngo / /yang spyi mthun gyi las kyi mthu las byung ba'i rlung gis chu de bsrubs pas/ 'o ma bskol ba'i spris ma ltar gser gyi sa gzhi chags so/ /chu de'ang phyi ni rngams su 'bum phrag brgyad/ /lhag ma dag ni gser du 'gyur/ /chu'i steng rim dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khrir gser gyi rang bzhin sa gzhir gyur to/ /chu dang gser gyi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /thad kur 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang / /stong phrag gsum dang brgya phrag ni/ /phyed dang lnga rnams kho na'o/ /gnyi ga'ang rgya mnyam mo/ /'khor yug tu ni sum 'gyur ro/ /yang dpag tshad sa ya phrag gsum 'bum phrag drug khri sum brgya lnga bcu'o/ /zhes te bzod dka'i zhing thams cad kyi dbus na snying por gyur zhing lhun po ltar mtho ba ni/spyi mthun smon lam chu gter che las 'khrungs/ /gling mang 'dab rgyas lhun po'i ze 'brus brgyan/ /phun tshogs lha mi'i longs spyod sbrang rtsis gang / /skye rgu bung ba'i nyer 'tsho ngo mtshar ldan/ /zhes pa ltar/ gnyis pa gling bzhi/ lha gnasasoso la sogs pa 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ de la lhun po gnya' shing 'dzin/ /gzhol mda' 'dzin dang seng ldeng can/ /de bzhin lta na sdug ri dang / /rta rna dang ni rnam 'dud dang / /mu khyud 'dzin ri'o de nas ni/ /zhes pa ni/ ri gling mu khyud rnams gser gyi sa gzhi la brten pa yin zhing / ri rab ni dbus na gnas shing / ri bdun gyi ra bas bskor ba'i tha ma ni mu khyud 'dzin yin no/ /401

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (3)gling rnams yin no de dag gi'ang / /phyi rol nas ni 'khor yug ste/ /gling bzhi dang 'khor yug tu bskor ro/ /de dag gi rgyu ni/ bdun ni gser yin de lcags so / / zhes pa ltar/ gnya' shing 'dzin sogs ri bdun ni gser/ 'khor yug ste brgyad pa ni lcags so/ /lhun po rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin/ /zhes te byang gser shar dngul lho be+e ḍūr+ya nub shel gyi rang bzhin no zhes 'byung la pad ma rā ga zhes kyang kha cig ste ngos bzhir grags so/ /ri ngos kyi mthus nam mkha' yang de bzhin du snang ste/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi phyogs logs be+e ḍūr+ya yin pas nam mkha' yang de bzhin gyi kha dog tu gyur to/ /nam mkha' ni thams cad kha dog gcig pa'o zhes kyang gsungs/ yang char gyi rgyun babs pas/ sa bon sna tshogs khong du yod pa'i chu de dag rnam pa du ma'i bye brag dang ldan pa'i rlung gis gzhig pa na/ gser la sogs pa'i khams rlung gis bsdus pa las/ ri dang gling dag tu yang gyur to/ /ri rab ni/ chu yi nang du brgyad khri dag /nub bo chu yi steng du yang / /dpag tshad dag ni brgyad khri'o/ /brgyad po'i phangs su phyed phyed dbri//de dag rngams su 'phangs dang mnyam/ /de dag bar du rol mtsho bdun/ /dang po stong phrag brgyad cu'o/ /de ni nang gi rgya mtsho yin/ /de yi ngos la sum 'gyur ro/ /rol mtsho gzhan ni byed phyed de/ /lhag ma phyi yi rgya mtsho yin/ /lhag ma ni mu khyud 'dzin dang 'khor yug bar/ de'i ni/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po yin te/tshwa sgo'i chu yis gang ba'o/ kha zheng gi tshad ni/ 'bum phrag gsum dang stong phrag ni nyi shu gnyis yin no/ /de lta bu'i mtsho de yang dum bu bzhir gyur pa med kyang phyogs kyi dbye bas phyi'i rgya mtsho chen ṭ+wāṃ )zhi zhes grags so/ /de la ni/ 'dzam

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa 'i gru chen kha skong dang bca4pa bzhugs/bu'i gling ste ngos gsum la/ /stong phrag gnyis so shing rta'i dbyibs/ /gcig la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di'i lto phyogs ma gtogs pa'i ngos gsum la ni dpag tshad nyis stong nyis stong yod la/ lho phyogs kyi ngos la ni dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi pa ste/ dbyibs ni shing rta'i dbyibs can gyi/ sog pa'i gdeng che ba ri rab la bstan pa khang bu brtsegs pa las gsungs so/ /shar gyi lus 'phags zla gam 'dra/ /ngos gsum 'di dang 'dra gcig la/ /dpag tshad sum brgya lnga bcu'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'khor lug la lta ba'i ngosal dpag tshad sum brgya lnga bcu yod la/ ngos gsum ni 'dzam bu'i gling dang 'dra zhing / dbyibs ni zla gam mo/ /ba longs spyod gling zlum po ste/ stong phrag phyed dang brgyad yin no/ /de'i dbus la phyed dang gsum/ /zhes gsungs te/ nub kyi ba longs spyod sna mtha' bskor du dpag tshad stong phrag phyed dang brgyad yin la / thad kur stong phrag phyed dang gsum pa/ dbyibs ni zlum po'o/ /sgra mi snyan rgyar gru bzhir mnyam/ /zhes gsungs te/ phyogs rer dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis gnyis te mtha' bskor du dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad la/ dbyibs ni gru bzhi'o/ /gling bzhi po der grangs nges sam/ 'on te gzhan yang yod ce na/ de yi bar na gling brgyad ni/ /lus dang lus 'phags sgra mi snyan/ /sgra mi snyan gyi zla dang ni/ /rnga yab dang ni rnga yab gzhan/ /g.yo ldan dang ni lam mchog 'gro/ /zhes gsungs te/ lus dang lus 'phags ni shar gyi g.yon dang g.yas kyi gling phran te zla gam/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla ni byang gi g.yon dang g.yas kyi gling phran te gru bzhi'o/ /g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro ni nub kyi g.yon dang 403

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (4)g.yas kyi gling phran te zlum po'o/ /rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan ni 'dzam bu'i gling gi g.yon dang g.yas kyi gling phran te sog kha'o/ /nyi ma dang zla ba ci la brten zhe na / rlung la brten te/ spyi mthun gyi las kyis bar snang la nyi zla dang skar ma rnams 'phul bar byed pa'i rlung dag grub ste/ ri rab la klong bzhin du 'khor ro / / nyi zla de dag 'di nas thag ji srid na gnas ce na/ nyi zla lhun po'i phyed na'o/ /zhes te/ gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mo dang mnyam pa nas rgyu'o/ /tshad ji ltar zhe na dpag tshad lnga bcu gcig dang bcas/ /zhes te de'ang zla ba'i tshad ni dpag tshad lnga bcu la/ nyi ma la ni dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig go /nyi ma'i 'og rgyu me shel las grub pas tsha ba dang snang bar byed la/ zla ba'i 'og gzhi chu shel las grub pas bsil zhing snang bar byed do/ /skar ma'i tshad ni rgyang grags bco brgyad nas/ rgyang grags gsum gyi bar ci rigs pa yod do/ /nyi zla gnyis kyisagling bzhir bya ba ji ltar byed ce na/ nam phyed nyi ma nub pa dang / /nyi ma phyed dang 'char dus gcig /ces te/ sgra mi snyan du nam phyed kyi tshe lus 'phags su nyi ma nub/ 'dzam bu'i gling du nyi ma phyed nas/ ba longs spyod du 'char te/ 'di ni nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dbang du byas so/ /dbus kyi lhun po la bang rim du zhe na/'di la bang rim bzhi yod de/ /bar gyi thag ni stong phrag bcu/ /stong phrag dag ni bcu drug dang / /brgyad dang bzhi dang gnyis 'phags so/ /de la lag na gzhong thogs dang / /phreng thogs dang ni rtag myos dang / /rgyal chen bzhi yi lha rnams gnas/ /zhes te ri rab la bang rim bzhi yod pa'i dang po la lag na gzhed thogs/ gnyis pa la phreng tho/༷ / gsum pa la rtag myos/ bzhi pa la

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha rnams dang bcas la/ der ma zad ri bdun la yang gnas pa yod de/ ri ni bdun po dag la yang / /zhes pas gnya' shing 'dzin sogs la yang rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i 'khor gyi lha dag gnas/ shes so/ /lhun po'i rtse na sum cu rtsa gsum/ de ni ngos la brgyad khri'o/ /thur du ji lta bar ngos re la yang brgyad khri brgyad khri'o/ kha cig ngos la nyi khri ste/ ngos bzhi/ phyogs bzhi'i ngos re re bzhin yang dpag tshad nyi khri nyi khri yod/ kun tu bskor ba na/dpag tshad brgyad khri'o/ /phyogs mtshams brtsegs pa bzhi la ni/ /lag na rdo rje gzhan dbus su/ /zhes ri rab rtse'i phyogs mtshams kyi grwa la dpag tshad lnga brgya'i tshad brtsegs pa'i gzhi la 'phags pa lag na rdo rje rnams gnas so/ /grong khyer lta na sdug ces pa/ /ngos la nyis stong lnga brgya pa/ /dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis gser gyi/ /rang bzhin gzhi bkra mnyen pa yod/ /ces pas/dbus na brgya byin gyi pho brang lta na sdug ngos rer dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya/'phangs su phyed dang gnyis pa zhig ni/ tshon brgyas rnam par bkra ba/ shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar reg na 'jam pa'o/ /de na rnam par rgyal byed de/ /ngos la nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /lta na sdug gi dbus na khang bzangs rnam par rgyal byed/rin po che dang dpal gyis che ba'i bdag nyid/ ngos ngos kyi srid du dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu pa zhig yod do/ /phyi rol shing rta sna tshogs dang / /rtsub 'gyur 'dres tshal dga' bas brgyan/ /zhes te/ shing rta sna tshogs can dang/ rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal dang / 'dres pa'i tshal dang / dga' ba'i tshal rnams yod do/ /'di dag gi ni phyogs bzhi na/ /nyi shus bcad nas sa gzhi bzang / /zhes pas/405

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)skyed tshal gyi phyogs bzhir dpag tshad nyi shus bcad pas lha rnams rtse ba'i gnas/ sa gzhi bzang po mdzes pa dang ldan pa yod do/ /byang shar mtshams na yongs 'du ste/ /lho nub mtshams na chos bzang ngo / /zhes pa/ byang shar na shing yongs 'du sa brtol zhes bya ba lha thams cad kyi 'dod pa'i dga' ba mchog gi gnas yod de/ rtsa ba ni dpag tshad lngar thug 'phangs su ni dpag tshad brgyar 'phags shing / yal 'dab dang lo mas dpag tshad lnga bcur khyab bo/ /dri bzang gi rdzi phyogs su dpag tshad lnga brgya/ rdzi phyogs ma yin par dpag tshad lnga bcur dri ngad ldang ngo / /de steng lha yi gzhal med khang/ /zhes pas sum cu rtsa gsum nas gong gi lha gnas ni/ sprin med kyi bar rlung dang rin po che'i gzhi la lha'i grong khyer chags so/ /rtsa gsum nas/ de'i steng gi lha gong ma rnams kyi bar bar gyi tshad ni/gnas nas gnas 'og ji srid pa/ /de nas de gong de yi srid/ /ces pas rgyal chen rigs bzhi nas gnas 'og 'dzam bu'i gling bar la dpag tshad bzhi khri/ de las sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bar bzhi khri/ de las 'og 'dzam bu'i gling gi bar tshad ni dpag tshad brgyad khri ste/ de bzhin du sum cu rtsa gsum nasa'athab bral gyi bar la yang dpag tshad brgyad khri'o/ /de nas dga' ldan gyi bar la dpag tshad 'bum drug khri'o/ /dga' ldan nas 'phrul dga'i bar la dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri/ de nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bar la dpag tshad drug 'bum bzhi khri 'dir gnas 'og ces pa ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling ste 'gyur ba med la/ rang rang gi gnas 'og la ni mi bya'o/ /de bzhin rtsis byed pa lasatshangs pa mdun na 'don dang / tshangs 4rdo/ gnyis la bar thag gi tshad de lta bu

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ ni med de/ kha che bye brag tu smra bas/ mdun na 'don ni tshangs pa chen po'i dru nga na nye bar gnas pas mdun na 'don te/ bram ze rig byed 'don pa'i mdun na bram ze gzhan 'khod pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de gnyis kyi gnas la gnas gzhan tha dad pa dang bar thag brtsir med la/ des na gzugs khamasaganas rigs bcu drug tu 'dod do/ /nyi 'og bye brag tu smra bas ni de gnyis la gnas gzhan tha dad pa'ang yod par bzhed do/ /gang ltar na/ de las gzhan pa rnams brtsis te/ gnas shin tu mthong nas/ gnas 'dzam bu'i gling gi bar du/dpag tshad ther 'bum chen po phrag bzhi dang / ther 'bum rkyang pa phrag gcig dang / dung phyur phrag brgya dang / sa ya phrag gsum dang bzhi khri yod pa de bzhin du / shin tu mthong nas 'og min gyi bar du yang de srid de/ 'dzam bu gling nas 'og min du 'gro ba'i bar gyi lam phyed ni gnas shin tu mthong yin no/ /slob dpon thogs med dang gnas brtan byang bzang gnyis ni gnas so so'i bar thag la dpag tshad bzhi khri bzhi khrir gnas mnyam pas/ shin tu mthong nas 'og min gyi bar du dpag tshad drug 'bum dang brgyad khri yod ces gsungs/'og min gyi gong na gnas gzhan med de/ de nyid mthu bor gyur pas na 'og min zhes bya'o/ /yang smras pa/ klu rnams ni rgya mtsho chen po dang rol mtsho rnamasal gtso bor 'dug cing / mtsho phran rnams la yang gnas so/ /lha ma yin rnamasani ri rab kyi nang dang / khong seng la gnas so/ /lhun po'i bang rim dang po la ni rin po che'i gzhong pa thogs pa rnams 'dug pas na gzhong thogs kyi gnas zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la ni me tog phreng ba thogs pa rnams 'dug pas na phreng 407

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa sna'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)thogs kyi gnas zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa la ni me tog gi chang dang/ rgun 'brum gyi chang gis rtag tu myos pa rnams 'dug pas na rtag myos kyi gnas zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa la ni rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha 'dug pas na rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i gnas zhes bya'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum zhes bya ba ni/ lha'i gtso bo sum cu rtsa gsum yod pa ste/ nor lha brgyad/ drag po bcu gcig nyi ma'i bu bcaganyis/ tha skar gyi bu gnyis te so gsum gnas pa'am yang na/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs kyi phyogs re re na lha'i grong khyer brgyad brgyad yod la/ de dag na lha'i blon po chen po brgyad brgyad dang / dbus brgya byin dang sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pas na/sum cu rtsa gsum pa zhes bya'o/ /yang na/ yid zhakhrugs kyi gnas dang / rtsed mos myos kyi gnas dang / mnyam zhabrugs dang/ seng seng po dang / me tog gi 'bras khab can dang / ljang bu bsos la sogs pa/ 'dzam bu'i gling du sgrag tu rung ba'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum yod pa ste/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi mdo las bshad pa'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum man chad na yod kyi/ de yan chad na med kyang 'dir spyi ming bye brag la btags so/ /yang na lha mo rnams kyi dpung pa'am phang par lha'i bu dang bu mo gnyis mnyam du skye bas mtshe ma'i gnas zhes kyang grags so/ /de yang 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor brtan pa la/ rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi gzhi chags par lha'i grong dag gnas so/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i steng du'ang rlung dang / rin po che'i gzhi la gnas pa'i lha'i grong khyer te/ sags dbang phyug byams pa mgon pos theg chen gyi chos ston pa'i dga' ston la longs spyod pas na dga' ldan zhesa~X ༈/ nyer bzhag dang pad dkar las/

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ thos pa mang dang chos 'dzin dang / shes rab ldan zhing thar pa brjod/ /yon tan rnam pa dga' ba'i mi/ /de rnams dga' ldan nye bar 'gro/ /zhes gsungasaso / / de'i steng du 'dod pa'i yul rang gis sprul pa la longs spyod pas 'phrul dga'o/ /gzhan gyis sprul pa la longs spyod du yod pas na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed do/ /'di dag man chad du ni 'dod pa'i bde ba la yid chags pas 'dod khams zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang / gnyis gnyis 'khyud cing lag bcangs dang //rgod dang bltas pas 'khrigs pa yin/ /zhes pas rgyal chen rigs bzhi sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams mi ltar gnyis gnyis 'khrig go'i/'thab bral ba rnamasadapung pas 'khyud pa tsam/ dga' ldan pa rnams ni lag bcangs/ 'phrul dga' pa rnams rgod pa/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams 'dod pa dang bde bas kyang ngo / /'dod lha 'di dag dang por skyes pa'i lus tshad ni/ mdzod las/byis pa lo lnga lon pa nas/ /lo bcu lon pa lta bu'i bar/ /de dag tu skyes ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa rnams ni/ mi'i byis pa lo lnga lon pa lta bu'i bong tshad du skye la/ de bzhin du/ 'dod lha gong ma rnams kyang / lo drug dang / bdun dang / brgyad dang / dgu dang / lo bas lon pa lta bu'i bong tshad du skye bar gsungs so/ /de'i steng du tshangs pa'i rigs su gtogs pas na tshangasarigs tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pas mdun na 'don/ tshangs chen te bsam gto dang po'o/ /de'i steng du 'od kyi rgya chung bsan 'od chung / 'od kyi rgya che bas tshad med 'od/ 'od shin tu che bas 'od gsal lo/ /de yang bsam gtan dang po na yang 'od yod mod kyang / lus 'od kyi rang bzhin yin la/ gnyis pa 409

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (()yan chad du ni lus nor bu'i 'od bzhin phyi nang gnyis kur 'od kyi rang bzhin du gnas la/ de dag gi dang por 'dug pas bsam gtan gnyis pa la 'od kyi ming gis btags so/ /de'i steng du ni yid kyi sa pa'i bde ba chung ngu dang ldan pas na dge chung / bde ba tshad med pas tshad med dge bde bas rgyud gang zhing rgyas pas dge rgyas te bsam gtan gsum pa'o/ /de'i steng du 'og gzhi sprin dang 'dra ba'i gzhi rten 'dab chags su med pas sprin med do/ /tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa'i bsod nams 'di bas lhag par cher skyes pas bsod nams skyes/ so skye'i gnas gzhan la brten pa rnams kyi nang nas 'bras bu che'o/ /'di dang 'du shes med pa'i lha rnams ni grong dang dgon pa'i tshul du gnas so ces kyang ngo / /bsam gtan gyi spel sgom chung ngu las byung ba mi che ba sems la 'gyod pa med pas mi gdung ba/ yon tan rgya che zhing mchog tu gyur pas gya nom snang ngo / /lta ba'am mthong ba rnam par dag pas shin tu mthong / gnasagazhan dang 'brel ba gang gi'ang 'og tu ma gyur pas na 'og min te/ de ltar na bsam gtan bzhi pa la gnas brgyad yod pa'i/ gong ma lnga la gnas gtsang ma zhes bya la/ de dag ni gzugs kyi khams te 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi gzugs shin tu bzang ba dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams kyi rgya'i tshad ni 'thab bral sogs bzhi ri rab kyi rtse mo dang mnyam mo zhes dang / kha cig gnyis 'gyur gyis gong ma che'o/ /zhes smra'o/ /bsam gtan dang po gling bzhi'i tshad tsam/ gnyis pa stong spyi phud tsam/ gsum pa stong gnyis pa'i tshad tsam/ bzhi pa stong gsum gyi tshad tsam du gsungs so/ kha cig gnas 'o/ ḍi gsum stong spyi phud tsam dang / bzhi

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcag pa bzhugs/ pa nas tshad med par snang ngo / /zhes bshad do/ /gzugs khams kyi lha rnams ni / mdzod las/ gzugs can rnams/ /kun rdzogs gos dang bcas pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pas/lus tshad rdzogs nas gos dang bcas te skye bar bshad do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched/ yod min med min skye mched rnams ni/ lam gyi gnas skabs su/ ting nge 'dzin tshul de ltar bsgoms pas/ 'bras bu'i tshe de la brten pa'i yid nye bar zhi ba thob pa rnams la de skad ces bya'o/ /sems kyi rten gzugs med kyi khams zhes brjod la / 'di la gnas gong 'og dang phan tshun med de/ gang du rnam shes 'gagasapa de nyid du thim par gnas so/ /slob dpon a bha ya ni/ dman pa la dgag sgra sbyar ba yin gyi/ gzugs gtan med pa ni ma yin te/ mdo myang 'das las/gzugs med khams kyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la me tog gi char phab cing mchod do zhes gsungs so/ /spyir snod dang bas kyi 'jig rten de dag rten cing 'brel ba'i dbang gis 'byung ba yin te/ bems po rnams ni rang rang gi nyer len gyi rgyu snga mas/ phyi ma 'bras bu'i ngo bo bskyed la/ snga ma'i lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen rnams kyis 'bras bu'i khyad par rnams 'phel bar byed pa ni phyi rten cing 'brel ba zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la sogs pa 'byon pa'i gnas 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid gzhan las ches khyad par 'phags pa yin te/ de'ang me bdun chu gcig la sogs pas gzhig par mi nus pa ni/ gling 'di nyid kyi dbus na gser gyi rang bzhin gyi gzhi la byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs nas/ rdo rje lta 411

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)bu'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed par mdzad pas/ rdo rje'i gdan mngon par grub ste/ de ni yul lam phyogs gzhan gyis 'gran bzod par mi nus par yod de/'phags pa nyan thos pa dag rdo rje rtse lnga pa gyen du bcas pa'i rwa dbus ma'i nang nas yar byang chub kyi shing skyes par bzhed/ theg pa chen po pa rnams/ rdo rje rgya gram du gnas pa'i phyogs kyi rwa dbus ma bzhi'i rtse mor thog ma nyid nas sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rten bzhis gzer btab/ lte ba nasabyang chub kyi shing skyes par bzhed cing / de'ang sangs rgyas rnams byon pa na/shing ngo bo gcig la rgyal ba rnams kyi bzhed smon ji ltar bar 'gyur te/ sangasargyas rnam gzigs kyi tshe ni/ pa ta li zhes pa'i shing dang / gtsug tor can gyi dus su shrī shi zhes bya ba dang / thams cad skyob kyi tshe a shwa ta zhes bya ba dang /log par dad sel gyi dus su u dum wa ra dang/ 'khor ba 'jig gi dus su ka pit+ta dang / gser thub kyi dus su 'dzam bu'i shing dang / 'od srung gi dus su n+ya gro ta dang / shākya thub pa'i dus su byang chub kyi shing dang / byams pa'i dus su klu shing du 'gyur bar bshad de/ 'di ni mdo bzhin du bris la/ gzhan du bstod pod du/ sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi bstod pa las ni de dag las cung zad mi 'dra bar bshad do/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i shar lho'i sa gzhi dang / phyi'i rgya mtsho nye ba na dpal gyi ri zhes bya ba/ grub pa dang rig 'dzin du mas brten pa yod do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs su po ta la zhes bya ba 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhugs pa'i gnas yod de/ de gnyis kyi bar ni gling 'di'i sa gzhi la brten pa'i mtsho'i cha shas kyis 4 1sdu yod do/ /nub byang gi mtshams su

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstar pa 'i rgya mtshor 'a sun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 'phags pa'i gnas sham+bha la zhes bya ba rigs ldan gyi tshogs kyis brten pa yod/ byang shar gyi mtshams na ri bo rtse lnga zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bzhugs gnas rnams yod do/ /de gnyis kyi bar mtshams gangs ri chen po'i phreng bas kun nas 'brel ba'o//gzhan yang bya rkang can dang / 'beg byed dang /gangs ri dang / ma la ya tsan dan gyi tshal dag gnas so/ /u ṭi ya na dang / tsa ri tra la sogs pa yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa mang du yod do/ /mdzod las/'di nas byang du ri nag po/ /dgu 'das gangs ri'o de nas ni/ /ces pa gling 'di'i 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid na/ ri nag po gsum yod do/ /yang gsum/yang gsum ste dgu 'das pa na gangs ri yod do/ /mdzod las/ sposang da ldan pa'i tshu rol na/ /chu zhed lnga bcu ldan pa'i mtsho/ /zhes pas/ gangs ri de'i pha rol/ sposang da ldan pa'i tshu rol na/ ma dros pa'i mtsho zhes bya ba/ chu bo gaṅgā shar/ si lho/ si tā byang /pak+ṣu nub ste chu bo bzhi 'babs pa yod do/ /mtsho de'i zhed dang chur yang dpag tshad lnga bcu lnga bcu ste/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba/ de'i nang du 'bras bu mngar po yod pa'i shing ljon pa/ 'dzam bu zhuk+ṣa zhes mngon par grub ste/ de'i phyir na gling 'di la 'dzam bu'i gling zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang gling 'dir grong khyer chen po bcu drug yod de/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ tho dkar dang / rgya yal dang/ gyad kyi yul dang / hi ma dang / pu nan ti dang / nam po dza dang / sbal kha dang / gnam gdong dang / hu na dang / phyi phyogs gdong dang / dgus te 'gro dang / gzhog thog dang /gcer bu dang / sbas sna dang /rdo 'jog dang / go bkra ste'o zhes gsungs so/ /413

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa sbya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/ (zhu)dbus kyi char ni/ grong khyer chen po drug gis kyang brgyan te/ mnyam ko dang /tsam pa ka dang / mnyan yod dang / ser skya dang / rgyal po'i khab dang / wā rā ṇa sri'o/ /de ltar khyad par du mas khyad par du byas pa'i gling ste/ rgya mtshos bcad cing skam sar gnas pa ni gling ngo / /yang chos kyi 'khor lo gsungs pa'i grong khyer drug ste/ mnyan yod gnas bcas tsam pa ka /wā rā ṇa sī yangs pa can/ /rgyal po'i khab ste drug po ste/ /'di rnams grong khyer chen po yin/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /gnyis pa zhu byed kyis bsdus pa bcud kyi sems can rnams kyi chags tshul bstan pa la spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ji ltar chags pa'i tshul dang / de dag gi lus tshad la sogs pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'od gsal ba'i lha nas tshe dang las dang bsod nams zad nas shi 'phos pa bsam gtan dang po'i gzhal yas khang stong par skye ba'o/ /de gcig bur gyur pas skyo ste bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa gzhan dag kyang 'dir skye bar gyur cig ces smon lam 'debs so/ /de'i smon lam lasaskyes pa ma yin yang bya rog dang ta la'i tshul du bsam gtan gnyis pa'i lha tshe dang las dang bsod nams zad pa shi nas der skye'o/ /de'i phyir dang por skyesapa ni/ lus che ba dang 'byin pa por sems pa'i phyir sems dpa' chen po dang /mes po dang / gtso bo zhes bya ba yin no/ /mu stegs pa dag gis ni gser gyi pad ma'i snying po las skyes pa'i phyir gser gyi snying po can dang / pad ma'i skyesaganas pa zhes kyang bsgrags so/ /nyis skyes pa de dag gi ni lus chung ba dang /de'i bsod nams las skyes par 4 zlo'i phyir 'khor yin no/ /de bzhin du

dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ rim gyis tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang / tshangs ris dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed la sogs pa 'dod pa'i lha rnams rim gyis chags shing / de'i rjesal rim pa ltar byang dang / nub dang / lho'i gling gi mi rnams skye la/ de nas gling gsum du mi dge ba chung ngu dang 'bring dang cher spyad pa/ rim pa ltar yi dwagasadang / dud 'gro dang / dmyal ba rnams su skyes te/ gang gi tshe mnar med du sems can gsar du skyes pa de'i tshe 'chags pa rdzogs pa yin no/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa dang gsum pa sogs 'chags na'ang tshul de dag yin no/ /gnyis pa de dag gi lus tshad la sogs pa bshad pa la/ ngan song gsum gyi lus tshad ni mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa'i phyir mdzod du ma bstan la/ sa'i dngosagazhi las kyang ngan song gsum mi dge ba che chung gis lus che chung du gyur pa tsam ma gtogs gsal bar ma gsungs so/ /mi rnams las 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams kyi lus tshad ni che ba rnams khru bzhi pa dang / chung ba rnams phyed bzhi pa ste/khru ni 'og nas 'chad pa'i phra rab rdul la sogs pa bsags pa'i tshad dang ldan pa yin gyi rang rang gi khru ni ma yin no/ /sa'i dngos gzhi las ni/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams kyi lus kyi tshad ni nges pa med de/ res 'ga' ni chen por 'gyur ro/ /res 'ga' ni chung ngur 'gyur te/ de yang rang rang gi khru tshad phyed dang bzhi'o/ /zhes bshad do/ shar lus 'phags po dang / nub ba longs spyod dang / byang sgra mi snyan pa zhes bya ba rnams rim pa ltar snga ma snga ma nyis 'gyur gyis bskyed pa khru brgyad dang / bcu drag dang / sum cu rtsa gnyis can/ de dag kyang 'dzam bu gling pa'i khru'i dbang se byas kyi/ sa'i dngos gzhi las/ shar gyi 4/5

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)lus 'phags po rnams kyi lus tshad ni nges pa yin te/ de dag kyang rang gi khru tshad phyed dang bzhi pa ste lus shin tu che ba'o/ shar gyi lus 'phags po ji lta ba bzhin du nub kyi ba longs spyod pa rnams dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams kyang lus shin tu che'o/ /zhes rang rang gi khru bzhi pa'am phyed dang bzhi pa kho nar bshad la/ gling phran gyi mi rnams ni gtso bo'i gling gi mi'i lus kyi phyed phyed dang ldan no zhes grags so/ /slob dpon gang ba spel gyis kyang / bar gyi gling brgyad po de dag thams cad ni lasang na pa'i dbang gis grub pa zhig ste/ de'i phyir na de na gnas pa'i mi rnams ni lus chung ba yin no/ /zhes bshad do/ /'dod pa dang ldan pa'i lha drug po'i lus tshad ni/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa rgyang grags bzhi cha yin pa nas/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rgyang grags dag phyed dang gnyis kyi bar du 'og ma las gong ma rgyang grags bzhi cha res bskyed pa'o/ /sa'i dngos gzhi las ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams kyi tshad ni rgyang grags kyi bzhi cha gcig pas lhag go /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi tshad ni rgyang grags phyed do / / de yan chad ni bzhi cha re lhag par blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa dang / lha ma yin gyi lus ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i tshad bzhin du rnam par bzhag par rigs par bya'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /gzugs can gyi lha rnams kyi dang po tshangasaris pa'i lus tshad/ dpag tshad phyed pa dang / tshangs ris pa de'i gong ma tshangasapa mdun na 'don pa dang / tshangs pa chen po dang / 'od chung ba rnams kyi lus ni rim par ltar dpag tshad phyed phyed kyis bskyed pa/ dpag tshad gcig dang /phyed dang gnyis dang / gnyis yin rdo/16/tshad med 'od yan chad ni lus nyis

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'a sun pa'i gru chen kha stong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 'gyur kyis che ste/ 'on kyang sprin med pa dpag tshad gsum dor ba ni khyad par yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar/ tshad med 'od dpag tshad bzhi/ 'od gsal ba brgyad dang /dge chung ba bcu drug dang / tshad med dge ba sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /dge rgyas pa drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / sprin med pa dpag tshad brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad las gsum dor ba'i brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / bsod nams skyes pa phyed dang sum brgya dang / 'bras bu che ba lnga brgya dang / mi che ba stong dang / mi gdung ba nyisastong dang / gya nom snang ba bzhi stong dang / shin tu mthong ba brgyad stong dang /'og min pa khri drug stong ngo / /gzugs med na ni lus med pas lus kyi tshad med la/ de na sprul pa'i gzugs yod par 'dod pa ltar na'ang tshad nges pa med do / / tshe'i tshad bstan pa ni/ byang gi sgra mi snyan na ni tshe lo stong thub ste nub dang shar gyi gling gnyis na ni rim pa bzhin snga ma snga ma'i phyed spangs pas lnga brgya dang phyed dang sum brgya/ 'dzam bu gling 'di na tshe'i tshad ma nges te/ tha ma thung ngur gyur pa na ni tshe'i tshad lo bcu pa dang / dang po ni tshe dpag tu med pa dang / de dag gi bar du'ang 'phel 'grib du ma yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod pa'i lha rnams kyi tshe tshad ni/ mi rnams lo lnga bcu la 'dod pa dag gi lha rnams las thams cad kyi 'og ma rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha dag gi nyin zhag gcig tu brtsis pas zhag sum cu la zla ba gcig dang / zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig yin pa des na tshe'i tshad rang gi lo lnga brgya'o/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi gong ma sum cu rtsa gsum pa la sogs ni zhag dang lo gnyis ka nyis 'gyur te/ snga ma'i bzhi 'gyur phyi ma'i tshe tshad yin pas 'di ltar sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams ni mi'i lo brgya la zhag 417

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo stong thub pa nas/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i mi'i lo stong drug brgya la zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo khri drug stong thub pa'i bar du'o/ /de dag la mi'i lo ni rim pa ltar/ dang po la sa ya phrag dgu dang /gnyis pa la sa ya phrag sum cu rtsa drug dang / gsum pa la dung phyur gcig dang bye ba bzhi dang sa ya bzhi dang / bzhi pa la dung phyur lnga dang bye ba bdun dang sa ya drug dang / lnga pa la ther 'bum gnyis dang / dung phyur gsum dang / sa ya bzhi dang /drug pa la ther 'bum dgu/dung phyur gnyis/bye ba gcig sa ya drug go/gal te sum cu rtsa gsum yan chad na nyi zla med pas nyin mtshan med pa'i phyir/zhag la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag dang snang ba'i bya ba yod par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhe na / de dag na nyi zla med kyang me tog kha bye ba dang / zum pa dang / bya skad 'byin pa dang / mi 'byin pa dang/ gnyid sangs pa dang/ bro ba na rim pa ltar nyin mo dang mtshan mo yin la/ snang ba'i bya ba ni rang gi lus la 'od yod pas byed pas 'gal ba med do/ /lha ma yin gyi tshe tshad ni/ sa'i dngos gzhi las/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang 'dra'o zhes bshad la/ dran pa nyer bzhag las ni mi'i lo lnga brgya dang drug brgya dang bdun brgya la rang rang gi nyin zhag rer byas pa'i/rang lo lnga stong dang / drug stong dang / bdun stong rim pa ltar/ sgra gcan dang mgul phreng bstan pa gnyis dang / me tog phreng gis thub par gsungs shing /thag zangs ris kyi tshe tshad ni ma gsungs so/ /gzugs can rnams la ni nyin mtshan med de/ nyin mtshan gyi rnam par 'jog byed med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzugasacan de dag gi tshe tshad ni rang gi lus gī rdod gzhal ba'i dpag tshad kyi grangs kyi

dam pa'i cho kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhug /tshad kyi bskal pa 'jal ba yin te/ 'di ltar gzugs can dang po bskal pa phyed/ /de yi gong ma phyed phyed bskyed/ /'od chung rnams kyi ltag yan chad/ /tshe ni nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur te/ sprin med bskal pa gsum dor ro/ /zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /rgyal ba'i yum la sogs pa mdo kha cig las ni/ gya nom snang dang shin tu mthong go rim bsgor nas/ gya nom snang gi rjes la 'og min bshad cing /slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdo drangs pa las kyang / shin tu mthong dang gya nom snang gi tshe tshad rim pa ltar/ bskal pa bzhi stong dang brgyad stong du bshad do/ /gzugs med bzhi po rnams ni rim pa ltar stong nyi shu dang / bzhi bcu dang /drug cu dang / brgyad cu thub pa na/ de rnams bskal pa stong phrag nyi shu nyi shu lhag pa yin no/ /'o na de dag thams cad bar bskal lam bskal chen yin zhe na/'od chung nas bzung nas bskal pa chen po yin te/ 'od chung de'i 'og ma tshangs chen man chad ni bskal pa chen po'i phyed bar bskal bzhi bcu la bskal par btags pa yin no/ /de ltar ma yin na tshangs chen pa ma shi bar snod 'jig pa'i me 'bar bar 'gyur ba dang / stongs nas kyang yod par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na tshangs ris pa bar bskal nyi shu dang / tshangs pa mdun na 'don bar bskal drug cur bar bskal gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ snod 'jig 'chags la bar bskal re re yod la/ snod 'chags pa ma rdzogs pa'i tshe tshangs pa ma skyesashing / snod 'jig pa'i gong du tshangs pa shi ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang bskal pa zhe gsum thub par bshad pa ni de dang nye ba'i phyir ro/ /des na tshangs chen dang 'od chung gi tshe tshad kyi bar na bar bskal brgyad yod do/ /sa'i dngos gzhi las419

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)ni / bar bskal nyi shu dang bzhi bcu dang / drug cu la bskal pa re re'i tha snyad du mdzad nas tshangs ris pa la sogs pa gsum gyi tshe tshad bskal pa re rer bshad do / / ngan song gi tshe'i tshad las yang sos la sogs pa tsha ba'i dmyal ba drug gi tshe tshad ni/ rim pa bzhin du 'dod lha rgyal chen ris bzhi la sogs pa drug po'i tshe tshad ji tsam bshad pa dang / yang sos pa la sogs pa drug gi nyin zhag mnyam par shes par byas te/ dang po drug snga ma'i brgyad 'gyur phyi ma'i tshe tshad yin pas 'di ltar rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i tshe tshad rang lo lnga brgya la yang sos pa'i nyin zhag gcig tu brtsis pa la sogs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i zhag sum cu la zla ba dang / zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig yin pa des na/ yang sos la sogs pa de dag rnams kyi tshe ra ni/ rang gi lo lnga brgya dang / stong dang / nyis stong dang /bzhi stong dang / brgyad stong dang / khri drug stong thub par 'dod pa'i lha drug po rnams dang lo'i grangs 'dra ba yin no/ /zhes shes par bya yi/ 'dir yang sosakyi nyin zhag gcig la mi lo sa ya phrag dgu dang / rang lo lnga brgya la mi lo phrag khrig bcu drug dang ther 'bum chen po gnyis yod pa nas/ tsha ba'i rang lo khri drug stong la mi lo gtam chen po lnga/ rab bkram brgyad/ rab bkram chen po brgyad phrag khrig dgu/ ther 'bum chen po gnyis yod pa'i bar du sbyar ro/ /rab tu tsha ba'i dmyal bas ni bar bskal phyed thub bo/ /mnar med pas ni bar gyi bskal pa gcig thub bo/ /dud 'gro rnams kyi tshe thung ba la nges pa med pasatshe mchog tu ring ba ni bar gyi bskal pa gcig thub ste/ lung las dge slong dag klu brgyad po 'di dag ni klu chen po ste 41/la par gnas pa sa 'dzin pa/ bya'i

dam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen 'a skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ rgyal po nam mkha' lding gis 'byin pa mi nus pa/ lha dang/ lha ma yin gyi yul yang / nyams su myong zhing so sor nyams su myong ba yin no/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dang / rta mgo dang /btang bzung dang / yid las byung dang / yul 'khor srung dang / nag po chen po dang / e la'i 'dabs so/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ khren tu thung ba ni/ yud tsam de'i tshe tshad dang bcas pa dag kyang yod do/ /yi dwags rnams ni mi'i zla stod la nyi mo dang / zla smad la mtshan mor byas nas/ mi rnams kyi zla ba gcig la yi dwags kyi nyin zhag gcig gi grangs su brtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub pa yin la/ bshes spring las/ bar chad med par sdug bsngal rten gyur pa/ /nyesapar spyad pa las kyi zhags pa yis//dra bas bcings pa'i lus can kha cig go/lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chi mi 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ba ni mi'i lo'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa las ni/ mi'i lo bcu la yi dwags kyi nyin zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgyar thub par gsungs te/ de yi ltar na rang lo lnga brgya la mi'i lo sa ya phrag gcig dang dgu 'bum du 'gyur ro / / sa'i dngos gzhi las ni/ dud 'gro dang yi dwags kyi tshe'i tshad ni nges pa med do zhes pa dang / de bzhin du nye 'khor gyi sems can dmyal ba dang / nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal bar skyes pa'i sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi tshe'i tshad ni nges pa med do zhes bshad do/ /grang dmyal gyi tshe'i tshad ni til sbyang ba ma ga dha'i bre'i til khal brgyad cus gang ba'i nang nas/ 'ga' zhig gis lo brgya brgya zhing til gcig ste re re phyung bas til de dag zad par gyur pa ni chu bur 421

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)can gyi tshe'i tshad yin te/ chu bur rdol ba can la sogs pa gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shus bsgyur ba'i 'gyur gyis phyi ma phyi ma ring ngo / /sa'i dngos gzhi las ni/ grang ba'i semasa'i can dmyal bar skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi che'i tshad ni/ sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes pa'i sems can rnams las phyi ma phyi ma phyed phyed gzhug par rig par bya'o/ /zhes byung ste/ de'i don kha cig tsha dmyal rnams kyi phyed phyed thung bar 'chad mod kyi/ tshe'i mtha'i mdo ltar na tsha dmyal drug bas grang dmyal dang po drug po ring bar mngon no/ /ci sngar smos pa'i sems can de dag bar ma dor mi 'chi bar tshe tshad ltar nges pa kho na yin nam zhe na/ sgra mi snyan pa dag ni stong du nges te/ bar ma dor 'chi ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /sgra mi snyan pa ma gtogs pa rnams la bar ma dor 'chi ba yod pa'i phyir nges pa ni ma yin gyi spyi'i tshe tshad smos pa yin no/ /'di rnams ni mdzod las gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin bris pa yin la 'dir ma smos pa gdags pa las byung ba'i don sdom du bsdus pa ni/bkres sgom gling bzhi 'dod lha na//gong ma na med gling gsum na//'bras chan zan phye sha 'khur ba'i/ /zas za sgra mi snyan pa rnams/ /ma smos 'bras kyi 'bru dag za/ /'dod lha dri dang bdud rtsi'o/ /gong na kham zas rnam par spang / /gshang gci gling bzhi dag na yod/ /yan chad na med char pa dag /'bab nyes pa dang legs pa dang / /lo nyes lo legs mu ge dag /gling gsum na yod sgra mi snyan/ /'dod lha yan chad de dag med/ /'jigs dang yid bde re 'jog ni//gling gsum dag dang 'dod lha la//sgra mi snyan dang gong na med//nor 'bru gser dngul nyo ba dag //dri 2gsum na yod sgra mi snyan/ /lha rnams

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jun pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ kun la yod ma yin/ /bzhin mdog dkar nag sngo bsangs dang / /skya snar gling gsum 'dod lha rnams/ /sngo ser dkar dmar sgra mi snyan/ /tshangs ris yan chad dkar po gnas/ /tshad du byas dang ma byas pa'i/ khang pa gling gsum 'dod lha na/ /sgra mi snyan dang gzugs khams pa/ /ched du byas pa ma yin nges/ /bal gos ras dang dar zab sogs/ /gling gsum na yod sgra mi snyan/ /'dod lha drug po srang phyed nas/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi cha yi bar/ /chas kyang sngo ser dkar dmar dang / /dpag bsam shing las 'byung bar bshad/ /gzugs khams gos dang bcas par skye/ /rang lus tshad las nyis 'gyur gyi/ /lhag pa'i gos dag gon par bshad//bag ma len dang gtong ba ni/ /gling gsum 'dod lha rnams la yod/ /sgra mi snyan dang gong na med/ /lus la tsha dang grang ba ni/ /gling gsum dag na sgra mi snyan/ /lha rnams rnam par spangs pa yin/ /dgun dpyid dbyar dang ston rnams ni/ /gling bzhi 'dod lha rnams na yod/ /gong ma na med nyin mtshan dang / /pha ma rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /rje bran gling gsum 'dod lha na/ /sgra mi snyan dang gong na med/ /nor dang 'bru yod gling gsum na'o/ /'bru yod nor med sgra mi snyan/ /nor yod 'bru med 'dod lha rnams/ /gnyis ka med pa gong ma yin/ /pha ma nas ni 'bru yi bar/ /kun la zhen pa gling gsum na/ /'bru ma gtogs la zhen pa ni/ /'dod lha sgra mi snyan dang ni/ /gong ma'i lha rnams zhen pa med/ /zla mtshan sbrum ma bu btsa' ba/ /gling bzhi na yod lha rnams ni/ /brdzus skyes khu ba 'byung ba yang / /mi rnams 'dod lha rlung dag rgyu/ /tshe dang lusadang 'khrig pa spyad/ /rtsa bar bshad phyir 'dir ma bris/ /mtho ris kyi ni longs423

brtse chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (zhu)spyod dag /lung bzhin du ni bsdebs pa yin/ /zhes shes par bya'o/ /snod ba rma kyi 'jig rten mngon par 'grub ba'i rgyu 'byung ba chen po bzhi'o/ /de'ang yod cing 'byung bsan 'byung ba'o/ /sa ni sra ba'o/ /chu ni gsher ba'o/ /me ni dro ba'o/ /rlung ni g.yo ba'o/ /'byung ba de dag gi shin tu phra ba'i mthar thug pa ni phra rab kyi rdul te gzhig tu med pa nyid do/ /de bdun ni rdul phran no/ /de bdun ni chu rdul lo/ /de bdun ni ri bong gi rdul lo/ /de bdun ni lug rdul lo/ /de bdun ni glang rdul lo/ /de bdun ni sro mo'o/ /de bdun ni shig gi tshad do/ /de bdun ni nas kyi tshad do/ /de dag 'dus pa las snod kyi 'jig rten dang lus grub bo/ /nas bdun ni sor gcig go /sor mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni khru gang ngo / khru bzhi ni 'dom gang ngo / /'dom lnga brgya la ni rgyang grags gcig go /rgyang grags brgyad la ni dpag tshad gcig go /'dis 'jig rten dang lus kyi tshad rnam par gzhal lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams grub pa'i rkyen ni/ der skye bar gyur pa'i sems can rnams kyi las mthun par bsags pa'i dbang gis so/ /gnyis pa mi'i 'gro ba ji ltar byung ba dang / mang pos bkur ba nas brtsams te 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal rabs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin rgyun ldan du breng chags shing /shākya'i rigs brgyud rgya bod rnams su legs par gyur pa/ gdung rabs kyi phreng ba zam ma chad par byung ba'i tshul brjod par bya'o/ /de'ang dang po ni/ khamasagong ma'i lha rnams 'dod khams su skye ba na/ rim bzhin bsam gtan gyi sems 'gags/ 'dod khams su skye ba'i bag chags kyi shas kyis 'dod khams kyi lha dang / lha ma yin dang mi //sa su 'gyur zhing / zhing khams gzhan

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i sru chen kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/nas 'dir skye ba'i bsam pa rnams kyang rim gyis byung ste/ rigs drug gi 'gro ba rnams su 'gyur zhing/ de dag gi skye gnas ni bzhi ste brdzus skyes mngal skyes/sgong skyes/drod gsher skyes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lung dang / mngon 'byung lasagasungs pa dang / mngon pa mdzod las gsungs pa dang / sa sde las 'phagasapa thogs med kyis gsungs pa dang / 'jig rten bzhag pa la sogs pa'i mdo rnams las shin tu rgyas par 'byung zhing bshad pa'i rnam grangs phran tshegs la mi 'dra ba bag re tsam 'byung yang / bshad pa'i babs mi mthun pa cher mi 'byung ngo / / 'dir snga ma ltar na/ mi rnams ni 'od gsal gyi lha las 'phos te skyesaso / / de dag kyang rang 'od kyis 'tsho zhing nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa 'od gsal gyi lha ci 'dra ba bzhin 'byung ste/ mdzod las/ sngar byung sems can gzugs can bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de rnams kyi ming ni sems can zhes grags pa tsam mo/ /de'i tshe sa'i gan ces bya ba mdog mar zhun lta bu/ ro gzhi sbrang rtsi ma bskol ba ltar shin tu zhim pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab cing /rang 'od ma gtogs pa nyi zla gza' skar dang / dus tshigs dang / skyes pa dang /bud med ni mi grag go /de'i dus sems can skam chags can zhig gis/bcud de sor mos blangs shing myangs pa na de la sred pas rim gyis khams kyi zas za'o/ /de sems can gzhan rnams kyis mthong nas myang bar byed do/ /de nas rim gyis ro la chags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /sa'i bcud de zos pa na lusagrang ba dang lci ba zhugs te/ kha dog bzang po dang 'od kyang mi snang ngo / /de'i tshe chos nyid kyis nam mkha' la nyi zla dang gza' skar dag byung zhing / skad cig425

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung gce0bsdus/ (4)thang cig yud tsam/ dus tshigs/ nyin mtshan/ zla phyed/ zla ba/ lo rnamasa'ajig rten du 'byung bar gyur to/ /de nas sems can rnams kyis sa'i bcud de za zhing tshe ring la yun ring bar gnas so/ /de rnams las kha zas cher zos pa ni mdog ngan la/ chung ngur zos pa ni mdog bzang ngo / /de dag mngon pa'i nga rgyal skyes te gcig gis gcig la kha dog bzang ngan gyis khyad du gsod do/ /'di tsam nas dang por nga rgyal byung / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos nyid blangs pa'i rgyu des sa'i bcud de yal lo/ /de nas sems can rnams kyi tshogs na ro bro ba ro bro ba zhes smras mod kyi 'on kyang gti mug pas don ni mi shes so/ /slar yang sa zhag dang ro phun sum tshogs pa/ dong kha'i me tog dang 'dra zhing sbrang rtsi btsir ba lta bu byung / de nyid za'o/ /des 'tsho ste tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas la/ kha zas mang khung du zos pas mdog bzang ngan la phan tshun khad du gsod do/ /de'i mthus sa zhag ni med de myu gu'i tshal zhes bya ba/ kha dog shing kha dam pa'i me tog lta bu la/ ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa skyes so/ /de za zhing tshe ni yun ring por gnas so/ /slar yang mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang sdig pa spyad pa'i dbang gisamyu gu ni med la/gcig gis gcig la mdun nas phar song phar song zhes smra'o//de'i tshe ma smos pa btab pa'i 'bras su lu shun pa dang phub ma med pa'i gtsang ma dag skyes te/ kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang /dri phun sum tshogs pa dang / ro phun sum tsho gos pa/ gzeg ma med cing dag la gtsang ba/ sor bzhi'i tshad tsam/yongs su g.yogs pa med pa/ de nangs brngas na nangs skye zhing / ji tsam brngasakyang rjes mi mngon no/ /sems can 4 2 6 de dag za zhing yun ring du gnas so/

dmas 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru za kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs/ khams kyi zas de khad kyis zos pas/ nyon mongs pa'i las sad pa'i dbang gis dbang po tha dad par gyur te/ pho mo zhes pa'i tha snyad du byung ngo / /de dag gcig la gcig phan chun mig tshugs su bltas pas chags par gyur zhing sred pa la brten nas log par zhugs so/ /'di ni 'dod chags mngon du gyur pa'i thog ma'o/ /de gzhan dag gis mthong nas/ kwa ye sems can ngan pa bya ba ma yin pa byed pa 'di lta bu zhes/ sa dang gseg ma dag 'thor bar byed pas zhag gcig nas bsnyen gyi bar du yang spong bar byed la/ sdig pa can log pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa de rnams kyis khang pa brtsigs nas 'dir bya ba ma yin pa spyod do/ /zhes zer bas gnas de la khyim khyim zhes grags te/ 'jig rten 'dir tha mal pa'i khang pa rtsom pa'i dang po yin no/ /de nas sems can snyoms las can zhig gis su lu yang do nub tu blangs so/ /de nas sa gzhan zhig gis salu len du 'dong ngo zhes brjod pas/ kye sems can khyod rang gis swā lu longs shig kho bos ni mdang du blangs zin to/ /zhes smras pa na/ de 'thad par shesanas gzhan rnams kyis kyang zhag gnyis dang bdun gyi bar gyi su lu blangs so/ /yang gzhan dag gis kyang kye 'di ni chogs kyis bdag gis kyang zla ba phyed dang gcig gi su lu blang ngo snyam nas blangs pas 'bru'i sog 'jog gis yongs su longs spyad pas swā lu rjen pa rnams shun pa dang phub mas g.yogs/ brngas pa dag kyang slar skye bar ma 'dod do/ /de nas sems can rnams phan tshun du 'tshogs te/ sngar gyi sa zhag byung ba man gyi sa zhag dag sgrogs shing / su lu yang skye bar ma gyur pas/ zhing dag brko bar bya'o zhes te/ bar mtshams bcad 427

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chog 'byung gces bsdus/ (4)nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi'o/ /'di ni nga'i 'o zhes bdag tu bzung ste sa'i khyon dag bgos te 'di ni zhing bdag tu 'dzin pa dang mu tshigs bre ba'i las kyi mtha' rtsom pa'i dang po'o/ /de nas sems can zhig gis rang gi su lu yod bzhin gzhan gyi swā lu ma byin par blangs so/ /bdag po des mthong nas deng khyod rang gi yod bzhin gzhan gyi su lu rku bar byed pa mi rigs so zhes smras te/ phar drangs tshur drangs te 'khor mang po'i dbus su khrid de/ kye shes ldan dga'adis nga'i swā lu nu bar byas so zhes spyos so/ /thams cad kyis kyang / sems can ngan pa khyed da phyin chad 'di ltar ma byed ces so/ /de na re khyod kyis bdag su lu'i phyir phar drangs nas 'khor mang po'i dbus su spyos so zhes rtsod cing /de nas thams cad tshogs shing / 'di ltar du spyo bar yang snang bas bdag cag gi nang nas sems can gzugs bzang zhing lta na sdug pa/ lhag par bsod nams che bar grags pa zhig bdag cag gi zhing pa rnams kha kyi bdag por bskos dang / des nyes pa byas pa dag la ni chad pas gcod la/ legs par byas pa rnams la phan gdags par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bgros nas zhing dag las thob shas sbyin par bya'o snyam nas bgros par byas so/ /bsod nams dang ldan pa de lta bu zhig skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bkur te/ chos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas thob shas kyis mchod cing bkur nas/ de la mang pos bkur bas mang pos bkur ba zhes bya ba de ni thub pa'i dbang po nyid yin par bshad do/ /de dag kyang mdzod las/ le los sog 'jog byas nas ni/ /'dzin can rnamasakyis zhing dpon bstabs/ /zhes dang /4༷da thams cad kyi bdag por gyur nas

dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru chen kha sgong dang bcas pa bzhugs/mnyam pa las skyong bar byed pa rgyal rigs dang / chos kyis skye rgu skyong zhing tshul khrims dang shes rab nyams su blangs te/ gnas pa la rgyal po rgyal po zhes smras so / / de'i ring la mi rnams kyi ming la sems can sems can zhes bya'o/ /dusaskabs 'di tsam nas mi rigs bzhi'am lngar gyur pa yin te/ de bzhin skye rgu thams cad bskyangs pa las/ /zhes sogs dang / sngon ni 'di dag thams cad kyang / /zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar/ 'thab rtsod kyis 'jigs/ 'bag gtsog gis skyo zhing / sgo gsum gyi spyod pa zhi ba dang / dul ba/ gtso bor bsgrub pa la dga' bas nags 'dabs dang / bas mtha'i dben pa brten cing gtsang sbra la gnas pa thams cad ni bram ze'i rigs su gyur/ sems can mang po zhing lasadang nor gyi 'tsho/ phyis rgya chen po la brtson/ ngo tsha dang khrel 'dzem ni che/ rang la ji ltar 'byor pa dang bstun te sbyin la dga' zhing gnyen 'dun dang nye ring mang po'i 'tsho thabs la mkhas pa rnams la ni rje rigs zhes zer/ yang semasacan mang po ngo tsha dang khrel 'dzem ni chung / gzu lum dang rang gzor spyod cing 'dzem bag dang bral bas cung 'tshol bar spyod cing / rigs gong ma la brten te 'tsho ba rnams la ni rmangs rigs zhes zer/ de la sems can mang po shin tu rmongs pas mi dge ba mtha' dag la 'chol bar spyod/ khrel dang bag yod ngo tsha ni gtan mi shes/ 'jig rten du smod pa'i bya ba dang las la bab chol du spyod cing / dam pa'i spyod pa dang shin tu 'gal ba rnams la rigasang na nam/ gdol pa'i rigs zer te/ bya ba'i khyad par de dag gis rigs bzhi'am lngar gyur te/chos mngon pa las/ chos dang spyod tshul bzang po kun tu spyod pas 'bor skyong 429

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (zhu)zhing rangs par byed pas na rgyal po'o/ /zhing rnams kyi bdag por gyur pas na rgyal rigs phyi rol tu sems shing gtsang sbra la spyod pas na bram ze'i rigs/ bya ba dang nyon mongs sna tshogs can gyi las byed pas na rje'u'i rigs/ ngan las dang gnod pa'i las byed pas na dmangs rigs/ ha cang nor la bskam zhing mi phyugs gsod pa/ mi rnams kyis gtum po zhes smod pa'i las can la ni gdol pa zhes bya'o/ /yang phyi rol pa dag ni/ der ni gser gyi sgo ngar gyur/ /de la tshangs pa skyes pa yin/ /zhes pas tshangs pa la ni 'jig rten mes po dang byed po zhes grags pa ltar te/ de yang sngon tshangs pa yid kyi sgo nga zhes bya ba gser btso ma'i kha dog lta bu zhig pad+mo mdzes pa'i nang nas byung ste/ de drod kyis smin par byas pa las/ skyes bu gdong bzhi pa/ ral pas khebs pa cig byung ste de'i ral pa che bas gdong bzhi las gling bzhi bskyed nas longs spyod dang bcas pa byung ba na/ de rnams la longs spyod pa po dgos par shes nas tshangs pa'i snying la bram ze dang / dpung pa la rgyal rigs/ brla la rje rigs/ rkang mthil la dmangs rigs te rigs bzhi bskyed nas longs spyod du bcug go /yang de rnams la phan pa'i rig pa zhig kyang slob par 'dod nas/ snyan ngag gi rig byed/ nges brjod kyi rig byed/ mchod sbyin gyi rig byed/ srid srung gi rig byed do / / rig byed chen po bzhi ni zhal bzhi po nas gsungs te/ tshangs pas tshe yi rig byed dran/ /de yis skye rgu'i mgon la bshad/ /ces zer ro/ /de ltar mi rigs bzhir gyes tshul dang / sngon rabs pa dag 'jig rten 'di'i bdag po tshangs pa yin par 'dod/ khyad par 4// byed gtsor byed pas/ /tshangs dang

ngam pa 'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'dun pa 'i gru chen kha sbong dang bcas pa bzhugs/rig byed pa ru grags/ /zhes te tshangs pa'i mthus 'jig rten dang gling bzhi/ mi rigs bzhi dang bcas pa chags par 'dod do/ /mang pos bkur ba'i sras 'od mdzes nas brtsams te rgya gar dang bod du byon pa la sogs pa'i rgyal rabs kyi 'phreng ba rnams ni rags pa tsam sngar yang bshad cing / zhib par rgyal rabs kyi yi ge rnams su blta'o/ /ji skad bshad pa'i sdod bcud de dag 'chags pa chags nas 'jigs pa/ mthar zhig nas stong par gnas pa rnams bar bskal nyi shu nyi shu re yod cing bsdoms pas bar bskal brgyad cu la bskal chen gcig ces bya'o/ /de lta'i bskal pa'i 'phreng ba rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ /gnyis pa bstan pa'i gnas tshad dngos la/ rnam grangs spyir bstan/gnad don ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bskal bzang / 'dul lung / mdzod 'grel sogs las bstan pa lo stong gnas par bshad/ snying rje pad dkar sogs las phyed dang nyis stong gnas par bshad/ zla ba'i snying po'i mdo sogs las nyis stong gnas par bshad/ rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel par phyed dang sum stong gnas par bshad/ dbyig gnyen gyi 'bum ṭika sogs las lnga stong gnas par bshad/ dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa las yar 'phel drag brgya pa'i bar du gnas par yang bshad/ lung rnams ni de dag nyid du blta dror bya'o/ /dris lan bsab par/ gal te de bzhin gshegs pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bud med 'jug tu gnang bar gyur na/ dam pa'i chos lnga brgyas sngar nub par 'gyur te/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ bud med rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'jug par mi dgos so/ /zhes bud med rab 431

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (4)tu byung bas lo lnga brgya 'grib par bshad do/ /blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa'i mdo'i 'grel par slad ma'i dus lnga brgya pa tha ma la/ zhes pa'i 'grel par/dper na mi'i tshe lo brgya thub pa la lo lnga ges bar du ni 'phel ba'i dus te/lus dang shes rab dang / rtsal la sogs pa 'phel zhing skye'o/ /de ltar lo lnga bcu 'das nas de'i phyi ma lnga bcu ni 'grib pa'i dus te/ lus dang / shes rab dang / rtsal la sogs pa nyams shing 'grib par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du sangasargyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'bras bu thob pa dang shin tu rgyas pa'i dus ni lo stong zhig 'dzam bu'i gling du gnas so/ /de yang phyed du bgos te lnga brgya snga ma ni 'phel ba'i dus su bzhag la/ lnga brgya phyi ma ni 'grib pa'i dus zhes bya'o/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar drug las lnga stong du gnas par bshad pa ni/ sgra ji bzhin pa'i nges don gyi tshig yin ste lnga brgya phrag bcu'i lnga brgya phrag dang po gsum la rim bzhin dgra bcom pa phyir mi 'ong rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob pa mang du 'byung bas/ 'bras bu'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum zhes bya zhing / de gsum la 'bras bu'i bstan pa gnas pa'o/ /de nas lnga brgya pa phrag gsum la rim bzhin lhag pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rnam par dag pa la gnas pa mang du 'byung bas/ sgrub pa'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum zhes bya zhing / de gsum la rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnas so/ /de nas lnga brgya pa phrag gsum la rim bzhin mngon pa'i sde snod/ mdo sde'i sde snod/ 'dul ba'i sde snod mang du 'byung bas lung gi dus kyi lnga brgya pa 4 3 2 gsum zhes bya zhing / de gsum la
